topic: Some people think that computers are more of a hindrance than help in today's society. Others believe that they are such indispensable tools that they would not be able to live or work without them.  Discuss both opinion and give your opinion.
essay:
It is widely known that computers can be found everywhere nowadays, and occasionally they are an inevitable realm. While some people regard these technologies tend to be obstacle rather than supportable devices, I would argue that they cannot be separated for our life thank to their huge function.

Following the developing era, computers technology are hardly to be isolated from our daily activities because most of people necessities can be covered by an advanced technology like computers. In supermarkets for example, computer eases tellers in accounting of purchasing or transaction, which result in decreasing number of lines. For this reason, a comfort of shoppers can always be ensured. It is thus an evident proof of why computers is a part of people life.

However, this does not mean that computers cannot be a barrier in the way people ran their life. Firstly, a habit in using computers for writing causes people be lazy in applying handwriting, so without computer people prefer for not writing instead. Furthermore, various tools equipped in computers attracts people in wasting their time. Abundant games and other application installed in computers prompts users to stay home and neglect their main responsibilities for their family and job. Not only this, computers even threat people future in acute dependence, and therefore they are less interaction each other.

To conclude, I do believe that computer's presence in our life has an immense role in spite of any drawbacks. Hence, people have to know how to use it wisely, by means that using computers appropriately is would be a better way has to be thoroughly thought.

topic: In the past, when students did a Ċ , they tended to study in their own country. Nowadays, they have more opportunity to study abroad? Ċ Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
These days, the majority of students tends to attend their higher educations in a foreign nation instead of their homeland. In my opinion , I take the view that this tendency provides plenty of valuable strengths and its advantages outweigh the disadvantages .

Attending a university degree abroad can be an unsuitable decision for several reasons. The strongest argument is that youngers will be far away from their families and friends . Despite building new relationships and meeting new colleagues , it will be impossible to find the persons who can replace parents and close friends . Moreover, they will surely feel negative emotions and miss the support and affection given by close people in their homeland , especially in the hardest moments , such as getting diseases or go into depression. In addition, If youth decide to go abroad , they will be undoubtedly under high pressure to being adapted to the new lifestyle. To put it differently, scholars should accept the new environment and the different cultures and try to find their comfort in this new life in order to be not lonely .That is why this trend may have some undesirable consequences.

However , this development can help youngers to build a brilliant career . Firstly, attending higher schooling in an advanced nation help students to boost their career because they will have more chances to get the adequate and the valuable opportunity for them .For example, the needy juniors who cannot support the expensive fees education in the university in their country can benefit from a scholarship offered by various international universities and therefore get the opportunity that they need . Secondly, this trend may contribute to the development of their personality. In other words , scholars who choose to leave their comfort zone in their country to another society , have the possibility to be more independent and assume their responsibilities alone , also meeting different mentalities and experiencing different experiences tends to improve their mental growth and communication skills .For instance , researchers show that youngers who leave early their country become more confident and extroverted than those who stay in their homeland . Thus this development can help juniors to be more successful in their life.

In conclusion , despite the diverse negative effects of getting higher education in a foreign nation, I strongly believe that this trend has plenty of benefits which exceed its drawbacks because it proves to be the best way for building a great career and developing their personality .

topic: Some people say that economic growth is the only way to end hunger and poverty, while others say that economic growth is damaging the environment so it must be stopped. Ċ Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
Although it is often claimed by some folks that starvation and destitution can only be eradicated by economic development, other people sometimes argued that the rapid rise of the economy may hamper the climate which needs to be stopped. In my opinion, despite having a few negative impacts on our environment, I think that economic growth is an inevitable factor for ending the food crisis and poverty.

To begin with, the economic indicators of a nation improve with the development of the financial condition of a country. In other words, since employment generation, an increase of purchasing power, and the rise of disposable income of citizens are improved, people can spend more money in purchasing foodstuffs, and they can similarly save money for future use. For example, Even though Bangladesh faced famine and economic crisis several time earlier, nowadays people have sufficient crops and grains with the improvement of the economy. Thus, improvements in financial indicators help to remove the impoverishment and food shortage among the people.

On the other hand, the surroundings and biodiversity of an area may be negatively influenced by the development of the economy. Water, soil, and air can be polluted severely from the industrial emissions and throwing of toxic substances as more and more industries need to be established for economic expansion. For instance, Dhaka, the capital of Bangladesh, has recently been recognized as one of the top contaminated city in the world with the advancement of its economy. Therefore, environmental issues of a country may be often required to be compromised in order to ensure the growth of the economy.

In conclusion, it is a debatable issue whether people should emphasise economic progress, or should protect the environment. In my opinion, the reduction of starvation and impoverishment is far more crucial for a country. However, environmental compliances should also be followed meticulously in order to protect the world.

topic: in spite of the advances made in agriculture, many people around the world still go hungry. Ċ Why is this case? Ċ What can be done about this problem?
essay:
Even though there have been numerous advancements in agriculture, a great number of people continue to starve because of poverty and labour exploitation. Fortunately, there are many actions which can be taken in order to solve this issue, such as investing in poor countries and making donations to philanthropic organizations.

There are a number of reasons to explain why there is still famine among humans. Firstly, despite globalization, several nations are tremendously poor, which means that their populations do not have access to education and job opportunities. Therefore, if these citizens do not earn salaries, undoubtedly they are not able to afford aliments. Furthermore, the exploitation of labour makes it impossible for workers to have enough money to buy food supplies. This is because many employers pay extremely low wages to their employees. As an illustration of this, hundreds of Brazilian workers have been found in similar conditions to slavery, in which they were receiving almost nothing in return for their work.

Luckily, there are a lot of ways to tackle this issue. First and foremost, rich nations should invest in small businesses in developing and poor countries, which would definitely provide better job opportunities for these workers. As a result, people would have the means to support themselves and no longer go hungry. Moreover, citizens from all over the world can make donations to organizations whose role is delivering food to people who are starving. For instance, Unicef is incredibly renowned for engaging in volunteer work in order to end famine around the globe.

In conclusion, there are millions of people starving nowadays since they are awfully poor and also are exploited by dishonest employers. Nonetheless, both governments and citizens can help to solve this problem by investing in poor nations and donating to institutions which provide food supplies to those who are in need.

topic: In the future, nobody will buy printed newspaper or books because they will be able to read everything they want online without paying. Ċ To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
essay:
Technology nowadays has brought a free online reading platform in which it could evoke a possibility that nobody will no longer buy physical books or newspapers. I disagree with that statement because some people are more comfortable with printed paper and entry to getting that platform might be expensive for some groups. Thus, real books might still be popular among the community.

Firstly, many groups around the world are more comfortable with real reading material, especially the elderly. For instance, the older generation is more likely to be unfamiliar with gadgets and to top it all off they also have bad eyesight in which digital things emit light that can possibly worsen them. The printed paper does not need to have tutorials to read them nor does it emit light. Hence, they will probably choose a real one.

Secondly, getting access to the internet and the gadget itself require money so it is not 100 per cent free for sure. For instance, books are licensed online in which they need to buy them first to be able to access them. The printed book does not require any of those things combined, they are easy to get and with a less price as well. So, the community will still probably prefer to get their hands on the real thing.

In conclusion, an online platform can be a popular reading place but according to my opinion, newspapers will still be relevant to the public since it is more comfortable and less expensive to access by all generations.

topic: In some countries, governments are encouraging industries and businesses to move to regional areas outside the big cities. Ċ Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages Ċ ?
essay:
Industries and businesses in some developed and developing countries are encouraged by governments to move in the rural areas from metropolitan cities. While there are benefits to it, there are some disadvantages operating them outside cities, as this essay will demonstrate.

The main disadvantage is, as cities are getting densely populated with no cleaner air to breathe, the best solution is to move some industries, and business in regional areas having less pollution. Moving to an area with low demand may be unprofitable as skilled resources may be unavailable. Also, dealing with providers, clients and other contacts may not be beneficial as customer base is located in the city. Apart from this, infrastructure can be less developed, that will be problematic for businesses. Moreover, public transportation could be poor outside the city, and workers have to relive on their own transportation. For example, Bombay is overcrowded with many companies, and many companies do not want to move away from here because everything is so readily available.

On the other hand, the main advantage of this is, with no space available for expansion of businesses and growth of industries in urban areas, the suburbs around cities are more likely to get developed. Because more land is available at a cheaper rate in the cities, the business could be expanded. Also, workers are available at less salary and it can be profitable for business and since more jobs are available, locals can benefit from it. In addition to this, employees are distressed unlike longer commutes to cities and they get a healthier environment to live in due to less pollution, and no traffic congestion. This results in, cities getting less populated, and results in the development of rural areas.

In conclusion, with the above in mind, it is clear that running businesses and industries in cities or outside cities, both have positive and negative aspects, however, in the long term, running businesses outside the city would have possibly greater advantages.

topic: Some people believe that children should have formal training at school to become good parents.  Do you agree or disagree? Give your own opinion.
essay:
Parenting is hard to master. For this reason, some people argue that children should be taught to be good parents by sending them to school's formal training. While this helps schoolchildren understand how to make responsible choices in family structure, I would argue that children should cogitate about how to gain academic attainments and leadership skills instead of learning this issue.

A school plays an important role to take formal training because it is a legal trusted institution. This becomes a good option as  parents own less time to mother their children so that school's formal training is more appropriate to master them. On the one hand, School has an integrated syllabus which can encourage children to have a good habit. In a consequence, students are able to understand a qualified culture which supports them to be responsible parents in the future.

In contrary to this, children should independently learn how to obtain an academic achievement and leadership skill. Both of them lead students to be good parents because an academic attainment becomes a strong motivation to gain a bright future. Likewise, leadership skills is more essential for children to manage a family structure in the future. In my point of view both skills should not be learnt at school's formal training.

The aforementioned evidence reveals that although school's formal training helps students understand how to be caring parents, schoolchildren have to learn how to achieve an academic performance and own leadership skills which are more useful for making a responsible family.

topic: Despite health warnings, a large number of people continue to smoke all over the world. Why should we be concerned about this? What solutions would you suggest?
essay:
Smoking has always been a polemical topic, and no matter how much money our government allot to this smoking issue, people still keep smoking spontaneously. This occurrence can engender a nightmare for our young generation and it will jeopardize our society.

At the early stage of our life, we usually imitate our parents actions since they the only people around us who spend lots of time with us. This process is called imprinting. While, it is a wonderful thing to have because we might be able to obtain some positive habits from our parents, notwithstanding it can also work in a negative way. Envision yourself, being a credulous and ingenuous child, obviously you will copy your parents' behavior, but it might turn out that your parents are smokers. As a result, smoking should be utterly prohibited by all means.

Aside from influencing horribly on our offspring, smoking could be noxious and irritating for many individuals, including myself. This activity usually disturbs as from working properly, and causes many accidents such as burning house, cars and other means. For instance, assume that you are a painstaking worker who yearns to have a content environment, but unexpectedly, there is a folk who passes you by with a cigarette in his mouth, clearly you will be hampered from working. This can lead towards the poor outcome of work, which can be really frustrating. Therefore, the government must truly muse and weigh about this problem, otherwise they might face the repercussions.

In conclusion, this smoking phenomena must be taken seriously by the government or it will cause an abundance of troublesome issues. I reckon that, the only remedy for this problem, is to set up a more powerful law which will robustly punish those individuals who keep smoking without worrying about the consequences.

topic: IELTS writing task 2: advertising. Topic: Some people say that advertising has positive economic effects. Others think it has negative social effects because it will make people feel dissatisfied with who they are and what they have. Discuss both these views and give your opinion.
essay:
These days, commercial advertisements are ubiquitous in our daily life. While some people believe they are conducive to economic development, others contend they may exert adverse influences. Personally, I am convinced that advertisements are a double-edged sword.

On the one hand, a number of individuals support the spread of advertisements for several reasons. The first one is that they can stimulate consumption. It is through commercials that consumers obtain information about products. Buyers, attracted by the quality and utility of these commodities, may be persuaded into purchasing them, therefore making contributions to the economy. Besides, advertising offers job opportunities. Advertising industry employs a great number of employees and enables them to earn their daily bread. As a result, the rate of unemployment can be maintained below a certain level and thus will not give rise to social problems.

However, some people are opposed to advertisements. This is mainly because they are likely to pose unfavourable impacts on consumers. To be specific, commercials tend to associate luxury brands with a relatively high social status. Influenced by the exaggerative claim, those who long for fame and wealth will be dissatisfied with their ordinary possessions and endeavour to acquire advertised products despite their limited means. This will certainly impose financial burdens on them. In addition, advertisements may cause anxiety to those people mentioned above. Commercials mislead them into creating a relationship between consumption and well-being. If they fail to afford advertised products, they may feel inferior to the better off and discontented about their status quo, which will affect their self-identification.

In conclusion, I maintain that both opinions are justifiable and that advertisements have benefits and drawbacks. Therefore, I suggest that limitations should be placed on them so as to give full play to their merits.

topic: Some parents buy their children a large number of toys to play with. What Ċ are the advantages and disadvantages for the child of having a large Ċ number of toys?
essay:
These days , many parents prefer to express their love towards their children by purchasing a wide variety of toys for them . Although I think that this method can have some obvious negative consequences , I believe that the advantages of having a large number of toys can outweigh its disadvantages .

On the one hand , there are some reasons that why people do not prefer to buy for their toddlers a considerable number of playthings . The strongest reason is that those youngsters who have multiple types of games tend to be introverted . In other words , children will become busier and occupied by discovering all types of games they own and playing with them ; consequently , they will spend less time with their parents and friends which can affect negatively their development in terms of communication skills . Moreover , this way of acting with youth remains a waste of money that should be invested in meaningful things because purchasing a variety of dolls requires a large sum of money . Finally , this habit is greedy because youngsters will have a strong desire to acquire more and more playthings and then they will not appreciate the simple ones and finally will not find joy in simplicity .

On the other hand , in spite of these arguments , there are several reasons that why parents prefer to buy for their toddlers a large number of pastimes. Firstly , there are some games that are made for educational purposes and help children to foster their learning and growth . For example , Lego learning blocks can help preschoolers to learn letters , numbers and languages skills . Secondly, playing with playthings can benefit the psychological development of youngsters and help them to develop useful skills such as creativity , cognitive thinking , social and spatial awareness which are crucial to boosting their mental and personalities .

In conclusion , despite that playing with a large number of toys can lead to some adverse effects on toddlers , I believe that it is a positive trend and the benefits that can bring exceed its drawbacks .

topic: Question: Happiness is considered very important in life. Why is it difficult to define? What factors are important in achieving happiness?
essay:
Happiness is a feeling of contentment and pleasure. Every individual wishes to achieve happiness in life, but happiness is such a complex feeling which can't be defined in just few lines. Every person has different description of happiness and thus, it can't be generalised.

Why is happiness so difficult to define? The only possible reply to this question is that, different people have different perspective and thus different meanings of happiness. For instance, for a poverty stricken labour, getting two meals a day is a happy moment, while for an industrialist, a profit of millions is a reason to be happy. A small child is happy getting a candy while an adult gets happy getting a job. Thus, happiness is a feeling which varies from person to person.

Though happiness is difficult to define, but it is hugely dependent on various factors. A person's expectations is the most important parameter. Expectations sometimes lead to disappointment and when they are fulfilled, one always feels happy. Another very essential factor is self-satisfaction. Without having satisfaction, an individual would feel uncomfortable in their present life and can never be happy. Satisfaction eventually makes a person happy.

Nevertheless, happiness is achieved when there is prosperity. Prosperity makes an individual complete. Prosperity is the availability of the necessities in abundance. Success, achievements, praise, recognition, financial security etc. are some other factors essential for achieving happiness. However, in the society, greed, corruption, selfishness, anger, lust etc. are detrimental to achieve happiness.

Therefore, achieving happiness is an easy and difficult task, both at the same time. If people want to find happiness, they will find it by watching their pets playing. On the other hand, nothing can make a person happy if they are full of greed and selfishness. Happiness is an ultimate feeling of self-contentment which depends on an individual's nature and attitude towards life. Happiness depends how we think our life is and thus its indefinite, undefined and completely abstract.

topic: As global trade increases, many goods, even those we use in a daily basis, are produced in other countries and have to be transported in long distances. Do you think the benefits of this trend outweigh the drawbacks?
essay:
Due to globalization and technological advancements,the production of a wide range of items, including our daily necessities, is no longer limited within the borders of a nation. Although some people may frown upon this trend due to its drawbacks, it looks to me that the benefits are far outweighing.

The major advantage of this development is that customers across the world can take advantage of higher-quality products at fairly competitive prices. This is due to the possibility of creating a fair playing field in terms of dynamic markets and relevant legislation, allowing for the wider availability of various brands and items for the general public. On the other hand, delivering critical materials and components across national boundaries is likely to mitigate the risk of resource scarcity in the local market. To be specific, if a country's raw materials for some essential commodities are in limited supply, transporting goods from another country could be an ideal solution to the local shortage, thus minimizing the unfavourable effects on the residents.

While others may oppose such a trend, claiming that long-distance transport is a major contributor to environmental disruption. This is true to some extent as delivering goods by plane is fuel-consuming and would lead to greenhouse gas emissions. However, a truth that should be explicitly stated is that private cars, not aeroplanes, are the primary source of global emissions. Furthermore, given the current research in the field of alternative energy, it should not be difficult to convert greenhouse gases like carbon dioxide into renewable fuels in the future, which could also provide human beings with a possible mechanism to store energy.

In conclusion, I am optimistic about this trend and firmly believe that delivering daily necessities to other countries provides mankind with significant merits as long as the whole society is mindful of them. potential risks associated with long-distance transportation and takes effective measures to minimize them.

topic: Many museums and history sites are mainly visited by tourists rather than local people why is this? What can we done to encourage people to visit museums and historical sites?
essay:
Some foreigners are more likely to go to museums and historical sites than local people. This case happens since these places lack of promotion to people in surrounding. For solving this problem, the officers can create campaign to encourage citizens to visit these historical places.

The main principal problem of this issue is that those places are not well-known by people around there because they tend to ignore what they have. The officers may do not promote these destinations to people living around those places. This results in people to overlook the existence of them. A recent study by Tokyo University found a fact when the researchers conducted a research in Indonesia that 200 museums in Indonesia only had at average 100 local visitors every month, while 80% young generations there did not know the best top five museums in Indonesia. It means that these places are unpopular for society.

The greatest way to tackle this problem is that the officers arrange the event to make museums and historical sites more popular such as "a movement to love museums". The officers can invite local citizens to come to museums and socialize to them about a valuable aspect regarding in visiting historical places. With this strategy, the officers can show attractive uniqueness of these places. A study in 2013 by The University of Sussex revealed that visitors of Madame Tussaud Museum in London increased at 30% in 2014 after the its officers created a campaign named 'visit museum 2013'. This brilliant idea brings effective solution.

All in all, poor promotion is primary reason why local people are unlikely to go museums and historical sites. However, people can organize a campaign to overcome this case. It is suggested that the officers should do regularly more or less once in six months.

topic: With the rise of e-books comes the decline in paper books. Some people see this as a good step forward while others do not. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this trend?
essay:
The development of technology has brought us to a new era where we gradually switch the way we read a book from papers to the digital version. Some people say it is a great movement while others believe that old-fashioned reading is irreplaceable. This essay will explore the pros and cons of both sides and demonstrate why those ideas are valid.

Regarding disadvantages, the main drawback of the rising number of e-books is that it increases the number of people who suffer from short-sighted diseases. It is undeniable that finishing a book takes many hours to devote, and doing it through electronic screens like laptops or iPad will damage our eyes. Additionally, those gadgets require strong energy from the battery. As a result, if the devices are running out of battery and the power source is not available, there will be no way the reader can access the electronic books.

Despite all the disadvantages of e-readers, I believe that the benefits are more significant to address. Firstly, the digital book will save the planet by reducing carbon footprints. While more than 30 million trees are cut down every year to produce textbooks, reading digital articles will dramatically reduce deforestation because it does not require any piece of paper. Secondly, e-books are portable and lightweight, allowing us to save countless files on a device. It is also evident that electronic books are easy to use due to a click on the screen will provide many features such as highlighting, making notes, and translating words. On the other hand, handbooks are bulky and heavy to carry around, taking so much effort for us to bring them everywhere.

In conclusion, while e-books have several disadvantages, itsCorrect pronoun usagetheirIt seems that there is a pronoun problem here.

show examples benefits undoubtedly matter to the environment and deliver lots of convenience in life. Thus, I think people should leave the old habit of reading, from a printed book to the digital ones.

topic: In the past, most people lived in small villages where everyone knew everyone else. Nowadays, most people live in large cities where they only know a few people in their area. What do you think were the advantages and disadvantages of living in a small community?
essay:
Several years ago, it is believed that numerous inhabitants staying in the settlement were close one another. However, in the modern time, societies living in the cosmopolitan merely have a few people communicating as well. While there are several benefits living in a small community, it also has certain drawbacks.

The mankind staying in a small community such as in the settlement will obtain kinship relationship. It is due to the fact that they can communicate regularly. To demonstrate, in the recent decades, many people living in villages in Indonesia such as Purwokerto, Cirebon and Kuningan and the other villages often make a conversation with their neighbourhood everytime. As a consequence, even though they live in a small community, yet they feel as a small family.

On the other hand, this circumstance occasionally causes several drawbacks for the inhabitants. First and foremost, living in a small community such in the rural area affects to boring condition in case local people stay in a long period. It is because they never encounter with the other people on their day-to-day lives. For instance, they always meet with the same people every day. Also, they will feel uphill when they face some accidents in order to ask a help since their neighbourhoods are busy in their garden or field in diurnal and nocturnal. To sum up, living in a small community sometimes deteriorates people.

topic: Many people prefer to watch foreign films rather than locally produced films. Why could this be? Should governments give more financial support to local film industries?
essay:
It is true that people nowadays favour foreign films than local films and the cause of such a phenomenon can be attributed to several reasons. Meanwhile, whether government should protect national film industries has also become a disputable issue.

The main reason why citizens are far more fond of films from other countries is that these films often have a better quality over local ones, which can bring amazing experience to the audience. Films from Hollywood, for example, are famous for their sophisticated plots, vivid visual effects, all-star casts as well as stunning original soundtracks. Although these factors may not be necessary for making a great movie, they still can attract most people's eyes.

It is a well-known fact that most of the time budgets for Hollywood films are extremely high, which enables these movies to achieve such a commercial success. As a result, in order to save local film industries from the downturn, I fully agree government to provide more financial support to help domestic movie companies enhance their film-making productivity from both quantitative and qualitative perspectives. Apart from this option, several measures can also be adopted by authorities concerned to tackle the issue, such as promoting patriotism, fostering more public interest in learning the art of film as well as building a more friendly environment for film production.

In conclusion, people do prefer foreign films in recent years, whereas many solutions are available to overcome this problem after various key factors are discovered and analyzed.

topic: Information technology enables many people to do their work outside their workplace (e.g at home, when travelling, etc). Do the benefits of this mobility outweigh the disadventages? Today's technology improvements
essay:
It goes without saying that technology improvement has bring a ripple effect on human life, especially when it comes to talk about employment flexibility. As such, it has allowed many workers to finish their task wherever they want to. Personally, I also think that the merits of this improvement outweight the drawbacks.

The information-technology impovement has influenced the flexibility of workers, especially on the way they complete their job. Obviously, this also relates to their productivity. Furthermore, some jobs in particular art company did not need to compel the workers to stay in office all the time. That is why they will get a huge benefits from this simplicity. This is because the artist can complete their painting in the other places, such as home, field, or in tourism places. Moreover, this mobility has influenced on how people arrange their time to work and to relax based on their own self. Additionally, the another benefit of this is relating to how the company has to reduce their outcome, due to the fact that, the office should not be operate 24 hours per day.

On the other hand, we can not deny that this technology improvement has some drawbacks too, owing to the fact that there also a job which force the labour to accomplish work in the office, in particular for a big company. For more detail, lets take an example on electronic services' companies. They tend to entire their time in the workplace because it it impossible to doing their job on the other places. That is why, I could say that the disadventages of this mobility are regarding to the effectiveness of workers time to make the problem clear.

Clearly, there are some benefits from technology advances since it can makes some particular work became more flexible and highly producing. However, it also has brought a drawbacks as the work became disorganise.

topic: Some people believe that it is more important to teach children the literature and history of their own country, rather than the literature and history of other countries. To what extent do you agree or disagree? the importance of teaching children history and literature
essay:
People may have different views about educating children the history and literature of their own nation rather than that of other countries. In my perspective, I totally agree this argument that children should know more knowledge of their own country from history and literature.

For these two reasons why children should be taught more about the stories based on the history and literature. On the one hand, children can learn the lesson from history and literature which happened to the great person so that children would have a better development. For example,World War II started due to benefits to some nations and caused inevitable damages on human being. Therefore, in order to prevent this situation from repeating, educating children national history and literature to let them know the reason why the war got starting. On the other hand, children can be more familiar with their own country by knowing more stories behind the nation through studying history and literature. Also, it makes children more understand who they are on this planet.

However, what if children only study history and literature of their own country, what will happen? It's believed that children will lose the sense of identity, which will lead to a ruined consequence, causing them escaping from their own country. Besides, children may make the same mistake as the great person of their own country such this problem might interfere children's growing.

In conclusion, it is crucial to teach children the history and literature of their own nation, which would make them more realize themselves.

By studying stories from their national heritage, children learn valuable lessons from the experiences of great historical figures, fostering moral and intellectual development. Understanding the causes of past events, such as the conflicts that led to World War II, helps prevent the repetition of destructive patterns. While there are concerns that a narrow focus on national history might limit perspective or lead to the repetition of past mistakes, the study of national figures and events remains crucial for informed and responsible citizenship.

topic: Essay: Some say that news has no connection with most people's life and it is a waste of time for most of us to read newspapers and watch television news programs. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
News importance is an issue which has many's the time generated a myriad of controversial debates. Whilst there is a school of thought which contends that current affairs are irrelevant to people's lives and it is such time down the drain watching news, I would be convinced that keeping posted with the news is not so purposeless as some certain individuals suppose.

To begin with, from my perspective, following the news has brought about numerous advantages to every civil. Firstly, gaining information from official sources is attributable to raise residents' awareness of prelevant events. Take COVID-19 as a stark example, with the proper guildline along with the up-to-the-minute national reports, the death toll can be kept at the minimum and citizens are armed with fundamental knowledge to remain safe. Nevertheless, phenomenon of watching information program is likely to facilitate forming comprehensive viewpoints about everyday issues such as politics, science or economy. Not only can news readers have their own stance when judging any angles but they also more topics to discuss with friends in daily talks.

On the other hand, it is true to some extend that a minority of news is loosely associated with human life . Specifically, celebrities' scandals, which are not crucial in citizens' lives are sometimes overly paid a great deal of attention to. However, this kinds of news could serve as a form of entertainment.

Given to this argument, I oppose dimissing news as an unnecessity, thus it is strikingly evident that official broadcasters invariably have a profound influence on humanity.

topic: Topic: Around the world, many adults are working from home, and more children are beginning to study from home because technology has become cheaper and more accessible. Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
essay:
Thanks to the advancement of technology, distant working and learning have been made possible for both workers and students. I think that this practice has brought about ample benefits to the society, yet other downsides of it should also be taken into consideration.

Firstly, working and learning from home do wonders for the environment. It has been statistically reported that the daily commute to work and school of citizens is the one of the main contributory factors to the increase in carbon emissions. By practicing distant learning and working, people can reduce the number of journeys they make every day, hence decreasing the amount of carbon footprint emitted from motorised vehicles. Besides, the lowered demand for fuels used to run transportation would also gradually put a halt to the overexploitation of fossil fuels, another environmental issue.

On the other hand, staying at home to learn and work continuously may have some certain adverse effect on people. Distant learning means that children will not have a chance to meet their peers face-to-face and have real interactions, which may negatively affect their communicative and social skills. More specifically, when students just study online, they would not have opportunities to encounter different social situations in which they have to deal with in real life, such as having a conflict with friends when playing. Moreover, learning and working from home discourage people from being physically active as they hardly have to move from place to place. This may result in a sedentary lifestyle and hence, other diseases such as obesity.

To conclude, distant learning and working may have significant impacts on the improvement of the environment. However, it may create some mental and physical issues to people who experience it for a long time.

topic: It is very important that children should study hard at school. Time spent playing sport is time wasted. Do you agree?
essay:
It is argued that having a sports class on school schedules is not that significant to giving full-time academic subjects to students. In my experiences, I think children should have time to play sports at school rather than study hard only as it can result in both their mental and physical health.

First of all, spending time playing sports can help school-age children relax from their hard studies. Playing like football, basketball, or swimming are activities to reduce their stresses, sitting and focusing on academic subjects all day. For example, I liked to go swim after my serious school classes at least three times a week, and as a result, I could hold the rest of the hard-study week. Thus, playing sports can help students to refresh and gain back some energy to study.

Secondly, students' physical health is also one of the most important reasons why they need to play sports because it can lead them to become strong, so they are ready for studying and can learn more things effectively. For instance, students who usually play sports, will be strong and have lots of energy more than students who do not play. Subsequently, they have more ability to study hard and never get sick.

In conclusion, giving time for students to do some sports activities can bring them benefits both on their mental and physical conditions, so they are more energetic and effective in academic learnings. Therefore, schools should balance students' time with physical activities,not either academic classes.

topic: Some people think that libraries are a waste of resources and money,so computers should replace them. However, others do not agree. Ċ Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
essay:
Some believe that computers should replace libraries as the latter ones are a waste of money and valuable resources. However, others disagree with that notion. I totally disagree that libraries are not useful as paper books are more convenient and effective in terms of education.

On the one hand, computers allow preserving more information while freeing a lot of useful space. Moreover, a modern desktop can store approximately more than 1000 e-books and audiobooks. Electronic sources of information are not as vulnerable as paper and resources on these devices can be easily transferred in a couple of minutes. Mobility is another feature of electronic devices. For instance, anyone can hold and read more than 100 electronic books at any moment while using laptops which is impossible in the case of physical books.

On the other hand, paper-based books are more convenient in terms of studying. Not only do they engage visual parts of the brain but also engage kinesthetic parts. This results in increasing the amount and quality of consuming information. For example, scientific studies among 2 groups of students proved that students who used textbooks to prepare for exams memorised by 40% more than the other group that used e-books. This fact is especially important for children and teenagers that study at schools and colleges.

In conclusion, I am absolutely convinced that libraries should not be replaced by computers because by using paper-based books people can study more efficiently. I would recommend preserving libraries as there are no better alternatives.

topic: 'anyone can do it' attitude In some countries today, there is an attitude that 'anyone can do it' in arts-music, literature, acting, art, etc. As a result, people with no talent become rich and famous and genuine talent is not valued or appreciated.  Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Nowadays, it is concerned that mediocre talents which earn people money and fame will lead to the undervaluation of genuine ones, with the popularity of the motto 'anyone can do it'. In my opinion, I do not subscribe to that statement because of two main reasons.

First of all, only true talents can shine and stay in the spotlight for a long period of time. With the help of internet and streaming videos, people can easily upload their performances which can go viral for a while if the responses are positive. Many international artists have done this to obtain their first contract with the CD labels, such as Colbie Caillat, Justin Biebers or Boyce Avenue. However, it is extremely crucial to remember that after that stage, they continuously gave the audience more of their artistic developments as well chart-topping songs in order to stay popular. In contrast, thousands of Youtube singers are forgotten because the lack of authentic gifts.

Second, it should be accented that people need to be more inspired and encouraged to show their talents in front of public, even if they are not exceptional or phenomenal like well-known artists. For instance, many reality shows like The Voice, X factors look for talented individuals by giving them incentives to step out of their comfort zones, to take their chances. In other words, without those encouragement, many A-rated singers will still remain unknown.

In conclusion, the worry about people with no talents getting famous at fast pace in our modern community is exaggerated. Speaking from my perspective, I believe that the attitude 'anyone can do it' should be emphasized and only real talents can survive in the competitive atmosphere of creating arts.

topic: Many small businesses are being forced to close because they are unable compete with multinational corporations? Ċ What problems does this cause and how can problems be solved?
essay:
Owing to the increasing competition from the international companies, most of the local businesses are continuously collapsing as they are unable to cope with the foreign goods.This essay will discuss that it would diminish the sources of livelihood for the general people, and further submit that sufficient availability of resources by the authorities, as a viable solution.

To commence with, there are several problems associated with this phenomenon.However, the major factor is that the closing of the smaller firms means a threat to the survival of the local businessmen.Since they are highly dependent on the sale of their goods, as they earn a living by selling their products.But the growth of the multinational industries would minimise the demands of their materials as large business companies are known for the quality of their manufactured substances.For instance, in India, in the recent years, tremendous foreign corporations have made a huge investment because it has a greatest market in the world.Hence, local markets would die soon.

To mitigate this issue, the administration authorities must come forward to prevent the decline of the small entrepreneurs.This means that the regimes should adopt an adequate policy so that business persons of their own country do not suffer.If governments allocate funds to reduce the deficiency of resources, then it will minimise the scope of their progress despite the growth of the global companies.For example, in India, the governing body provides subsidies to the young people, who are new in the business in order to fuel their trade.

In conclusion, although small traders are facing stiff competition from the developed organisations and are consistently losing their significance and it will adversely affect their normal lifestyle, a possible solution would be to assign capital to these people through various grants in order to provide them latest sources to nurture their career development.

topic: Many people work long hours, leaving very little time for leisure activities. Ċ Does this situation has more advantages or more disadvantages?
essay:
There is no doubt that, in most developing countries, most people working long hours is a usual thing. Although it is good for both country and individual that people spend most of their times by focusing in their jobs, there are pros and cons in this statement.

On the one hand, the meaning of people working long hours is country's productivity grows and support economic growth for the nation. Individually, they will earn a lot of money by doing this hard work. Therefore, the family's financial status will be high. For instance, in Japan, most people working long hours became traditional their daily lifestyles. As a clear result, Japan became the richest country in Asia. In addition, many Japanese feel that early back home is a kind of shame in their society.Therefore, they used to spend most of their time at work. Consequently, their living standard is higher than around neighbour countries.

On the other hand as the disadvantages, the long working day provides tired mentally and physically, reduce focusing on their task and lack of pace spending on their loved ones. The average population only can perform about 8 hours a day. That is why, in some countries, there are specific working hours per week has been in place as a rule. If people feel being exhausted, they cannot produce any good ideas for their works. Therefore, it can cause many mistakes in their work as well as lead to workplace accidents. Moreover, spending too much time on work reduces your family's time and personal leisure activity. That will damage your health and relationship with your family.

To sum up, working and spending too much on work are reducing personal space. That will give you negative effects in long term. There is no benefit at all after over too much-putting effort into whatever it is. Therefore, a live and work balance lifestyle will give more advantages than the other in my opinion.

topic: These days many families move to other countries for work. Some people believe that children in these families benefit from this move. However, others believe that it makes life more difficult for the children. Ċ Discuss both these views and give your opinion.
essay:
Nowadays, there is an increase in the trend of moving abroad as people believe that their family tend to obtain several benefits. However, some argue that it is more likely to make difficulties in life, by doing so. This essay points out the rationales behind the two contrasting viewpoints and provides examples before my conclusion is reached.

On the one hand, moving to other countries can bring about difficulties in not only parent lifestyle but also their children. This is due to the fact that in order to earn an extraordinary life abroad, they need to adapt to both the culture and spoken language. For example, they are required to speak well in that language in order to study and work easily with their new colleagues. Additionally, it is hard for the children to change from the old environment and to fit in the new one in a small amount of time so that can lead to the mental health of their children as well.

On the other hand, the family can also gain advantages by changing their living. This is because moving to a new place comes with certain prices that are the efficient education, the good workplace, and also the welfare. For instance, during the COVID-19 pandemic, many Thai people have moved to the US to get a vaccination and settle down there due to the failure of medical management of the government. Consequently, it is worth the risk to move to a new place that offers many profits to their life.

In conclusion, although it is hard to adapt themselves to a new country that they have never experienced before, the merits offered is worthwhile to be at risk.

topic: Some people think that job satisfaction is more important than job security. Others think that people cannot expect to enjoy a job and that having a permanent job is more important. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
In present-day society, whether job satisfaction is more important than job safety has arisen a debate. Some people assert, that nothing matters more than enjoying their work, whereas others argue that the aspect of employment stability comes first when finding a job. I think that both factors are important, and it is ideal to have a job where you can enjoy both.

Many people work in places where do not satisfy them, nonetheless, it is considered for some that it is gratifying to count with a business that can provide them with a permanent contract as a guarantee of their permanence in the company. Workers admit that for them that is vital to meet their obligations with their families, bills, education of their kids, and payment of the mortgage. To illustrate further, my brother who has got five children and his wife depend on their monthly wages to cover all the necessary expenses and he is willing to sacrifice his satisfaction as long as he is provided with a constant income. Unfortunately, this sacrifice affects his wellness, since the level of stress and exhaustion are high.

On the other hand, some individuals have the opportunity to have a contract in places where they can do what they love, and do not feel like working is a heavy load in their schedules. Some of them are hired for seasonal periods and their contracts are for a limited time which affects their finances; however, others have the privilege to count with a full-time contract and at the same time have the satisfaction to work in what they desire which grants them the chance to obtain a consistent income and have the benefit of not being affected by a stressful job. Individuals that can have these two advantages in their workplaces are known to have a more happy and healthy life according to the American magazine wellness.

To conclude, the aspects of employee safety and the level of satisfaction at work are equally essential for a person. Nevertheless, many people do not have the opportunity to enjoy both of them.

essay:
Recently, most people are spending a large amount of fund on their wedding function. It is considered by many that spending a lot of cash on wedding parties led to issues for the newly couples . In my opinion, I agree that spending high amounts of money on wedding parties caused financial instability and early divorce rate among new family.

On the one hand, it believes that spending a large amount of money on a wedding ceremony cause financial instability in the new home. This is because they spent a high percentage of their savings on the ceremony. As a result, this leads to the inability of the family to cope with any financial issues that arise after the party . Therefore, this caused a breakdown for both the couples financially and mentally. For example,many studies have shown that newly wedded people that spent large amounts of money on their wedding parties tend to become a burden to their family after the ceremony due to the inability to finance daily items need for the growth of the new home.

On the other hand ,spending a large amount of money on wedding ceremony also cause early divorce rate between newly wedded couples. For instance, many researchers have shown that most elaborate wedding ceremonies separated after a year of their joining together. This is because most of the couple's wedding set wedding because of the party attached but not because of love .Therefore, this caused an early separation between the new family.

In conclusion, I believe that financial breakdown and separation between the team are problems related to large elaborate wedding ceremonies .

topic: Some people argue that it is more important to have an enjoyable job than to earn a lot of money. Others disagree and think that a good salary leads to a better life.
essay:
When it comes to job selecting, everything becomes sensitive. I do believe that having preferable job is more essential than obtaining high salary, while others object it and consider earn much money will bring to a brighter life.

Regarding well-paid job, people believe it changes their lives become more convenient in two ways. Firstly, good payment enables them to spend a lot of money to cover all of their daily necessities. According to the latest study in India, the number of low-income families undergoes significant increase year by year. As a result, many of them experience starvation and even death. Next, high salary lets the people having high education. These days, the education requires an expensive fee that cause many poor societies cannot afford it. In South Korea, it is noted that the rich people obtained the higher percentage in master degree and doctoral as their latest education, while the poor one just reach senior high school and bachelor degree as their highest education. Therefore, it is proven that high-income jobs will lead the people to a brighter future.

However, in my opinion doing a favorable work is more pivotal than obtaining much money. Feeling enjoy in working will enable the human being have high possibility to gain the happiness, the most important thing in humans' life. Based on recent research, it was found that mostly wealthy people in East Asia, such as Japan and South Korea, committed suicide. It means that much money cannot bring happiness in humans' life. Consequently, having a job that they love is the vocal point for people in order to pursue a better life.

To sum up, despite the merits emerged by high salary jobs, I totally believe that the passion-based work is the most impressive thing that individuals should have in reaching a good life. They have to rethink in selecting their jobs and try to prioritize their happiness.

topic: It is generally believed that some people are born with natural talents, for instance sports or music, and others are not. However, it is sometimes claimed that any child can be taught to become a good sports person or musician. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
Undoubtedly, the majority of exponents postulate that a quite number of people are gifted with inherited skills; whereas, others maintain that younglings could acquire ingenuity via vocational training. I accord that some persons are birthed with enough aptitude; notwithstanding, this disquisition delves into in-depth reasoning to advance why I believe so.

Apparently, the proponents that maintain that individuals could be created with inborn artistries – have their justification. The reasoning might due to the fact that some rare talented people still exist whether or not they attend professional classes for formal education. In detail, such a population still capable to clinch success in specific areas simply because they are inherited with skills .For example, Rajiv Gandhi, the former prime minister of India, had neither attended the school of politics as a major nor learned the history subject as a minor, but still, he was the best leader because he got the leadership qualities from his politician mother. Thus, the vindication for the argument of being naturally talented.

Conversely, could the contenders that posit that juvenile instructed to be an outstanding superstar, be absolutely right? Certainly, yes, it follows the principles of appropriate grooming and persistent dedication. In detail, many eminent scientists and medical experts procured their adroitness with the help of professionals, and by learning and failing the task hundreds of times. For instance, an article by GNA (Guardian Newspaper of America), stated that in 2009, 30% of scientists in NASA, successfully procured their goals, who were not offsprings of scientific parents, but through enough education, and deep perseverance. Moreover, one can also be nurtured if he is ready to push his limits in a specific field by being highly motivated. For illustration, a sportsman can be a national champion by practising sports with hard work. Hence, the justification for skills that could be instructed.

To conclude, having explored both outlooks, it is clear that virtuosity can be both intrinsic and groomed in schools. However, I recapitulated that some individuals are gifted with intrinsic aptitude.

topic: Some educationalists think that international exchange visit will benefit teenagers at the school. To what extent do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
Some educationalists believe that teenagers will get benefits from taking part in international exchange visit. Even though there are some drawbacks when moving abroad in exchanging programs, the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.

On the one hand, traveling and staying in other countries will bring some drawbacks when the youth have an exchange visit. There are culture shocks that might affect the quality of the journey if the exchange nation has so different and strange rules in the regular activities or costumes. Weather can also be a problem for those who live in a tropical area to a cooler place.

However, there are more benefits that teenagers can get when attending an exchange visit. One advantage is the ability to have self-development that is necessary for the youth. When teenagers live far from their home country and meet new people in a different environment, they will have a chance to develop their interpersonal skills, problem-solving skills and independent opinions. Furthermore, gaining new knowledge and understanding the culture of another nation is a plus that they cannot learn and really know in their schools. To encourage the youth to take part in these exchange visits, there are many organizations running for this purpose such as AFS Intercultural Programs and AIESEC that focus on developing necessary skills and experiences.

In conclusion, despite some disadvantages when teenagers attend international exchange visits, it is still a good chance for them to develop important skills which are needful for their future and to learn new things. Governments should support these kind of learning to bring back the best results in education.

topic: Some people think the government should spend more money on public services other than waste money on arts. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Nowadays, the government have laid great emphasis on arts by finance investment, which raises a heated debate. The majority of people believe the authorities are supposed to largely subsidize the public services rather than arts. Others, However, argue that the government should give priority to arts. In my observation, it is a necessity to support the public services in urgent.

There is no doubt that more money ought to be spend on public services. It is well acknowledged that public services, definitely, are increasingly relevant to the lives of citizens, including housing, traveling and banking. There is a gap, Nevertheless, between the quality of a number of public services and the expectation of individuals. More specifically, some obvious examples could illustrate it clearly. One of the public services, the spring rush, hardly satisfy the passengers before and after the Spring Festive in terms of tickets, which has been a difficult problem for government to cope with. Another example is concerning the access to and speed of Internet. There are numerous residents in the rural and remote areas who have no accessible Internet and in many regions, urban included, who bear a slow speed of Internet.

Others, however, suggest that the investment on arts by government should not be canceled. The reasons partly lie on that arts, as the component of culture of nations, are indispensable to the nations and people. In addition, arts could fulfill the psychological requirement of the public to a large extent.

In sum, the government's money is essential and necessary to sustain the public services which are in need by most people, though arts is also important to human beings.

topic: It is becoming increasingly popular to have a year off between finishing school and going to university. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this? Ċ Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
Recently, the number of students who finished school and have a gap period is significantly increased. This occurrence may affect the advantages and disadvantages that I will explain in this essay.

First and foremost, a growing number of juveniles who spend time after graduating high school will be beneficial for them to boost their expertise and skills by enrolling the college. According to this, even though they experienced a gap year, it is not too late to join the educational institution. The students have a huge opportunity to opt specific course or major that they intend to encourage their capability to prepare for getting a quality job position. As an example, the young people who enter the university and are competent in the particular field will be easier to derive a job. Furthermore, after graduating from the university, they will acquire a professional abbreviation, such as Bachelor of nursing or Bacher of Art. Consequently, this may positively impact due to the rising of productive individuals who are competent in the working-age population.

On the one hand, this issue may lead to a disadvantageous phenomenon if the teenagers do not desire to develop their abilities and waste their time for a year. Furthermore, it will affect prosperity in the future since they will be jobless and cannot compete with others. For example, the youth who are uninterested in getting a higher degree has fewer capabilities than the university student who enhanced particular skills. Therefore, it seems hard and competitive for them to secure their lives with permanent job positions due to a lack of competencies.

In conclusion, it does not matter for high-school graduates has a gap year, but it will be more advantageous for their future if they continue their study to get a higher degree, and it will negatively impact and become disadvantages if their standstill to improve their development.

Major claim:  
It does not matter if high school graduates take a gap year, but it is more beneficial for their future if they continue their studies to obtain a higher degree, and detrimental if they remain stagnant in their development.

Claim 1:  
Taking a gap year can still lead to educational and professional benefits if students later enroll in college.  
Premise: Even after a gap year, it is not too late to join an educational institution.

Premise: Young people who enter university and gain competence in a particular field are more likely to secure employment.

Premise: If teenagers do not seek to improve their abilities and waste their time, it may result in disadvantages.  
Premise: This can affect future prosperity, as they may remain jobless and unable to compete in the job market.  
Premise: Youth uninterested in pursuing a higher degree have fewer capabilities compared to university students who develop specific skills.

Graduates in fields like nursing or the arts are better positioned to secure employment and build stable careers. However, if students remain stagnant during the gap year and do not develop their abilities, they risk falling behind, facing limited job prospects and reduced competitiveness in the labor market. Without pursuing further education or skill development, they may struggle to obtain permanent, meaningful employment.

topic: In the future, it seems it will be more difficult to live on the Earth. Some people think more money should be spent on researching other planets to live, such as Mars. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement? funds for space exploration
essay:
There are some individuals believe that mankind should invest more in seeking possibility of life outside the Earth due to difficulties of living on it in the future. In my opinion, I totally disagree with this view.

One reason is that searching life on other planets is waste of money. As we were know, some organizations like NASA annually spend millions of dollars to figure out living signals within our universe, but there is no sign of life announced so far. In addition, human being only exists in a suitable environment which has many necessary elements, such as water, atmosphere, temperature, etc. But this depends on distance among planets and the Sun. For instance, the temperature on Venus is very hot because it is the nearest star to the Sun.

The second reason is that recovering the Earth is the best solution to eliminate the difficulties. It will be more difficult to live on the Earth because it is being damaged by human's activities. Therefore we should spend more money implementing campaigns to improve our environment, such as cutting down on industrial emissions, planting trees, educating our next generation to protect the Earth, and so on. Moreover, if we can find other planets to live, but we continue destroying them by harmful activities, we are in the end no longer to exist.

In conclusion, although many people think that spending money to search other places outside the Earth is a way to tackle the difficulties of living in the future, I believe that protecting the Earth is the best solution.

topic: Some students prefer classes with open discussions between the professor and students and almost no lectures. Other students prefer classes with lectures and almost no discussions. Which do you prefer? Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.
essay:
There are different ways to arrange classes. I prefer classes in which I can have an open discussion with my classmates and professors. There are two reasons why to me it's the best way to study: first of all, it promotes better understanding of subjects and secondly, it is more interesting. In the following essay I'll explain those reasons.

In my opinion, open discussions are better than lectures because they help students relate to subjects. When you study a topic in class, discussion requires you to think and share your opinions and experience with classmates. For example, during my classes on taxation in my classmates and I compared how different taxes affect our country's economy and our lives, and it helped me understand and remember the logic behind calculating various taxes. Moreover, open discussions help professors to immediately evaluate the students' level of understanding, identify problems and modify the lessons accordingly. This way by the time of examinations students have a better understanding of subjects.

Secondly, classes in which students and professors exchange opinions seem more interesting to me. In my university lectures aren't popular among students and nobody likes taking notes while the professor is reading a lecture. My classmates say it becomes hard to concentrate and think about what they're writing, they get tired and start dreaming instead - and I agree with them. Moreover, open discussions make me feel like my opinion on subjects matters and it encourages me to keep studying .

Overall, I believe that any way to study is okay as long as it work for you. However, for me having more open discussions and less lectures is better. It's more challenging but also more effective. Discussions make me feel connected to the subjects I'm studying, that's why I prefer them to lectures.

topic: Some people think that teachers should be responsible for teaching students how to judge right and wrong and how to behave well. Some say that teachers should only teach students about academic subjects. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
Some people argue that teaching students to behave well and to assess right and wrong is important. However, others think that teachers have to focus on teaching academic lessons only. I believe that there are strong reasons underlying on these statements which I will discuss further in this essay.

On the one hand, it is responsibility for the teacher educates children while in the school. Their main duty is preparing their students reaches their dream in the future. Based on this thought, some people believe that teacher should only focus on teaching school subjects thereby their students understand the lessons properly. Meanwhile, teaching the children to behave well and to judge right and wrong is parent's responsibility, because it is out of school curriculum. Thus, parents and teachers possess their own roles to educate the children.

On the other hand, tough main duty of teachers is teaching in the class, however they are a respected figure in the school. Their behaviors are an example particularly for their students. Therefore, it is important to teacher initiate their students behaving well and judging what is right and wrong. Hence in the future, their students are not only success in the job, but also polite and wise to make a decision in their life.

To sum up, indeed teacher's main duty is teaching the school subjects which is based on the school curriculum. However, in my point of view, it is better if teachers become a good figure for their students and collaborate well with the parents to educate the children. topic: Nowadays we are producing more and more rubbish. Ċ Why do you think this is happening? Ċ What can governments do to help reduce the amount of rubbish produced? Ċ Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
Rubbish production has increased considerably over the last few years. In this essay, I will argue why I believe this problem is occurring and suggest some strategies that governments can take to decrease the amount of garbage generated.

Waste production is highly influenced by individuals' exaggerated consumption. In many countries, Capitalism's lifestyle and advertisements induce people to consume more products, which leads to greater rubbish production and thus pollution. For instance, many people are influenced by TV commercials and digital influencers to purchase a more modern cellphone even though they already have a decent cellphone to use. In some cases, this may even lead to an inadequate discard of the old cellphone, which is very harmful to the environment. Therefore, the more products we consume, the more trash will be produced.

There are some actions governments can take to overcome this challenge. One way is to obligate companies to collect and recycle the products, such as electro domestics, that the public can no longer use or does not want to use anymore. Another way is to promote environmental education programs in schools to encourage sustainable consumption at an early age. Finally, there should be around the cities, stations where people can correctly discard their solid waste and receive incentives for that, such as discounts on their water or power bills.

In conclusion, rubbish production is caused by unsustainable consumption, which can cause environmental problems. This issue can be lessened by partnerships with companies, environmental education programs in educational facilities, and the implementation of recycling stations in cities.

topic: Some people think that it is more effective for student to study in groups, while other believe that it is better for them to study alone. Ċ Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Education is undeniably one of the important factors for a successful career in the future. Thereby, the curriculum is constantly changing for decades to find the perfect one to ensure that juveniles have sufficient knowledge. Particularly, there is an argument whether studying as a group is better than studying alone or not. In my perspective, I believe that the adaptation of both styles is the best option for the young generation.

First of all,  association work is certainly beneficial for students to learn how to work cooperatively with others. Teamwork requires patience and the ability to adapt with different people in order to complete certain tasks are challenging yet important for every profession because doing alone may not be effective to finish assignments on time. For example, in medical careers such as nurses or doctors, 1 patient needs a lot of care at once by doing alone can be challenging and the patient's safety is at risk. For this reason, everyone needs to be able to help each other. Consequently, if juveniles already have this skill, it will be easier for them to adapt to this situation. Hence, studying together gives a chance to confirm what they understand in the class is correct or not by confirming with their friends during group gatherings.

On the other hand, less distraction is found if students learn individually. By staying alone, they are able to focus on the content rather than talking or playing when their friends are around. For illustration, when preparing for an examination, if kids stay together, they may lose concentration and ask each other to do something else instead. Furthermore, they can pick their prefered study method as everyone has a different style of learning if they learn individually. For instance, some may prefer to open music when reading while others may find it is annoying.

In conclusion, both perspectives have their own benefits and drawbacks. Nevertheless, I suggest that teachers should adopt both styles by doing regular lecture classes, adding some group assignments and allowing self-learning time to ensure a dynamic curriculum and prevent repetitiveness which can be boring for the current generation.
