topic: Nowadays food has become easier to prepare. Has this change improved the way people live? Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.
essay:
In modern life, people must work very hard to get a good job and to achieve a higher position in their company or their organization. They don't have enough time to prepare complex, traditional meals everyday. The way to prepare meals becomes simpler, quicker and easier. This change brings a better life for busy people.

People have more time to work when they only use a little bit time to prepare food. People can not spend much time on the meal preparation, if they must work at least eight hours per day. In Vietnam, officers often work from forty to forty four hours per week, so they don't have time to make the meal. They often have lunch at restaurant and have simple dinner at home. If they want to make the life more interesting, they will organize some small events in the weekends.

In addition, women are released from their household working. Normally, women are responsible for the meals preparation. They spend less time to make meals depend on kitchen machines as well as the way to cook is simpler and easier. It means that they have opportunity to do more important things for their career. Really, nowadays women have more successful, they play important role in many big companies and corporations.

Finally, young people have more time to enjoy the time. In stead of spending more time for meals, they can use their time to do social activities, to go to the cinema, to read interesting books, to play sports. When people can do what they prefer, they will feel happy. Indeed, they have a more plentiful and better life than the previous generations.

To summarize, people simplify the way to prepare food so that they can have more time for other activities. They can do more useful and more interesting things, it improves their life.

topic: Some people say that the clothes people wear are the most important indication of what they are like. Others, however, say that people should not be judged by the clothes they wear.  Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Don't judge something from the cover, this quote means physical appearances can not describe human personality. While this notion leads some proponents to promote identifying someone from their clothes is wrong, others argue clothes mirror human's attitude since character play an important role in picking out some clothes to wear.

There is no doubt that fashion has influenced people's lives in many ways. Consequently, this becomes the main point to indicate what others are like since they believe clothes performs characteristic of some people. Evidence of this can be seen when most companies conduct an employee's enrollment. One of their assessments is clothes since the meaning of this is what candidates wear will show their performance in work. For this reason, this is going wrong since this notion gives rise to over judge and people will believe that clothes are a permanent indicator to identify human personality.

However, there are more convincing arguments in disfavor of such notion. First and foremost, it has been proven that human's personality is influenced by their decision making entire lives, not the clothes. Let takes Bob Sugino as a sample, a well-known Indonesian success person, he never wears formal clothes in their meeting albeit an important conference in which he will only wear a short since he believes clothes have not correlation with his capacity. Therefore, it will become worse if people only judge others with their suit.

In conclusion, it is evident clothes that people wear not important identification what there are like. Society must avoid this indicator since it will cause misunderstanding.

topic: Improvements in health, education and trade are essential for the development of poorer nations. However, the governments of richer nations should take more responsibilities for helping the poorer nations in such areas. Ċ To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
essay:
In this constantly developing world, the hospitals, educational institutes and a country's GDP are the factors which are considered imperative for the progress of financially weak nations. Also, the developed countries must come together to support the struggling nations in these sectors. I completely agree with the aforementioned statement and will explain why in this essay.

First of all, the progressing nations often need external assistance in the health and education fields due to the lack of expertise and funds. Therefore, the neighboring powerful countries should show interest to help them financial or strategically so they could proceed in the right direction. The USA, for instance, has established various educational institutes in North African countries and also provided them with medical aids to fight against severe diseases and pandemics. Hence, it is quite ethical to support weak neighbours by educating or improving their health facilities.

On the other hand, the flourishment of business and trade offer huge benefits in terms of job opportunities and generating revenue. In such fields, the established nations could offer low-interest loans coupled with some beneficial trade deals to help them grow rapidly. For example, Pakistan had signed various trade deals with Afghanistan after the Russian invasion to bring them on their feet, which eventually imposed a significant positive impact of their economy. Thus, slight assistance from the neighbours could increase their progression rate quite drastically.

To sum up, it is undoubtedly obvious that heath, education and business sectors are certainly the fundamental needs for a countries development; So, the developed nations should support the developing ones in these areas. Building new hospitals, providing the pieces of equipment, sharing educational structure and promoting businesses are a few steps that could be taken to help the developing neighbours.

topic: Nowadays people make new friends through social networks and internet chat groups. Some people think this is good. Others think that face-to-face interaction is essential. Ċ Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
There is a widely held perception among many people that making new friends via social networks and internet chat groups is good. Others opine that face-to-face conversations are important. While there are certainly valid arguments to the contrary, I am strongly inclined to the view that that face-to-face interactions are indeed essential and better.

On the one hand, befriending people through social networks or chat groups helps a person to get acquainted with the culture and norms of a foreign country. For instance, by using social networking platforms like Twitter or Facebook, many people have learned about different country's cultureSuggestiona different country's culture by talking to people of other countries. Moreover, chatting groups are becoming famous on the internet and with the help of this, people find a way to connect with each other through similar interests. In this way, a person's knowledge can be increased as they are being exposed to different point of views.

On the other hand, for a sociable population, it is salient that people engage in face-to-face conversations on a daily basis. In addition, using social media requires the use of a laptop or a smartphone, which can make a person follow a sedentary lifestyle and can also worsen eye health. Furthermore, one point which I believe to be absolutely pivotal is the safety concerns when using the internet to make new friends. Countless cases have been reported where people on social media lie about their identity and cheat naive people by deceiving them to meet them in real life. According to a report of the CBN, numerous ingenuous young girls have gone missing in the past 2 years because of meeting fake people on the internet.

By way of conclusion, I reaffirm my position that face-to-face interaction is fundamental. Even though making friends through social networks and internet chat groups has some perks, communicating face-to-face is safer and hence, better.

topic: News editors decide what to broadcast on television and what to print in newspapers. What factors do you think influcence these decisions? Do we become used to bad news, and would it be better if more good news was reported?
essay:
It is true that editors need to make difficult decisions which stories they broadcast or publish, and their decisions are influenced by several factors. In my opinion, we are exposed to too much bad news such that publication of more positive news should be encouraged.

There are a variety of criteria on how news editors decide on where to publish a news. Firstly, they usually try to match the content of the story with the interest of their audience. For example, news on bank robbery is not an interesting topic for young people, therefore the might decide to publish this on newspaper which has older people as the audience. Secondly, companies with some advertisement budget are also having a strong influence. For instance, if there was an advertisement about a running shoe on television, broadcasting a marathon event on the same media would be a preferred decision. Lastly, some pressure from the owners who are promoting their political agenda is another consideration factor.

I think there are too much negativity have been published or displayed on majority of news outlets. For example, we read many worrying stories about crime in the neighbourhood, or we also watched news about a war that happened in another country. As a result of being exposed to these negative news, many people become less sensitive and more cynical about the world. I think it is a good idea to encourage more publication on something more positive, such as stories on volunteering program, and act of kindness. These kind of stories would bring more inspiration and hopefully help people to be more optimistic about life in general.

In conclusion, a news editor has a range of considerations when deciding what news to publish, and I would like to see more positive news over the negative stories.

topic: Some people think young people should follow the traditions of their society. Others think that they should be free to behave as individuals. Ċ Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
The people of different societies follow different sets of cultural norms. Although it is asserted by a number of folks that youngsters ought to pursue the tradition of their own community, other folks believe that children should be allowed to follow their own instinct independently. This essay will discuss why obeying behaviour patterns of own ethnic group is significant than behaving unruly.

To begin with, young generations need to be acted upon the rules and norms of a society for upholding social bondage. Since different groups of people have different sets of social rules, it is inevitable for a person to comply with the traditions of his own culture in order to preserve the unique identity of a community. For instance, Lungi, a traditional dresses of the sub-continent, is widely used in Bangladesh. Wearing this distinct cloth is a symbol of the Bengali tradition, and it is considered the identity of members of the Bengali ethnicity. Thus, children should carry on the traditions and heritage of their own culture in order to strengthen the connection with other public within a nation.

On the other hand, in the era of globalization, people often prefer to follow their own rule freely. To be more precise, as the world is becoming seemingly borderless due to the wide use of the internet and satellite, the idea of following norms and customs of a specific area is sometimes considered preposterous. To illustrate, western dresses are more popular than traditional dresses among a great number of public in Bangladesh. As such, Lungi has been gradually losing its popularity and it is sometimes thought of as a backdated dress. Therefore, individuals often choose to follow their own instinct to satisfy their needs rather than follow the rules of the ethnic group.

In conclusion, some folks claim that the customs of territory must be obeyed by the youngsters, while other publics think that children should act upon their own spirit. In my opinion, young generations should uphold the unique activities of their society so as to conserve the identity of their own community.

topic: LANGUAGE Ċ 1.	Every year several languages die out. Some people think that this is not important because life will be easier if there are fewer languages in the world. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion.
essay:
It is true that the number of the languages around the world is diminishing every year. Although, the growing popularity of English and the ease of life associated with it, makes the people think that the extinction of some smaller languages is not something to worry about, I strongly disagree with this point of view. In my opinion, the humanity faces two main negative aspects of this development, such as the cultural and the practical ones.

Firstly, there is a cultural aspect bound to the obliteration of the languages in danger, because each language is associated with a part of human culture and which presents a huge humanitarian tragedy. Moreover, every language carries own cultural code, which encrypts both a psychology and a philosophy of a nation's spirit as well as its history. For example, through the languages one can study not only the culture of a particular ethnicity, but also its economic and social achievements. As a result, when a language dies somewhere on the planet we loose a part of the human nature everywhere.

On the other hand, one cannot underestimate the practical side stemming from the usage of the single international language everywhere, such as the international trade, the economic relations, the tourism and the medicine. However, there are practical values stemming from the use of the rare languages. For instance, the US army had widely used some of the dying Indian languages to secure information processing between the army's units. Therefore, there is some practical value in keeping the disappearing languages alive.

In conclusion, even though the growing usage of English as the world's lingua Franca has many positive effects on the people's life, it is very important to preserve the smaller languages. The extinction of some minor languages worsens the world civilization and deprives it from many practical benefits.

topic: Ielts Writing task 2: colour Topic: Psycologists have known for many years that colour can affect how people feel. so attention should be given to colour schemes when decorating places such as offices and hospitals. How true is this statement? How far does colour influence people's health and capacity for work?
essay:
Nowadays, colour plays such a huge role in our emotional lives, from our living places to social contexts. this essay will discuss the colour affections out side of domestic lives, particularly in places such as offices and hospitals.

From my business perspective, people have been aware of the impact of colour on employees and customers. Some of the most successful companies like Facebook or Google are famous with the relaxed shades offices where the decorations in every contexts are suitable for innovative and effective atmosphere. If employees worked in an office that has too many and inapropriate colours or patterns on the walls, they would hardly pay attention and then make their work unproductive. Additionally, visitors and customers may be too curious with the colours surroundings them to focus on what they are looking for. As the result, an creative and efficient colours' place would be ideal work contexts for everyone.

Similarly, hospital colours codes are also conducted strictly to enhance patient's health. Bright colours would be less acceptable on a hospital ward, where patients are trying to recover from operations and sickness. In fact, relaxing colours are decorated such as pastels in order to create a cozy peaceful and energetic room for resting. On the other hand, children's room in hospital areas are likely to need some forms of entertainment; a wall that have nice pictures and posters in oranges and bright red. Also, doctors and nurses might prefer brighter surroundings when they take a break from work.

In conclusion, colours have a direct link to our feelings and It is vital to design our surrounding lives that the occupants could be able to have their best.

topic: When choosing a job, the salary is the most important consideration. Ċ To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
The most crucial aspect of picking a career is debatable. Many people believe that compensation is the most vital aspect, needs to consider. This essay will discuss why I oppose that the wage is not entirely the most important factor. This essay will discuss what the essential is.

The importance of earnings in many cases, on the one hand, is deniable. Necessitating to provide for families and paying bills, earning a decent income seems inevitable. making enough money for any parent, indeed, would be significant because of providing for their children. Therefore, considering salary could be one of the indispensables while choosing an occupation. Some individuals, additionally, may want to experience a magnificent luxury life, for that they may consider the compensation the only factor of any jobs to achieve to their intention. Nonetheless, this is not the case for everyone, as individuals preferences could vary.

On the other hand, a wide range of factors should be measured for choosing an occupation. Undoubtedly, having a good life is related to what career an individual has. Thus picking the right career is more than just salary since a person spends a majority of daily time on that profession. it would not be appropriate if someone had to bear too much pressure on his job, even with a considerable wage, As this has detrimental effects not only physical but also mental. Only income, plus, might not be everyone goal to choose or commence work. Perhaps, many people may choose to work for different purposes. People who work for charity could be an excellent sample, which in this case, income is not the issue. in my perspective, there are crucial sides other than wage should be considered

In conclusion, as the primary reasons mentioned, although the salary might be considered the most vital aspect of selecting a job, this is only one of which, should be viewed as much as other essential aspects and I disagree with it.

topic: In many countries, the proportion of elderly people is increasing steadily. Does this trend have more positive than negative effects on society?
essay:
Currently, the population of the old keeps a steady rise among countries, particularly in the affluent countries. From my perspective, this is a positive trend for our society.

Apparently, the government has more flexible money if the pressure of the old remains steady. This is because the authorities can dedicate more funds to improving other infrastructure facilities, ranging from schools meeting people's basis right of receiving education to museums where people feel relax after the stiff competitions in the society, instead of senior houses. In this way, the level of citizens' quality is enhanced greatly, which benefits in building the knowledge-based society.

Furthermore, as the percentage of retirees grow gradually, the pressure the government shoulders relieves to a larger extent. Every year, the new born rate of the world increases dramatically, thus making the society difficult to assume the huge population stress. If more elderly people appear, it would pose a grave threat to the immature well-fare system in the society as a whole. What can be more disturbing is to contribute to instability on society.

Beyond that, the gradual increase percentage of the old is a positive sign for an ever-lasting society. Only if the medical care of a society are developing shiftily will more people prolong their life span and lower the rate of becoming old as well. Therefore, such society should be drawn on, playing a model role among others.

In conclusion, the elder population which remains a steady increase rate in many countries is positive phenomenon in terms of the limited funds, pressure and image of the government.

topic: packaging waste problem Do you think consumers should avoid over packaged products or it is the responsibility of the producer to avoid extra packaging of products?" Give your views or any relevant example with your own experience.
essay:
Whether or not to shy away from over packaged products has always been a controversial topic. I personally believe that producers shall not take on the responsibility regarding over packaging and the consumers should continue buying this type of product. Therefore, I will be pleased to discuss two reasons behind this belief and then support them with my personal examples.

First of all, most of packages these days are recyclable, therefore there is no point to stop purchasing overly packaged products. This is not at all surprising, considering that an increasing number of individual people attempt to promote sustainability; consequently, most packages can be recycled anyway. For example, when I walk into my grocery stores, most of the items that I end up purchasing always has a recycling symbol on them.

Apart from products being recyclable, by over packaging a certain product, it will most likely be well protected which is what most consumers are looking for; no one wants their products to become defective due to lack of packaging. This is especially important to picky, detailed customers as most of them expect the products to be perfect and be delivered safely to their homes. For example, I always end up with defective items as the manufacturer does not package their products properly.

Having discussed the importance of over packaging products, it can be concluded that both consumers and producers should not be against overly packaged products as they are recyclable and well protected. Consequently, I disagree with the statement above.

topic: Nowadays many people choose to be self-employed, rather than to work for a company or organization. Ċ Why might this be the case? Ċ What could be the disadvantages of being self-employed?
essay:
Jobs play a vital role in the survival of people. At present, more and more individuals prefer self-employment compared to working for an employer. In this essay, I would be discussing the reasons why this is the case, as well as the downsides of self-sustaining jobs.

Those working as freelancers have more control of their schedules. For example, a mother of two is working as a fit-out contractor wherein she accepts renovation projects as a source of income and inspects the sites only once a week. As a result, she gets to attend to her children and spend more time with them because she does not have a hectic schedule. In addition, they do not have the liability to report to supervisors since they are their own bosses. Consequently, there is no one to police them.

However, being self-employed does have drawbacks. First, there is the fear of not earning enough money for survival. For instance, an employed graphic artist will receive his or her full salary every end of the month, compared to a freelancer who will earn depending on the number of projects he commissions. Second, the expenses like space rental, transportation, government contributions, and utility bills are solely covered by the owner. Lastly, work is not stable since they are project-dependent.

In conclusion, a proportion of people are more inclined to self-employment than being a regular employee. This might be due to the fact that they have more freedom. Moreover, there is no assurance of sustainable earnings.

topic: At the present time, the population of some countries includes a relatively large number of young adults, compared with the number of of older people. Ċ Do the advantages of this situation outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
Nowadays, there are more adolescents than adults in certain countries. Personally, I believe this situation offers more benefits because young people are more productive and healthy as opposed to the older generation.

First and foremost, having more young ones than adults means a more productive nation. Unlike adults who are usually frail and meagre in strength, the younger individuals are full of energy and thus able to perform more than them. Today, most of the wealthy countries have a higher population of adolescents because these contribute to the output of the nation more than the other group does. For example, The United Kingdom is known for its strong economy on the global market due to the fact that young people contribute greatly to make this possible. This is why it is advantageous to have a country's population full of such-like ones. I too fully concur with this notion.

Secondly, young people contribute to a healthy and strong nation. Today, it is a global problem to spend more money on healthcare ,especially for the elderly, yet with the majority of the population being that of adolescents who are fit and healthy, any country can stand strong healthwise with very little expenditure on health. For instance, in a survey conducted on the benefits of having a healthy and younger generation, it was determined that a youth helps in halting the spread of infectious diseases since he possesses a very strong immunity. Therefore, young people are a precious gem to any country especially if they make up the majority of the population.

By way of conclusion,I reaffirm my stance that it is more advantageous to have more young people than adults because they contribute to a healthy and productive nation. Hence, it means fewer expenses for the government.

topic: Prompts: Without capital punishment (the death penalty) our lives are less secure and crimes of violence increase. Capital punishment is essential to control violence in society. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
essay:
To execute or not to execute, to me, is like to be or not to be. This is a question. However, I, as a human being, believe capital punishment should be banned for three reasons below.

Firstly, from a perspective of social morality, death penalty should be banned. The protection of human lives, freedom, properties and such rights is the main purpose of organizing a government. Consequently, it is governments' obligation to protect their citizens' lives but not deprive them.

Secondly, from a perspective of social deviant behavior, death penalty should be abolished. A tit-for-tat strategy, comparing to a pay-back-in-kind strategy, would impact the young generation adversely. By paying back an eye for an eye, we might stick our lives in a vicious circle. Conversely, when we embrace kindness and goodness toward others, we are capable to have better lives. Furthermore, how can we condemn an unfeeling murderer exploiting people's lives while we are doing the same thing?

Thirdly, from a perspective of healing, death penalty should be abrogated. Some revenge-focused individuals consider that nothing is going to change unless they finally kill the person who has killed their beloved ones. On the contrary, revenge will never cure the grief and emptiness of a lost loved one. What is more, revenge is useless in that it does not bring the victim back to life. The truth is that forgiveness is the only way to start the healing process.

In summary, even though people hold various viewpoints toward death penalty, taking social morality, social deviant behavior and healing process into account, I am still for banning death penalty.

topic: Today people are surrounded by advertising. This affects what people think is important and has a negative impact on people’s lives. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Advertising can be all around us in many different forms nowadays. In my opinion, it is partially true that it has some advantages. However, I agree that it could bring along more of the disadvantages. This essay will elaborate on my point of view.

In this modern world, there are plenty of offers of products and services that brought high competition in the market. Thus, creating more channels for advertising such as using digital ads and social media, online reviews or macro-micro influencers, has become crucial in business development in order to reach more customers and turn their interest into purchasing. While these actions would only help the business owners with increasing their product reach and their revenues, their downsides are inevitably pushed to consumers.

As aforementioned, to get customers’ focus, the marketers tend to design their commercial to be as splendid as possible which is also mean the least flaws they would provide. For example, restaurants are likely to state in the menu with a tiny font saying that the picture is only for advertising to disguise customer about the portions or how it looks, or supplement sellers hiring a TV star to be the face of the product to gain more liability while it does not actually meet the standard of the Ministry of Health as frequently seen in the news. Just as if the advertising is depended only on the morality and credibility of the business owners. As a result of not reaching all the essential information, the consumers could be harmed from misusing the product or wasting money on what they do not actually expect.

In conclusion, I agree that the increase of advertising format might benefit the producers but it cannot outweigh the disadvantages of the consumers that have to face in purchasing products and services.

topic: Opinions about innovative developments Topic: Some people say that modern innovations bring a lot of problems than benefits, do you agree or disagree ?
essay:
The controversial consequences of innovative developments are recently under the spotlight of society. While there are some strong arguments that they affect our life in different negative ways, I support the view that the benefits of technological advances far outweigh their drawbacks.

It is undeniable that technology breakthroughs, such as the manufacturing machines of next generation that installed in warehouses across the world, cause an increasing unemployment rate among blue collar workers. However, I would argue they accelerate the transformation of society and in turn improve the quality of life in the long term. Take the same example, sophisticated machinery perform much better than human in areas where the accuracy is the priority. Careless mistakes in calculation can be avoid, and at the same time, they save us from labour-intensive exercises and let us concentrate on essential creative tasks.

Alongside advanced computational capabilities, innovations in the field of communication open a new world of opportunities. Thanks to modern connecting software pioneers like Slack and Zoom, a great number of employees manage to work remotely yet together and companies keep operating during the lockdown period. Another obvious example is the popularity of online learning, some first-class universities are able to offer online courses through Coursera with the help of communication and real-time date transmission technology. They triumph geological boundaries and encourage handicapped group and even full-time staff continue self-development anytime, anywhere.

In conclusion, innovative technology certainly has a problematic aspect, I still believe that it is beneficial rather than bewildering from the perspective of humanity and society.

topic: Modern lifestyles are completely different from the way people lived in the past. Some people think the changes have been very positive, while others believe they have been very negative. Discuss both these points of view and give your own opinion
essay:
The importance of modernization, which was always debatable has now become more controversial, with a plethora of people claiming that it is beneficial while others reject this notion. The substantial influence of this trend has sparked controversy over the potential impact in recent years till the end. In my opinion, today's lifestyle has adverse facets. This proposition appears to be more rational. This essay will further elaborate on both the beneficial and adverse effects of this trend and thus will lead to a logical conclusion.

Analyzing the statement and explaining further, the first and foremost reason behind this is that electrical devices made human beings live more comfortable and easier than ever before. To illustrate, smart devices allow users to communicate overseas merely in a matter of seconds, which was a difficult task a few years back. Another benefit is that advanced transportation facilities save time and reduce the risk of an accident while driving, with enormous development in the transport sector. Needless to say, all these merits stand in good stead.

However, there are a number of pitfalls that negate these arguments that humans are totally addicted to smartphones, which directly affects their mental stability and physical aspects such as depression and bad eyesight. Besides, people are replaced with machines due to high-tech innovations, which increase the unemployment rate and poverty. Similarly, the radiation emitted by mobile phones harms flora and fauna as well. Hence, it is apparent why numerous are against this trend.

To recapitulate, according to the arguments aforementioned above, one can reach a conclusion that the benefits of modernization are instrumental indeed. Nevertheless, its potential drawbacks should not be overlooked either.

topic: The media pay too much attention to the lives and relationships of celebrities such as actors, singers or footballers. They should spend more time reporting the lives of ordinary people instead.  To what extent do you agree or disagree
essay:
Prominent people such as actors, singers or footballers are more prestige to become news objects than an ordinary person for the journalists. I tend to disagree with these notions. Whereas, celebrities are more important, but unwell-known citizens must be attention by media.

The lives of inhabitants should not be ignored by news hunter. It is because information about the condition of them will become a picture of community of citizens in a nation, and it will make other people know what problem that they have, and also what solution that able to give for them. For example, the improvement of quality life of inhabitants in Flores, Indonesia after media reported about clean water issue in that place. As a result, many donors help to build water transport system in Flores. Although, this information is important to know people conditions in other places, but celebrities news are more essential.

Celebrity life is attractive news for citizens. Artists, singers, and football players are public figures for society.Thus, it more crucial to update about their recent information. It is because all of people know about them, and ordinary people also put their attention to those well-known persons. Taking Raffi Ahmad who an Indonesia artist as an example. The television program about his household and daily live has highest rating of viewer than other television shows. This is a proof that media and also viewer put much their attention to his live.

To sum up, media never ignore information of famous celebrities like actors, singer, or footballers. I believe, news about them more fascinating than about ordinary people lives although it also important to report news about common inhabitants.

topic: One problem faced by almost every larger city is traffic congestion. What do you think the causes are? What solutions can you suggest?
essay:
The vast majority of the population deems that traffic congestion is composed of the essential issues of vibrant cities. In addition, some people claim that local governments should concern about this trouble. I advocate strongly with both statements and am going to reflect on this essay my own view of such a common issue and to provide possible solutions to resolve it.

On the one hand, it can be spotted that this tendency of an increase in the number of cars across the city triggers multiple repercussions. Also noteworthy is that the core ramification of traffic congestion consists of air pollution. A more detailed look at this trouble affords the population to infer some reasons for it. First of all, a large number of people embark to live in the urban area, rather than in the rural. Hence, the swelling population in capitals or other cities provoke a rise in the purchase of various vehicles such as automobiles or motorcycles. Secondly, a person in the city receives a sufficient wage in order to buy a novice car. Therefore, the spike in the number of cars in the city has a huge impact on traffic congestion.

On the other hand, this issue should take under control by the state departments. For instance, the number of drivers can be restricted throughout some hours, especially during the peak hours in the morning and in the evening. Furthermore, the government may be provided regulations or limitations, which must keep by citizens. Nevertheless, some cities, for example, Los Angels, have involved these solutions because of the serious situation with traffic and pollution overall.

To summarise, I would stress that I suggest definitely the main statement and my arguments confirm this. Nonetheless, a driver must decide upon for himself how his use of a car can be so dreadful for the local environment.

topic: Increasing the price of petrol is the best way to solve the growing the traffic and pollution problems. To what extent do you agree or disagree? What other measures do you think might be effective?
essay:
Currently, the growing traffic issues and pollution problems are severe in some big cities like Beijing and Shanghai. According to a survey, the average time length spent on the road to work has reached nearly three hours for an individual in Beijing. Therefore, the authority raises a lot measures to control the serious conditions, one of the methods is to improve the price of petrol. As far as I am concerned, there is little correlation between the pollution issues and the petrol consuming by normal citizens. Some other methods may work well.

It is no doubt that the rising price of gasoline has exerted some positive effects on the control of traffic problems. Increasing number of residents prefer to work by public transportation, considering that driving private cars induces a large financial output. At the same time ,the air is getting cleaner with less vehicles on roads. However, it is a problem for the employees whose houses are far from the working locations, because taking subways with a fixed line can be time wasting. They would prefer a private drive for convenience regardless of the spending on the gasoline. Look from this perspective, the rise of petrol cannot solve all the problems which we meet at present. Some comprehensive measurements should be implemented.

At present, the state implements some other measures to constrain the booming traffic, such as improving the identifying level of purchasing vehicles and odd-even traffic restrictions. In this way a large number of cars are limited to be driven on roads. The contamination problems get remission at the same time.

To sum up, the select of increasing the price of petrol has its advantages. But ,it is not the best way to reach a satisfied target. Some other measures like odd-even traffic restrictions should be implemented simultaneously.

topic: The internet has greatly increased our access to information. To what extent do you think this is a good thing? Ċ Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
Advances in technology bring so much ease to activities on a daily basis. Nowadays, the use of the web has been on the increase globally and notably, it has enhanced the ability to obtain data. I strongly believe it's positive influence and this essay will explore the reasons why the trend has my backing.

To begin with, the internet has made the acquisition of information very simple. Prior to the advancement in technology, in order to get the desirable knowledge, you needed to navigate through different catalogues in the library gathering books. Even though, sometime a library may not solve the problem because many more textbooks might be needed, which may not be present in the same library. Nevertheless, these days with the help of the web, you need not to have much stress to get what he wants. For example, I stay in the comfort of my room, have some clicks of the mouse and get the details that I want without much Ado.

On the other hand, some critics argue that the proliferation in the use of the internet has caused health hazards such as eyestrain. Particularly, it could be true as greater number of people focus too much attention looking at LCD screens of desktop and smart phones with little consideration on their health. For instance, 3 optometrist friends of mine have reported massive increase in the number of patients with computer vision syndrome. Nonetheless, it should not pose much problem because there are adequate measures available that, if taken, will limit any adverse risk on the eye, these include protective eye wares that limit or block ultraviolet blue lights that are emitted by LCD screens.

In summary, the web has been of great importance by making information easily accessible to us, although there could be drawbacks in its usage, such as too much exposure of harmful Rays to the eye, but such demerits can be absolutely taken care of and shouldn't be of too much concern.

topic: Women should have an equal role alongside men in both police and armed forces. To what extend do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Females should be given the same representation as males in the cops and military tasks. I partially agree with this statement. In this essay, I will highlight how women can demonstrate significant performance in the army and also discuss the contrary side to it.

To begin with, firstly, both genders are equally intelligent. Though the anatomy of the boy is comparatively fit for roles that involve fighting, running and displaying strength, it only applies to the major public. Secondly, Some women are exceptionally stronger than guys. To illustrate, Karnam Malleshwari from India won a gold medal for the country in weight lifting. She outperformed the record set by other male contestants during the Olympics. Therefore, exceptional people like Karnam Malleshwari can equally perform in attack and defence teams or sometimes outperform them too.

Conversely, not all ladies can comply with the specifications of some operations that involve physical power. In such scenarios, tweaking the rules to fit them in these tasks could be counter-productive. In addition, when it comes to jobs that involve saving people and society, equal representation should be the last concern. topic: Task2 : More and more families have computers in their homes, and children spend a great deal of their time using their home computers. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this situation and give you own opinions.
essay:
Nowadays, South Koreans' most families have their home computers, thereby many children affect by it from very young age. The children could use it as a toy, listening a song and drawing pictures instead of on a paper that it has increasingly changed for the last a decade. In the past, a lot of children used to play outside with their friends, but today, they prefer to spend their free time at home and be alone with the computers. Whether the computer has fundamentally beneficial influence on them, or it has detrimental effect, many people believe that computer is an essential item which they must have.

First of all, the computer may be not only electric equipment, especially, the internet introduced to us many years ago. The children are not necessary to get help from their parents while they are doing home works, because they could find informations of school works anytime on the internet with the computers. It is more convenience and does not need time consuming to go to the library

Even though, the computer are using in a positive way, some people insist that the computers have negative side for the children. Almost half of the children who have used the computer, they show that have addicted to playing computer's games and watching programs on the internet. When their parents are tried to stop them, they may show such an anger toward their parents and do not want to change their habbits. In addition, they easily connected to web-sites which is only for adults, it could seriously damage their brains and childhoods.

In conclusion, it seems that using computer is necessary in many ways, but disadvantage is stronger than advantage. I strongly recommend that the parents should not allow the children to spend time with the computers alone and make some strict rules of using it.

topic: Increasing the price of petrol is the best way to solve growing traffic and pollution problems. Ċ To what extent do you agree or disagree? Ċ What other measures do you think might be effective?
essay:
It is argued that the best method to tackle the problem of increasing the rate of traffic jams and pollution is adjusting the price of petrol. I strongly agree with this statement although there might be other metrics to overcome these problems that will be elaborated on in the following paragraphs.

Air pollution and gridlocks are two main problems that are related to the low cost of petrol in the vast majority of countries. In my opinion, this is the most constructive policy that decision-makers can make. To begin with, it is highly likely to derive commuters to utilize public transport and other environmentally-friendly means of transportation like bicycles. It may bring about reducing the use of private cars that leads to reduce air pollution and gridlocks. In addition, when petrol price goes up, taxi fairs soar that are bound to cause a significant fall in the rate of passengers who have used taxies as the main means of transportation, just due in no small part to its cheap fairs. For example, third world countries that are a rich source of fuel fossils, like Iran, are imposing severe pressure on the private taxi sector to increase the rate of fares.

On the other hand, other methods of tackling these problems are by no means negligible. Firstly, pricing policies might be imposed on using private vehicles. To illustrate more, pricing will be a proper scenario to reduce vehicles in crowded spots of cities and as a result, traffic jams will be disappeared. Secondly, importing electrical automobiles or developing infrastructures to produce more electric cars during each year might be another alternative. These vehicles are more likely to dramatically sink the releasing amount of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere. Similarly, t can result in reducing air pollution by using renewable energies. For instance, ‘Tesla’ company is a real pioneer in protecting our environment by using electrical powerful engines in lieu of diseal ones.

In conclusion, It is true that adjusting petrol cost will be the main reason for having high-quality air condition and streets with low traffic volumes.

topic: Many people are optimistic of the 21st century and see it as an opportunity to make positive changes to the world. To what extent do you share their optimism? Ċ What changes would you like to see in the new century?
essay:
It is undeniable that the world is developing rapidly, so that people’s quality of life has improved enormously over the decades. Remarkable factors for this change are due to upmarket infrastructure, advanced medical facilities, and various prospects taken by the government to boost people’s living standards. However, some people believe, artificial intelligence (AI) results of the Industrial Revolution may even conquer people’s daily function. I strongly concur with this thought, that the quality of life has grown when compared to centuries ago, which will be discussed in the following passage.

Firstly, as several upmarket infrastructures are being introduced and implemented, people’s lives are much easier and convenient. For example, public transport inevitably improves the current problems of traffic congestion and pollution. Modern, latest, speedy public transport will help to stimulate people using them more. Meanwhile, the government should cooperate with other medical-related organizations, to construct and invent further functional medical facilities. As they upgrade the infrastructure, equipment, and services of hospitals, more people will have the chance to be treated by expertise doctors with the help of advanced technology. For instance, people all around the world are hoping that scientists and doctors would discover a final cure for COVID-19.

On the flip side, numerous people are concerned with the implementation of artificial intelligence in the Industrial Revolution and daily activities. For example, robots tend to become a powerful alternative for an assembly line instead of ordinary workers. As a result, there will be a sharp increase in the unemployment rate. Moreover, the application of AI in a robot vacuum is likely to turn people to become lazy and lack of basic skills such as doing chores at their own houses.

In conclusion, despite some downsides that the modern future may bring, it is reasonable to know that people are yearning for brighter and fulfilled upcoming days. Additionally, we are about to be benefited from top-notch infrastructure, higher-level medical aid together with proper avail the usefulness of AI.

topic: Some people think that instead of preventing climate change, we need to find a way to live with it. To what extend do you agree?
essay:
In recent years, climate change has represented a threat to the existence of life on the planet Earth. However, some people argue that humans should stop deterring temperature variations and attempt to adapt to them. I completely disagree with this argument because I believe in the necessity to fight this crisis and in the drastic consequences that can take place if this problem is left to exacerbate. Thus, in this essay, I will illustrate my point of view thoroughly.

Governments should find solutions to the climate change crisis through strict measures. The paramount governmental action should be legislating strict laws that keep the environment safe. These laws should impose green taxes on drivers, airline companies and other polluters to reduce the imitation of carbon dioxide. Furthermore, governments should invest in renewable energy production from solar, wind or water power. The Netherlands, for instance, has succeeded to encourage its citizens to depend on solar power in homes and on the wind in agriculture. If these measures are taken by most of the world’s countries, humans will be able to deter this phenomenon from destroying the human race’s existence.

On the contrary, if this issue is left to exacerbate, the consequences will be disastrous. More natural catastrophes such as floods, tycoons, wildfires and tsunamis will take place. These catastrophes will continue killing people and destroying wildlife and infrastructure. Moreover, countries will spend a tremendous amount of money to find homes and jobs for individuals who are forced to migrate to nearby cities. According to Joe Biden’s speech on climate change at the end of 2020, the natural disasters that occurred in the past decade has cost the American administration two billion dollars. Therefore, leaving this natural crisis without a solution could lead to worse results than trying to ignore it or live with it.

In conclusion, in my opinion, administrations should address the climate change catastrophe because it is impossible to secure the human race’s existence on Earth by adapting to the drastic repercussions of it. Thus, countries should allocate efforts and funds to prevent this dilemma from intensifying.

topic: 'Telecommuting' refers to workers doing their job from home for part of each week and communicating with their office using computer technology. Telecommuting is growing in many countries and is expected to be common for most office workers in the coming decades. How do you think society will be affected by the growth of telecommuting?
essay:
The massive popularity of telecommuting which provides simplicity for employees to carry out their works at home and to communicate the office thingy from computer is forecast to increase in the future. This circumstance is likely to change the technological and social lifestyle towards public in general.

To begin with, the uplifting interest of telecommuting emerges several alterations in people's daily life. Every single activity is presumably near by the development of sophisticated technology in order to undertake the job. Workers, moreover, will have a wide range of choices to opt the most suitable and convenient place to finish the tasks since they do it at their home. As a result, a vast majority of people will switch some ways of living with the new trends.

The predominant effects from telecommuting and changing daily life could be vary including merits and demerits. Due to the familiarising of technology, the detrimental impact comes since people could utilise computerisation into crime such as hacking and cyber-crime. However, there is still an upside in which the result in workloads in going to be better due to the fact that convenience of working places is controlled by employers' autonomous decision. Therefore, mood and spirit of carrying out tasks are always elevated into the maximum point that encourages effectiveness.

In conclusion, while that way of working is changing, other aspects of lives will be affected as well. New working methods of telecommunicating, therefore, generate several beneficial and detrimental effects for a myriad of society.

topic: Every year several languages die out. Some people think that this is not important because life will Ċ be easier if there are fewer languages in the world. Ċ To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
essay:
There are more than ten thousand different linguists around the world. I believe that the world may be benefitted with less languages, while I agree that they represent heritage of a nation should be preserved.

There are some advantages of speaking fewer language. Firstly, there may be minimum difficulty in understanding each other. As a result, the flow of trade will be smooth across the border and businesses will flourish, further accelerating globalisation. There will be a few hurdles for a local trader to expand globally. For instance, In India, there are more than a thousand local languages, which may act as a barrier for international businesses to promote their products, hence with a limited dialect it will be convenient for investor to communicate and understand the needs of the people. Secondly, it may boost immigration. In other words, one of the main problems of migration is to understand the words spoken by local people, which can be mitigated with limited dialect.

On the other hand, many ancient linguistic spoken globally has their own history and tradition attached to it which are followed for decades. This means that with extinction of it, many cultures will also be forgotten. Furthermore, many new words are derived from old literature. For example, many of the English words, spoken across the border, are derived from Sanskrit, which is not slowly phasing out from the world.

In conclusion, although development is an important factor for people to succeed and have a better future, it should not be achieved by compromising the ancient language which reflects the genesis of humankind.

essay:
Some people argue that building libraries will spend money in futile way. Because everyone has home Internet, it can be used to find information. I strongly disagree since I think that libraries and Internet have different function in obtaining information. Firstly, some information does not publish public on the Internet and then much Internet information is anonymous.

Many textbooks now are archived on the Internet in which can be accessed by all people either to be free or to be paid. However, some of them is totally published only as textbook or has time to be posted online.  So that people who need that book, have to find it on the bookstore. Based on the article of New York Time Magazine that two books in agriculture field have published in textbook forms and the publisher informed that those books were not available in digital form. Therefore, people only can read them manually without any Internet access.

Besides, allocating money to establish libraries will bring benefits since people can access exact information on the books. As many people know that, some information on the internet is provided anonymously. For instance, a student found support information for his essay on Internet. It was good; unfortunately, it did not insert the author of the information. So, it cannot be a source to cite. However, when he found on the books, it would be very clear.

To draw a conclusion, I firmly disagree that library building just waste much money since certain information can only find in a book. Moreover, the information from books has an exact writer in which it is different when people cite from the internet. 274w

While the Internet offers convenience, not all information is available online, and some textbooks remain in print only, requiring physical access. Additionally, online sources may lack clear authorship, making them unreliable for citation, as seen when a student could not reference an anonymous web source but found the same information clearly attributed in a book. Although some argue that home Internet access makes libraries unnecessary, this overlooks the fact that many resources are still unavailable digitally, underscoring the continued importance of libraries.

topic: A growing number of people feel that animals should not be exploited by people and that they should have the same rights as humans, while others argue that humans must employ animals to satisfy their various needs, including uses for food and research. Ċ Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
People have different views about treatment of animals. While there are some good arguments in favour of treating animals in the same way humans are, I believe that it is better use them as we desire for food and medical research.

There are certain people in society which claim that animals should be treated fairly by human beings. The reason is they are also living creatures, and they have the same feelings like humans, such as happiness, pain, and so on. Therefore, they deserve the treatment in the right way. Moreover, killing animals for human needs may destroy the balance of nature. Because, animals have their own ways of population control and harmful human activities are not morally acceptable.

On the other hand, some individuals argue that animals are created to fulfil human needs. Firstly, animals are important as food sources. They provide people nutrition, which is essential for living. For instance, sheep are consumed because of being high in protein Secondly, animal research brings in manifold benefits for human life, especially in education. Results from animal studies are crucial for closing knowledge gaps about health and disease in both humans and animals. Understanding cell and organ function help researchers design experiments to test new treatments in people. For example, several new drugs are being tested in some mice or monkeys before they are being tested on human beings.

In conclusion, there are convincing arguments both for and against treatment of animals. However, it seems to me that animals have the same rights as humans and deserve to be treated fairly.

topic: Today, the high sales of popular consumer goods reflect the power of advertising and not the real needs of the society in which they are sold.
essay:
Today is the age of technology; media has deep influence on the life of men. Nowadays, almost every products company use media advertisements to expand their products. These advertisements attract people to buy goods; even they have no need of those things. Now it is the spark debated that advertisements are changing the lifestyle of man through many aspects. However, it depends on the man think first to purchase anything.

Nowadays, products makers hire big advertising companies to promote their merchandise. However, these advertising companies organise advertisements in such a pretty way that attract people, specially adults to purchase those goods without need of that. Now, companies use actors and film stars to play a role in advertisements to offer merchandise in an attractive way. In this way, adults want to buy those things which are presented by their favourite celebrities. Similarly, food and toys' companies are producing advertisements based on music and thrill. In this way, they target children to buy these goods. For example, nowadays lots of mobile advertisements are presented by famous film stars, this thing attract the youngsters to buy these products.

On the other hand, these advertisements have negative impacts on society to some extent. Advertisements motivate adults to buy unnecessary things and in some situations it is difficult for parents to fulfil their desires. Similarly, many people can afford these unnecessary things and show off their things. In addition, it has negatively affected others mind. However, it is the responsibility of people realise the things which are necessary for them.

It is concluded that it is the man dependence to purchase things and advertisements have no effects. However, in the case of children it is difficult for parents to control them. It is the duty of government to ban such advertisements which exploit the society.

abstractive_summary: Advertisements significantly influence human lifestyles in the modern technological age, shaping consumer behavior through pervasive media campaigns. Companies widely use attractive advertising strategies, often featuring celebrities and thrilling content, to entice people—especially adults and children—into purchasing unnecessary products. These tactics particularly target youngsters, making it difficult for parents to manage demands and leading to social pressures and financial strain. While some argue that individuals should exercise personal responsibility in distinguishing needs from wants, the strong psychological appeal of advertisements, especially on children, challenges this view. Given their societal impact, there is a growing call for governments to regulate ads that exploit consumer vulnerabilities and promote excessive consumption.

topic: Due the advancement in computer technology the trend of working from home will bring a dramatic change to people’s lives. Is it a positive or negative development? Ċ Give your opinion and examples.
essay:
These days, the world is developing faster than before, and advanced technology has changed the planet since recent decades. In this regard, modern people are willing to work at home, as it offers convenient and comfortable for the employees. While some people believe that it can bring positive outcomes to the job market, others feel that due to working from household the greatest number of people cannot get the job-satisfaction. Personally, I believe that working through the internet is a positive trend.

On the one hand, it is true that this trend can be a positive one. Due to digital technologies, there is no need to spend a lot of time in the buses and cabins in order to get the workplace. Furthermore, this tendency will give the employees, many opportunities such as flexible working hours, convenience and the chance to spend time with family. For instance, the average time for getting to the workplace is two hours. That is to say, many individuals are keen to waste their two hours every day, and working through the internet give the chance to not waste these hours.

On the other hand, some people may accuse this tendency. They believe that if there is not face-to-face communication, consequently, the job-satisfaction will not be. Moreover, in many cases, some customers do not believe the internet commercial organizations because of the high risk of fraud. For instance, staying at home can negatively affect the employees, as working from household not give many possibilities to demonstrate the skills and abilities. In this case, many ambitious people can suffer from these trends.

In conclusion, although many people believe that not visiting the workplace will affect the world negatively, personally, in my opinion, I believe that these changes have many advantages too. However, the most important thing is regulating these tendencies in the right direction.

topic: These days, we are seeing an increasing amount of violence on TV, and this is having a negative impact on children's behaviour. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Nowadays, the number of violent programs on television is increasing rapidly. There are those who say that could affect negatively how children behave. In my opinion, children should be restricted from watching violence on television due to its pessimistic impacts.

First of all, television with violent shows or channels could easily affects children's characteristics, since they are still at ages of discovering themselves and shaping their own personalities. For example, a small boy often watches movies which include lots of fight-scenes. As a consequence, those action somehow lead him to similar thoughts and behaviour. He then may become aggressive and stubborn, eventhough he used tobe a good-natured boy.

Secondly, it is a truth that children tend to imitate a lot of things they see. And this does not except for violence on television which they watch everyday. As children are not mature and knowledgeable enough to control their mind and manage their orientation, they might feel interested in anything and want to try it once. In many situations, that caused serious problems. For instance, there was a group of teenagers who were arrested as robbers and murders. The point here is that thay said they did this after watching an action film, and they even did not know killing someone is committing crime. It sounds unbelieveable but it happened.

To conclude, for the purpose of satisfying people who are fond of adventure, horror, or detective, more and more violent contents are being performed on television today. But in cases of audiences who are children, those programs really have a lot of disadvantages which affect their behaviour. If adults continue allowing children to watch more violent television programs, we must be seriously worried about whether they would develop themselves the right way.

topic: When choosing a job, the salary is the most important consideration. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
When selecting a job, many people prioritise the lucrative one over the pleasant workplace environment or personal enjoyment. From my perspective, I prefer immersing myself in my dream career to living with the one with handsome salary.

On the one hand, some workers have a preference for profitable jobs as financial is a prerequisite to meet their basic needs. For example, we all need money to pay for housing, food, bills, health care, and education. Therefore, most people consider it a priority to at least earn a salary that allows them to cover these needs and have a reasonable quality of life. If people chose their jobs based on enjoyment or other non-financial factors, they might find it difficult to make ends meet. Artists and musicians, for instance, are known for choosing a career path that they love, but that does not always provide them with enough money to live comfortably and raise their family.

Nevertheless, I believe that other considerations are just as important as what we earn in our jobs. Firstly, personal relationships and the atmosphere in a workplace are extremely crucial when choosing a job. Having a good manager or friendly colleagues, for example, can make a huge difference to workers’ levels of happiness and general quality of life. Secondly, many people’s feelings of job satisfaction come from their professional achievements, the skills they learn, and the position they reach, rather than the payment they earn. Finally, some people choose a career because they want to help others and contribute something positive to society.

To conclude, it is obvious that salaries certainly affect people’s choice of profession. However, I do not believe that wage outweighs all other factors.

topic: In the past, most people lived in small villages where everyone knew everyone else. Nowadays, most people live in large cities where they only know a few people in their area.  what do you think were the advantages and disadvantages of living in a small community?
essay:
These days, some people live in big cities where they have just a little communication with others, whilst in the past, people who lived in the small villages communicated with every person in their area. Therefore, I would argue that the benefits of this trend outweigh the drawbacks.

On the positive side, people living in small community are easy to remember each other. This is because the number of people is not as much as in big cities, so they may be able to interact well with everyone in their regions. For instance, when there is a disaster in the village, the chief can recognize the citizens to be evacuated from one area to another area by checking his inhabitant lists. Therefore, the small community creates people to be solid one another. In addition, citizens can have a good cooperation with others such cleaning village together.

However, a negative side in the small community is that the citizens will keep away from the other people outside their community. For example, when there is a visitor comes to their area, the local people usually prevent to make an interaction because visitors may be able to bring different culture from other regions, so the genuine culture in the small community decreases gradually. Consequently, it is hard for the people to update their information such as technology communication, medicine when it comes to living in the countryside.

To sum up, although there is a drawback of living in small community, it is evident that people are closer one another by having a good cooperation and kinship relationship in the same area.

topic: The percentage of overweight children in western countries has increased by almost 20% in the last ten years. Discuss the causes and effects of this disturbing trend.
essay:
Obesity in western countries' kids can be seen commonly and is quickly increasing from last decade. This essay intends to discuss the reasons behind this alarming situation as well as its effects.

To begin with, the root cause of obesity in children is due to bad eating habits. Kids these days do not like protein or fibre rich meal as they are tasteless and they run after the fast-food corners to eat spicy and less-nutrient cuisine items. The junk foods contain more fat than nutrition, thus, casts a bad effect on children's fitness. Another reason for obese children is lack of parent support as young ones do not have culinary skills and they seek their parents to get something to eat and guardians because of lack of time can not take care of their kid's meal schedule, so, children go out and get in touch with junk food.

This obesity casts its detrimental consequences on kids. Due to lack of proper nutrition, children get more prone to health problems such as cholesterol or heart-related diseases. For instance, researchers have shown the data of adults having more health problems who were obese since their childhood than those who were fit and fine. Another bad effect is on a child's intellectual abilities starts declining as these nutrition-less snacks do not produce enough energy for the brain to work activity instead they make a child fat and passive.

In conclusion, these sugary and fast food corners made children obese and less active in terms of physically and mentally.

topic: Some people think that a sense of competition in children should be encouraged. Others believe that children who are taught to co-operative rather than compete become more useful adults. Ċ Discuss both views and give yours own opinion.
essay:
Few individuals contend that students must develop competitive attitudes to excel in their future endeavours. Whereas opponents advocate that they should learn co-operation rather than a skill to defeat their counterparts. I will shed light on both viewpoints and I am in the favour of health competitions.

To begin with, there are many positives of having a sense of surpassing each other in the school. Children do hard work to compete with their peers in studies that ultimately improve the overall standard of education. For instance, if classmates want to beat their colleagues' performance, they need more diligence which enhances the grades of the whole class. Moreover, young ones are learning an important skill in order to excel in the highly competitive world. As they have to face challenges in the future where they will have to exhibit their individualism.

On the contrary, there are enormous benefits of seeking co-operation instead of competition. First and foremost, cooperative people are more sympathetic who care about others in spite of harming them for their victory. Secondly, this phenomenon can bring harmony to the already polarized world which would decrease the chances of dangerous wars among rival nations. For example, the leaders who are brought up in a cooperative environment can negotiate with their opponents for the give and take so that fatal conflicts can be avoided.

In conclusion, I believe that even though the attitudes of co-operation are pivotal to minimize differences in society, constructive competitions are equally important for social and economic development. Educators should focus on both strategies so that a fine balance should be maintained.

topic: living in a country where you have to speak a foreign languages can cause serious social problems as well as practical problems. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
essay:
People living in a foreign country for a better life and environment. Moving to a new nation where masses have different languages can cause various social and practical issues for newcomers. In my opinion, I completely agree with this perspective due to the communication difficulties and lack of knowledge about the facilities in that area.

Firstly, the good reason to explain this situation is that due to the language barrier, the conversation among people is difficult to initiate and interpret. As a result,it becomes tough to socialize with the locals. Hence,foreigners feel neglected and avoided by the residents. For instance,immigrants usually hesitate to go out because they are not capable enough to understand native speakers and do not want to become a stock of mocking material to other people.

Another reason to consider is that most of the immigrants face problems in the practical scenario.They are not familiar with different locations,so they generally suffer to find new locations. topic: increasing the price of petrol is the best way to solve growing traffic and pollution problems. Ċ to what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Intensified utilization of gasoline automobiles is the major source of contamination, observed by scientists for over 100 years. Therefore, escalating gas costs is the ideal method to resolve increasing road congestion as well as toxic waste. Hence, I entirely agree with this opinion provided that elimination of greenhouse gases is necessary.

To begin, the foremost advantage is economic benefit. With petrol prices soaring upwards, several people will adapt to walking consequently, putting less pressure on natural resources. Meanwhile, the lower amount of pollution is likely to result in a cutback of medical expenses which is beneficial for the economy. For instance, if the value of petrol is rocketed by 20%, greenhouse gases are going to reduce. This implies that in order to conserve biodiversity and the fiscal environment, we should implement the law.

The second reason is that overall well-being is improved. In other words, many humans will opt for bicycles involving cardio exercises which will speed up the blood rush improving health. For example, a recent survey conducted in 2020 in various nations demonstrated the fact that cyclists and walkers are more athletic rather than automobile users. For that reason, it is better not only for fitness but also for diminishing highway interchange.

To conclude, multiplication of worth with regard to fuel is vital to sustaining the economy and survival of living beings. In addition, there are a few other procedures such as exploiting a low amount of mineral deposits in order that future generations will be able to consume it with ease. If we make use of minerals correctly, then we will be capable of meeting the needs of the population in an enhanced way.
