topic: Every country should have a free health service, even if this means that the latest medical treatments may not be available through the service because they are too expensive. Ċ To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
It is considered by most of the people that medical services should be made free for everyone, although the advanced medical services might not be free because of their hefty cost. In my opinion, I agree that citizens should be given free medical services as it will make the nation healthy and disease-free. However, I also believe that there should be concessions given to the citizens in case of advanced medical treatments.

First of all, countries need to maintain the health of their people. Most of the countries, particularly in developing countries where people do not have enough income to get a medical check-up suffer from serious health issues. To illustrate this, India is one of the countries where people suffer from chronic diseases and severe health issues, and they are unable to get medical service owing to their poverty condition. Therefore, every individual should have access to free medical services to get the diagnosis of the disease in proper time.

However, due to the advancement in medical science, there are various types of advanced and modern treatments available these days, which show positive results within the stipulated time. Take, for example, chemotherapy, laser treatments, and radiotherapy, which are successful in curbing hazardous diseases such as cancer. These treatments are generally costly, and only those people who are financially stable can afford it. Consequently, lower-income people are not able to get proper treatment due to financial issues. Hence, even if these costly treatments can't be provided free of cost to the people, at least the government should provide medical insurance facilities or discounts so that income deprived people can afford these treatments.

To conclude, In my opinion, the government should provide essential medical services to all the citizens, and insurance facilities can be provided for expensive treatments. In this way, the country can improve the well-being of the people to maintain the happiness index.

topic: People living in large cities today face many problems in their everyday life. What are these problems? Should governments encourage people to move to smaller regional towns?
essay:
In the contemporary world, along with the urbanisation, people's lives have become more difficult with various aspects. Some of them can be named as low quality of basic amenities, space constraints and lack of social security. Following essay will discuss these difficulties in details and come to a conclusion whether the governments should take actions to promote people to live in suburban areas instead of large cities.

Firstly, lack of breathing space is one of the burning issues that residents are facing in big towns. Large crowds are living in smaller areas due to this reason and it causes pollution in the surrounding environment. The children of these families get sick all the time because of poor hygiene situations in their vicinity. Secondly, crime rates will go up in these areas by putting residents in danger. For example, juvenile delinquency will be much higher compared to other areas which are less crowded. Thirdly, the government may not be able to provide proper infrastructure in these locations such as better roads, water, electricity or better drainage systems. This will get the situation much worse as it will directly affect people's health.

The local authorities can take various actions to minimise such situations. They can take initiatives to improve important infrastructure, transportation, healthcare and education in suburban areas so urban citizens will encourage to shift out of the city with better standards. For instance, people tend to shift to regional cities to raise their children as most of them are fed up with the hectic city lives.

In conclusion, rapid growth of the urbanisation will put people's lives in danger in many ways and the only solution to overcome this situation is to move out to suburban locations. It's indispensable that the aforementioned government interferences to encourage citizens to move out of the larger cities to suburbs.

topic: Some believe that it is beneficial to show foreign films while others feel this can have a negative impact on local culture. Ċ Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
The question of whether showing film productions from other countries have merits or drawbacks is quite a controversial topic today. This essay will discuss both sides and provide evidence for the given reasons. In my view, foreign films are ought to be available to everyone.

On the one hand, it is considered by some, that it is advantageous to display films from other nations. Firstly, I agree with this statement, since it provides a larger variety of shows. For instance, according to a recent study conducted by Harvard, eighty per cent of those asked stated that they would prefer not a local, but an international movie. Secondly, experiencing other cultures might be an option through watching films. Also, considering historical productions, it can give the viewer a great ton of knowledge and information.

On the other hand, others argue that foreign movies have disadvantages. They might say that by watching foreign contents, the local and the national film industry are not supported. Furthermore, these disputed films might have a negative impact, due to the fact that every nation have different morals and it would result in a change of the culture, as it can be alluring to some. For example, in a recent article published by The New York Times wrote, that most movies are censored when shown in China and other Asian countries, as Chinese people are ought not to follow American scrupulous.

To conclude, the benefits and the drawbacks regarding foreign film productions are widely disputed. I do believe that it can be advantageous as long as it is not harmful to the local film industry.

topic: Some people think that parents should teach children how to be good members of the society. Others, however, believe that school is the place to learn this. growing-up stages from different aspects
essay:
Being a good member in society is an important lesson for children, and who should take such responsibility, whether parents or school, becoming a worth discussing issue. I think both sides play equally important roles and reasons are following.

Firstly, imitation is children's nature, and the way they learn to treat the world. Furthermore, their first models are usually their parents, who spent most of time with during the childhood. Kids copy parents' behavior, regarding the words they use, the attitude they toward others and the value they have. There is a Chinese saying that goes, like father like son, which means what kind of parents will have the same type of children.

Secondly, after entering schools, where not only provide the educational opportunities, but also a place children start to learn how to cope with others. This is their step to socialize. Apart from the peer, teachers are model to the kids as well, since they replace the roles as parents in school life, who lead children explore the world. You can image a school as a small society, where the child will face many frustrations and joy, learning how to be a mature adult.

To conclude, although people hold different views toward who should teach children be a great participant of society, whether parents or school, I suppose each roles are significant since these people will affect the children in many aspects during their growing-up stages.

topic: Some people think that large, impressive buildings are important for a city. Others believe that the money should be spent on improving schools and hospitals. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Country allocates budget to develop public facilities of city for their citizen. Some people believe that government has to build spectacular structures, whereas others think that it is more significant to use them on reforming schools and hospitals. For two of views, I believe that the fantastic building can show identity of city and become a business place, then schools and hospitals will also help human beings to access great education and proper health.

People think that state has to invest its money on developing special buildings for several reasons. Firstly, they can show the identity or image of its city. As an example, Petronas Twin Tower in Malaysia has been become an icon of Kuala Lumpur even country of Malaysia. Some tourists travel to Malaysia to visit the building for taking photograph or just adore the view. Not only this, fabulous structures are also built to make a central of business, such as shopping center, entertainment area, and tourism place. They will lead investors and give profit to the country.

However, I believe that the budget will offer more positive impact if the government estimate to improve hospitals, so society can receive health services, like qualified doctors, the best drugs, comfortable patient treatment rooms, sophisticated hospital equipment, and affordable cost. Therefore, people will never feel worry when they have to cure their illnesses. Finally, individuals have a right to obtain education, so country should concern on this issue. Pleasurable school, professional teachers, complete library, advanced laboratory, and good textbooks can support people to achieve great education.

To conclude, although some people argue that spectacular buildings are very prominent as they can become the icon and make profit, I would argue there is sufficient evidence to prefer schools and hospitals. Moreover, government should act based on need and interest of society.

topic: More and more people want to buy clothes, cars and other products from well-known Ċ brands. What are the reasons? Do you think it is a positive or negative development?
essay:
In the 21st century, branding has emerged as a new way of marketing and selling the products. Due to it, the majority of the people, wants to buy these kinds of goods, as the quality, service of these goods is generally high. However, I my view, it is a positive development and we will elaborate in the essay.

To begin with, one of the main reasons why people want to buy the branded thing is, it has high status value as compared to the other products which are available in the market. In addition, these merchandise is of optimum quality as compare to its competitor's. For instance, if we consider the Apple iPhone, which has high status value and it is dream of majority of people to purchase an iPhone, on top it, the quality of the phone is on par to any phone available in the market. Therefore, from the above reasons, it is clear why people want to buy branded merchandise.

However, from my point of view, I consider it as a positive growth due to following reasons. Firstly, it is a totally new kind of business approach as there is no competition with its contenders. Secondly, organizations can totally concentrate on making and updating their products of the superior quality. For example, the iPhone's user interface is extraordinary as they update it every year, and the reason why people always want to buy this phone despite being most expensive phone. Hence, from these points we can say that, it is the positive development of the institutions as well as for the customers.

To conclude, these days people are attracted towards the branded products because of their quality, service, status symbol and worthiness as compared to their pricing. These all benefits are to the customers and that is the reason, why, I feel it is the positive development.

topic: There are social, medical, and technical problems associated with the use of mobile phones. What forms do they take? Do you agree that the problems outweigh the benefits of the mobile phones?
essay:
Presently, the popularity of mobile phones has brought about a lot of convenience, but at the meanwhile a variety of problems as well, such as social, medical and technical problems. Notwithstanding, I do not think these disadvantages will outweigh the advantages brought by cell phones. In this essay, I would like to analyse these three issues in order to support my viewpoint. First of all, almost everything that changed our life style also cause some controversial social issues and mobile phones are not out of expectation.

Speaking emphatically on the phone in public areas such as school appears to be contemptuous and insulting. What is worse, some students utilize their phones as an effective cheating device in examinations. Nevertheless, it is not impossible to solve these problems, as long as some regulations and rules can be effectively implemented. Another worth mentioning that harmful effects on our health are lethal. In particular, the telephone is used to transmit calls and messages and there are some who fear that these electromagnetic waves could deteriorate human's brain and memory. However, it has not been claimed by any scientific studies.

According to many, it has been declared that overusing of the electronic devices, including mobile phones could lead to possibilities of suffering hearing loss. In addition, other debatable obstacles are about the techniques. As a matter of fact, there is panic among the people that their conversation can be intercepted by the third party. Consequently, a more efficient and reliable system may be invented to guarantee the private information of users.

In conclusion, the mobile phone has become an indispensable tool in people’s usual life. Not only used for communication, but it also functions as an Internet browser and so forth. The contribution of the mobile phone to our modern society is prominent and people’s dependence on it is irreversible, even though it has a number of problems that should be well handled.

topic: The number of students studying science at university is constantly declining. What do you think are the causes? What effects will this have on our society?
essay:
It is undeniable that university education is fundamental to educate the students. However, since the last few years, there is a significant decrease in the count of students who study in a medical field. In this essay, I will discuss the reasons behind the massive shift including high paying education and difficulties to secure a job, along with its negative implications for society.

The pivotal factors that are responsible for a decline such as expensive education and job insecurity. It is seen that in order to pursue the M.B.B.S degree one need to pay higher fees which is a herculean task for the vast majority of students. Also, sometimes degree holders have to face immense difficulties in order to secure good job positions because employment demands reference and previous experience. As a result, students get disappointed and alleviate their admission in a science stream. For example, a student with fresh doctorate degree denied by the hospitals due to the lack of experience. Thus, above-mentioned are the causes for a change.

The trend could bring some potential cons to the community. Firstly, the incessant drop of students in the medical stream could lead towards the far worse outcomes because there will be a decrease in the number of scientists, doctors, nurses, science educators, then the several positions will be vacant in the hospitals and people have to wait for a longer time for the treatment. The situation could put people's lives at risk. Secondly, the government of our country needs to hire the science experts from the different nations, which will affect the economic structure of our country, as the doctors and teachers from other countries will charge high salary. For instance, the investigators of NASA are in high demand and quite expensive for another country. Overall, our society will face the problems due to the inclination of the science group in the universities.

To conclude, people's preferences have been changed these days as only a few students opt to study science for higher education. The essay has discussed why it is happening and its effects for the individual as a whole are myriad, which needs to be addressed to keep the number of science students constant.

topic: Immigration has a huge impact on the society. What are the main causes of immigration? To what consequences can it lead?
essay:
Over a period of time immigration has played a vital role in the society. Since they also contribute to the country's economy.

The predominant reason behind moving is opportunity and secure future, developing countries fail to offer advance health care and employment benefit like Canada, Austrial and United Kingdom. In other words, in search of such advantages people immigrates to settle countries so that they can be stable. For example, numerous IT professional brain drain to the USA, every year so that they can earn good amount of money to be settled in their life.

However, on the other hand, such schemes can lead negative impact like cultural difference since the adaptation of an unknown place can bring in the culture shock. Since they are unaware about the place eating habit and the types of clothing As a result, many get into self isolation which has a dire mental effects like anxiety and depression. Secondly, the language barrier is always a problem to survive is countries like Germany, Spain, Chain and many more. It becomes difficult to cope. For a person in and out needs to deal with these people on a daily basis, even for daily needs, it becomes challenging to handle the issue. For instance, according to the Germany immigration, it is one of the eligibility criteria for a person to know their language.

To conclude, many of them migrate in search of dynamic life, but has to face the consequence like differences in culture and language problem.

topic: Many countries aim to improve their standard by economic development, but some important social values are lost as a result. Do you think the advantages of economic development outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
Several nations target to improve their status through economic evolution, due to which some of the important social values are sacrificed. I believe that the pros of economic development can overcome the demerits of this notion because, with economic advancement, the infrastructure of the country could be improved.

The main benefit of good economic status is that every sector can develop because with strong economic conditions nations can invest more money to fulfil the desires of the citizens. For example, if a country has good financial conditions, then more hospitals, schools and free aid services could be established for the welfare of the people. Moreover, the government can improve job sectors and more people can attain employment. Thus, economic development plays a key role in the overall improvement of the nation.

Secondly, with developed economic status, the price inflation will decrease. Consequently, a person can earn more and save more money. They can spend money on their amusement activities. Everyone can live a comfortable and luxurious lifestyle. Children can attain a high level of education. Hence; the crime rate will decrease. In other words, individuals can live a stress-free life.

Although with this progress, citizens can lose some of their social values such as they could not spend much time with their family members, due to their hectic schedules. In other words, sometimes, they will miss their family functions but this progress will prove more beneficial for everyone.

In conclusion, the economic growth of the nation will support the basic structure of the country and its advantages can overcome its disadvantage.

topic: Topic:  Everyone should become vegetarian because they do not need to eat meat to have a healthy diet. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
It is a common belief that becoming vegetarian is better for everyone's health because there is no meat in their diet. Although meat brings a lot of nutrients, I personally agree with the idea becoming vegetarian and have no meat in diet.

On the one hand, vegetables give us adequate nutrition to support our bodies. A well-planned vegetarian diet contains all the nutrients that we need. It is naturally high in fibre and low in saturated fats, which can help to prevent cancer. Vegetarian also reduce the risk of heart diseases due to the fat in meat. For example, many vegetables are great sources of vitamins and mineral such as vitamin A,E as well as calcium. Therefore, instead of eating many kind of food to get these vitamins, everyone only need to eat these vegetables.

On the other hand, having vegetarian diet and stopping to eat meat can improve the environment as well. It is high time people stopped killing animals necessarily. Growing vegetables and cereals for ourselves rather than for cattle will greatly reduce the human impact on the environment. For instance, livestock farming has a vast environmental footprint. It contributes to land and water degradation which can lead to biodiversity loss,acid rain and deforestation. Nowhere is this impact more apparent than climate change-livestock farming contribute a noticeable proportion of human produced greenhouse gas emissions worldwide.

In conclusion, I believe that vegetarian diet is better for everyone because of its nutrition, and having no meat in our diet also help to improve the environment.

abstractive_summary: A vegetarian diet is better for everyone due to its strong nutritional benefits and positive environmental impact. It provides all essential nutrients through a variety of vegetables that are rich in vitamins, minerals, fibre, and low in saturated fats, reducing the risk of chronic diseases like cancer and heart disease. Additionally, avoiding meat eliminates dietary reliance on animal fats linked to health problems. Environmentally, shifting from livestock farming to growing plant-based foods reduces greenhouse gas emissions, deforestation, and water and land degradation. While some argue that meat supplies important nutrients, a well-planned vegetarian diet adequately meets nutritional needs, making the shift both healthy and sustainable.

topic: Some people say that the clothes people wear are the most important indication of what they are like. Others, however, say that people should not be judged by the clother they wear. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
It is true that the way people dress is able to reflect their job in this modern era. However, some people argue that the clothes cannot be used to indicate their background. I strongly believe that society's status is not able to be assessed just based on their dress.

These days, clothes which are worn by society can reflect their occupation and personalities. The physical appearance is able to make several perceptions regarding to character of people's proficiency. For instance, the women who work at night club tend to wear sexy dresses. They obligated to wear several clothes which can attract the visitors' attention, particularly the men. In the fact that they are supposed to show the best appearance every night to their client thought they are forced or not. Nevertheless, I would argue that the fashion which people choose cannot be used to decide who they are like.

Appearance is not lead role to show people's fashion style. Sometimes, several people likely convenient to wear clothes which make them comfortable or they love, whether they wear it in the right place and the right time or not. For example, the inhabitants tend to use T-shirt everyday even though they are wealthy people. Other societies who do not recognize them will judge that they do not have much money to purchase several good clothes which can enhance their appearance. Thus, those societies have the wrong perception in judging a person. It is evident that dresses are not able to determine people's status.

To sum up, clothes can show lots of people's jobs. Yet, I personally believe that people cannot asses other humans just based on what they see. Truthfully, the society must know other people first, before they judge other inhabitants' behaviour and background,

topic: In many countries, plastic bags are the main type of rubbish. They cause water and land pollution, so they should be banned. To what extent do you agree? Strict ban on plastic bags.
essay:
Pollution is one of the greatest problems here on Earth. Plastics bags contribute to the planet's downhill, therefore, many countries have banned plastic bags to save the environment. In my opinion, I completely agree to this reinforcement.

Trash is not environmental-friendly. It is also one of the causes of water pollution. Plastics bags are the main type of trash that can harm the ocean, as well as the sea creautures. Death of sea mammals are all over the news because of their accidental inhalation or intake of plastic products. Thus, dead animals in the ocean is toxic to people and to those who are main sources of income rely on fishing.

In addition to that, not only the water is polluted, but the land as well. Flood is one of the main outcome of rubbish bags stuck under the land or storage of waste materials. When storm comes, there are dams who are responsible for collecting the water in the cities caused by rain, however, because plastic bags are in the way, the function of dams is not met, thus, causing flood to some areas.

As an example, In the Philippines, there are cities where they do not allow plastic bags in the establishments, grocery stores, fast food chains and even hotels. They promote using of paper bags as a replacement to plastic products. Imposing a slogan that the humanity should lessen the use of plastic materials.

Therefore, I totally agree that banning plastic bags can help the world to be a better place. This law can reduce water and land pollution to many countries. With that in mind, people will be aware of the harmful effects of plastic bags to the environment.

abstractive_summary: Banning plastic bags can help make the world a better place by addressing widespread environmental degradation. Plastic bags are a major pollutant, harming both land and marine ecosystems, contributing to ocean pollution, and endangering marine life through ingestion and entanglement, which in turn threatens human health and livelihoods. They also block drainage systems and dams, leading to flooding in urban areas. Many countries recognize this issue, with places like the Philippines successfully implementing bans in businesses while promoting paper alternatives and public campaigns to reduce plastic use. Such measures not only decrease pollution in water and soil but also raise awareness about the damaging environmental impact of plastic bags, fostering more sustainable consumer behavior.

topic: In some countries, an increasing number of people are suffering from health problems as a result of eating too much fast food. It is therefore necessary for governments to impose a higher tax on this kind of food. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
essay:
There is an increasing tendency among people to carry about their health. Despite it, people in some countries are suffering diseases cause by consumption in excessive quantity. Therefore, governments may impose taxes on this kind of unhealthy products. I partly agree with this statement since the country’s rules should help society in any possible way.

On the one hand, overeating is the issue that provokes serious diseases such as adiposity, head issues and even death. That is why imposing immense imposts may have a vital role in decreasing these outcomes. Citizens will not be able to pay extra money for fast food. A good illustration for this is the society’s addiction to McDonald as well as KFC where society tends to harmful consumption. In case imposing taxes, if the public has to pay more, they will choose more useful snakes in these cafes.

On the other hand, authorities can take appropriate measures and emphasize citizens to follow an active lifestyle. In fact, developing outdoor gyms, cycling lines can determine society’s involvement in sport and healthy eating. For example, according to social research, Netherland has the healthiest nation due to the high rate of sports activities which are in free access for the citizens. In addition, reducing taxes for supermarkets and restaurants which offer organic food may result in encouragement people to eat full of minerals and vitamins products.

In conclusion, although putting high imposts on meals consumption can minimize the rate of fatness to some extent. Nevertheless, the state authorities may introduce well-being activities as well as health-oriented programs for the catering establishment.

topic: Some people think that only managers should make decisions in the company while others think that employees should also be involved in the process of decision-making . Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
The decisions should be made by only supervisors or executives, according to some people. Other people, nevertheless, opine that everyone in a company should be involved in making these things. In my opinion, all members should decide on their own jobs. Both sides along with my perspectives linked to the topic will be outlined in the following paragraphs.

There are many arguments in favour of all action should be taken by managers. The most important one is that most managers are graduated with a master degree or bachelor degree. There is a universal consensus that almost all universities are more likely to teach their students to know more about the various aspects of business such as finance, marketing, operation, and countless business fields. Additionally, most supervisors are trained to make difficult stuff with the best outcome. As a result, they are opted to set the company goals. For example, most higher-rank employees, including Tim Cook, who graduated from an MBA program tend to head the club's long-term goal .

There are, however, a host of arguments put forward against all decisions based on only the executive team. First and foremost, one significant counterargument is that operators always understand the detail of their shop-floor jobs more than their bosses do. Without a doubt, most employees can sometimes give invaluable ideas to make a better party's decision. Without the involvement of every employee, the group hardly can move forward. Consequently, Chief Executive Officer should encourage all members to involve in the process of decision-making. An outstanding example would be that startup companies allow all staff to find the common goals that everyone will achieve.

To sum up, even though making company's way by higher-rank staffs has various reasons, I am of the opinion that everyone should be involved in the process. Unless only executive teams decide everything, it is more likely that the growth of the community will increase insignificantly.

topic: Some people think that all university students should study whatever they like. Others believe that they should only be allowed to study subjects that will be useful in the future, such as those related to science and technology. Ċ Discuss both these views and give your opinion
essay:
Subjects that should be taught in educational institutes is contentious topic these days.As one section of the society believe that learners must be given the freedom to choose their favourite subjects at the college.While others assert that the universities must teach them the subjects that are useful for them in future and their course may relate to the IT sector.As far as my views are concerned,I profoundly assert that pupils must be given an independent choice to select their subjects.However,I would like to cast light on both views in the upcoming paragraphs.

To commence with,the first and foremost reason why denizens believe that university students must learn whatever they want to comment that grasping the knowledge in the field of the interest of a pupil can produce a fruitful result as they can become experts in the field.Furthermore,this is the era of specialisation and people usually consult the individuals who have gained sufficient knowledge in their respective areas.For instance,according to the Earning Time of India,a non-technical student like an accountant earns Rs 60,000 pm on an average basis in India and salary is much higher if we compare the pay of an engineer.For this reason,individuals should choose the subjects of their choice that will prove a great investment in the future.

Conversely, others believe the educational institutions must teach technical courses to the learners that will be beneficial for them in future.Firstly,the graduates will bring technological advancement to the nation that will not only lead to the development of the country as well as it will diminish the unemployment-related issues.For example,a news survey done by the Oxford institute depicts that by 2050 everything that we are doing manually now would be done with the help of robotics technology.As a result,teachers and the government must take pivotal steps to implement only technical courses in the institutes as the future belongs to the people who have gained knowledge in the science and technology sector.

In conclusion,different people think distinctly.Besides it,in this particular case ,some believe that students must be given a preference to choose the subjects while others contradict this idea.Hence,I certainly believe that pupils must be given an independent choice to select their course as they can become masters of their field that will secure their future.Moreover,learning technology-related subjects notably holds a paramount role in the coming era but one should prefer the subjects according to their choice.

On the other hand, basically, the advancement of technology ease its users' life. Young people mostly interract each other by using social media accounts which means they use internet access regularly. In additional, office workers, academicians, businessmen, housewives or whoever they are, make internet being one of their necessity to do their works. For example, a researcher will spend much time conducting his research unless he has an internet access.

To sum up, I genuinely believe that this kind of cutting-edge technology does effect most of inhabitants' way of life. Simply it eases everyone's needs indeed.

topic: Some people believe that it is good to share as much information as possible ina scientific research, bussiness and the acedemic world. Others believe that some information is too important or too valuable to be shared freely. Ċ Dicuss both the views and give your own opinion?
essay:
There is a party that thinks that everyone should get access to any type of data while others prefer not to share due to its importance. In this essay, I am going to illustrate both parties and then give my personal opinion.

On one hand, there is a consensus that believes that we have to control the information we share with the public. The main reason why this group have this notion is that some types of information might lead to atrocities if it was in the wrong hand. Thus, governments should be extremely aware of the data that it shares wit with the common. Scammers, for example, arrived in a stage where they use the data are given to us as a tool for their operations.

On the other hand, we have a voice that advocates more transparency due to their altruism and mindset. This is to say that this group believes that the more information we share, the more innovation will have. Furthermore, sometimes our findings might guide someone to come up with a new cure for some disease, an invention might increase our lifespan, or maybe a tool to help us increase our productivity. MoMo, for instance, is a famous app to manage someone life from important meetings to submitting homework.

In conclusion, it seems that the two parties have fair viewpoints. On balance, however, I tend to believe that we have to give access to any kind of data this is because it might lead to more developments, advancements, and state-of-the-art inventions.

topic: Women and men are commonly seen as having different strengths and weaknesses. Is it right to exclude males or females from certain professions because of their gender? gender discrimination in some jobs
essay:
It is thought that males and females have different strength and deficiency points, thus the gender is considered a criteria in jobs hiring and selection in specific places. This assays disagrees that women are under-qualified therefore they are unsuitable in certain jobs. This essay will explain the reason behind this opinion as gender has no effect in the quality of task performance in different careers as well as various types of jobs that women were outstanding in them.

It is unfair to classify women as being suitable to a specified list of jobs. The sex of the applicant has nothing to do with the performance quality as skills required in different jobs are usually established by self-discipline and training not given as privilege to specific gender. For example, a BBC news network has once reported that women participation in jobs that was considered before as exclusive for men increased by 35% from the beginning of this century.

Also, it must be mentioned that women were superior to men in significant types of jobs throughout history. Long list of females has proven higher level performance in comparison to males despite the risky nature of that work. For instance, the first person who break the world record number in climbing the highest mountain in the world was a girl in 1934 and the event was huge achievement and strong evidence of the unlimited capability of women.

In conclusion, discrimination between males and females in certain work types is unacceptable and definitely has no sense. Women are considered partners to men and they proved that by long history of their success.

topic: Many governments think that economic progress is their most important goal. Some people, however, think that other types of progress are equally important for a country. Ċ Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
People have different views about how governments should measure their countries’ progress. While economic progress is of course essential, I agree with those who believe that other measures of improvement are just as important.

There are three key reasons why economic growth is seen as a fundamental goal for countries. Firstly, a healthy economy result in job creation, a high level of employment, and better salaries for all citizens. Secondly, economic advance ensures that more money is available for governments to spend on infrastructure and public services. For example, a government with higher revenues can invest in the country's transport network, its education system and its hospitals. Finally, a strong economy can help a country’s standing on the global stage, in terms of its political influence and trading power.

However, I would argue that various other forms of development are just as significant as the economic factors mentioned above. In particular, we should consider the area of social justice, human rights, equality and democracy itself. For example, the treatment of minority groups is often seen as a reflection of the moral standards and level of development of a society. Perhaps another key consideration when judging the progress of a modern country should be how well that country protects the natural environment, and whether it is moving towards environmental sustainability. Alternatively, the success of a nation could be measured by looking at the health, well-being and happiness of its residents.

In conclusion, the economy is obviously a key marker of a country’s success, but social, environmental and health criteria are equally significant.

topic: Essay Question:Some businesses now say that no one can smoke cigarettes in any of their offices. Some governments have banned smoking in all public places. This is a good idea but it takes away some of our freedom. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Smoking is harmful to the individual as well as the environment.Many organizations and the governments of most of the countries have banned smoking in work and public places in order to protect their employers and citizens.Although,many people believe that this is the best approach to save the environment some argue that it curbs the right of an individual.

On one hand,smoking banned in public places is beneficial to passive smokers who acquire diseases due to people smoking around them.For example in India,this has lead to massive reduction in smoking related diseases like tuberculosis and lung cancer.There is a saying called "Prevention is better than cure".Government of India is using it's expenditure to impose these laws and in creating awareness instead of spending on drugs to cure these diseases.In Companies,productivity has increased since most of the time is used efficiently and effectively.Air pollution has come down and the incidence of infertility for which one of the main cause is smoking has also reduced.

On the other hand,the nature of human psychology is that when we attempt to control someone,they will overdo it.Youngsters and teenagers will try to explore believing that this is their right and therefore leads to behavioral and addiction problems.In order to protect their rights,governments of nations can build secluded areas especially meant for smoking to safeguard both the environment and the human rights.This is already in vogue in many of the developed countries.

To conclude,in my opinion,smoking which is detrimental to the soceity should be banned by implementing laws and educating the public through media and newspapers.I disagree with the fact that it curbs the freedom of an individual.

topic: The govt should make people take the responsibility for their actions to the environment. TO what extent do you agree?
essay:
It has been argued by many that protection of the environment is an important task of the government and people should be taken to task for their actions affecting the environmental conditions. In my opinion, I fully agree with this as it will inculcate a sense of responsibility among the inhabitants and will also keep the surroundings neat and clean.

On the one hand, it's the duty of a state to keep a check on the activities, of its citizens, affecting the locality. Firstly, awareness should be created by media campaigns. Secondly, rules should be made and communicated to all regarding the protection of surroundings. Furthermore, adequate facilities must be provided for the uplift and upkeep of the area. This will, ultimately, develop responsible attitudes among the people and they will try to preserve the nature as their utmost duty. For instance, the Swiss people are among those who have kept the natural beauty in its original shape and they are backed up by their rulers as well.

On the other hand, people should be encouraged to keep their vicinities protected and dirt free. Apart from cleaning their homes, they are also expected to keep their nearby town updated. This can be achieved by providing garbage bins, a sanitation truck for collection of all filthy material and recycling of the whole material. Moreover, community centres must be tasked to keep an eye on the sanitary conditions of the cities and helping in maintaining the world pollution free. For example, the same practice has been followed in the UAE where the government has fixed monitoring devices to keep the towns beautiful.

To conclude, I believe that natural resources are available to all of us in one form or the other, but it's our duty to keep them safe and protected.

topic: The internet has transformed the way information is shared and consumed, but it has also created problems that did not exist before. What are the most serious problems associated with the internet and what solutions can you suggest?
essay:
In modern digital era, the growth of advanced technology has revolutionized the way people to do everything. Internet as a product of sophisticated technology has many benefits in human life such as changing the way information to be shared and consumed by public, yet it also has appeared causes these days. Although internet has merits and demerits, personally I do believe that some viable solutions should be taken to tackle this problems.

Needless to say, many people argue that internet damages culture. Firstly, by surfing to internet, everyone can find global information easily. They tend to be influenced by foreign cultures which serve different programmes without any filtration. For instance, internet provides many websites contained negative content which can be accessed for all aged groups. Secondly, internet can change people's lifestyle into sedentary lifestyle. It is really hazardous when children play online game in long period which tends to make them getting obesity. Another problem can be seen is many people utilize internet to do some digital crimes such as fraud and kid napping.

The aforementioned evidence occurs multifaceted problems. To overcome this, I do believe that government, parents, and education institution should work together to tackle this problems. First of all, the government should be active to ban websites which contain negative content. In addition, they have to create a standard regulation to filter the websites. For example, Ministry of Technology and Information in Indonesia has campaigned "internet positive" programme by blocking several websites which are inappropriate with the standard. Moreover, parents and educational also should take a role to give the best education in order to protect children and people doing negative activities.

All in all, multiple stakeholders play an essential role in making regulation to restrain irresponsible activities using internet. So, the predominant upside of using internet can be utilized broadly.

topic: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Ċ Write about the following topic. Ċ Buying things on the Internet, such as books, air tickets and groceries, is becoming more and more popular. Ċ Do the advantages of shopping in this way outweigh the disadvantages? Ċ Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Ċ You should write at least 250 words.
essay:
It is often said that purchasing things on the internet such as printed_materials ,air tickets and groceries is becoming common as well as popular among the population in the world. From my point of view ,I suppose this could have more upsides rather than downsides.

Firstly ,one of the main drawbacks that should be considered is closing independent and local shops all around the world. For example ,to purchase items by people online , going shopping will be eroded and there is no denying that big brand names also companies that sell books ,air tickets and other commodities will go under. Additionally ,they may lose their money. Needless to say ,as a result of bankruptcy ,organizations decide to lay someone off. This could be a dire situation for both companies and individuals. All things considered ,this makes it clear the disadvantages of purchasing things online are conspicuous that should not be ignored.

Secondly ,apart from drawbacks ,some benefits should be introduced. For instance ,we all know in most countries all around the world ,human beings are working full_time and there is not enough time to shop around and try something on. This is true that the best option for citizens is purchasing their essential hard and paperbacks on the internet. Moreover ,from time to time buying an air ticket for abroad trips are more accessible on multiple websites. Therefore ,it becomes apparent there are numerous benefits behind each drawback that must be reflected on.

To summarise ,I personally believe that this trend could be useful as well as helpful in today's modern universe. It is predicted that to continue increasing online pages to purchase items all the population will have an appropriate chance to find the essential substances to buy.

topic: Some people think that because some children find some subjects such as mathematics and philosophy difficult they ought to be optional instead of compulsory. To what extend do you agree?
essay:
There is currently a contentious argument over whether few courses need to be optional rather than compulsory. This is particularly when it comes to courses like mathematics and philosophy which many children find it hard to understand. I totally disagree with this opinion because these are basic courses every child must learn and I believe that there is nothing a youngster cannot learn with proper teaching.

Firstly, the main reason why I don't believe this notion is because every class course structure is carefully designed such that a child is infused with the knowledge that will be greatly useful for them when they come to an age. For instance, in India mathematics is a common subject that we can find in any school and the knowledge a baby develops by learning this subject is used in day to day activities. This is why every course is mandatory and cannot be made optional.

Secondly, why I disagree is due to the fact that with proper training a kid can learn anything. For example, some children find it hard to understand philosophy but with proper teaching and teaching with real-world examples will make it easy for a child to understand the subject. It can also be improved by focusing more on children that find it hard to understand by explaining it in a way they understand. As all the subjects can be taught to a kid, I don't think any course needs to be made optional.

In conclusion, I completely disagree that some subjects that are hard for a child need to be made optional because of the reasons discussed above that every course is designed carefully and a child can understand anything with proper guidance.

topic: Some people think that the government should take care of disadvantaged people such as the unemployed and homeless people. What is the cause of the problem? To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
In the modern world, many people are willing to help disadvantaged people, as these individuals cannot survive without the assistance of the rich and affluent people. However, others feel that there are should not be any assistance, as people should run their livelihood by themselves. Personally, I believe that poor people should be motivated by the authorities.

On the one hand, it is true that the main cause of this problem is unemployment. In this regard, many cannot afford many things. Furthermore, economic instability is the second reason why many citizens are not able to earn money. To illustrate, due to the high prices of properties, some people are living in the streets. Thirdly, the process of globalization has caused many problems for unskilled people, as big companies and organizations are willing to employ a well-qualified worker.

On the other hand, it is clear that there are some people who are not keen to provide support for the unemployed and homeless people. They tend to think that the government should concentrate on other challenges such as health care and education. Moreover, some people believe that if the authorities provide the support for these people, they will not start working, as they are not willing to earn money. For instance, many people who have no property, are indolent people.

In conclusion, although many people reckon to think that there is no point to support these people, others feel that the government should take care of these people. In this case, I believe that the government should provide the job for these individuals. Accordingly, they should take up working, as they are supposed to earn money for their family and relatives.

topic: The number of people are at risk at serious health problem is only because of overweight. what is the reason and how it can be solved?
essay:
It has been claimed that obesity puts individuals at risk of acquiring so many serious illnesses. This essay will examine the reason for this trend and a solution will be provided.

It is undeniable that obesity is the mother of so many serious health conditions due to the fact that people who are overweight most likely have not a healthy lifestyle and do not have healthy diets . In fact, it has been proven by scientists and doctors that obesity is the major cause of high blood pressure and diabetes for the same reasons above. For instance, based on many studies, people who are overweight are ten times more at risks of dying as a result of cardiac problems compared to other people. Even the risk of getting cancer is higher for obese people. Thus, having a high body mass index that can be the result of not being active and having a healthy diet can put one at risk of getting sick.

To tackle this problem, people should start being active and doing exercise on a regular basis. They should also stop eating high-calorie foods including sugars and fast foods. Another solution would be to be mindful of children and even start a healthy lifestyle from childhood. For example in Japan parents of overweight kids need to get into a health program starting as early as grade1 and the whole family will get education and training on different weight reducing exercises and activities besides having to take some cooking classes. Therefore as can be seen obesity can be treated with the help of a good diet and exercise planning.

To sum up, the overweight population are at high risk of getting serious diseases.This health condition can be treated without medication and only by sticking to a healthy lifestyle. There are some people who have hormonal problems that need some medication to deal with. However,this rule can a majority of them to have a healthy life.

topic: Fossil fuels are themain source of energy around the world. However, people are being encouraged to use alternative energy sources such as wind energy, solar energy and so on. Do you think this is a positive or negative development and why.
essay:
It is true that fossil fuels are an essential source of energy globally. Although , it has several drawbacks that cannot be denied because of which, many people believe other sources of energy should be used in order to save the earth. In my opinion, it is important to utilize other resources to generate energy.

To begin with, petroleum and other nonrenewable energy resources are dangerous and has various impact around the world. From generation to consumption these energies are the major source of natural destruction such as plants and animals. Furthermore, pollution is a major concern in many countries these days because of gas emissions. For instance, Lahore is considered to be the most polluted city in the world and have the lowest visibility rate due to the rise in pollution and gases. The governing bodies set a high alert in the city as people are suffering from various diseases mainly lung infections. The production of gases and disposal of chemical waste in the sea is also affecting the marine habitat.

On the other hand, science has introduced various natural methods to generate energy that are more eco-friendly. One of the examples is, making of energy through solar can play a vital role to secure the earth, as well as the wind can consume to generate multiple energies without any harm to the environment. For example, Germany set a bar in the world by generating electricity through solar panels and by end of 2025 the entire country will produce energy through this natural system. Moreover, they have introduced electric cars to control pollution and consequently , the environment is cleaner than before.

To conclude, I completely agree with the fact that natural energy resources are helpful to nature and the environment. Therefore, it is a positive approach to implement natural ways to produce energy as this will save the world from pollution and further destruction to our habitat.

topic: People believe that there should be fixed punishments for each types of crime. Others, however, argue that the circumstances of an individual crime and the motivation for committing it, should always be taken into account when deciding on the punishment. Discuss both view and give your own opinion
essay:
The idea that criminals should be punished in set punishments regardless of the reasons why they have done so remains a source of controversy. While some agree with this perspective, others claim that people must take under consideration what have pushed each individual to commit these crimes before coming to the final conclusion. This essay will discuss both these views and illustrate my own viewpoint.

In the first place, many people argue that every kind of offence should have its own distinctive treatments which are unchanged. This is mainly because it will cost much less time, resources and effort to tackle these unlawful behaviours. In other words, they find courts of law wastefully used and not necessarily as people only need to apply a fixed set of rules to pass judgement on criminals. Hence, without having to consider what decisions to make, people whose job is to debate cases in a court of law can save for themselves a tremendous amount of time as well as money. Additionally, they have a prejudice that considering the motivation of criminals is emotional, which is unsuitable, therefore unacceptable in sentencing a person.

On the other hand, a great number of people believe that the culprits who commit a same crime are not supposed to receive a same sentence. To be more specific, they want each case to be thoroughly investigated by looking at different perspectives. For example, the motivation and the incitement are two of the manifold factors pushing a man to behave illegally. A man who killed another one for defending purpose can not be judged as equally guilty as those who did the same but for evil motives. Therefore, by examining carefully some hidden aspects, judges can draw more exact and reasonable conclusions without losing the original purposes of sentencing.

To conclude, whether each type of crime should have separate fixed ways of treatment is disputable. However, I personally favour the idea that it would be much more practical and fair if judges pay close attention in considering various factors, such as motivation, which lead a person to commit serious crimes.

topic: Some people think that too much money is spent on repairing old buildings,instead of repairing old buildings,that money should be spent on knocking down old buildings and building new ones .To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
An old structure in the form monuments, towers and temples generally requires huge sums in maintenance in the economy. Some people think spending money for the vintage infrastructure is a waste of money, while others believe that allotting separate funds for the conservation of those precious architectures is relevant. In my opinion, I do not agree with the former proposition and support the segments where the budget of repairing an old building is considered.

There are myriad of reasons to signify the emphasis on refurbishing older buildings. Firstly, structures created in history are part of our heritage, which holds numerous mystery with them. For instance, the Pyramids of Egypt, which are still revealing factual data of those times. Also, they remind modern generation about the roots of human history with the preliminary traditions and cultures.

Simultaneously, demolishing older buildings would incur destruction cost on one hand and archaeological loss of the property to the society on another. In fact, many government opts to invest huge sums in the restoration work and converting them into a museum, art galleries and hotels. Palaces in Rajasthans, for example, fort of Udaipur is one the luxurious hotels in the world that generates higher revenue to boost the economy through tourism. Therefore, many are in favour of rebuilding historical places, instead of knocking them down.

In conclusion, fixing old infrastructure is both expensive and time consuming for the modern society. However, it is worth to do so, as breaking an older architect is not only difficult, but it could lead to irreparable cultural losses. This essay has discussed in detail, the reasons for encouraging the restoration processes of older buildings.

topic: Some people think that children would benefit if they attend nursery school before primary school while some people think that children should stay all day with their families. Discuss both the views and give your opinion.
essay:
Education is the key to success for everyone. Some people think that kids should attend pre-school whereas others believe that they should spend time at home. In this essay, I will discuss both views and give my strong opinion in the favour of attending play schools before going to first class.

To begin with, children should be admitted to the play-way schools which will help them in adjust with new people. They will learn about the classroom environment in advance and become familiar with this schedule . For example, If a student is directly sent to primary school then it might be shocking for him to stay away from their parents for a long time which may cause homesickness and other illnesses and even fear of going to school. Therefore pre-schools help the pupils to prepare for their primary schools.

In contrast to the above point, children can get their initial learnings from their parents by staying at home in safe hands. Because in school, they may get injured while playing with other students and can hit others as well. For example, there was news in the paper that a girl was raped in primary school by a security guard. This type of incident can create mental stress on kids and result in a lack of interest in their studies.

In nutshell, Although there are some reasons for not attending the preschools like the security of the kids, in my opinion wisely selecting an institute with good feedback and having a secured environment help the kids to be prepared for their primary institutions.

topic: Governments should spend money on railways rather than roads. To what extend do you agree or disagree with this statement.
essay:
Rational budgeting and diverting funds is considered to be a crucial task for any government, which includes improving public transport. Whilst some experts consider the role of roads as the key economic driver, I strongly advocate the need of up-gradation of technology in railways, as in my opinion, they are the most affordable and efficient mode of transport.

Investing in improving tracks and installing lastest developed products on the trains can not only improve on the journey time but also on the overall experience. Particularly in a country like India, trains help a large number of humans reach their destination at an economical cost, this enables even common man access to farthest corners. By investing in upgrading the engines and railway track to electric powered, we can increase the affordability, reducing carbon emission as a result of burning fossil fuels. For example, if the Delhi metro was running on diesel engines instead of electric, the air pollution level in the city, which is already considered bad enough, would have been highly toxic today. Procuring the advanced engines ensured long-term sustainability, though it might have cost high initially.

Moreover, with the introduction of bullet trains and hyperloop trains, it is predicted that we can reduce the time taken to traverse between major cities to less than half of what it takes in traditional locomotives, due to this businessmen can then make quick official trips without wasting their precious time. For instance, India recently announced plans to launch bullet trains service between Ahemdabad and Mumbai, two big financial hubs of the region, the journey which currently needs 12 hours approximately will eventually get reduced to 3 hours. In other words, a business trip that required 2 days at least, can now be squeezed into a single day.

In conclusion, I opine that, though ensuring holistic development of the country is the government's duty, prioritizing the need to spend money on the railway over the development of road network should be done. This step tends to benefit a larger group of people, ranging from a common man to big business owners.

topic: Many museums charge for admission while others are free. Ċ Do you think the advantages of charging people for admission to museums outweigh the disadvantages.
essay:
In the current times, there are many museums which are charging an entry fee, while there are others in which the access is free. In my opinion, exhibitions, must charge an admission fee as the funds collected can be used in the maintenance and restoration of the museums. However, free entry to museums will pose some serious hazards too.

There are many advantages of charging an entry ticket to such places. Firstly, with the money collected from visitors, janitors can be employed who will ensure that the cleanliness of the space is maintained. Secondly, security guards can be deployed to control and monitor the growing number of tourists. Moreover, if it is a historical museum, the admission charge could be used in the restoration of some old artefacts, including old paintings, costumes and weapons. For instance, a science museum would require money for the maintenance of the equipments and the machines, to be able to demonstrate experiments to visitors.

On the other hand, asking the tourists to not pay an admission ticket has some obvious disadvantages as well. By doing so, the exhibitions become inaccessible to many. In other words, the lower strata of society who are struggling to make ends meet would be unable to visit such places and educate their children about history or natural science with live examples. Additionally, if no access fee is charged, the visitors will start misusing the place for their intended use and it would be difficult to maintain law and order such situations.

In conclusion, museums must pay an entrance charge to ensure correct law and order is maintained. Therefore, the disadvantage of the museums being unaffordable to many can be ignored.

topic: The government should lower the budget on the arts to allocate more money to education. Ċ To what extent do you agree?
essay:
It is clear that, the main responsibility of every state is providing the essential needs of society and developing a nation. There is dissension that the authority should reduce outlay on the artwork and redirect this budget to develop the educational system of the country, while others disagree with this and claim that art projects still demand support from the power. There are valid opinions on both sides, which I will now consider.

On the one hand, there are many reasons to sponsor the idea that technique plays a vital role in social life. First and foremost, the art is related to the identity and unity of people in a country. Moreover, no one can argue that the technique reflects or the creativity of people in a certain time and place. Furthermore, traditional artwork can demonstrate national customs and lifestyle of people in the past. In other words, craft diversity has been handed down for hundreds of years as a treasure, that is why people should not give it to oblivion.

On the other hand, there are multifarious factors to fortify the educational institutions. Important to realise that subsidizing on learning by the politics is more consequential than paying attention to art. Likewise, developing schooling can produce better quality citizens and advanced skill employees to the global work market. As a result, the nation and the regime attain a new level of industrialization and development in all areas of life eventually.

To sum up, in my opinion, even though national artworks have sentimental value to a nation, it is not more necessary than study. From my point of view, the ministry should direct more resources to the expansion of science rather than funding for the craft, as more benefits of this can lead to the prosperity in the future.

topic: We are becoming less influenced by advertising now than in the past. What are the reasons? Is it a positive or negative development?
essay:
The use of online sources brought more awareness in the public these days as compared to a decade ago, while population were so innocent and easily got attracted to the product through the advert. Moreover, people are using product reviews and consumer's comments to make a choice whether to buy or not. In my opinion, it is a significantly positive amplification because an individual could save more just spending on necessities. The essay will analyse the aforementioned reason by using the examples and further discuss, how it is a positive development.

It is undeniable that folks are more active online than a past time, so they are able to get all types of information about everything and not rely only on advertisements. Additionally, when a person wants to buy an item, firstly, they check consumer suggestions and opinions online in the review section and then they made- up a selection. On the other hand in the past companies use celebrities to endorse the brand and customers got attract by that strategy because they were not aware enough. For example, I bought a washing machine a few months ago, but I checked the comments and suggestions first about the machines and the company's customer service. Thus, it is the main reason for the decline in the influence of the advertisement on the audience.

However, it should not be forgotten that, with this awareness, an individual could save more amount of money. In addition to it, the crowd in the old decades followed the commercials about a specific commodity if they bought the wrong one they had to buy it over again and they spend more. For instance, when I was a child my father bought the same shower shop by followed a popular advert on TV and did not get any better results but in these days if we buying something and checking everything online.

In conclusion, even though online awareness is a primary cause of a decrease in influences on the public. Despite that, it is a positive development because people become able to save more money and efforts because they now know their basic needs and what to buy or not due to the trend.

topic: many types of food on the market People can eat a wide variety of food that can be grown in other areas. As a result, people can eat more food produced in other regions than local food. Do you think the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
With more developed transports, people now can try numerous specialties from other places within a short time. This trend brings in benefits as well as drawbacks to both products and consumers.

There is no denying that people can now eat many types of food, fruits, and vegetables grown from far-away regions. This helps to vary the flavor of meals. Moreover, food which is produced on farms is absolutely fresh, delicious, and has a unique flavor from those areas. Besides, consuming food from the poor countryside is a way to support their financial development. On the other hand, the disadvantages of this trend can easily be seen in the cost of food. Imported food have higher costs due to transportation fees, storage fees, and packaging fees. One more weak point is the difficulty in the storage process. Food in the transport process is in danger of being damaged.

In general, both advantages and disadvantages can be pointed out from this phenomenon. However, which one has higher effects depends on your purpose of uses. It will be beneficial if you focus on the original tastes. In contrast, if what you are concerned about is staying on budget, cheap-priced food with similar quality is the best choice.

To conclude, whether using food produced from your regions or other places both have good and bad sides. Depending on your usage, you will choose a way to maximize the benefits.

topic: Travelling in group with a tour guide is the best way to travel. Ċ Do you agree or disagree with this statement?
essay:
There is no doubt that these days tour guider is an available choice for travelling and it is wide spreading with a group. The question is, is transported with a group of people, including a tourist guider the best way? In this essay, I am going to discuss my opinion and draw my own conclusion.

In terms on the positive side, being grouped to travel worldwide is quite funny, it lets you communicate with a lot of travellers who are interested in the same place as you are visiting. The main reason given to support this claim is that people enjoying meeting new societies and nations. To illustrate, if you travelled with your friends usually, you would feel less excited, which leads you the opportunity to start a new chat with strangers. In other words, tourists are for helping people to keep providing themselves to be knowledgeable. For example, guidelines comprise information, but it is not necessary to follow the instructions.

However, on the other hand, there are disadvantages of transporting with a tourist. First of all, extroverts are discomfort whenever they are in public. Put differently, chatting with strangers might not go so well after all. It might be a start of a trouble. Secondly, there is a limited time in each place, that could not be enough. This is because visitors are more likely to be explorers. Also, people like to be in a relaxing place with a quiet atmosphere. Hence, groups could be too noisy.

In conclusion, although it is said that travelling with a company and a tourist guide can be harmful and boring. I believe that it is the best way to travel, especially to cities and historic places.

topic: the best route to a successful career Some people believe that studying at university or college is the best route to a successful career, while others believe that it is better to get a job straight after school.  Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
In recent years, many people believe that studying at higher education would be a better approach to get better job opportunities. However, a number of opponents express that getting a job as soon as students finish school would be outweighed. This essay will discusses both sides and draw out my perspective.

It is apparent fact that people with qualifications not only likely to get well-paid job, but they also become more competitive to open the door in the labor market. Furthermore, skilled workers really need for sectors, such as economy, engineering, information technology and so on. For example, nowadays, manual jobs have been gradually replaced by robots controlled by engineers, whereas we always need specialists who specialize in their field to design, create and develop machine systems.

On the other hand, firstly, learning at university or college would spend them too much money and time, while they have to do extra time to struggle with live expense being more and more expensive. And as a result, this problem led to their downswing in studying. Secondly, degree would be not really necessary in some industries or service professions which needs manual workers. For instance, in developed countries, they always need wide ranges of labors for home services, such as plumber, cleaning carpets, and the price of these service is being increased day by day.

In conclusion, all above opinions are make sense. Therefore, it is really hard for me to draw a definite conclusion. For my opinion, the demerits of learning at higher education are overshadowed by the merits, so we should go to either university or college to get better life.

topic: Governments should spend less money on restoring old buildings and more money for new housing and roads development. Ċ To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Municipalities must not use resources on reviving aged structures but invest them in fresh houses and road refurbishment. I partly agree with this statement because new houses and roads would be easier and less expensive to construct but old buildings are equally important because they form the core of the identity of the place. These factors are discussed below.

First and foremost, investing in new housing and roads development sounds ideal for a government because it is cheaper and more convenient to do than trying to revamp old buildings whose designs may be outdated. The older the structure the more the difficulty and cost of fixing it. That is why certain places in Italy have been surrounded by a fence and declared to be prohibited spaces for the general public. Secondly, new pathways for cars and residences for people ensure that fresh areas can be used for residential purposes. For example, this is the reason that prompted the local council of Bulawayo (in Zimbabwe) to construct new streets and homes in its downtown areas with the elderly populations being most targeted for the new scheme.

Nevertheless, on the other hand, aged structures are critical in helping to identify a location. In certain countries like England, they are used as historical sites for tourism purposes which justifies their importance. It would even be difficult to go around a location where one cannot identify a longstanding structure. One friend, as an example, once said to me that they have been in Brussels for a very long time but still use the train station as the starting point when looking to explore the metropolis to avoid getting lost.

In conclusion, to a greater extent, it sounds less ideal to fix older buildings and wiser to go for newer ones (and roads alike) due to the convenience and reduced cost of doing so. However, we cannot overlook the importance of an old structure in preserving the heritage of a place and making it easier to explore.
