topic: New stories on TV and newspapers are very often accompanied by pictures. Some people say that these pictures are more effective than words. What is your opinion about this?
essay:
It is a fact that pictures are accompanied by televisions and newspapers these days. Many people like this approach of presenting pictures about the stories. In my opinion, these are indeed helpful in describing the moral and thoughts of the stories. Also, it is more valuable than words.

Pictures are so handy nowadays to present the stories in short. To elaborate this, it is a tendency of people to go through the drawings and pictures before go deep into the stories described in media. Also, these are always the point of attraction to all ages of the people. Every one of us always attracted towards the picture and try to understand the meaning behind it.

Further, children are fond of looking at the fascinated drawings and pictures. They innate many thoughts and ideas looking at the pictures shown in newspapers or television. For them, picture is the first impression before the stories. Hence, this plays an important role in case of the youngsters. In addition to this, many writers and entrepreneurs agree with the viewpoint about the importance of a picture in real world. According to them, pictures carry many words and offer outlook of the story.

To recapitulate, it is undeniable that pictures play key role behind the stories as it narrates the moral and sensitive details of the stories. According to me, words would be too lengthy and time consuming to elaborate the whole story; whereas through pictures one can explain the viewpoint of the story in short.

topic: Some people believe that adults always do exercise and sports because of the major sports events that shown on T.V like the Olympic Games and Football World Cup. While others say that there are many other ways to encourage them to practice exercises other than T.V shows. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
It is an undeniable fact that, the people these days show a great interest in sports. Some people think that it is the influence of gaming events, like the Olympics and Football World Cup, which compels them to exercise. While, others argue that certain other methods could be applied to encourage people to work out, apart from these television shows. In this essay, I would like to discuss both these schools of thought and would suggest that the former point of view is far better than the latter.

Firstly, introducing physical training classes in the schools and colleges could have a great impact on compelling people towards sports. For example, when children are made to participate in exercise classes in schools, they learn to stay fit from the very early years of their life. Moreover, they develop a deep interest in exercising and staying healthy, which they continue even when they get old. Secondly, arranging sports competitions in educational institutions could also motivate people to take part in the games. But, these measures are, unfortunately, inapplicable to every child and adult. This is because not every institute is able to offer such facilities to the students.

On the contrary, with the availability of television in every house in the world, these days, and with a large number of channels featuring sporting events, it is quite easy for most of the people, both adults and children, to watch them and practice whichever game they like. For instance, there are a large number of fans of Christiano Ronaldo, a renowned footballer, who follow him and try to be like him, for which they play football keenly and thus stay healthy. Similarly, badminton and cycling, are the sports in which many people take part, because they watch their favourite players on the television shows and idealize them. This copying is a healthy one and there is no harm if people choose to stay healthy this way.

To conclude, although, with the provision of options like training classes and gaming competitions, adults could be motivated to exercise, nonetheless, watching their idols winning on T.V is aan endorsement made in a passport that allows the bearer to enter the country issuing itVisa booster for the people and a far more important reason to work out.

topic: Big sporting events are shown on television like Olympic and world cup , some people say that this would encourage adult to exercise. Others say that other ways we can encourage exercises. Ċ What do you think?
essay:
Sports have played a very important role in the lives of the human beings, since time immemorial. They have served as platforms for people to come together and flex their muscles. With the technological advancements, we now have the comfort of watching large sports events on our televisions. While some believe that this can encourage physical activity, others are of the opinion that there are better alternatives to motivate exercise. I strongly believe that there are other better methods than watching TV to induce people to workout and this essay will support my opinion with relevant evidences.

Before the invention of TV, children used to play everyday with other kids in their locality or schools in the evening. This regular habit of playing promoted physical fitness right from a very young age. However, after the introduction of the small screen at homes, more and more children have started becoming addicted to watching shows rather than going outside and playing. For example, the obesity levels of children in today's World are the highest on record. Therefore, we can observe that the comfort of watching sports events and other shows at home has only reduced the habit of playing among children.

The large events such as World Cup, FIFA, Olympics, etc., are particularly seen by adults. The fact is that when people watch these games, the same hormones that secrete in the players are secreted in the viewers as well. For instance, a man watching a football match becomes associated with the players mentally and believes that he is playing the game, leading to his body generating adrenaline, the stress hormone. This is dangerous because the individual gets the satisfaction of having done the physical activity, without actually doing it, resulting in zero motivation to take the effort to perform the exercise.

In a nutshell, viewing the games on small screen does not in any way help in promoting physical activity. Therefore, more suitable methods such as organizing marathons, tournaments and adventure games in the local community can go a long way in imparting fitness goals and good habits among the public. It is recommended that public awareness on the hazards of obesity and the need to exercise is propagated and appropriate measures like organizing community events are taken by the local Government.

topic: Task 2: Some people believe that the personal information of violent criminals should be made available to the public. Others think that this information should be protected. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
It is a common belief that concealing criminals' personal information should be mandatory as a national policy to prevent discrimination towards their innocent families. However, I firmly believe that publicize criminals' identity more persuasive as it could protect our community.

To begin with, protecting offenders' personal information helps their families not to be discriminated against and unequally treated in society. In addition, this could highly victimize the criminals' families as people predispose to stay away from relatives who have relationships with them. For instance, research in a British university conducted by prominent professors indicated that a significantly high number of individuals who have relationships with criminals suicided due to stress and strains they endured from the discrimination of their society.

On top of that, many people believe that revealing the identities of criminals publicly encourage people to be aware of the pervasive threats around them. Moreover, making civilians acknowledge notorious criminals' information helps them to stay away from offenders, prepare better plans or self-protect tools and consequently reduce crime cases. For example, research in Vietnam was conducted to observe the changes in the community after a publishment of a government policy which is to require the national media to publicize the criminals' personal information. It pointed a fact that the crime rate has dwindled substantially and most citizens have raised their awareness towards crimes.

In conclusion, it would be a righteous way to keep the offenders' identities secret in order to eradicate the discrimination rate towards innocent people such as their relatives. However, I support the idea that government should make the identities of criminals known publicly due to the unparalleled benefit of protecting their citizens.

topic: When a country develops its technology, the traditional skills and ways of life die out. It is pointless to try and keep them alive. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
essay:
It is a common belief nowadays that fast-developing technology leads to the extinction of the authentic lifestyle, furthermore, it is commonly accepted that there is no point in keeping the traditions alive. In this essay, I will look into this opinion and will provide the reasons why I completely disagree with the statement.

Firstly, a nation without a past can not have a future – it Is a saying of a great writer – Alexander Pushkin. In other words, national identity helps to build a strong and united community. A good illustration of this is Japan, which has drastically changed after World War II. This change occurred due to the traditional ethics of hard work and loyalty to the employer, thus supporting and feeding one of the greatest economies in the world.

Secondly, the authenticity of a certain country draws huge tourist attention, also resulting in a touristic sector’s development. For example, the numbers of travellers to Mongolia are rising on a yearly basis. The explorers are fascinated by the unique nomadic lifestyle of the population, such as living in a yurt, raising cattle while constantly moving from one pasture to another. This exclusiveness and the feeling of observing the diversity are the main drivers of Mongolia’s budget income, therefore it is vital to keep the traditions and to pass them on to future generations.

In conclusion, I strongly disagree that there is no justification for preserving the nation’s authenticity. Communities with sustainable traditions have proven to develop stronger economies, as well as contributing to tourism growth.

topic: Research suggests that majority of criminal who send to prison would commit crimes when set free, what do you think of this case? What to be done to solve this problem?
essay:
With the criminal rate surging, some people argue that the hardened criminals violate laws simply for offences' criminal tendency. They even suggest that these culprits should be punished by capital punishment. From my perspective, however, reverting to crime is rooted in several reasons, including the proliferation of mistreatment in cells, crime's trauma and criminals being dis-socialized. To cope with the problems, lenient measures should be adopted by authorities.

Firstly, the contributing factor is ill-treat. The number of inmates suffered from the cruel punishment has on the rise. Convicts abused may disobey impulsively the law when they are out of prisons. Moreover, inmates' trauma is blamed for the raising rate of repeated offenders. Convicts lived in the astonishingly harsh condition would more likely to resent society, thereby breaking the law once again, with no regard for the moral code. The repeated crime is also influenced by perpetrators' isolated life. Inmates being imprisoned for years are probably unable to integrate into a community because they are concerned about the society's discrimination.

The fundamental solution to reduce the number of hardened criminals would be to enhance surveillance systems in jails, in order that convicts' fight could be under control. In addition, the corruption, bribery and abuses of prisoners should be prevented, which can greatly better inmates' life condition. Meanwhile, authorities should educate the prisoners about how to be a law-abiding-citizens and provide them with employment opportunities. Most importantly, while the existence of discrimination, the authorities should encourage local companies to offer jobs to first-time offenders.

In conclusion, the reason for the issue of the repeated crime is diverse. Technically, only through either careful process or lenient policy could we decrease the incidence of the repeated crime and improve security of the society.

topic: Should wealthy nations be required to share their wealth among poorer nations by providing such things as food and education? Or is it the responsibility of the governments of poorer nations to look after their citizens themselves?
essay:
Some people believe that the wealthy nations should aid the poor countries by providing the basic needs like food and education while others advocate that it is the responsibility of the administrations of these countries to fulfil the needs of their people. Although both parties have strong justifications for their opinions, I believe that the ruling authorities of a particular nation are liable to provide the basic amenities to its citizens.

To begin with, it is aChange the articletheIt appears that the article a may be incorrect in this context. Consider changing it.

show examples sole duty of the government to make arrangements for the natives in terms of living and schooling because they are elected by the same people to make the country progressive. To further elaborate, if the funds and charity are readily available to the governing bodies of the poorer countries, they will not pull themselves to make the better policies for their country and thus the fate of the nation will remain in dark. For example, Nigeria got the financial aid for the years and the ruling party members ruined the nation with corruption and the society couldn't help itself to become self-sufficient.

Secondly, providing aids to others is unfair for the people of the rich countries as it is the hard-earned money of the people which they hand over to the government in terms of tax. To explain briefly, there should not be any burden on the citizens of the first world countries to pay taxes and funds to authorities unless they get no return on it, this is absolute injustice with them. For instance, an individual works hard for hours to feed his family and if the part of his earning is taken and spent on some other then it is unacceptable on his part. However, in some circumstances like natural disasters, pandemics or war situations, it is obligatory on every human being to help the needy.

To conclude, the governments of unfortunate countries should not rely on aid and funds from strong nations, instead, they should make policies and schemes for the welfare of their own citizens which will be beneficial in the long run. Moreover, it is the basic right of every human to work for and make a better lifestyle for himself and his family, hence it is not good to increase the burden of taxes on the people of stable nations.

topic: There are many different types of music in the world today. Why do we need music? Is the traditional music of a country more important than the International music that is heard everywhere nowadays?
essay:
Music plays an important role in people's lives. They need music to booster their mood particularly when they have to workout. Sadly, people have a tendency to choose international music than traditional one. This essay will discuss about these two notions.

Music helps people to get better mood in exercise since it can set tone followed by people's movements. They feel to be accompanied with the harmony or intonation of music, and this makes them more spirit to do sport. For illustrate, when I joined in fitness centre, I was likely to listen to fast beat music in my MP3 player, while I did my cardio exercise on treadmill equipment. I could undergo for more than 30 minutes. In reverse, when I forgot to use it, I only did less than 10 minutes. This is the reason why the music is very essential for people's lives.

For music preference, people especially young generations tend to choose international music particularly with song or lyrics than traditional music. They like this music as they can develop their English ability in listening. This helps their ears sensible listen to English vocabulary. A recent study by Tokyo University found that 60% of senior high school students in Japan could accomplish listening exam at 80% due to listening western music regularly. This means that the music can be used for studying method. However, they may lack of traditional music references.

All in all, people harness the music to stimulate their moods in doing sport. However, some others prefer to international than traditional music. There is an anxiety that the latter may become extinct if several people listen to the former more.

topic: More and more measures to improve the security in the urban area have been introduced because of the increased crime. Do the benefits of the measures outweigh the drawbacks?
essay:
The authority is increasingly making more enhancements in security system due to the upsurge in the number of offences during recent years . In my opinion, the goodpoints of this approach far eclipse its drawbacks for several reasons

Firstly, this change in policy helps guarantee a secured life, improving life quality. Recent installament of CCTV and increase in patrolmen seem to have a positive effect in reducing crime rate. To illustrate, gangsters and murders that previously constantly posing a threat to many people's life no longer have any chance to commit a crime for fear of being recorded by the camera. Moreover,  in case of emergencies, police tend to act more promptly, which saves several lives in gun-fightings. Therefore, people feel safer and have more satisfaction in life.

Another season that makes improving security the optimal solution is that it helps improve many key sectors in one country, especially the economy. This is because a safe living environment attracts a large number long-term residents. This, in the long run , will potentially lead to the establishment and thriving of several companies and corporations, bettering the economy.

However, opponents of this policy claim that it is excessively expensive the government cannot afford and there are other critical issues that are more urgent. This does not stand to reason as security is a long-term investment which is beneficial to bot the government and residents. Moreover,if we do not invest properly in it the consequences may be severe, which would definitely lead to more cost to cover. For example, recent chaos in some states of USA causes by insecurities is disturbing both the politic situation

In conclusion, the complaint about extravagance and uneffectiveness of spending on security system is groundless. For a better future, governments should have no hesitation in enhancing domestic security.

topic: The number of overweight children in developed countries is increasing. Some people think this is due to problems such as the growing number of fast food outlets. Others believe that parents are to blame for not looking after their children's health. Ċ To what extent do you agree with these views?
essay:
It has been argued by many that the obesity in kids is increasing in many developed countries due to increased consumption of fast food, while others believe that it's due to careless attitudes of the parents towards their kid's health. In my opinion, I think that the both schools of thoughts are valid, as the junk food outlets and the carefree behaviour of the guardians are responsible for this trend.

On the one hand, due to the increased pace of life, the fast food is gaining popularity in all parts of the world. Firstly, the items like burgers, pizza and potato fries are very much famous in the kids. Secondly, they have a high caloric count as they are rich in carbohydrates and fats. Moreover, they are made cheaper to attract the customers. So, all this disturbs the equilibrium in the body of a youngster and he starts gaining weight. For example, according to a recent research of the UK, there is a rise of 46% in the popularity of junk edibles in the younger age group.

On the other hand, the elders are so much busy in their jobs that they are not paying proper attention to their family. The mothers tend to buy time by serving ready made items to the young ones. Furthermore, there is a rising trend in the families to go out for excursions and have dinner in a restaurant. All this increases the use of unhealthy meals and this is the main cause of gaining weight of the growing body. For instance, about 67% of the school going population are obese due to frequent use of hot dogs in the USA.

To conclude, I think that it's a matter of great concern and has to be resolved by proper education of all the tiers of life, so that our future generation is disease free and more productive.

topic: It is better for college students to live far away from home than live at home with their parents. Ċ Do you agree or disagree? Ċ You should write at least 250 words.
essay:
Should students stay in hostels or should they continue to live in their family house? This topic has somewhat become debatable. I strongly agree with the premise that students must not live in their homes during student life. In the following paragraphs, I will discuss why living on campus is more effective and how living further away from the college can be a potential impediment to studies.

To begin with, the biggest advantage of living in an on campus facility like a hostel is that students have access to all the necessary amenities like libraries, computer labs etc. Hence, they can conduct their studies more effectively. The ambience that on-campus residential facilities provide is also very conducive for studying. In addition to that, since hostels are normally situated in the same vicinity as the College campus, daily commute becomes very easy and is not at all hectic.

In contrast, living in your parent’s house while studying has several inherent problems. For instance, in order to study productively and effectively, right environment is of absolute importance. Unfortunately, a well-disciplined environment of that of a classroom cannot be replicated at home. Students might spend more than usual time on extracurricular activities like playing video games, watching T.V., excessively staying out at night with friends etc. Which may consequently impact their grades.

To conclude, students must prefer to live in hostels instead of staying in their own house during college years. This will allow them to focus more efficiently on studies and they can also refrain themselves from engaging in unnecessary activities that may have a deteriorating impact on their study life.

topic: "Everybody should donate a fixed amount of their income to support charity." How far do you share this viewpoint?
essay:
Nowadays, doing charity has become a popular activity that many people participate in. This leads to the idea that everyone should contribute a stable part of their revenue to charity. From my point of view, there are some loop holes of this idea that lead to my disagreement.

To begin with, obliging everyone to donate their money without considering their will does not seem to be a sound decision. This mean that it should not be expected a person to contribute their money with a cranky face because doing charity is not solely giving money but also the willingness to help others of donators. Another argument is that since workers are paid differently, giving a fixed amount of money seems fair but in the pattern of living standard, the lower-income people may find it more struggling in daily life than higher-income people do. This might make the situation decline because people with low income might become the ones who should receive charity. Last but not least, encouraging everyone to contribute money can be the root of social corruption. The result of this is that lazy people might take advantage of the policy to receive money from the ones who contribute their effort to make a better society. Those dependent people would be burden of community if the idea were supported.

I accept that raising fund for poor people is a humane activity. It can help promote economy and motivate people to work harder. However, the disadvantages tend to overwhelm the advantages brought by the idea.

To conclude, due to the differences in status and living condition, forcing everyone to donate money should not be encouraged. Instead, everyone can help poor people with voluntary activities or donating old clothes instead of money.

While financial support can aid the poor and stimulate economic effort, voluntary forms of assistance—such as donating goods or time—are more equitable and sustainable alternatives that preserve both dignity and personal responsibility.

topic: Some people think the government should take measures regarding the healthy lifestyles of individuals. Others think it must be managed by individuals. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
essay:
It is often argued that the government should take responsibility for ensuring healthy lifestyles for its people. However, others consider that this should be done by the person himself. In this essay, I will discuss both points of view and conclude with my own opinion.

On the one hand, the government, as an administrative body, can do a lot to improve the health of its citizens. For instance, it can enhance health awareness through different educational programs. The more people know about the benefits of a balanced diet, as well as physical activity, the more likely they are to build a healthy future generation. Besides, the state may build sports facilities, such as fitness centres, swimming pools and more to increase the citizens` motivation to exercise.

On the other hand, a person is equally responsible for his well-being. No matter how hard the government tries to promote a healthy lifestyle to the masses, it will not succeed if the citizens do not want to follow it. A good illustration of this is the warnings, such as "Smoking kills" on cigarettes and "Alcohol is harmful to health", which can be seen on television. These messages in most cases do not stop people and do not force them to quit their bad habits. In addition, the same thing often happens with textbooks and articles on the Internet that teach how to eat and exercise properly.

In conclusion, both arguments have a significant impact on people`s healthy lives in their own way. Therefore, I believe that both the state and the individual are responsible for maintaining the well-being of the nation.

topic: In the future, students may have the choice of studying at home by using technology such as computers or television or of studying at traditional schools. Which would you prefer?
essay:
In this essay I want to discuss the difference between studying at home by using technology and at traditional schools. There are some students who prefer to use technology at home when they study. I prefer to study at home by using technology for three reasons: comfort, speed, and better meaning.

First, difference between study technology and traditional schools is comfortable. When I study, I can use my computer to find anything I want. For example, if my teacher gave me assignments, I can do it by computer. Also, if I have homework, I can type it to make it become clear when my teacher reads it. However the traditional schools are uncomfortable to do any assignments and not clear when I did the homework by hand.

topic: Some educationalists say that every child should be taught how to play a musical instrument. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Since musical instruments such as piano, trumpet and violin... have been demonstrated to have numerous merits for humane, many specialists in education claim that it is essential for children to learn to play an instrument. From my perspective, I am in definite support of this contention.

To begin with, teaching children how to play an instrument has some certain disadvantages. First, it can be time-consuming if children don't like the instrument that they learn. Without patient and passion, a child can easily drop out of the process when being an amateur. Second, it costs parents a great deal of money if they want their children can play a musical instrument smoothly. Since learning to play an instrument is a long term investment, the expense is absolutely not small at all.

However, despite some minor downsides, I believe that learning how to play an instrument owns many more benefits in comparison. The most obvious one is that it helps children gain more confidence towards their friends. If a child is not good at studying, then knowing how to play an instrument can make her or him have aspect to proud of. Therefore, having the ability to play an instrument is a great tool for children to be self-confident.

In addition, playing an instrument is proved to have positive mental effects on individuals. Not only does it increase ones' intelligence, but it also prevents handful of mental illnesses such as sleeplessness, stress,... These are really necessary for each person in this innovative era.

In conclusion, although teaching children how to play a musical instrument has some risks, I have a great belief that every child should be given opportunity to learn an instrument as its merits outweigh all downsides.

topic: Nowadays because of digital technology it is possible for not only studios but also individuals to produce their own films. Ċ Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
essay:
These days, films are not only could be made by studios, but also by ourselves due to the development of digital technology. While I agree that making movies on our own is very beneficial, I believe that this advancing will also raise fears of mass-unemployment.

On the one hand, in the rising of technology, I would agree that making videos with our hands is an amusing and valuable thing. In other words, producing films on our own, firstly, helps us having a sense of attractiveness to spread our ideas creatively. Secondly, a large amount of investment on making movies is steadily decreased. Also, we do not have to depend on the filming crew. We can record films based on our desires, use our favourite device, or even in choosing costumes. Finally, the shops which are selling cameras will have a chance to achieve interests from a great number of people who want to produce videos themselves.

On the other hand, these modern facilities are not only beneficial, but also cause significant mass-unemployment problems. It means that studios are now cannot work regularly because of the development of automation. In particular, photographers might not be rented, sponsors are not accepted due to the advantages of technology listed above. Lastly, some people are who are not likely to be profession will cause the bad quality of the production, so videos they have made are not as good as the professional's.

In conclusion, although advancing machinery has a variety of advantages, I believe that its disadvantages are now causing a lot of issues.

topic: Many people depend on their cars for everyday domestic, social, and working needs. However, unlimited use of cars causes a number of problems. What are some of these problems? What can be done to reduce the use of cars?
essay:
Nowadays, people relay on driving cars for their daily activities. Unfortunately, the increasing use of cars lead us to another problem concerning our environment such as air pollution and the lack of natural resources. Government's role to make strict regulation will be a great help to limit the use of cars.

One of the main issue caused by cars is air pollution. When a car's engine is running, several different types of gasses and particles are emitted that can have bad effects on the environment. For instance, we can make a comparison between the air's quality in big cities such as Jakarta and the small one. Jakarta feels very hot while we still can feel fresh air in small city with the less numbers of cars. The hot weather in Jakarta is caused by the vehicle emissions.

On the other hand, the increasing number on the use of cars will also lead to the lack of natural resources. Cars use gasoline to operate. Many cars means that there will be much gasoline needed while the amount of gasoline in our earth is very limited. If there is significant amount on the use of gasoline, then it is just about time until we will run out of gasoline and it will surely damage the stability of our environment.

To sum up, the unlimited use of cars will not be good for our environment to come. One alternative way to reduce the numbers of cars is the role of government as the stakeholders to make strict regulation on limiting the use of cars.

topic: The growth of online shopping will one day lead to all shops in town and cities closing. Ċ Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Nowadays, e-commerce sites are rising day by day, which results in shut down of many stores in the big cities. This approach is causing the problem to many shopkeepers. I partially agreed with this statement. This essay shall discuss the both views with some examples in subsequent paragraphs.

To commence with, the first and foremost reason for the high demands of the online shopping is time-saving. In addition, due to time congestion, youngsters generally prefer buying items online. Not only it saves time, but also it is more convenient. For example, working peoples did not get enough time for going to the shop. Moreover, an individual likes to order the product from their home. This process is time-consuming as well as money effective. Furthermore, it is generally observed that most of the websites offer many discounts or money back schemes which attract customers to participate.

On the other hand, most of the shops in the mall does not offer an attractive discount and imposed extra charges. This approach makes the cut off towards them. For example, doing shopping from any outlet, requires the whole day and cost you more as compared to the online stores. This issue may resolve by reducing hidden charges and by providing a good discount to a person. This problem would be solved by offering the same price as online sites. This process may help the small shops to attract more people and also for growing their business.

topic: Some people think that the governments of developing countries should introduce new technology to improve the quality of life, while some people believe that the best way is to develop education. Discuss both views and give your opinion
essay:
Opinions are divided on whether the state authorities of countries under development should invest in advanced technology or education in order to enhance citizens’ well-being.

On the one hand, developing cutting-edge technology can benefit underprivileged countries’ inhabitants in two ways.Firstly, high-tech inventions can solve some of the critical issues in developing cities.For example, genetically-modified food which comes from latest technology can adapt to harsh growing conditions like areas suffered from drought or flooding areas. This can help solve the food shortage problem in some countries, so as to improve citizenry’s living standards. In addition, technology development can bring about job opportunities. Officials have to employ many people as well as getting help from developing countries if they want to have technological advancement. There will be a imparting of knowledge from developing countries to the inferior one, equipping residents with the valuable technique, allowing places to turn into a knowledge-based economy in the long run.

On the other hand, some individuals contend that the impoverished countries should focus on improving the education level of civilians. The administrative parties can increase the expenditures on teaching so as to employ more qualified teachers from foreign places, teaching people standardized universal language, English. For instance, this can increase the literary rate of citizens while at the same time boosts the employability of inhabitants in the poor countries. They can get job opportunities from a large scale international firm or even work overseas. Therefore, city dwellers’ living conditions can be greatly enhanced by earning more salary from big companies.

In conclusion, in my opinion, an impoverished nation cannot only rely on education improvement or technology alone to better citizens’ life quality. Only if both of them are incorporated, can locals really enjoy a good standard of living.

topic: Some people believe that it is good to share as much as possible in scientific research, business and the academic world. Others believe that some information is too important or too valuable to be shared freely. Ċ Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
People’s opinions differ on whether different information in science or business should be shared freely or not. While I believe that sharing data has enormous advantages, I reckon some types of info should be kept secret.

On the one hand, there are several situations where sharing data could be beneficial. Academic research is a good example. Collaboration between universities even those who are placed in different continents has been common for several years. For respecting the rights of researchers, there are many protocols like NDA that make this joining safe and secure for both sides. Moreover, when humankind is struggling with a worldwide disease like Covid, sharing findings of the ways of stopping it from spreading or curing the patients is a task for each doctor. Also, each company needs the flow of information between its employees to be clear and straight. Businesses’ thrive depending on the level of their human resources knowledge.

On the other hand, there is critical information that if be accessible for everyone could result in catastrophic events. The knowledge of the creation of missiles and atomic bombs are such examples that the case of seepage would threaten the lives of many people around the world. Although sharing health care knowledge is ethical, the rights of inventors and explorers should be considered too. If their discoveries are shared out, their enthusiasm for further research would vanish after a while.

In conclusion, sharing information freely is a good practice for many situations, but there are some cases that restricting public access is inevitable.

topic: Planting trees is very important .some people says that trees should be planted in the vacant areas of cities and town, while others says that housing facilities should be build instead. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
People have differing views concerning the question of how to use vacant areas in the cities. While some argue that it would be better to develop housing and associated facilities in these spaces, I believe that planting trees is much more vital for human's life.

There are various reasons why some people believe that uninhabited areas inside the cities should be allocated to build new buildings. They may assert that nowadays, due to the rapid pace of population growth, housing demand is increasing. Therefore, it may be reasonable to benefit the whole interior potential to occupy residents; particularly those working in the cities. Because people certainly prefer to be as much close to their workplace as they can to reduce the cost of living related to commuting. Besides, proponents of this idea argue that each city needs to be known by its landmarks principally made of deserted ground in the city centre. As a result, these skyscrapers can attract more tourists, leading to making new job opportunities for local people.

In spite of these arguments, I believe that cities are required to achieve the right balance between housing and gardening. Firstly, trees are considered to be the Earth's lungs. They naturally absorb a huge amount of generated CO2 and produce O2 as the first key element to be live, resulting in breathing a more purified air. Secondly, people are mainly looking for a relaxing atmosphere matched with their nature. This prospect will be bleak unless a natural environment is provided by planting as many trees as possible. The reason why this is assumed is that not only are they able to mitigate the sound pollution, but also they are claimed to be an effective way to diminish the crime rate. Finally, this world belongs to all creatures correlating to each other in a natural cycle. Forests, as one of the most significant habitat, have a pivotal role to play to prevent the irreparable negative impacts of changing ecosystem in a long- term.

In conclusion, although it might seem that housing expansion is necessary for cities, in my view, governments should attach great importance to developing green spaces.

topic: Nowadays the way many people interact with each other has changed because of technology. In what ways has technology affected the types of relationships that people make? Has this been a positive or negative development?
essay:
In the present age, due to the rapid development of technology, a great transform occurs in the ways of communication between individuals. Personally, I think the influence to the types of relationships is vary.

Obviously, the innovation of telephone is the first remarkable change in communication means brought by the boost of technology, wich altered the traditional ways of contact between the relatives and friends--mail, telegraph or visit by costly transport. Then the mobile phone occured, as well as the short message, fulfilling the demand of keeping in touch regardless of time and place. Finally, the increasing number of poeple, especially the youngsters, have chosen online chatting as the first option of communication means, which can broaden the range of making friends.

Admittedly, this trend brings many merits in efficiency of making friends, saving time and money compared with visit. Even so, it still has some demerits as follows: firstly, just like fast foods, the efficiency tend to decrease the sentimental investments in each relationship, thus those youngsters who used to chat online only can hardly have a sense equalling to that in those time when people wrote letters to express themselves. Additionally, crimes may be committed during the meet of "internet friends" in the reality.

To conclude, even though the development of technology brings us many conveniences in contact and making new friends, I still hope it will not make us lose those precious senses of feeling, as well as beware of those "new friends" while meeting.

topic: In many countries, women and men are working full time .it is there fore logical for men and women to share household tasks.to what extent do you agree or disagree.
essay:
Nowadays, in most of the countries, men and women are working full time without any disparities. Hence, it is reasonable for both of them to share the household tasks. In my opinion, I agree with this notion. Obviously, it is a feasible claim. In this essay, we'll discuss the relevant attributes for it.

To begin with, at present, there aren't any differences in the working hours among male and female. Indeed, now, women tend to out-perform men in numerous ways. Moreover, due to this situation, women are no longer the kitchen servants. Which, they've been doing for decades. For instance, there is literally no job particular to men now. Almost all of the jobs have witnessed women participations. So, it is apparent that, female's aren't constrained to a little space anymore.

Secondly, due to the equality, both men and women can take the responsibilities for the household tasks. On the other hand, men have to understand this situation, and bare the activities at least to a certain extent. In addition, it's better to prioritize their needs according to the prevailing conditions. For example, if both are working couples, they can help each other corresponding with their work schedule, and commitments. Which would be a better solution for this problem. Thus, the trend has been changed now.

In conclusion, though, women are better in managing the home, men have to involve themselves voluntarily, and also they have to understand their partner's situation. Lastly, by mutual approaching, we can eliminate unnecessary arguments, which may lead to misunderstandings among the family.

topic: An increasing number of children have become hooked on fast food and aerated drinks that do not provide much nutrition. This poor diet has led to a rise in obesity among children. Ċ What are the problems that are associated with obesity in children and what steps could be taken to prevent it?
essay:
Health issues particularly related to obesity caused by the large consumption of fast food and soft drinks is rapidly accelerating in the modern era and children are the main victims of it. This essay will firstly, examine various negative aspects of this trend and secondly, some of the feasible solutions will be discussed.

To begin with, if youngsters continue to consume these ready-made foods, the consequence of it will be observed in the generations to come. To elaborate, unhealthy diet at these food establishments is responsible for overweightness which in turn causes some of the debilitating diseases such as cardiovascular disease, high blood pressure sometimes leading a person to death. For example, with widespread of the fast food outlets in our town, there has been an unbelievable rise in the obesity among the children and many deaths had been reported in previous years due to heart attacks. Furthermore, this drastic disease of overweight increases the expenditure in society as the healthcare institutes raise the prices when they go in demand.

On the other hand, there are numerous ways we can combat this deteriorating health issue and the long-term solution is the workout. To further explain, partaking in daily exercise is the best way we can tackle the problem of obesity naturally without taking medicines, full of side effects. For instance, if schools include fitness classes to their syllabus, the children would develop the habit of daily exercise, hence making it possible to reduce the problem of obesity.In addition to the above, the governing bodies should regulate the laws against the advertisement of these fast foods and drinks which are mainly tempting to children.

To conclude, the health issues related to weight are increasing among the youth and it has some serious consequences in form of diseases which can pass to coming generations, also it can increase the death rate. However, by encouraging people to go for running and sports will help us to tackle this issue in the long run, moreover, adverts of these fast foods should be checked by administration.

topic: Some people say that the clothes people wear are the most important indication of what they are like. Others, however, say that people should not be judged by the clothes they wear.  Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Labelled someone by their appearance is being debated. Some people argue that the most essential indication of what people like is by seeing what clothes which they wear while the opponents say that people should not be judged by their look.  I personally argue that although first impression is important, judging someone by their clothes is not fair since there are several values that can be used for assess them.

There might be a reason why people think that they can judge someone by looking at what clothes that he or she wears. It cannot be denied when there is a job interview, an interviewer will see how an applicant dressed at the first time they come to the company. The applicant who is not well dressed will be judged automatically as an impolite person since they will be assessed but they do not show their best clothes. As a consequence, that applicant may not be considered as a strong candidate to get the position in the company.

On the other hand, it is not fair to judge people by only looking at their style before they show their capability. There are several points that can be used as consideration. First, the way people behave is the most significant factor. It would be useless if the well-dressed applicant shows bad attitude during the job interview. Moreover, skills and capabilities are also important for assessment. I believe that these factors are more vital than someone's appearance.

To sum up, I strongly agree that people cannot be judged only by their clothes because there are more principal factors that should be considered before assessing people.

topic: Some people work for the same organization all their working life. Others think that it is better to work for different organizations. Discuss both these views and give your opinion.
essay:
Myriad people prefer to work with their current organization for a longer time in their career, whereas, other ponder that switching the companies are beneficial. In my opinion, I do believe that being associated with one company for more than years can make your life flexible, and build trust, however, working with manifold firms enhance employee skills and remuneration.

On the one hand, it is irrefutable, that an employee can earn credence and maintain the equilibrium of his personal and professional activity if he lasts in the same office. To be more precise, once the trustworthy relationship establishes such as honesty, and reliability between the manager and the worker, it becomes easy to take the ownership of critical clients and the projects, however, with the new company, it takes ages to build this integrity. Moreover, the co-workers have well adjusted with other things as well, for instance, the shift hours, public holidays, team members, and manage their personal matters accordingly, which is imperative to live a hassle-free life.

On the other hand, changing the agency within the time frame can aid the workman to upgrade his knowledge and draw a handsome salary. Simply stated, if an individual work with multifarious companies he ameliorates his understanding by learning new applications such as Tableau, data, science, Excel, and PowerPoint based on his previous experience and qualification. Additionally, when this proficiency adds to his curriculum vitae it will automatically boost his salary and demand in the market. Therefore, it is advisable to hands-on different training to upsurge your financial condition and the current position.

In conclusion, I cannot but agree that working in a similar corporation can make a faithful relationship with the management and adjust your life well, however, shifting the workplace can increase your learning and honorarium.

topic: Some people think that it is fine for professional sportsmen and sportswomen to misbehave on or off the field, as long as they are playing well. Do you agree or disagree with this statement?
essay:
There have been some arguments in favour of allowing wrongdoing among professional athletes on and off the field provided that they maintain outstanding performance. While I agree that this may be somewhat acceptable, I am of the opinion that inappropriate behaviour should not be tolerated for several reasons.

The main reason why some families support athletic transgression is that it draws more attention and thus generates more money. Most society already is interested in professional business tournaments since this is when the best of the best go head-to-head to defend their title and gain recognition. However, this interest is doubled when these competitions become more than a display of athletic abilities. They like it when athletes provoke their opponents through actions that trigger them. One example of this is a UFC match-up where an Irish mixed martial arts fighter offered alcoholic beverages to his Muslim rival at a press conference leading up to this event. The result was a verbal altercation that received millions of views on social media platforms, which profited the fight organizers.

However, I strongly believe that such inappropriacy in sport cannot be allowed as It affects other nations involved in many respects. Firstly, unacceptable behaviour on the part of a professional athlete, whether it be before, after or during a game, may increase the likelihood of physical harm to the public as well as themselves. If a sportsman exhibits signs of aggression and disrespect towards their counterparts, chances are they will be treated in the same way by other players. This, as a result, creates a toxic environment lacking elements of sportsmanship, which is conducive to clashes between teams and even brawls. Further, unprofessionalism of this sort by famous athletes sends the wrong message to their admirers. It teaches them they are entitled to behave however they like once they achieve some success in life. Eventually, similar unacceptable acts from professional sportspeople might contribute to the normalization of offence among the population.

In conclusion, despite the positive views in support of misbehaviour in business, I would argue that there should be no room for this trend given that it can be a cause for physical damage to other communities and normalize mismanagement among millions of fans of play.

topic: Countries are becoming more and more similar because people are able to buy the same products anywhere in the world. Ċ Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
essay:
Due to the globalization, many parts of the world have been revolutionized. This will lead to the people from various nations are using the same products in their routine life. As per my opinion, this will affect in an irrefutable manner which represents the unity between the people. The essay will discuss above notion with arguments in below paragraphs.

To begin with, the predominant reason is that most of the people over the world are now educated. This will make them to select the product which would be beneficial for their health. Even having the enough money to buy it. Moreover, the availability of technology will introduce the people about the new items in the market. Although, any item which will be published in the foreign country for the first time, many people in India are using it in a few days due to fast growing world. For example, research conducted shows that most of the young people were wearing the shoes from Nike, as it provides the comfort and create status in their friend circle.

Furthermore, in the contemporary world, people are travelling to a various part of the universe. This will be expanded only due to the availability of products from their home country. At last, people who went to the foreign country will find the similar nature, people by having a same choice of some of the items. This will help them to expand their social relation in the unknown country. For instance, most of the children make their friends by having a similar choice of food and who wear similar brand clothes.

In conclusion, there are many positive points of this diversity which help to grow the individual’s ability. Even one should ready to migrate and expand their relation in the unknown place having similarity of daily products.

topic: Children who are brought up in families that do not have large amounts of money are Ċ better prepared to deal with the problems of adult life than children brought up by Ċ wealthy parents. Ċ To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
essay:
Parenting in poor or middle-class families is quite different in the sense that their children are well constructed to face difficulties of life from the upper-status ones. I completely believe in the above-mentioned statement. However, in order to overcome the adulthood problems apart from wealth, moral values and experiences also help a lot.

Firstly, kids in lower-income familial environments start to learn the importance of even small things such as clothes,toys or books because they have been told how hard it is to earn and what it takes to fulfil the basic requirements of daily livings and get the chance to fight in worse possible situations. While, children of a wealthy family are offered varieties of foods, garments, play stations from the very beginning therefore, they presume it costs nothing to have it all. Thus, if any financial crisis happens there become more devastated. For example, pandemic lockdown caused loss of income in all small and big businesses and it has been seen that the below-average income people managed the situation more smoothly than those who were living lavishly.

In addition, adolescents with less pocket money turn out to be more passionate about their career, one because they look forward to having the highest paying jobs and secondly it will upgrade their standard of living for the whole family. On the contrary, prosperous people will not see the need to work hard as they already have a high-end class. For instance, big renowned companies are being inherited to their next generations without any capability assessment of their sons or daughters which makes them even more vulnerable if any mishappenings come across as they are not prepared for that.

To sum up, less moneyed adults have more exposure and experience of surviving in all not so good conditions however, richness keeps people more fragile to lifetime obstacles. But with moral values from elders and their self-described lessons can help in solving all the puzzles of life.

topic: In some countries an increasing number of people are suffering from health problems as a result of eating too much fast food. It is therefore necessary for governments to impose a higher tax on this kind of food. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Health problems in the recent era are constantly on the rise caused by fast food, which is unhygienic. A number of the general public believe the government should increase the tax rate on this type of bread; however, I agree with this statement and incline towards the latter opinion for two reasons. All these will explore in the ensuring essay.

To begin with, when the price of fast foodstuff is rising for increasing tax then it is not possible for the poor to eat. For example, a recent study found that many children consuming fast feed during school time, but it is now low down in more countries for increasing taxes on restaurants, bars, feed courts, etc. As a result, children’s fitness obesity and different types of the health problems are decreases, moreover, the high price of unhygienic foods make difficult to buy these types of cuisine, which are hidden save their money and cost of medicine to their unconses mind.

Furthermore, creating awareness of fast foodstuff means providing information to people about unhealthy food and how to make this kind of meal. For instance, much social awareness is a success by camping and advertising, which can help to grow a healthy population. Although the fast meal is effective for working-person who have no time to make meat, it is not good for the immune system. Despite the argument to the contrary, I very strongly feel a high tax on unhealthy cuisine is the best option.

In conclusion, it must be said that fitness problems have become a complex issue with no easy solution. Last but not least awareness and increasing the price of fast meat is one of the best solutions.

Combining taxation with education offers a comprehensive, effective strategy for tackling diet-related health issues.

topic: The media pay too much attention to the lives and relationships of celebrities such as actors, singers or footballers. They should spend more time reporting the lives of ordinary people instead. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Power of media can influence reader perception and their viewpoint about something. Currently, famous people lives attract everyone to know regarding what they do and mass media provide many information about them. There are contrast opinions in society that it is important for media to give more attention to superstar activities or vice versa. In this case, I opine that media has to report same proportion concerning not only extra ordinary people but also ordinary people who can inspire the viewer.

Generally, the media only focus to report public figures in their news because of rating. Therefore, they can get more profit such as advertising. To illustrate, public are more curious on the Beckham's life so media crew always observe his daily activities. Finally, their report can get more attention from people who want to know about him around the world and it is opportunity. There is no doubt that famous people have magnetism for the media.

On the other hand, a few media provide information of ordinary people. For that reason, the curiosity from reader is the problem since a slight people have interest on their activities. For instance, inventor found an electrical car so it is imperative to share this information in order to motivate others. So, this activities have to get media attention so that the society will think to change their mind about energy alternative.

The aforementioned evidence shows that although celebrities always get more attention from media, news of people who can make people inspired are important too. Where possible, the mass media must have news column which talk success story of commonplace who can motivate others.

topic: Some people believe that it is best to accept a bad situations Such as an unsatisfactory job or shortage of money.others argue that is better to try and improve Such situations . Ċ Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
As humans,we cannot always expect the best or achieve what we desire.We sometimes have to face unexpected bad situations in our lives which we never wanted to happen.Even though it is said it is better to accept certain unsatisfactory situations in our lives I believe that it is worthwhile trying and improve such occasions. Above viewpoint is thoroughly discussed in this essay.

Firstly,talking about accepting bad situations, there are instances in life that we cannot avoid where we do not have any option at all.Those instances may come to our lives for a reason. Either to challenge us or to teach us a lesson. For example, accepting an unsatisfactory job with an unhealthy working environment ,with low payments, with high pressure sounds like ringing a bell to give up or to reject. But maybe giving a try to it, would completely change a person's life. One may learn something through that experience. Similarly,when it comes to the shortage of money, it is better to accept it , to spend within your capacity rather than doing things one cannot afford and falling down. Life is not fair or equal to everyone.Sometimes it's better to accept who we are or what we are doing and be happy with it.

However, trying hard and improving such situations is better. Faith and not giving up on yourself can help anyone cross wide borders that they have never thought of. One will never fail by trying hard or wanting more. This doesn't mean being contempt with what we have, but to try harder and reach far. topic: With recent development in technology like e-books, some people feel that printed media like books, newspaper, and magazines will soon be a thing of the past. Other feel that these forms of media will never disappear.  What is your opinion?
essay:
The advance era has change a half of adapting human for technology particularly hobby in reading. Since the digital media is more convenience for the vast majority of people, they argue that fast and loose printed book would be an ancient object. Yet, the rest of the people consider that the conventional media such as novels, newsletter, and magazine remains exist thanks to the habitually reading paper from early age.

Some people, in this day and age, are more likely to read pre-digital media since reading physical book is the habit. This ritual has been created widely as the childhood experience which relates to familiarity optimal reading environment. A research of Simeone Benedetto in a couple of years ago pointed that the large majority of the population is still trained to use paper since early childhood. This has widely influenced on the preference for paper. In the other word, several individuals are more likely reading traditional book due to the innate cultural on regular activity.

The leading-edge technology has led some communities are more aware of the alternatives in order to help into reading properly. Since e-book has launched, reading on travel has gotten easier for e-reader. The 2008 Springer Survey found that the eBook were more frequent users mostly accessed eBook for research and study purpose  The 2008 Springer Survey found that eBooks more frequent was used for reference books and textbook. Mostly users were attracted in comfortably having a sophisticated device. It means that electronic books are popular in whole area of research.

In conclusion, eBook is widely used by e-reader since the modern age, moreover,  printed books are not loss supporter. In my point of view, It is imperative that non-digital-book should be survived because it stimulates reading interest.

topic: Some people think that large, impressive buildings are important for a city. Others believe that the money should be spent on improving schools and hospitals.  Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
The architecture as a vital element of country improvement is assumed by some people. Whereas construct sorts of exciting models are crucial, others perceive that government funds should be allocated to regenerate the other establishment that can increase the quality of human's life especially in education and healthiness. I strongly believe that repairing the public facilities such as schools and hospitals will bring more benefits than build any spectacular scaffoldings.

These days an age, the unique and attractive buildings such as tower blocks are needed in several regions to represent their advanced architectures. It is important for every region since it will be their characteristic which people around the world never neglect the area. Taking Eiffel Tower in Paris as an example. It is very famous tower, so most of inhabitants around the world cannot circumvent the luxurious of Paris. A city will famous when it has an elegant landmark.

In contrast, there are many serious problems that government have to tackle. Quality of schools and hospitals is more essential to improve since it involves human rights and influences the capability of human resources. Schools as mediums of education and hospitals where people consult their health ought to obtain maximum funding from government. To illustrate, Finland has a high criterion in education system which offers remarkable services for students. As a result, the intelligent residents generate more new ideas that affect the country development. Therefore, a country has to guarantee maximally edification and healthfulness of their human resources.

All in all, whilst spectacular architecture is significant as an identity of a country, quality of public services such as hospitals and schools are more important for government, so it is acceptable to expand the money allocation for upgrading the standardization.

topic: The purpose of businesses is to make money and they should concentrate only on this. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
It is interesting to talk about business today. An issue such as the main purpose of company is the debatable talk because of its complexity. Some people think that business is made to only focus on making profit. However, I briefly disagree with the statement because there are other things that the employers can do.

The ones who only search the way to make their company on the green level always think that their main success is to make money. However, company as the one searching a profit in the other countries has the responsibility to the nation in which they lived. Business is to not only gather the money in the certain country but also overcome the problem in the particular country. Microsoft, having all branch offices around the world, has committed to solve the problem in the nation where the branch on. In Indonesia, several PCs have been given by Microsoft to solve the infrastructure problem so that the education will be available for all students in Indonesia.

Furthermore, they should not only focus on how to make money as greater as possible. There are a lot of good routines that they can do such as gathering with the official to talk about the future condition so that they can solve the problems that are predicted to happen in the future. Also, giving a chance to upgrade the skills of the employee can be useful for the workers. The worker should not too much be demanded about the performance to only focus on making money.

All in all, from the points that I mentioned before, I strongly disagree with the popular opinion that the company has to only focus on how to make money. I believe that there are other purposes that the company can do to not only gather money but also solve the other problems around.

topic: It is important for children to learn the difference between right and wrong at early stage. Punishment is necessary to help them learn the difference. To what extent do you agree or disagree.
essay:
It is always good to learn about good and bad at an early age to stay out of the consequences. It is a hot topic to discuss, whether or not, we should incorporate disciplinary action to make them understand right and wrong. I opine with the idea of not teaching this lesson with the fear of punishments.

Firstly, we should understand that every child is unique and possesses different capabilities to accomplish the assigned task. In this case, if we punish a slow learner, it will be an injustice to that individual. For instance, it was published in one of the articles in the newspaper, that stated about a kid who ran away from the home, as his parents were hitting him for improving his hygiene.

Secondly, any task accomplished by force will nullify its significance, as it is done without interest. When we are liking the work assigned to us, we do it with interest, but when the work provided by force we finish it unreligiously. For example, one of my uncles always complains that his elder son never makes his bed in the morning for which he is not allowed to play. He is forced to do that task and thus he does it without interest.

Thirdly, a child may undergo a mental trauma if that child is treated harshly because he or she is not able to learn a concept. Fear of harsh treatment can make you finish the given task, but you cannot realise its requirement and significance. Such as, a student became introvert as he was exposed to corporal punishments because of his habit of using slangs.

To sum up, looking into the aforementioned factors, we should not use corporal punishment to teach students; as it always results in a negative situation. Rather, we should learn to understand the challenges that a child is facing to learn. However, it is necessary to know about right and wrong at an early age, a learner should be given enough time.

topic: The Government is spending a lot of money to discover life on other planets. Some people think that government is wasting money and should spend more money addressing the problems of public. To what extent do you agree?
essay:
Nowadays, due to the advancement of technology, scientists have provided evidence of life on other planets. The government had been very supportive of this research financially; however, there have been recent arguments where some people believe it can be used better in addressing problems of the public. In this essay, I will discuss my notes on this concern and provide my extent of agreement.

Firstly, it is genuine for the public to be concerned as there were various situations in recent times when the government failed in extending its support. For instance, considering the latest flooding in Chennai, India where most lower rural areas were evacuated and there was severe damage to public property. Although there was no death recorded, civilians had suffered a lack of shelter and food. If there was additional support from the rulers, the situation would have been handled better. As a result, public concern is understandable.

Secondly, On the other hand, we are blessed to be in a rapidly developing environment. It is the responsibility of the rulers to support every sector. It would not be fair to consider any field less important. Addressing this point, I feel there is a set budget planned for every sector and all these decisions are made at the beginning of the new financial year also they do have emergency relief funds which are used for unforeseen incidents. For example, if there is a forest fire, the required course of action is taken and sometimes its spread can be worst than expected. In such cases, they fall short of the aid and might provide slower service. In those scenarios, individuals may experience inadequate support from the officials.

To conclude, I feel being supportive of the new developments is a wonderful practice, at the same time, failure in addressing problems cannot be overlooked. Both locals and officials need to understand each other's needs and work together for a better society. I do not agree nor disagree with the argument.

topic: Some people feel that entertainers (e.g. film stars, pop musicians or sports star) are paid too much money. Ċ Do you agree or disagree? Ċ Which other types of job should be highly paid?
essay:
Artists such as actors, pop musicians, and athletes are overpaid according to some. However they have an important role in society to increase profit and make people happy, clearly, the government should allocate more budget to individuals who have more significant jobs.

topic: It is inevitable that traditional cultures will be lost as technology develops. Technology and traditional cultures are incompatible. Ċ To what extent do you agree or disagree with this view?
essay:
Nowadays, humanity is becoming developed, and there is no denying the fact that this phenomenon changes the culture and habits of some communities. Although over-reliance on technology may cause that traditional customs become forgotten, in this essay, I will investigate whether technological advancements are able to coexist with historical tradition.

On the one hand, most traditional actions became outdated in that they have been replaced by electrical appliances. For instance, festivals in Spain, where people congregate to prepare a certain type of food such as tomato sauce are no longer held inasmuch as the respective fruits are processed in factories. In addition, this brings greater benefit as it could be conducted the whole year by professional workers not only once a year by inexperienced people.

Turning to the other side of the argument, traditional cultures emerged from a set of values that are still passed from generation to generation. In fact, if they were forgotten, many nations would lose their identity and would no longer recognisable in the world. Moreover, distinctive features of specific countries could be used as an advertisement to encourage tourists to visit their state. Japan is a good example of land that is able to earn money by selling their cultural heritage to visitors, and at the same time they have a high level of technological development.

All things considered, in my view, culture and technology need to be interlocked in that country is not able to reach their full economic unless they are connected. Furthermore, without its history, the state loses its soul and becomes only a spot on the map which may lead to regression, not development.

topic: There is an increasing trend for people to live alone. What is causing this to happen? Will it have a negative or a positive impact on society?
essay:
The extraordinary rise of living alone is among the most significant social trends of the modern world. Living alone is ubiquitous in developed, open societies, and this particularly affects health and health care. In my opinion, experiencing one has an adverse impact on society.

One possibility is that there is a causal link between living alone, being socially isolated, and feeling lonely. But these are three distinct conditions, and living alone does not necessarily mean experiencing one or both of the others (being isolated or feeling lonely). Overall, the main cause of living alone is the tendency of life, nowadays, people do not get married any more than previously. Secondly, individuals frequently spend more time studying and working, especially in civic. Research shows that Americans who are working as journalists, scholars, health care providers, and business persons usually conflate living alone, feeling lonely, and being isolated, and the result is widespread confusion about each condition.

In more detail, living alone is the consequence of isolation because of physical frailty as well as for deaths in their family and friendship networks. Thus, they have smaller social networks and less stable contact with children, and they face heightened risks of isolation if they divorce or become widowers.

The risks of social isolation depend not only on which kind of people, but also on the place people are living. Poor neighborhoods with a robust social infrastructure, busy sidewalks, and these social infrastructures suffered higher mortality rates.

At these points, most policy recommendations for reducing living alone are essential. As the population ages and the number of people aging alone grows, societies throughout the world will need to develop new supportive housing programs and new forms of elderly care.
