topic: It is a natural process for animal species to become extinct (e.g. dinosaur, dodo…) There is no reason why people should try to prevent this from happening. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
According to the widely accepted theory of evolution of Charles Darwin, extinction is only consequential when natural selection is at play. In the modern-day, some people are of the opinion that humans should not interfere with that eliminating process. I only agree with this view partially, as many species have been wiped out not by nature but by human activities.

It is undeniable that the extinction of animal species is natural in some cases. By the mechanism of survival of the fittest, organisms that are adaptive to their environment will be able to propagate their genes while those who are not will gradually die out. It is important that humans do not reverse this natural process as it will result in catastrophic disturbances to existing ecosystems. For example, no laboratories should attempt to bring back the dinosaurs which went extinct due to changes in the Earth’s climate many years ago, without any artificial influences. If they are to succeed, manufactured dinosaurs might become loose and cause casualties not only to human communities but also to those of other species as well.

Nevertheless, human exploitation has lead to the extinction of many species, and these are the cases in which people have to take preventive actions. In recent decades, the increased needs for food and housing of the growing human population have resulted in deforestation, global warming, wildfires, and many other destructive impacts on the environment. Subsequently, numerous species are currently extinct or endangered at the hand of starvation and loss of habitats. If prolonged, future generations of humans will have to bear severe consequences. For instance, regarding extinct species of plants, scientists have raised the question of whether they could have been used to cure diseases,Remove the commaapplyIt appears that you have an unnecessary comma in a compound predicate. Consider removing it.

show examples and proposed that along with their extinction might be the obliteration of cancer or HIV medications.

To summarize, while nature is the driving force behind the extinction of some species, the extraction of resources by humans accounts for a rising number of species coming to their ends. Therefore, although people should not interfere with the former, they ought to participate in conservation efforts initiated around the globe to address the problematic latter.

topic: Some people think that robots are important for human’s future development. Others think that robots have negative effects on society. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
In recent years, humans are heavily adapted to advanced technologies and it has become an integral part of life. Robots are considered to be one of the greatest innovations of mankind. Certain individuals believe that they are harmful to humans while some stratum of society argue that they are crucial for the future. I personally believe that robotics is a positive development for the world.

To begin with, some people assert that these techno-savvy machines can endanger human life. This is because robots are not emotionally intelligent to distinguish what set of operations are right or wrong; which can have a detrimental effect. To illustrate, a recent accident involving a Telsa electric car that killed two people points fingers at its autonomous driving feature. Moreover, these robots running on a specific algorithm are in the early stage of development that can be exposed to hacking. For instance, if these machines are employed in the banking sector, there is a high probable chance of account hacking and other fraudulent activities.

On the other hand, benefits derived from the invention of robots are significant for the development of the future. Most importantly, these automated machines can be deployed in places that are hazardous to humans. For example, a robot called Mini-Manbo has become the central part of the cleaning-up process in the damaged Fukushima reactor, where it is dangerous for humans to execute these tasks. Additionally, the heavy automation by robots in the automobile industry and hazardous chemical plants has reduced stress on employee’s health and increased productivity and precision in these sectors.

In conclusion, although, some argue that robots can be potentially life-threatening and cannot be considered safe to be employed in various industries such as banking, I strongly believe that they can bring a positive change for the future.

topic: Influence of human beings on the worlds ecosystem is leading to the extinction of species and loss of biodiversity. Causes and solutions
essay:
In recent years, human activities have drastically impacted biodiversity leading to the extinction of many endangered species. The essay will discuss the main causes and provide a few solutions to control the situation.

To commence with, the first and foremost cause for this negative influence on our ecosystem is overpopulation. There has been a dramatic rise in the population rate, leading to an increase in demand for land, resulting in the loss of habitat for various animals. People, for instance, in the pursuit of accommodation end up cutting down forests and occupying the space meant for the other species. In addition, various environmental issues, like water contamination, emissions from cars and other vehicles and improper disposal of waste are responsible for our loss of biodiversity. These actions of the public pollute the environment leading these pollutants to enter the food chain of the animals. Aquatic creatures are subjected to water contamination and are leading towards dwindling numbers and might become extinct.

There are a few solutions to control and maintain the ecosystem. Firstly, the government should impose certain laws to control the population, especially where the trend is extremely high. It can be achieved by awareness campaigns. Furthermore, it is the responsibility of us as a society to mitigate the environmental concerns that are affecting the habitat and life of other beings in the world. For example, proper disposal of waste in landfills and waste processing centres. Moreover, pollution caused due to vehicles can be reduced by opting for public transport.

In conclusion, there are many causes of the situation like the rise in the number of individuals and irresponsible behaviour towards the animals by polluting the air and water. It can be solved by taking measures, including controlling population growth to reduce the need for deforestation along with preserving the environment.

topic: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement: Ċ Only people who earn a lot of money are successful. Ċ Use specific reasons and details to support your answer.
essay:
Arguably, it is believed that individuals with high incomes are well-succeeded. Personally, I disagree with the view since financial resources are not solely the unique outlet to define success. Although these two terms are so close. This essay will shed light on both sides of the view and provide anecdotal evidence to prove the arguments.

On the one hand, much money does not define a successful person. In other words, there are others variables to be taken into regard such as emotional imprint and connectedness with others. For instance, someone has a million dollars in his bank account and fail to deal with others, this can not be considered as a well-succeeded, it is claimed by a group of connoisseurs of the University of Michigan in their recent investigation carried out last year. As a result, communities misunderstand the concept and regard billionaires as the most successful individuals across the world.

On the other hand, big money earning is closely related to prosperity. Because of what money is possible to do, this term is undoubtedly linked to fame and outcomes. For example, football players who gain big are said to be wealthy and extremely successful, despite sometimes there are not as prosperous as it is said. Moreover, a plethora of them grapples to be in the first team.

In conclusion, notwithstanding the close link between these two terms, the true meaning of well-succeeded go beyond the number of income gained. However, other social parameters should be taken into consideration. Therefore, I still disagree with the statement.

topic: Some people think that environment problem should be solved on a global scale while others believe it is better to deal with them nationally Ċ Discuss the both the sides and give your opinion
essay:
While some people believe that ecological issues should be solved globally, others feel that it should be solved nationally. I believe that although it is a global issue; solutions, such as regulations and campaigns can be introduced at national level.

To begin with, there are a few reasons why some people think that it is a worldwide issue. Firstly, the environment affects people around the world, regardless of its nation. One apparent example is the infamous global warming where it affects every place on earth by the increasing temperature and sea level. Secondly, nature behaviour is not limited to just a country; For example, seasonal birds that migrate from a colder to a warmer place across several countries. All the above are the examples of problems that we encounter today.

On the other hands, I believe that each nation can play a part to reduce these problems. In the first place, the government could launch a nationwide campaign to raise public awareness about these ecological issues. For instance, a nationwide ban on plastic usage, which has been an effective way to reduce plastic waste. Another way forward could be by protecting the natural forest, in conjunction with the objectives to reduce immediate problems, such as food chain interruption that may lead to certain extinction of animals of plants.

In conclusion, environmental problem may seem to be a global scale issue, however, dealing with these issues can be started at the national scale. I personally believe that every government need to resolve this nationally and contribute as part of global resolution.

topic: Mandatory foreign language education. In some educational systems, children are required to study one or more foreign languages. In others, foreign language study is not a requirement. What are the potential benefits of foreign language study? Do you think foreign language study is an important part of education?
essay:
Foreign language study in much social research of scientists is said to be an efficient method to sharpen a logical mentality and raise the brainstorming for children. I suppose it should be a requirement in all schools.

Firstly, studying a new language brings children a chance to enlarge their cultural capital. It helps them discover and explore new conventions and historical backgrounds of countries.

Secondly, one of the most significant roles of languages is to accessibly communicate to "the whole world". Professional documents can not be reserved all in only a language, so studying a new language is perfectly a great deal for children to reach the best qualifications in their major. Although their purpose is for business or just purely casual communication, languages turn out helpful and dispensable for a brilliantly successful career path.

Thirdly, studying a foreign language is able to enhance the student's concentration and memorizing ability. Fundamentally, they have to achieve four skills: listening, reading, writing, and speaking of a language if they want to use it proficiently. That is absolutely long-term and hard progress, they will need so much willingness and effort with an extreme concentration. Through practicing every day, it improves them day by day and creates them a powerful foundation of mentality. After being advanced in a language, student's intelligence would be more extended, their memorizing ability would be better organized. Probably they would become a detail-oriented, diligent, and motivated person. I strongly believe that language sharply influences student's characters as well, more patient and placid to navigate solutions for assignments and problems in communication and generally in life.

Overall, I see that it is highly essential to make foreign language studies become required in all schools. It is genuinely worthwhile an excellent preparation for student's adulthood in their far future.

topic: In some countries, it is common for women to participate in the workforce when their children are young. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this?
essay:
Nowadays, in few countries , it is observed that females are becoming more active and are participating in various work. I find this practice to show both sides, considering the benefits of financial growth and improved standard of living and drawbacks such as weak mother-minor bonding and improper parenting.

The utmost advantage of a working mother is financial growth. In order to provide a better lifestyle to their offsprings, mothers work even though their children are young. The main reason behind this is to provide basic requirements to their kids like higher education, better clothes and gadgets. Secondly, to improve the standard of living of their family, women choose to work. In this way, ladies develop a pleasant atmosphere around their kids which helps them to acquire quality education and a healthy lifestyle. For instance, a research paper from the University of Toronto stated that 60% of the working females tend to provide good facilities and a better standard of living to their offsprings. This often results in major skills development like confidence and leadership among women.

On the other hand, while we consider the repercussions of this scenario are the weak connection between mother and her minor and the inappropriate parenting. When the mom is working, children are left alone at home and the attachment between parent-child decreases due to reduced interaction. They may try to spend more time with toys and gadgets. Furthermore, due to improper parenting, children sometimes find themselves in difficult positions like drug dealings, murders and accidents because of no supervision. For example, my aunt was working as a police officer and her son was caught in a major crime because of a lack of parenting.

In conclusion, the employed female helps in the betterment of their family's economical condition and lifestyle. However, this will result in poor parenting and relationships with their kids. I believe that although it deteriorates bonding with their children, the advantage of the economic development outweighs the disadvantage.

topic: The internet is probably the most significant invention of the last 30 years. Without it, our lives would be completely different. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Technology invention makes mankind's lives more convenient. The internet is the most popular innovation of the three decades which some people argue that without it their live quite dissimilar. I do agree that networking makes communication easier, although the rising of cyber crime is increasing.

In the past people can connected across the globe only by mail, then it has developed by using phone and know we can do it by the internet. This improvement proves invention in technology gives facilities to humankind especially in correspondence. For instance, people in India can connect directly to their relatives in the Netherlands by using video call from smart phone, sending e-mail and using social networking such as Facebook, Twitter and others only just in a few minutes. As a result people can keep contact more intense to others although they are separated by distance. It is evident that the internet fosters in communication.

However, there is no doubt that the internet also has demerit in human's life such as the rising of cyber crime. In the light of the recent cyber-attacks on bank, health insurers, retailers and other sectors. It's no surprise that everyone is concerned, because of the risk in financial loss or other deceptions. For sample, somebody can hack credit card and use it to purchase. As a result of this, society new a law that can prevent from criminal networking. It is conclude that the internet impact the inclining of cyber crime.

To conclude, although there is a probability that causes the rate of cyber crime is rising, but I agree that the internet makes a significant difference in people's lives, especially to communicate easily. I suggest the Government should in charge to make some rules related to the risk mitigation around cyber security.

topic: Several languages die every year. Many people feel this is a positive trend and that a world with fewer language promotes harmony and uderstanding between people.Analyze both sides of this arguement and provide your opinion
essay:
Nowadays, whether should major languages be dominated in the world has caused a hot topic. Some people think that we can improve communication efficiency by using major language. Others argue that the rare language should be protected and appreciated. In my opinion, it is necessary make rare language to survive.

Firstly, it is obvious that different language demonstrates different cultures. We do not know what we lose if that language is died. For example, in my hometown, we have a lot of songs and stories that based on our own language. Those things will be disappeared forever if that language is died. Furthermore, language helps community to remain cohesive and have a strong sense of identity.

Secondly, language is a treasure that belongs to all human rice. It deserves all people to protect. Furthermore, some rare language makes a great contribution to the civilization of human history. The clue of original of human races could be found by understanding those rare languages.

It is true that the communication efficiency could be improved by speaking only fewer languages. However, the ethnic cohesion could be weakening by dying of language.

In sum, we should take our responsibility to maintain the diversity of language. It is not only enriching our cultural richness, but level the great treasure to our future generation.

topic: Many children these days have an unhealthy lifestyle. Both schools and parents are responsible for solving this problem. To what extent do you agree with this statement?
essay:
Unhealthy lifestyle, especially in food, has affected many children to consume poor food. The advanced technology in food production has made some foods produced fastly with many additives. Certainly, both schools and parents have responsibility to prevent this case. Besides that, two other parties that have to control it are government and food industry.

Children age is a stage of human life that they can not distinguish a good and bad thing yet. Their thought is still immature to decide on something. Therefore, they are easier to choose some unhealthy meals to eat even though it consists of additives such as flavouring, colouring and artificial sweeteners.

These four groups -government, food industry, schools and parents- have to pay more attention to solve this problem together but appropriate with each role. Government, as the first power of a country, have to supervise the food manufacture and make a regulation about the food production. They have to ban unhealthy food distribution. The food factory should produce a healthy product, not only notice to the taste but also care about the nutrition. Schools should provide a sanitary canteen for student and deliver the information about health food regularly. Then, one that also important is the parent's role to take care of their children's meal such as preparing a healthy lunchbox and teaching them to be aware in the risk of unhealthy food consumption.

In conclusion, all parties have to take action to face this case start from now. If these four elements work together to prevent it, the children will be protected by unhealthy lifestyle.

essay:

To conclude, possessing cars are enhancing at a high pace. The essay discussed the view along with some advantages likewise easy to be punctual and road safety. In addition to it, it also provided some challenges such as excessive traffic and less seeking to public means of communication.

topic: Without capital punishment (the death penalty) our lives are less secure and crimes or violence increase. Capital punishment is essential to control violence in society. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Practiced in more than 21 countries around the globe, death penalty is the execution one has to undergo for the capital crimes he has done. Many people agree that the society is more secure if the capital punishment is put into practice. However, there are also some who claim that taking other people's life is inhuman. I personally agree with the first point of view. 65

One important argument in favor of my view comes with the ancient saying 'Eye for an eye, tooth for a tooth'. Even in the justice system of the first primitive tribes the mentality was the same: if someone took one's life, he had to be killed. For example, in Ancient Greece murderers and rapers were burned or decapitated in the center of the village, in the settler's eyes. Rulers used to believe that it was a model for other people who, by seeing those terrifying scenes, would be aware of what might have happened to them if they committed murders. 100

What is more, people who are not punished and are set free are more likely to commit murders again. It has been scientifically proven that 70 percent of the prisoners who are released from prison continue to kill people for different reasons. Even if they are psychopaths or work with mafia, the outcome is the same: innocent people are killed and going out in the streets becomes a more and more dangerous activity for everyone. The death penalty is the perfect punishment, because the killer who is eliminated will not strike again. 94

All these being considered, the rate of crime and violence would dramatically increase if capital punishment was not put into practice. I am inclined to believe that our society is safer if the killers pay the same price as their innocent victims did. 43

topic: Business & cultural exchange between countries is increasing and this is thought to be a positive development by some. However, others believe that it might lead to loss of identity. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
In recent times, it has become increasingly common for countries to interact both on a business as well cultural level. Nevertheless, While some people view this change as beneficial, others are of the opinion that it may disrupt and alter the core values of countries. This essay will demonstrate, why I agree with those who argue that this trend has been a curse more than a blessing.

One of the most significant benefits of globalisation is it has made travelling affordable than it used to be. For instance, whereas in the past it may have a cost the average person a year's salary to travel from India to Australia, these days it is possible for Indian tourists to enjoy a last-minute city break in Sydney for the cost of half a month's pay. Therefore, for explorers, this increasing trend of business exchange is seen as a boon.

Nevertheless, one reason why some people are sceptical about this development is, Multinational companies who extend their business into various countries end up controlling how that particular country works. To illustrate, the farmers in India are widely affected by international companies who try to encroach their lands to construct factories. Consequently, this leads to bankruptcy and farmers relocating causing cultural loss. As a result, this can alter the identity of the country

In conclusion, although globalisation has its benefits, it is important to consider the problems it creates such as how it affects the average farmer. This is why I believe this approach has more disadvantages than it has advantages.

topic: Some people think that teenagers should concentrate on all subjects at school. Others believe that teenagers should focus on the subjects they are best at or they are most interested in. To what extent do you agree?
essay:
It is considered by some people that the adolescents should focus on every subject, while many others believe that they should concentrate on particular ones of their interests. In my opinion, both of the thinking have equal importance and the teenagers should decide depending on their age.

On one hand, younger adolescents, studying in schools should concentrate on each subject the school is offering them. In addition, at this young age, they need to learn about everything that is possible for them and as they are not enough mature to know which one is good for them, they should not pick on particular subjects to focus on. For instance, it is difficult for them to choose a topic that they are interested in since a pupil does not know if he wants to become a doctor, an engineer, a lawyer or etc. Therefore, younger teenagers should study and concentrate on all of the subjects at school and decide later to focus on chosen subjects.

On the other hand, adult teenagers have the capability to decide which topic will be good for them to concentrate on. As all of them have been studied in their schools, they have clear visions of their interests and ideas about the professions in which they want to pursue their future. For example, they need to focus on biology in their school to be a doctor, similarly math and physics are the subjects one needs to concentrate on to become an engineer. Furthermore, the adult teenagers have the maturity to understand what is good and bad for them and in what they are interested to study in detail and thus they can decide on their own to focus further on any particular one.

In conclusion, younger teenagers should concentrate on all of the subjects to know and learn about everything that could help them to decide on which they want to focus on particularly in future.

topic: In some countries there are many problems involving teenagers. Some people think it is because parents spend much time at work not home. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Younger people now-a-days are prone to bad habits and were indulging in several illegal activities. Few individuals consider this situation as a consequence of improper parental care. I agree with this belief and In this essay I am going to provide the reasons with suitable examples.

Firstly, I believe that parents are the actual tutors for the younger ones. If they don't allocate an adequate amount of time with the children, adolescence cannot develop personally and mentally. Therefore parental guidance plays a the crucial role in the growth of the offspring. For an instance, in a recent crime survey which was conducted in India, some of the bigger cities such as Mumbai and Hyderabad were recorded as cities with top most youth crime rate.

Secondly, in the current society, individuals are more concerned about their work due to numerous factors such as tight schedules in the project and over work load.Ultimately, they have to stretch out of office hours in order to accomplish the given tasks.Therefore, they are not even spending a minimum duration of time with their children, which is a shameful aspect.Finally, this leads to stupid behaviour in kids as they were not receiving affection from their parents. For an instance, In the year 2019, Times of New York has reported a huge increase in child abuse cases in the US.

To conclude, I strongly believe that teenagers were getting spoiled due to the lack of parental care. This situation cannot be improved unless and until parents change their attitude.Thus, elder people are the key to the child's success.

topic: Some people believe that engaging in an active pastime does more to develop childrens’ life skills than time spent reading. Ċ To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
With the growing importance of having an interactive learning approach as compared to having a theoretical one, a majority of the parents have the impression that engaging in an active pastime can be fruitful for a child as compared to reading books. I completely agree with this belief and this essay will highlight how this development can benefit the childrens' mindset.

There are several life skills that an individual can learn through playgroups or by joining a sports club. By including sports as part of their schedule, a child can learn several life skills that reading cannot teach such as teamwork, networking or cooperation, all of which are important when they enter the corporate world. For instance, as per research conducted by Cambridge University, 60% of the leaders and CEOs actively participated in at least one sport during their schooling, thereby giving them the ability to lead teams and collaborate at a company level.

In addition to sports, playing video games can also contribute to building a child's mindset. With the rise in digital advancements, there is a lot of room for an individual to learn while gaming. The graphics and the design used in programming these games can trigger a child's creativity, thereby giving them the ability to think out-of-the-box and stand out from the crowd. Further, video games result in creating a flow mindset among the children, that is, forcing them to think ahead of time and plan for the next move at each instance. For example, in games like Call of Duty and Pubg, each character is forced to be constantly alert and plan ahead of their opponent's move.

To summarize, while there is ample knowledge available through books, there is a lot for a child to learn through active hobbies. There is no doubt that sports and gaming can contribute towards developing important life skills among children. I strongly believe that parents should support this idea and encourage their offspring to follow their passion and hobbies.

topic: Some people think that universities should provide graduates with the knowledge and skills needed in the workplace. Others think that the true function of a university should be to give access to knowledge for its own sake, regardless of whether the course is useful to an employer. What, in your opinion, should be the function of a university?
essay:
There have been various heated debates over whether colleges should focus on educating learners skills related to their desire vocations or solely concentrate on academic intelligence. In my opinion, the ultimate purpose of universities should be to expose students to expertise in the worksite.

Firstly, there is no need for students to waste time learning other subjects irrelevant to their pursuing jobs. Students may feel bored and unfair if they have to take classes which are out of their main major. For example, if one's field is language, why must one study calculation? It is such a time-consuming and exhausting process. Instead of imposing unrelated subjects on the curriculum and make it an endless four-year degree, universities should reduce the academic load and pay more attention to the essential skills for the students' career.

Secondly, providing students with vocational skills is a great way to prepare them well before they enter the workplace. topic: Most artists earn low salaries and should therefore receive funding from government in order for them to continue with their work. To what extent do you agree?
essay:
The occupation of an artist is to practise or perform any of the creative arts, using the conscious use of skill and creative imagination. Despite being expressive through their talents, artists are not well-paid. Should there be any financial assistance from the governments? I am of the opinion that regulators ought to act as enablers rather than directly funding craftsmen to pursue their careers.

Some people believe that the majority of contemporary artists are barely surviving financially. Because of people losing interest in arts, the income earned by an average artist has gone down dismally. The situation, for instance, has been worsening post the pandemic as numerous cities are either under severe lockdowns or facing stringent restrictions resulting in a minuscule number of art-related activities. Furthermore, the cancellation of events such as music concerts, galleries, film releases has incurred immense losses to the workers in the associated industries. As a result of this, several artisans might think to switch their careers in other fields that can have detrimental effects on society and culture.

One of the solutions propagated has been that government should support artisans with the fiscal arrangements. However, this appears to be a short-term and less effective measure as a country's resources are limited and this may put additional distress on the state budget. Alternatively, policymakers should design mechanisms that enable artists to showcase their creativity to a larger audience. To illustrate, with the help of modern tools of digital technology and social media, platforms ought to be created in order to facilitate entertainers to connect with their viewers or followers. In addition to this, regulators should reassess to relax censorship in some of the fields for enhanced freedom of expression.

To conclude, considering the dismal state of craftsmen, administrators should step in to safeguard the creative and cultural heritage. The solution of fiscal arrangements seems practically imprudent and therefore, a more coherent approach to enable bridging the gap between artists and audience is the need of the hour.

topic: Many people say that the only way to guarantee a good job is to complete a course of university education. Others claim that it is better to start work after school and gain experience in the world of work. Discuss
essay:
In the todays world, finding the perfect and suitable position plays a crucial role in everyone's life. While most of the people say a good employment can be achieved by getting a graduation from university, Others say that it can obviously be gained through the experience of working after completing the school.This essay will discuss both the sides as higher studies give better knowledge in a particular area, alternately doing job gives the real time exposure of the situation.

On one hand, Pursuing their academics in the varsity gives them the better knowledge as well as letting them get hands-on in fields in which they want to on the career. By this particular method the universities follow, companies will come forward show interest to offer jobs to these candidates. For instance, Students who got passed out top most universities are getting higher paid and have settled career.In addition to this, having an academic background from higher level educational institution, not only gives good work, but also a struggle free life.

On the other hand, Getting a work position after the school education is also a good option as it will give the ongoing exposure as well as growth in their future prospects. This is because doing a particular profession from the early life makes an individual to learn everything from ground level and that results in hands on knowledge in field from bottom to top. For example, an employee joined as the cleaning staff in a coffee shop and gets gradually promoted and becomes a manager has experience of end to end process which benefits a lot to him. Furthermore this will give ample of confidence to take any kind of challenges in the future regarding his career.

Finally, both having the high level education benefits to have perfect idea and to get expertise, thereby helps to posses a perfect job. While possessing a profession right after school education also can get a suitable job as this increases the real time experience.

topic: Some people believe that entertainers are more important than scientists. Do you agree or disagree? Support with reasons and examples from your own experience.
essay:
It is often argued that entertainers are more influential and prime characters of the society by many people. However, I believe that scientists have greater importance than entertainers.

Firstly, scientific people invent new technology to improve the quality of human life. What I mean by this is that the new things discovered by them mostly ease the daily life of mankind as tend to use them. Moreover, they always think about the difficulties of humans and animals and try to invest more time and energy to bring the change. For example, the invention of aeroplane saved lots of time for travellers as they initially used slow means of transportation. Additionally, they always try to improve the efficiency of existing systems. That is why scientific people are role models of the society.

The Second reason is that most of the scientists risk their life in developing medicines that are harmful or hazardous. In other words, there are many deadly diseases in the world that are transmitted to a human body even through a touch. Medical researchers often have to deal with this kind of situations, where they should not think of their life, in developing a solution. For Instance, during the deadly outbreak of Ebola virus in West Africa, many doctors have risked their lives to treat them. In addition to this, they often encounter new challenges like the danger from the harsh chemicals in the labs or from the financial burdens if they fail. Hence, these difficulties prove that they are more important to the society.

To sum up, although entertainers are more popular for their daily shows, Science people are the principal figures of the world. It is their courage and interest to discover new technologies are the reasons of why they are in the front position.

topic: Experts, kindly need your time to review my essay :-) Food can be produced much more cheaply today because of improved fertilisers and better machinery. However, some of the methods used to do this may be dangerous to human health and may have negative effects on local communities. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
There is no doubt that the way of producing food as a primary need of people to survive is much cheaper in the present life. It is obviously because of the advancing of fertilizer as well as sophisticated machinery. While such revolution brings a huge number of benefits, the drawbacks of it which is likely to be harmful for well-being should be taken into account due to having some negative effects on societies. Considering many respects, I personally agree with the latter consideration.

The first consideration which supports my view is the contamination of chemical essence which is likely to be involved in using fertilizers. The improved fertilizers usage is highly required some additional chemical essence to lengthening the expired date of food produced. Based on several updated scientifically inventions, this is particularly harmful for human health knowing that the accumulation of such kind of essence will increase the risk of cancer on the human body.

Another consideration is the relying of inhabitants on instant food produced mainly by better machinery which has a tendency to make inhabitants lazy to make their own food. There are a lot of evidence in our surrounding proven that the existence of instant food that is usually called as 'junk food' not to encourage people to be proactive in reserving healthy food for daily consumption. Clearly, it is not good for inhabitants' lifestyle which tends to simplify everything, including health.

Having said the two main consideration concerning the chemical essence involvement as well as the alteration of inhabitants' way of life, it seems to me that I do not agree with the former opinion because the using of such technology clearly brings many disadvantages that should be paid more attention.

topic: Some people say that feeling of competition should be encouraged in children others say they should be taught to become cooperative. What is your opinion?
essay:
Children should learn many basic things so that they could survive in the future. Some people think that teaching children a sense of competition is better than a sense of being cooperative. I believe that both skills are needed by children in order to be successful.

First of all, being competitive is important for children because they are live in the world that full race and people always try to be the best. In other words, it is useful to help children growing a desire to win a competition. For example, in studying path children who are competitive will put more efforts to be smarter than the others. Needless to say, competitive sense should be taught to children since the early age to push them explore their potential.

Secondly, being cooperative is also crucial for the children as they are human being who always need others. As a social creature, human need each other to help them fulfil their needs and to achieve a goal. There are some moments of our life when we need to do something together with others, whether it is mandatory or it is better that way. In those cases, being cooperative is needed. For instance, when doing a study group kids must be able to be cooperative in sharing ideas and make a compromise decision. Thus, this skill is significant to improve their personal quality.

To sum up, both senses are necessary for children. It helps them learn how to cooperate with mates and to win the race.

topic: Caring for children is probably the most important job in any society. because of this, all mothers and fathers should be required to take a course that prepares them to be good parents. To what extent do you agree or disagree with these views?
essay:
Although it can be a good concept that parents ought to know some pieces of information prior to starting a family by engaging in a number of classes, which are relevant to children caring, in my standpoint, it does not guarantee successful upbringing.

For one thing, there are many reasons why it may not be a proper blueprint for all the community members. Firstly, due to the fact that each family has been brought up according to various cultures, even if they take part in these kinds of courses it can not cover all the parts. In addition, parents tend to nurture their children according to their interests and attitudes not merely a bunch of theories. Secondly, although these classes can enhance mothers' and fathers' awareness to a great extent, it is likely to be arduous to enforce this knowledge. For example, due to the fact parents are either dual-income or overworked, it proves pretty hard to attend to new information that has recently been taken.

For another thing, when it comes to compulsory activities, it might be said that how to oblige individuals to partake in a certain course consequently that it does not have a reverse result. In another word, it may have a number of irrecoverable consequences on the nation who have just decided to have children, which may have a direct effect on breeding rate in the society. Moreover, even though the new generation seems to be inexperienced in that respect, it should not be forgotten that they much prefer to adapt their approach in real-life concerning each situation. For instance, when their child is badly_behavied they can adjust themselves to a new position, which suits the whole family best.

In conclusion, considering that each family has brought up in various culture, being difficult to enforce these methods, and being unpleasant for society to do something against their will, in my opinion, it would be better to be optional.

topic: Some people prefer to eat at food stands or restaurants. Other people prefer to prepare and eat food at home. Which do you prefer? Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.
essay:
Although I admit that eating at food stands and restaurants is timesaving, I prefer to prepare and eat food at home. There are three reasons for that. First, it is healthier second, it is less expensive and third, it is like a hobby for me.

First, preparing and eating food at home is healthier. I go to the store and buy the best selected ingredients to cook with. Also, I wash and prepare them carefully. However, there is no guarantee that they do these at food stands or restaurants. For instance, I go out to eat food once or twice a month and I always have trouble with hair on my plate or dirty spoon/ knife.

Second, preparing and eating food at home is less expensive. I can buy some ingredients and cook any meal that I want to, however, I can't afford that meal in most of restaurants. Also, I bet I cook better than them. For instance, when my parents or my friends invite me for a dinner at an expensive restaurant, I reject them and insist on having a dinner in my place. They always leave by saying ` they love to have a dinner in my place'.

Third, preparing and eating food at home is like a hobby for me. I can spend lots of time with cooking experiments. For instance, I had a recipe of macaroon from my colleague the previous day and I decided to make it after work. When I took my macaroons to work yesterday, all my colleagues loved them and appreciated my ambition.

For these reasons, I believe that I prefer to prepare and eat food at home because it is healthier, it is less expensive and, it is like a hobby for me.

topic: Lately more and more work has to be done by machines. Do you think positive effects of this development outweigh the negative effects on individual and society?
essay:
Many organizations and factories have revolutionized their workforce by adopting automated system to meet the growing demand of today's business world yet it is argued that, this transition has negative impact on workers and communities. In my view, its benefits outweigh its drawbacks.

Perhaps, the major argument that is made against this development is, it may result in higher unemployment rate. This means, a single machine can easily make hundreds of employees redundant. Moreover, People failing to support their families may instill the sense of injustice and resentment and this is often one of the reasons that, people turn to crime to fulfill their basic needs of life, when they are unable to find work. Thus, this clearly shows that replacing humans with machines to perform jobs can cause irreparable damage to both, individuals and societies.

However, while there are some drawbacks to this approach, there are also numbers of potential benefits to this technology. Firstly, machines can perform work more efficiently in comparison to human employees as these automated machines are carefully designed to utilize less resource and increase productivity. Secondly, there are occasions where it is more sensible to use machines than to perform jobs manually such as, coal mining industry, where workers health can be seriously affected and even sometimes put their lives in grave danger. Lastly, this technology encourages people to learn new skills and enforce societies to educate rather being stuck for lifetime of unskilled job. Therefore, as a result, this development can improve productivity, save lives and even educate societies.

In conclusion, I believe, it is highly vital to adopt this development if we need to survive in today's competitive world. However, governments and authorities should establish regulations to overcome unemployment rate and compensate people by providing them trainings and more skill-full employment opportunities.

topic: Some people say History is one of the most important school subjects. Other people think that, in today’s world, subjects like Science and Technology are more important than History. Ċ Discuss both the views and give your opinion.
essay:
Being a science lover, I’d like to say that information and technology are more important than History, but that’s not to say that History doesn’t offer its own merits and while skill and machinery take us forward, our past guides us forward.

Firstly, with the rapid advancement in education and the increasing reliance of humanity on automation, it is very logical to think that systems and automation are more important than our past. For example, being a software engineer is one of the highest paying jobs, whereas being a Historian doesn’t really pay that well; Nonetheless, a career in past is not at all useless, but in terms of what society values more, technique and machinery definitely take the cake. Furthermore, the number of appliances used by modern society on a daily basis is increasing exponentially. These are only possible due to the advancement in Sciences.

However, yesteryear teaches us our past, and what is a society cannot exist without having a past, perhaps one of great victories or one of sorrow and awe. This learning from our past is crucial, Further, by learning from our past we can avoid mistakes made by civilization in the past. Like, we can learn from the actions of governments in the early 20th century which led to the two world wars and build a better world with a more functioning government that can perform better than said government and avoid such conflicts. Consequently, while technique and automation are the ropes that will pull us ahead while yesterday forms the stepping stones on which we walk now.

In conclusion, I stand by my opinion that Science and Technology are more important subjects than History as they offer better job opportunities and can take humanity forward by leaps and bounds.

topic: Some people think that a sense of competition in children should be encouraged. Others believe that children who are taught to co-operate rather than compete become more useful adults. Discuss both these views and give your opinion.
essay:
It is often argued that we should encourage rivalry in children rather than collaboration. Despite the benefit of competition, I believe that young ones that work together become of better use as adults. However, in this essay, the arguments surrounding these issues will be discussed.

Many people think that children should compete. They believe that if children are rivals, then it might bring out the best in them. An example of this is, when they participate in an athletic or academic contest, this might make them put in more effort in order to do better than their peers, especially if a reward is at stake. This could result in an outstanding performance in young people, which in turn might positively boost their confidence around their colleagues. Despite this advantage, I would suggest that this could be a serious problem for some kids, such as; the academically weak and the less athletic ones. If these youngsters are not able to keep up due to the feeling of insufficiency or pressure, they might become self-loathing or depressed.

On the other hand, I advocate the view that children who are taught to co-operate rather than contend become more useful adults. The principal reason for this is that it will certainly teach them 'teamwork'. This means that every one of them will work together and probably cover or support each other's weaknesses to achieve a goal. For instance, when an athletic child is paired with an academically sound one for a project, they will both share the workload based on their strengths. This will produce a better outcome when the project is finished and will also increase the possibility of them becoming of more use as adults, in society, at work or even in their homes.

In conclusion, although competitiveness might bring out the best, the advantage of working with one another outweighs it, in childhood and adulthood. Regardless, we must always make sure that there is a healthy balance when competing or co-operating.

topic: Some people who have been in prison become good citizens later, and it is often argued that these are the best people to talk to teenagers about dangers of committing a crime. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
It is true that a lot of prisoners change into good people after they were released from jail. There is some controversy over whether they are the best people to give advice to youngster about the negative effect of crime. I personally strongly agree with the statement and I have some reasons to support it which will be explained briefly in the following paragraph.

To begin with, public always have prejudices against ex-prisoner but not all of them have a bad personality. A lot of them committed crimes because they were in a desperate situation, for example they could not find a job to support their family who was in dire need. In prison, they were provided with technical skill and personal development program. After accepted back to the society, they work harder and become more successful than regular citizens as they have learned a lesson from their past. Those who have committed a crime and have been sentenced to be imprisoned often understand the value of life and thus change radically.

Lots of young people, in the opposite, are not mature enough to appreciate their lifetime. Lacking guidance from custodians, youngsters lost their target of life, start to lead a life of debauchery, and then some of them commit crimes by mistakes. I believe this is the point which experiences from a former prisoner, who have changed their life, can help. With ex-prisoner shares, it is hoped that youngster's view could be broadened, their awareness of the dangerous side of crimes could be raised. Therefore, young people would become good citizens.

All in all, I totally support the idea that former prisoners who have changed their life will be admirable mentors. After learning valuable lessons from people who were imprisoned, it is hoped that youngsters would avoid from crime activities in the future.

topic: In some countries, even though the rates of serious crimes are decreasing, people feel less safe than ever before. What do you think are the causes of this problem and what measures could be taken to solve it?
essay:
Despite the reduction in crime rate in nation around the globe, many citizens still feel unsafe. In my opinion, factors such as the misuse of social media and the inefficiency of the justice organization could be the reasons for this unrest.

One reason people constantly feel insecure is that social media has become a tool used for the circulation of false news. Mischievous politicians who selfishly aim to promote their political propaganda use this as a medium to propagate false news. As a result, members of the society are burdened by troubling news thereby feeling unsafe. Another reason citizens feelSuggestionfeels insecure is due to the corruption of the justice department. The legal system has been manipulated such that many criminal cases are left unattended to. For this reason, people have lost faith in the competence of the court of law, hence, they feel insecure.

In order to boost and restore the confidence of individuals in the society, there are a number of measures to be taken. Firstly, individuals ought to confirm the source of the information they get and its authenticity before forwarding it to their contact list. Also, the government should sensitise its citizens on the dangers of spreading false news. For instance, some months ago, radio stations aired advertisements, creating awareness of the need to curb the spread the spread of fake information as mandated by the government. Secondly, the image of the justice system has to be revamped. The judiciary should set up the legal system in a way that criminal cases would be heard and sentences pronounced without delay in order to restore the faith of citizens and keep them at ease.

To conclude, even though criminal activities are on the decline globally, a series of events are responsible for the insecurity individuals feel. I believe the authorities, as well as members of the society have their roles to place to alleviate the feeling of unrest. For example, stopping the spread of fake information and restoring the image of the image of the judiciary in order to make citizens feel safe in their environment.

topic: Some people say that it is possible to tell a lot about a person's culture and character from their choice of clothes. Do you agree or disagree? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own experience or knowledge.
essay:
It is commonly believed that people's background and personality can be recognized by what they wear. Although the majority of people nowadays are open to wearing whatever they want, others in certain demographic areas still express their culture by wearing specific cloth, and there are also some religions, which have specific dress codes for whoever believes in them. That is why I completely agree with the above statement. This essay will discuss why I support this opinion and will also give a logical conclusion.

Firstly, It is beyond any doubt that communities in certain demographic areas wear clothes that are common in their culture. For instance, men in southern Asia wear skirts, this is due to the fact that they think that skirts are more comfortable than pants. However, this might sound odd to others, it is completely fine to wear skirts in this society. Thus, cultural background and personality could be reflected by what others wear.

Secondly, there are some religions that have a general dress style for whoever believes in these religions. For example, Muslim women have to wear headscarves to cover their hair if they decided to go outside their home. Because it is thought in Islam that Muslim women should be preserved by wearing head scarfs. Therefore, it is easy to recognize Muslim women by their headscarves.

To conclude, cultural background and personality could be sometimes determined by others' choice of cloth. I believe that this is true because there are some communities that show their culture by wearing special outfits. In addition, some religions are known to have a certain dress code.

topic: New technologies have changed the way of children spend their free time. Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
Youngsters are finding new methods to spend their leisure time due to advancement in the latest technologies. Although teenagers will often struggle with health and social conditions due to a sedentary lifestyle, they will also gain significant knowledge that will help them to learn many new tools. In my opinion, new technologies provide more advantages than their downsides.

The greatest benefit of new technologies is that children can learn more about things happening around the world which will help them to enhance their intellect. This has become possible due to immense development in the field of internet and connectivity that allows young people to access information anytime through any part of the world. For instance, through YouTube and Reddit young folks gets access to various groups of people and channels where they can learn and discuss various domains ranging from science, gadgets, novels, etc., enables them to connect with like-minded people and helps them to broaden their perspectives. As can be seen, these advantages have a hugely profound impact on the future of children.

The first main disadvantage is developing a habit of the desk-bounded way of life. They spend numerous hours of time sitting in front of computers which may lead to various health issues. To give an example, continuous working on laptops can give immense strain on their eyes resulting in pain and dryness. In addition, as a result of lack of movement and exercise can result in obesity. Secondly, it is observed that juveniles find it difficult to interact with others and can develop social anxiety due to the lack of face-to-face communication. These issues can have long-lasting effects on the mind of young people.

In conclusion, new technologies have no doubt changed children's way of spending time. While there are few drawbacks which concern youngster’s health and communal behaviour, the positive side completely outweighs it, thus, accelerating their intelligence and knowledge levels.

topic: Some people think the government should increase the cost of fuel for cars and other vehicles in order to solve environmental problems. To what extent do you agree or disagree.
essay:
It is true that traffic emissions are a major cause of air pollution problems . Some people believe that in order to fight this issue, the authority should raise the prices of fuel . In my opinion , I totally agree with this view and believe that this approach can be an effective solution to reduce air pollution problems.

Firstly, this approach encourages individuals to drive only when needed which will undoubtedly decrease the emission of gases . To put it simply , If the prices of gasoline increase , consumers will become demotivated to use vehicles in their daily life activities and tend to practice physical activities which is a clean habit for the environment . For instance , instead of driving cars or taking public transportations , individuals will prefer to bike a bicycle or walking for the purpose of going to their works and studies . That is why this approach can be a useful solution for decrease people dependence on gasoline .

Secondly , raising the cost of oil can encourage companies to opt for clean alternative sources of power . Even if the prices of fuel become higher , the consumption of this source of power is still higher in the industry fields . Consequently , they will think seriously to start using other types of energy such as solar and renewable sources which remain valuable alternatives for industries and do not affect negatively the environment .

In conclusion , I strongly believe that the fuel price increase can help the government to combat the problem of vehicle emissions because it discourages the use of vehicles and encourages consumers to use clean alternative sources of energy .

topic: Some people feel that sports is beneficial to the society. Others, however believe that it is nothing but a leisure activity. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
People have different opinions on the benefits of sports. Some argue that sports are useful for the society while others feel that sports are only for leisure. I firmly believe that sports are essential for the society and let us consider the differing opinions on the same.

While the money earned from ticket sales of most sports events goes to the organizers and players, there are several instances when sports events are organized for raising funds for charitable purposes. For instance, funds raised in IPL matches in 2007 were donated for rehabilitation of Tsunami victims in India. In these cases, the sports events directly contribute to the welfare of the community. Sports activities tend to bring together people in a common gathering and promotes social development. Further, sports help in the overall personality improvement of players honing their leadership, team spirit, physical and mental stamina. Thus, sports are beneficial to the public in multiple ways.

However, on the other hand, there are people who believe that sports can only serve as leisure activities. This could be true when there is no real value addition to the people involved. For example, if a person watches a football match on TV, he does not engage himself with others watching the match and there is no development as a result. In such scenarios, sports are reduced to merely a past time than societal value adder.

In conclusion, sports are beneficial to the society because during the current time when children immerse themselves in video games and lack physical activity, sports act as motivating factors for people to come together and be physically fit. A community where its citizens are physically strong is a healthy community. Therefore, in my opinion, sports definitely play a role in the development of a healthy society.

topic: Some organisations believe that their employees should dress smartly. Others value quality of work above appearance. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion. Dress Code Policy at the workplace
essay:
Over the past decade, dresscode at work has never failed to draw public attention and provoke debates. Some people assert that the employees should show their proffesion by their dressing styles while the other hold their view that the staffs had better give more notice on their working efficiency to appearance. In this essay, I will go more intensively into these two opinions and give my personal perpective.

Firstly, it is essential to recognize that smartly attractive dresscode at the offices possibly and indirectly encourage the staffs' interest or motivation at work. To be more specific, the fact that the employees have their own alternatives to adopt what they probably wear to the offices will make them more willing to concentrate on their jobs as the more delighted they get, the more productive they may perform. Furthermore, the scenio that all the staffs in the firm dress fashionably and proffesionally really show an amazing and interesting brand image for the company.

On the other hand, it is equally vital to recognize that labour productivity is of much higher essence compared to showing off the dressing styles at work. For example, notwithstanding serving in the same industry field, Vietjet Air actually make customers bear in mind their much more marvelous and high-fashioned uniforms than those of Vietnam Airlines. Nonetheless, Vietnam Airlines successfully achieves higher reputation due to their careful service and safer flights, which makes it manage to maintain its position and firmly stands still on the top.

In conclusion, every view has its own merits and drawbacks. To my point of view, under no circumstances does paying more attention to dress intelligently and gorgeously at the offices impact detrimentally on working productivity. As a result, I will give my support to the idea of freedom of dressing at work.

topic: Some people think that parents should teach children how to be good members of society. Others, however, believe that school is the place to learn this. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Some people have different views with regard to the question of how to train children to be a nice component of the community. In my views, parents and school must collaborate together to nurture better children's attitude.

On the other hand, the school can certainly assist to encourage children to be nice in society. Social experiences that school offers will provide how to get on with each other for children. There are types of social experience such as meeting with their peers, playing together and building teamwork. Through the progression of education, invaluable life experiences and social development skills are being taken away from our children. As a result, we would hope that school is the ultimate opportunities to gain experiences and the understanding of life.

On the other hand. I believe that family is the first school not only in term of socialization and citizenship but also in term of general education. Firstly, a positive family environment will give children examples. They can follow in order to better relate to others when they leave this environment. Secondly, in a family, a child learns to trust. Thirdly, a child then learns to compromise and to see that others have needs as well and trained that a co-operative society is a happier and more productive one for all. Finally, parents must be in charge to establish the best attitude for their children to be the right community member.

In conclusion, while school can certainly aid to construct social experience. I believe that Parents are a paramount importance key to supervise their children.

Moreover, technology provides better security at all the places even for that no need to hire human, such as in many multinational companies to open the door a face recognition system is there.

topic: There are social, medical, and technical problems associated with the use of mobile phones. What forms do they take? Do you agree that the problems outweigh the benefits of the mobile phone?
essay:

By considering some examples below, I still strongly believe that these problems that these problems do not defeat the benefits in the long run.

For some people, mobile phone use reduces humans' face-to-face social life quality. People only realize health problem as WHO (World Health Organisation) warned people about radiation produced by mobile phone, which turned out to have the highest level among all other electronics devices. Radiation may cause major health problems, especially cancer. Finally, users sometimes upset when some technical problems such as network errors or screen failure not maintained well by manufacturers.

However, mobile phones technologies are undoubtedly have been facilitating many aspects in our lives. Despite the aforementioned problems, this particular device also helps us, ironically also in the same fields. Mobile social media applications definitely help people to communicate with each other, finding new friends as well reunite them with old friends. Developers also create useful and practical features to help them becoming more aware of their health conditions like heart rate, body mass index and how many steps have they take in a day. Lastly, mobile phone producers are being more consumer-friendly nowadays to maintain their brand image.

All in all, people should bear in mind to not only point out the drawbacks of mobile phones, but also consider how to overcome them. I am convinced that the benefits of mobile phones have higher values than the disadvantages.

topic: some youngsters choose to live away from parents. In many countries around the world young people decide to leave their parents' home once they finish school. They start living on their own or sharing a home with friends. Do you agree or disagree with this approach? Give your opinion.
essay:
Self-dependent is nowadays a trend observed in many countries where the youngster after finishing their school leave their hometown to another region of the world to become motivated, independent and can stand on their feet. In my opinion, I completely agree with this approach and in details are discussed in the following paragraphs.

Firstly, the approach of living independently makes us confident, strong enough to face the world challenges, living without parents allow people to understand the real world and an opportunity to learn things themselves. Take for an example, In India, most students after finishing their school life tend to move abroad leaving behind their families to acquire higher studies and better job possibilities to grab as much as the knowledge they can from the world.

Secondly, Living alone or with friends provide the platform for the youngster to have an independent decision in critical situations and teaches a lot to the person about his decision-making capabilities and teaches about the human behaviour, such as dealing with other people around you independently, taking medical care of your ill roommate and helping your friend in assignments, creating shared values with friends and neighbour are beneficial and memorable for the young generation to have a good human touch.

In conclusion, allowing a youngster to live away from the parent is a very hard decision but it has a fruitful output and teaches their children to understand the real world and build up their self-confidence and make them stand on their feet.

topic: In the past shopping was a routine domestic task. Many people nowadays regard it as a hobby. Ċ To what extent do you think this is positive trend?
essay:
In former times, shopping used to be an everyday household chore in which individuals bought essential items only when necessary. However, it is noticeable that many individuals view it as a leisure activity these days . In my point of view, I partly agree that it should be considered as a positive phenomenon due to its enormous economic benefits, even though it might encourage rash buying behaviour sometimes.

First and foremost, as a consequence of the availability of numerous products and increased comfort level in shopping centres, one tends to spend more money in an impulsive way. Many people buy things which fascinate them even if it has no use in their lives. Moreover, they are further fueled by credit availability, as they do not have to pay the whole amount upfront. Unfortunately, this may land them in deep debt. For instance, according to a recent study conducted by the University of Melbourne in 2018, 43% of youngsters aged below 30 admitted that they had shopped recklessly without evaluating their current financial conditions thoroughly, which sometimes resulted in long-term credit card debts.

Nonetheless, shopping is seen as an economic growth factor that produces more employment and triggers the creation of new companies and business expansion. If individuals shop more often, shopping centres and retail stores will have a higher income which can lead to business success and survival. In addition, new companies can be created as there will be more customers willing to buy and support these new products and services. For example, Christmas is one of the seasons where people spent the greatest amount of money shopping. As a result, there is a higher demand for products, services and labour which benefits society considerably.

In conclusion, I believe that although irrational shopping habits might be seen as a negative side effect of recreational shopping behaviour, it brings tremendous economic benefits to society as a whole. In the foreseeable future, it is predicted that the number of avid shoppers might increase dramatically because of the increasing popularity of online shopping platforms.

topic: Q: Spending lot of time on holding wedding parties and other celebration is just a waste of money. Others, however think they are necessary for individual and society. Discuss both the views and give your opinion.
essay:
Party culture has become inevitable in this modern era. Throwing parties is considered as a great means for socializing. Be it birthday, wedding, or even job increment, everyone would ask, "So when is the party? ". These get-together is considered as medium to be more gregarious. However, a serious question is raised on the prodigal money spent on the parties.

Proponents of the ornate parties feels, hosting such celebration will get them introduced to many connections. More grander a party is, more people would participate. This would fetch them important contact, which might help them later in their individual betterment, such as, job finding, etc. Moreover, many people feels this party culture adds more colour to their lifetime events such as, wedding, birthday, etc. Thus, they are able to share their happiness with their friends and relatives.

However, the opponents of the party culture raise concern over the money spent over these momentous celebrations. This section of society feels that, the amount spent on these celebration can be diverted towards a greater cause. In fact, I have seen several people who cut-down their wedding cost and donate the saved amount to some educational institution. This gives them a sense of satisfaction and happiness.

In my opinion, parties are essential, at the same time, money consumed by these celebration must be frugal. Instead of staging a extravagant and pompous party, people can showcase their joy in a simple and elegant manner. Happiness is a state of mind. Hence, people should learn to discover their jubilation from a judicious celebration.

topic: Universities should allocate the same amount of money to students' sports activities as they allocate to their libraries. Ċ To what extent do you agree with this view?
essay:
Universities are places of higher learning in every field, which includes sports. However, there are some who believe that sports activities at the university level should not be given the same amount of monetary support as libraries.Furthermore, I believe that sports activities are as important as libraries.

Firstly, A common adage illustrating my perspective is, a healthy mind in a healthy body. Moreover, Games cannot be conducted just by including them in the curricula. As a result, It needs commitment and action resulting in hiring coaches; providing facilities, amenities & supplies; networking; and participation in sporting events. In such a scenario, a student enrolling in a sport as part of his university education has a wholesome experience of fitness, discipline, a winning attitude and sportsmanship, as which he can only read about in the library.

Secondly, People who support the thinking that funding for sporting activities has to be reduced believe that sports will distract students from the primary goal of acing in academics. Burying his head in books is not enough for a student to excel. Although, It will only make him a bookworm, give him a headache, a bad posture, and an inability to be practical. On the other hand, indulging in sports activities is a scientifically proven way of accelerating blood circulation to all parts of the body, especially the brain, which sustains the brain for the work it needs to do in the library. Finally, It will also add good posture and real life experiences with teammates, as well as we will go a long way to make him a successful human being.

In conclusion, I agree that libraries and sports should be treated equally by universities, where funding them is concerned. Therefore, to summarize, Moreover, let me give you an example.
