topic: Some people say that advertising is extremely successful at persuading us to buy things. Other people think advertising is so common that we no longer pay attention to it. Ċ Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
The effects of commercials have remained a highly contentious subject among citizens in recent years. While some believe advertising does a great job at influencing people to purchase their products, others claim that it is too repetitive and has become a nuisance for everyone. In my opinion, both views have a valid point and I will discuss them in this essay.

On the one hand, it is true that a large number of people have been influenced by advertisements in several ways. First of all, some companies often hire celebrities to promote their products on social media. In a way, it helps the product to become more widespread as well as makes it more legit and trustworthy. Moreover, using new and refreshing concepts to advertise is also a good idea to convince people to buy. For instance, some commercials have catchy songs or stunning visuals to impress viewers and make them remember the products more vividly.

On the other hand, we have been bombarded by advertisements for too long that we started to have a negative attitude toward them. They appear everywhere, from street billboards to social media websites and as a result, people do not pay attention to them anymore. Thus, more and more promotion videos use too much exaggeration that citizens no longer have faith in it. Take mobile games as a typical example, its advertisements show the gameplay that does not reflect the truth, therefore ended up becoming hated by everyone.

To conclude, there is no doubt that commercials can be successful in some ways, although it has become too common that people started to feel annoyed by them. Personally, due to the prior explanation, I believe both views are acceptable.

topic: TOPIC: News media is important in our society. Why is it so important? Do you think its influence is generally positive or negative?
essay:
People now seem to get most of the information from the various forms of news media and whether it is important and has a positive impact in modern society or not has sparked spirited debate. My discussion will be as follows.

There is no denying the fact that news media plays an indispensable role in modern society. At first, if news media disappears, the public cannot participate their political life actively because young people who are the future of a nation will lose the chance to hotly discuss and study current affairs and old people who have rich experience cannot offer precious advice. However, if news media exists, news concerning fashion will enrich people's leisure and work life as a glance of entertaining news will be quite satisfying and can alleviate their pressure.

Admittedly, news media both has its pros and cons. Firstly, it can be deceptive and misleading as news media may give an exaggerated account of the issue without any sense of responsibility. However, news media keeps people informed of current affairs, enabling people to have easy access to the global world. For instance, people would not be told on time how is going about the air crush in Malaysia without the help of news media. Besides, some news reported about celebrities, tourism and so on is quite entertaining, which can alleviate people's pressure from their daily life.

In conclusion, news media plays a significant role in current society and it exerts a more positive impact.

topic: Some people say that the main environmental problem of our time is the loss of particular species of plants and animals. Others say that there are more important environment problems. Discuss both these views and give your opinion.
essay:
In today's fast-paced world, our mother earth faces the danger of extensive loss of greenery, which is forests, and many animals are on the verge of extinction. While some believe that global warming and the consequent climate changes pose a major threat to the earth, I could not agree more with this view.

On the one hand, some people believe that the ecosystem imbalance is the crucial environmental issue we face today. In other words, exotic vegetation may not be possible in any kind of soil, and the regions that support these plants should be isolated away from harmful factories. Additionally, illegal animal poaching which happens in underdeveloped countries, and also in other nations, contribute tremendously towards the permanent loss of certain animal species. Hunting wild animals, for instance, seriously affects the food chain that exists in nature.

On the other hand, it is often strongly stressed by some that the climate change issues we face today are as a result of global warming, which in itself is the vital environment problem. Owing to the growing human population, deforestation silently happens in the background, even though environmentalists are against this idea. This also gradually minimises the natural water resources that are available for the entire mankind and animal kingdom. The recent Amazon forest fire, for example, is a blunt truth showing the nature encroachment by us, to fulfil our evergrowing needs. Moreover, this also contributes to the off-season tsunamis and storms, which are a consequence of the off-balance in nature.

In conclusion, while people may vary in their opinions, I firmly believe that erasing forests and thereby reducing the natural water content in this earth poses an extensive threat to the unprecedented change in the climate.

topic: Some people believe that visitors to other countries should follow local customs and behavior. Others think that the host country should welcome cultural differences Discuss both these views and give your opinion.
essay:
In a world with a rich variety of cultures and nationalities it is hard to follow certain rules and customs. Trivial behavior in one society may be seen as inadmissible in another. Some people think that tourists and representatives of other cultures should follow behaviour accepted in a country they visit. However, others consider that the host country should be tolerant to the cultural differences. In this essay, I will discuss both views and give my own opinion.

Every country and every nation has its own specific culture and mode of life that visitors want to see and experience. That is what makes them commit various trips around the world. Therefore, there is an instruction that should be taken into account by travelers: local inhabitants and customs should be respected. For example, in Muslim countries such as Morocco and Egypt, tourists seem not to wear revealing outfits and show their feelings in a public places as this behavior may be reckoned as a disrespect to secular beliefs of natives.

On the other hand, cultural differences may diversify societies. In London, for instance, there are many representatives of multifarious countries and cultures who follow their traditional behavior. Native dwellers can discover a great number of extraordinary things talking to or watching people appurtenant to other culture. This variety may improve relations between countries and nations and increase the world view of native residents as visitors can share their beliefs, customs and lifestyle.

In my opinion, cultural differences should be welcomed by everyone as this has numerous advantages. However, visitors should be aware of customs of the country they visit and respect them.

topic: IELTS Writing Task 2: Some people say that economic growth is the only way to end world poverty and hunger. Others say that economic growth is damaging the environment and should stop. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
One of the growing trends that have gained popularity worldwide is economic development due to its apparent human and social benefits. Although it ensures that the country is out of starvation and poverty in society, others claim that this would have detrimental effects on the environment and should not be perpetuated.

On the one hand, solid economic progress is an optimal way for tackling hunger and poverty. First, the government has enough national budgets to allocate food security and raise living standards, requiring more resources from authorities. In fact, the government increases the national output by collecting more taxes through incentive policies to grow the business to maximise profits. Second, economic prosperity also contributes to significantly reducing the unemployment rate, thus creating more employment opportunities. This means that people make income to afford the basic needs of living things by their abilities.

On the other hand, environmental degradation can arise from investing in the economy. First, factories pollute the air by releasing gas emissions into the atmosphere, or sewage is being discharged into rivers, lakes. If enterprises show concerns for environmental consequences, they would be willing to invest in environmentally friendly technology in order to maximise environmental consequences. Second, the ignorance of the government on allowing enormous projects regardless of ensuring the environment since its benefits, which provide more jobs and pay more taxes for local authorities. The asking of strict regulations to suitable environments acts as a deterrent for attracting the projects or getting development target quickly.

In conclusion, although economic growth is vital to some, protecting the environment is crucial for most. Depending on the conditions and abilities, countries should be able to find their best mix.

topic: People naturally resist making changes in their lives. What kind of problems can this cause? What solutions can you suggest? reluctance to change
essay:
It is not uncommon that resistance to change is a striking human's instinctive trait. Although there will undoubtedly be some negative consequences, some steps can be taken to mitigate these potential problems.

Being reluctant to change can decelerate human evolution and civilization. If early human races' inner fears of the unknown were far greater than an eagerness to find new homes, they wound be content with their status quo and and the turning point in human evolution was unlikely to take place. From individual perspective, resistance to change is the biggest obstacle preventing excellence. For example, employees may not bring out the best in them since the dread of failure outweighs the rewards, leading to a monotonous world where people are afraid to be different. This means either world famous inventors or advanced gadgets would not exist while outbreak of epidemics would threaten existence of human beings.

However, there are several actions can be taken to solve the problems described above. Firstly, organizations should promote a culture where changes are encouraged. By being tolerate to losses and rewarding innovation, uncertainties will be replaced by excellence and other scientific breakthroughs. In addition, competition should be held both locally and internationally to fuel major successes in all areas. By taking part in a contest, contestants have to present and defend their most compelling ideas in order to achieve highest prize. Kickstarter and other crowdfunding platforms have proved their efficiency in inspiring and empower young people to make changes for the better. An increasing number of ideas turning into real-life commodities, in fact, shows a brighter outlook for the future of human kind.

In conclusion, while struggling to change hinders evolution of human being to individual level, a transparent and supporting culture may eliminate the risks involved in change process, thereby boost revolution in every domain of life.

topic: Nowadays, there is a trend that reports of media focus on problems and emergencies rather than positive development. Some people think it is harmful to individuals and to society. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
One of the most conspicuous trends in today's world is media channels. Some people believe that news channels focus only on controversies rather than focus on global problems. On the other hand, others argue that the media have their limitations and freedom to choose contentSuggestionthe content that need to be telecasted. As such, there are both merits and demerits for this trend. I agree that all media content should be equally distributed and cover all the matters with equal importance for social harmony.

Firstly, there is a deluge of arguments and the most preponderant is that corporate style, working to influence news television programs focuses more on commercials and less focus on content. Moreover, media broadcasts are free to air and the only income generated is through advertising commercials through rating. For instance, a recent survey suggests that half of the television viewers are loosing interest in watching the news because of too long commercials. Needless to say, money minded business mentality made television more boring and less appealing programs.

Secondly, another pivotal aspect is that to gain instant rating and popularity controversies are the only possible way to gain huge viewers. In addition, change in viewers tastes made media representatives shift their focus from positive development programs to advertise programs. For example, Foxstar media had huge losses in its recent sports sponsorship and trying to earn more money from commercials to pacify the loss incurred. Hence, the media have chosen to make money out of their programs and not to spread awareness or to benefit people.

In conclusion, one can clearly understand that financial burden can make press agents to shift their focus from innovative programs to controversial content. Finally, the role of the media is too dire to ignore.

topic: Some parents believe children’s leisure activities should be always educational, but others think it will cause more pressure on children. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Education acts a fundamental to the progress of a country, a community or an individual. Leisure time is very important for kids to relax themselves after hours of study. Many parents suggest that leisure activities should always be educational. This might have some advantages, but I believe that children must be allowed to choose their own recreational activities.

To commence with, parents want their kids to be successful in life. Most of them have developed the notion that the only way to achieve is to work hard and concentrate on studies. Thus, they want the recreational activities to be educational in nature. This could help the kids gain some intellectual knowledge in their playing activities. For example, parents often play the game of city, animal and food with their children as it helps kids with spelling and general knowledge.

On the other hand, spending free time on educational activities only, might irate  kids. They may feel that they have to study in their free time as well. This can cause stress to them and they might even lose interest in studies. Kids should be encouraged to play outdoor games, or to perform some art in their playing time. These activities relaxes and rejuvenates their mind. For instance, if kids play outdoor games regularly, then they attain better physical and mental health because physical exercise improves breathing and destroys fat cells and stress causing hormones. Therefore, students should be allowed to choose their leisure activities.

To conclude, I think that having educational activities as recreation could be beneficial, if it is practiced on an irregular basis only. Parents should allow their children to watch television, play outdoor or indoor games as per their wish, in their free time. This would help children grow mentally and physically.

topic: Some people say that the clothes people wear the most important indication of what they are like. Others, however, say that people should not be judged by the clothes they wear. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Clothes help to protect body. Not only this, it is believed that garments put on by people could differentiate people's personality from other people. However, it is argued that judging people by their outfit is unjustified.

Apparently clothes are often used as a significant sign of the tendency what people are like. A 2015 recent study by Renata Rim as psychologist from Ohio University conducted that the accuracy of identification people's personality by the clothes style which is worn by people is 85%. Afterwards, she found that 31 of 35 people from different age cohorts who have different favorite clothes and fashion style have different personality. To illustrate, people who wear short pants and T-shirts, they are more likely to be easy-going, while people who dressed elegant are more friendly but tend to be selfish. Evidence of this can be seen that apparel can express their own individuality.

However, clothes may not result in an impression about people's behaviour. Journal of Fashion Marketing and Management published in 2013 shows researchers carried out the research with over 300 adults (men and women) in Manchester City related to assesment of people's appearance. This study shows people are bound to judge strange people in a-50 second of seeing another,yet 55 % of their judgment was not matched with the real personality of those. It is clear that making judgment about people from the clothes they wear is not always right.

The aforementioned evidence shows that clothes could indicate people's behaviour. However it is believed that it is not superficial to judge someone by the way they dress. It is imperative that choice of dress style should be carefully because people will make all sorts of assumptions and decisions about us without proper evidence.

For example, Charles  Darwin  received  Joshua  Wedgwood's X chromosome so his  cleverness through his mother. Therefore, if a man wants smart sons his best bet is to marry a smart woman. Children ability represent parent cleverness .

However, I would argue that intelligence can develop by learning. People decide to spend their time, and finding the resources they need to get wicked smart. Therefore, it is mean more practice and good evironment will be improve someone intelligence.

topic: many children these days have an unhealthy lifestyle. both schools and parents are responsible for solving this problem. to what extent do you agree with this statement?
essay:
Today's generation is forced by unknown trends to do every action quickly or instantly than before. As a result, some children are identified unhealthy due to their daily habits. Regards to this, I realise that schools and parents are the main roles who have to take responsibility in dealing with this issue because both of them are the closest systems of environment in children lives.

Schools have duties to educate children to have healthy ways of life because they are the first educational places for human resources in gaining basic knowledge. Moreover, children almost allocate all their day times in class to study. For this reason, schools have compulsory tasks to invite all their students in applying healthy lifestyle. To illustrate, school can ask students to bring vegetables or fruits every day to be eaten in lunch time. This can make them used to healthier habits rather than doing nothing when the students bring chicken nuggets and burgers frequently.

Furthermore, parents are the most responsible actors to provide healthy life to kids. Kids still have no jobs and be dependent on their parents financially. Consequently, parents should be able to serve nutritious food every day such as accustoming them to consume meats, veggies, fruits, and milk. If their children do not seem to like those menus, it would be still another parents' duty to find ways in appealing healthy menus to their children. By doing this, children will have better fitness and be protected by the threat of disease. So, it is inevitable job for parents in making their kids live healthily.

To conclude, schools and parents are significant stakeholders to implement healthy lifestyle in children because of their educative roles and influences in children daily meals. In this case, I hope that all families and school can be cooperative to realise healthy life however strategies they would decide.

topic: being a celebrity such as a famous film star or sports personality brings problems as well as benefits. Do you think that being a celebrity has more benefits or more problems?
essay:
Fame and its impact on the lifestyle of celebrities fascinate many people. Contributing personality stories in newspapers and magazines can potentially lead to selling thousands of newspapers and magazines. In my view, this status has more challenges than advantages for the people concerned.

There are clear benefits to being famous. The images presented in the public show us prominent individuals enjoying an enviable lifestyle; they live in huge mansions, drive expensive cars, and wear the latest in high fashion. Thus, fame obviously brings great wealth for them. In addition, their frequent appearances in the media mean that celebrities have an influence that extends beyond their professional skills. Considering the fact that young people want to be like them, and so the famous can earn even more money by endorsing different products and brands. Although simple being in the spotlight may be enough for some, the main benefits of popularity appear to be financial and material.

Nevertheless, the high level of reputation has its own problems as well. The ability to influence others and the notion of fame itself are both dependent on appearing in the media on a regular basis, which means that celebrities have very little privacy. The same media that creates their honour is highly likely to share their lives stories that are less positive. In fact, it could be argued that negative stories sell more newspapers or attract more clicks than any other. This in turn put an enormous amount of pressure not only on the individuals concerned but also on the community close to them. As a result, their relationships and family life suffer. Clearly, the fortune that stems from popularity comes at a substantial personal cost.

In conclusion, there are clear financial benefits to being famous as well as enormous personal challenges. In my view, the constant publishing coverage is far too intrusive, and the loss of privacy is much too high a price to pay for the financial rewards.

topic: Some people say now there is less communication between the family members than in the past. Ċ To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
In today’s fast paced world, there is an evident spike in the communication gap between the members of the family, when compared to the last few decades. I would agree with this view, with an exception that, there are still some sections of the society, which are following some definitive guidelines to keep their family relations healthy.

Firstly, the section of the people who believe that transparency in the family is declining, might argue that this situation is due to the daily work schedules of the modern families. These families, which are majorly the nuclear families, having parents as the working class and their children are in modern education, experiencing so much of daily stress. For example, as per the survey by The Times of India, 3 out of 5 families in today’s metropolitan cities are nuclear families, and both the partners are doing day jobs. As a result, the family members will not get any personal time to share their feelings, which increases the gap between the partners.

Additionally, another key factor which leads to family disintegration, is the intrusion of mobile technology, and social media in their personal life. In fact, the present day, every person owns a mobile with a truck load of social media apps, like Facebook. To exemplify this, the recent article published by “The Business Insider” clearly shown the multifold increase in the smartphone usage by young kids in the family, especially on mobile gaming. In contrast, if people spend their precious time for having a meaningful conversation, it can lead to a treasured family experience.

In conclusion, although there are some groups focusing on the intra-family communications, the majority of the world is facing family mistrusts and communication pitfalls, due to the technological advancements, and lifestyle impediments. So, I opine that, in this twenty first century there is an evident proof of mis-communication in the family members and they have to be addressed at various levels. Hence, I would recommend that, every family must devote a few hours of their personal time to eat, chat and laugh together.

topic: The use of electronic media has a negative effect on personal relationship between people. To what extend do you agree or disagree??
essay:
In modern era, sophisticated gadgets adapt human interconnection in the word. Some people argue that it gives bad impression with people relationships. I personally disagree with this statement because in some situations the electronic media helps human communication.

Occasionally, most people become individualist because they focus on their smartphone than others. As an illustration, nowadays, some people meet with friends but they do not pay attention with them because in the same time they do multi-task such as chatting or playing games. In addition, others make a dinner together but when they wait their errand, every person focus on their electronic media and don't care with others. Based on the situations there is validity why some people presume about that. However, I believe that electronic media gives advantages for human relation.

The sophisticated gadget helps the human to interact with others efficiently and easily. Social networking connects all people in the world effectively by e-mail, social media and video conference. It means that the gadget helps human to relate with others. For instance, most people can be linked with their lost friends with social networking by using a smartphone or a laptop. Furthermore, it helps some people who have disability in communication with their relatives by chatting, because they cannot talk directly with others.

In conclusion, the information and technology era changes the human interaction by gadgets. Some people convince that this condition presents some negative effects. Although, it gives bad impact but it helps most people to relate with others effectively than before.

topic: The use of electronic media has a negative effect on personal relationships between people. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Cutting-edge communication technology influences the way people interacting with each other. It is true that electronic devices bring a drawback in social relationships, but I totally disagree if this developed technology is seen as a sinister in people's personal lives.

Some people state that social connection among them is badly affected by the mass uses of electronic communication equipment, such as convenient mobile phones. Electronic media these days are easy to be used by people of all generations, from the children to the old. The most handy, sophisticated and favourite communication device, smart phone, makes people more likely to focus on their devices when they met with other people in real life. When in a meeting, for example, people who addicted to smartphones are easily distracted by the ring of it and ignore their surroundings. However, although it is evident that there is a bad effect of using electronic media for communication, I state that the use of this style of communication are absolutely beneficial.

Undoubtedly, electronic devices widen the range of people's connection with other people. As nowadays virtually every people owns an advanced communication devices, it is possible for the to keep in touch with anyone, anytime and anywhere they want. The difference of time zone and the length of distance does not matter. In addition, recently group chat becomes popular among people as it can connect people with someone who  is barely known in the past. Thus, it can increase the number of relations they have.

In conclusion, it is true that there is a negative effect of electronically communication style, but it is not a great deal compared to the benefits. In my view, people should balance their virtual and real-life communication in order to avoid their prior relationships get worse.

topic: Most employers interview candidates before hiring them. Do you think this is the best way to do it? In your opinion, what is the best method for choosing employees?
essay:
Getting new job and having interview are linked as a common way within companies. While most companies or employers think it is efficient to get best candidate, I believe some methods should be considered further.

To some people who have relation major of communication with people, interview might work well, but for some are not. There will be nervous before having the meeting to interviewer, and it is possible that a candidate will not perform satisfy answers. For example, when my first interview to teach in a school,  a week before, I already got worries for questions might be coming, and I got fever and stress during a week before meeting the principle for interviewing. However, aptitude test and writing essay might be the answers better than giving interview.

Aptitude tests are delivering candidate to show how qualified someone is within the  academic, and writing essay can be seen as valuable because employers can analyze the strength and weakness points in public knowledge and social interest. Recent studies reported by Queen University said that 70% of 1000 candidates agree that they are prepared well to getting aptitude test and writing essay, and those tests are helpful method to get a new job in 2014. With this kind of tests, I believe nervous and worries can be decreased within candidates

In conclusion, interview can be successful to certain people who have communication skill only, and for the remaining sharing intelligences by aptitude test and writing essay are valuable method to be done.

topic: The best way to solve the world’s environmental problem is to increase the cost of fuel. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
There comes an argument that the finest way to resolve the issues related to the environment on this planet is to upraise the price of power generating materials.Even though I see a point in it , I cannot totally agree with it for the reasons listed below.

To begin with, the outcomes of increasing the price of the energy sources like coal and gas are as follows.Firstly, if the rates of the raw materials reach extreme high, people use them consciously.That means , only the required amount will be consumed by the population.For example, if the price of electricity-producing items like coal increases, this will in turn increase the power charges.As a consequence, people try to save the bill by using current only when required.As a consequence, fuel production reduces.As a result, harmful greenhouse gases that are emitted at a coal-burning station decreases.In such a way , extra addition of pollutants into the air comes down.

On the other hand, rising the cost of the fuel sources can only decrease further worsening of the planet. However , it is indeed required to compensate for the harm which had already taken place.Hence, some measures like tree plantation in open areas, shifting towards renewable sources should be opted for recharging the environment from the ongoing destruction.For instance, The Governments of the nations should campaign about the detrimental effects of deforestation and overuse of fuels.Thus alerting the population about future disasters and initiating the idea of alternative energy-producing elements.

To conclude, air pollution has been the worst situation which the whole world is dealing with.Hene I believe that instead of looking only at increasing the cost of the fuels the ruling bodies of the countries should as well as educate the people about the destruction they are going to face if they do not save the earth from this scenario.

topic: is advertising making people similar? Some people think that advertising discourages us from being different individuals, as all people want to do the same and look the same. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
People are flooded with commercial advertisements all the time either at home or outside. It is sometimes argued that people lose their identity by using similar products promoted in the advertisement. From my point of view, I completely disagree with this statement.

Thanks to advertising, both large and small companies have the opportunity to enable customers to know their products. People are exposed to kinds of products with different styles and patterns produced by the companies. At the same time of providing more choices for the consumers, advertisements also create the demands in the market to a large extent. By using products merchandised by diverse companies, people are distinguished by their clothing and accessories. On the surface, the one wearing a pair of Vans looks entirely different from another one wearing boots produced by UGG.

In addition, individual character comes more from the educational background and thoughts than wearing. The knowledge imparted in schools cultivates students' tough and tolerant personalities so that those who are well-educated tend to look more energetic and courteous than those wearing similar but ignorant and narrow. What's worse, when seeing the same advertisement of a fancy handbag, an ambitious university student may be inspired to earn money to afford it in the future while another youth who drops out of school in the childhood may commit a crime by robbing others of the bag. This is because people react differently to the same advertisement depending on their consciousness.

In conclusion, I do not agree that advertising is making people similar to each other. On the contrary, they have loads of choices to wear and do variously due to diverse advertisements.

topic: Influence of human being on the world's ecosystem is leading to the extinction of species and loss of bio-diversity. What are the primary causes of loss of bio-diversity? What solutions can you suggest?
essay:
In our times, a staggering number of animal and plant species is facing the threat of becoming extinct due to human activities. This essay will examine the main reasons for this phenomenon and ways to tackle the problem will be analysed.

The first cause of the diminishing diversity of biological life is pollution. Land, water, air and nuclear pollution contribute significantly to the global warming issue, which directly affects the wildlife. Many animals are unable to live under higher temperature. An example is polar bear who cannot survive in the poles with melted iceberg and limited food supply. Another factor is deforestation for wood logging and city development. Without vegetation, the animals' habitat is totally destroyed. Thus, living things find it hard to exist or reproduce and become endangered.

To remedy the situation of wildlife extinction, the public awareness of environmental protection should be raised. More educational promotion has to be done to instill to the citizens the importance of being eco-friendly. People should be reminded that the temperature of air-conditioner should be set at 25.5 degree Celsius to lessen the negative effects of global warming. Another possible solution is more stringent laws and regulations. The government should set up fines for polluters with the polluters pay principle. This can be illustrated by laws requiring factories to pay according to the waste produced in a certain period of time. This aims at reducing the level of pollution.

In conclusion, the major human causes to the depletion of flora and fauna include serious pollution and cutting of trees. To protect our ecosystem, we should be more aware of protecting the earth.

topic: Government should invest more money in science education rather than other subjects to develop the country. Ċ Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
It is forecasted that a nation will make more progress if the state authorities allocate a vast amount of their budget on the technical subjects instead of others. I partially agree with the statement as an allotment in other courses are needed to maintain balance in the society.

Resourcing scientific study will help the next generation to survive in the competitive market. This world is changing subsequently following the technical breakthrough. Therefore, it is required to educate the citizens about the scientific updates and make them competent enough to innovate upgraded devices and services, or else they might leg behind. In turn, the future generation will have a successful career and lead the trade market. For example, Japan is one of the wealthiest countries in the world invests most of its money on science education, which let them become top in the list of GDP.

Nevertheless, other subjects should get equal priority because only technology cannot maintain a community. Apart from the technical knowledge, people have to take other aspects of surviving in their account, like as humanity, socializing, religion, communication and so on to live a cheerful life; without proper knowledge and implement of these, a society might lack etiquette, unity and bonding. Hence, to have a moderate human society, other areas of education, such as social science, arts, marketing and so on are also required to be patronized by the government. For instance, at present, many youngsters are addicted to electronic gadgets which consequently let them become insensitive to other significant issues; if these children are counselled by the psychologists, they might revive themselves.

In conclusion, although more allotment on the scientific study will be very conducive for a country to grow and survive, the demands of other modules are equally required because of maintaining the proper human living standard.

topic: Due to the development and rapid expansion of supermarkets, many small local businesses are unable to compete. Some people think that the closure of local business will bring about the death of local communities. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
As a result of the growth of supermarkets in some areas, there are some negative impacts on local communities, especially their enterprises. Therefore, some argue that this trend may lead to affect local businesses. In my opinion, it is not a serious issue that might threaten the population. Furthermore, it might beneficial for both localities and tourists.

It is obvious that lack of traditional shops may pose some problems to localities, especially job opportunities since they usually make things to sell. However, having a supermarket in a town is useful because people can select and buy items in this place. Moreover, it is not a wastage of time since they do not need to go to a city for grocery shopping. For example, if chefs want to cook food, they can do it immediately.

On the contrary, in modern societies, there are several shopping malls and supermarkets where the public can either enjoy shopping or do some activities such as watching movies, singing karaoke and having dinner. Due to this development, the public has a good life quality. Thus, local people should get this welfare equally. In addition to this, local citizens can prepare themselves before living in a modern community if they have a supermarket.

Lastly, this development is likely to enhance the living standards of the population in a long term.

In conclusion, even though there are some disadvantages of the expansion of the supermarkets, it is found that there are several advantages to the society and the population.

topic: In some cultures, children are often told that they can achieve anything if they try hard enough. Ċ What are the advantages and disadvantages of giving children this message?
essay:
In some societies, children are often advised that in order to reach any goal, they should work intensively. Although this belief has some benefits, the drawbacks cannot be neglected. In this essay, both of them will be discussed.

These days more and more children are encouraged to work harder to reach their objectives. In this fast-paced era, life is more complex than before. The speed of life forces individuals to take appropriate and immediate actions on their plans. Therefore, youngsters who make extra endeavours and do not stop trying hard would be more successful in their life. For example, many famous people like Bill Gates told that he had studied and worked efficiently more than eight hours per day for his aims. As a result, he has achieved his goals faster than some of his classmates consequently. Secondly, making good plans and following them would prohibit children from getting bored and laziness. In this way, they are more self-determined for the rest of life.

On the other hand, advising children to work hard would result in having much stress. Setting too many goals in schools and persuading them to get high scores or win a match makes them more anxious. For instance, there are many champions and professional surgeons who complain about being nervous due to overworking during school time. Furthermore, some youngsters do not have enough talent or are unwilling to accomplish every task. So, motivating them to reach any goal in any way makes them depressed. It means that those who could not accomplish their objectives despite further efforts would tend to commit suicide after failure. I think it has a serious effect on the whole society.

In conclusion, although this attitude and culture of telling the youth that by working hard they can fulfil their aims would have some advantages, it can be led to anxiety if they do not pay attention enough to their health both mentally and physically.

topic: whoever controls the media also controls opinions and attitudes of the people and there is little can be done to rectify this. To what extend do you agree or disagree?
essay:
There is no doubt that media plays an important role in shaping the mindset of the people, whoever controls the media has the power to influence people's opinions and attitudes. While many argue that a little can be done to reduce the influence, I believe that this is not true. In this essay, I will support my view with examples.

Firstly, one can follow more than one source to check the credibility of the information. This is because comparing information from multiple authors can help to identify the main points of the issue and make one's own judgement. However, if the person is following only one medium of information he may be looking only at one side of the coin. As a consequence, this may manipulate his judgement ability. For example, If a person is following only the government run media outlet, He may only learn about the benefits of the policies but might not know the negatives.

Secondly, an individual can analyse the issues by himself. The reason for this is he can have a better understanding of the issue at hand. For instance, if the person is not sure about the details provided by the media can choose to understand the situation by himself. However, If the individual chose to follow only one media he may not be able to understand the real situation. As a result, this may hamper his decision-making abilities.

To conclude, In my view decreasing the influence of media can be achieved through following multiple sources and making own analysis. These methods can be two approaches to tackle the influence of news owners.

topic: Many museums and historical sites are mainly visited by tourists but not by local people. Why is this the case and what can be done to attract more local people to visit these places?
essay:
It is undeniable that the local people tend to travel internationally or nationally, they barely choose their local attractions to explore. This phenomenon is supposed to result from several reasons. To tackle this matter, solutions should be applied to change the situation in a positive way.

To begin with, the main cause originated in lacking of knowledge. The local people don't comprehend about their region history leading to unaware of the importance of attractions. They seem to amuse visiting places overseas or famous monuments that promoted on the Internet. They prefer traveling to strange places to visiting in their town, despite without knowledge about local places.

To address this, the government needs to encourage people to acquire local understanding as educating in school as well as organize knowledge competitions locally. The second key to deal with is that the government gives more incentives for local people to visit local attractions. For example, Ba Đen mountain is one of the most sacred places that lots of both international and national visitors. In recently, the government has promoted to local people by making discount for the people having local identification, I think it is considered to be an ingenious advertisement campaign.

topic: Q: Some people decide to start their own business instead of working for a company or organization. Do the advantages for people working for their own business outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
The huge number of unemployments is one of the crucial problems which have to be faced by numerous countries. In this case, many people think that everybody should have entrepreneur spirit to start a business, instead of trying to gain a job in an occupation. I personally believe that starting to be the entrepreneur has much more benefits to them rather than the drawbacks.

In fact, entrepreneurs have to face the huge risk that their own businesses can experience default anytime. It is because the world economic crisis can suddenly come and disturb the stabilization of their business as well as own company. For instance, 1998 witnessed global crisis and caused many private companies in Indonesia bankrupt. Finally, numerous entrepreneurs must let their profit and asset of their own company lost. Thus, I think that they have to overcome the possibility if their companies collapse into bankrupt.

On the other hand, the entrepreneurs are the people who are free to do something in their companies. It is because they do not work to other people. To illustrate this, the owner of shop can manage the time and income of their shop. Consequently, the entrepreneurs can be more creative to operate their own companies. There is no doubt that independency of entrepreneurs also support the government programs to deal with the number of jobless.

To sum up, it is evident that beginning to create the own business has more pros rather than cons. The successful businessman should encourage societies to start their own business and the government should support the spirit as entrepreneurs by financial aid.

topic: Countries are becoming mor and more similar because people are able to buy the same products anywhere in the world. Do you think this is a positive or negative development? It is true that the globalization has made the world a global village and the countries are lot more similar than ever before.
essay:
Nowadays, the development of modern lifestyle in the glob has provided significant access to all types of goods from different regions. Yet, there remains a controversial debate as to whether the overall efficiency of this phenomenon can be benevolent or it can result in excruciatingly destructive consequences. This essay will discuss the proposed topic from both sides of view with some detailed explanations.

Firstly, this criteria is able to make people's life more convenient. This is an indisputable fact that the possibility of buying some special commodities from other countries that are hard to find in one's nation can improve the living standards in that place. For instance, being able to purchase high-tech devices produced by limited nations can significantly promote the living standards in another location, which can be a beneficial factor in provoking people's enthusiasm toward the modern world; also, people will have the strength to make better communication with that region since they understand the cultural background of that nation by using their products. Consequently, this is a positive trend to be capable of buying other country's goods without border limitation.

On the other hand, the quality of a commodity can be affected negatively in another country. As a matter of fact, ease of a product's availability from other nations can not mean the same characteristics as the producing nation. As a salient example, there are some agricultural products in some regions that are classified at different rates ; however, the low rate products will be exported to other destinations that can be a political policy , while these products experience high prices that make them unapproachable for the majority of people. Furthermore, the same good of other places can not be a way to evaluate the quality of that thing.

In conclusion, I once again reaffirm that the capability of buying various things in your nation can result in various benefits and drawbacks; meanwhile, I strongly believe that its disadvantages outweigh its pros. Additionally, I highly recommend establishing some rules about the quality of the products being exported to other nations to make their accessibility worthy.

essay:
Nowadays, we live in cosmopolitan countries as people emigrate from their original country to another looking for the best life and better job opportunity. Hence, they face different languages on daily basis. Because we are not aware of all foreign languages, we have a problem dealing with variant scenarios. I totally agree that if we didn't understand each other language can cause social embarrassment. This essay will demonstrate many situations caused due to this issue.

First, English is the international language all over the world. However, we should agree that some words have different pronunciations in many countries. For instance, we have Indian speaks is not clear as a standard British accent. They used to say the word "Vork" instead of "Work",although they are advanced, these tiny mistakes cause confusion for people who are not familiar with their accent.

Moreover, some countries speak only in their mother tongue which leads to some difficulty for tourists in dealing with them. For example, if you travelled to Japan, you may notice that all street signs in Japanese. So if you seek advice in order to go specific location, some citizens can't understand you well in order to guide you. Therefore, the only solution if are planning to stay long is to learn their basic dialects. ,Also you need to be fully aware of their culture to avoid any miscommunication.

In conclusion, although, language barriers’ can cause many obstacles for some people, we need to be persistent in order to understand other persons unlike us. I believe that this problem can be faded over time as long as you are open-minded to absorb nationalities with different languages and attitudes.

topic: Some people believe online reading materials should only be used for a child to learn to read, whereas others believe only printed material should be used.Discuss both views and give your Opinion.
essay:
It is believed by some that children should be taught reading using digitized materials, while others argue that paper-based reading is better. This essay looks at both perspectives and then I will give my own view.

One of the main reasons why some people prefer to employ virtual techniques to teach their children the reading skills is that these techniques are more attractive to students. This is because such techniques include a variety of aiding utilities, such as motion graphics and animated videos, which can significantly assist in the learning process. Certainly, it is a matter of fact that, when pupils have fun in learning, they can easily engage with tutoring. Consequently, they can grasp the knowledge quite more quickly. Another reason why it is thought that unconventional teaching of children is better is that it is less costly; it is less required to print books and papers. Many recent surveys show that countries utilizing online methods are more likely to cut the cost of education.

On the other hand, there are several explanations of the increasing number of people who support printed-based learning for children. First, when reading stories and graphics are touchable, a child will not need to use computers to learn reading. This means that child's eyes can be saved from computer screen's radiation harms. Another significant aspect that can be considered is that learning, reading through printed materials can be more effective. This is due to the need of a human teacher to facilitate the spelling and pronunciation of words, which is hardly can be achieved by a computer-based tutor. Furthermore, accompanying tutors with early-aged students can guarantee a two-way learning process, unlike the one-way learning in virtual means.

In conclusion, I am convinced that both approaches are necessary to teach learning to a young student effectively. As nowadays technology is becoming a vital element in the children's life, it should be utilized wisely to assist in the learning process. If both papered and online methods were used in reading tutoring, a child would, perhaps, improve the reading fluency in a shorter time, instead of depending solely on one method.

topic: Several languages are in danger of extinction because they are spoken by very small number of people. Some people say that governments should spend public money on saving these languages, while others believe that would be a waste of money. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
There are certain languages which are endangered due to a few speakers left in the whole world. While some argue that tax money should be utilized to rescue these languages, others consider it a waste as several areas worth it more, namely, education and health sectors. In my perspective, it is a matter of grave importance to save a part of our history; therefore, a small portion of the annual budget could be assigned to it.

The supports of spending money on saving languages present the argument that these are a vital part of our culture and must be treasured for our coming generations. For example, by transferring the language in printed form and translating its literature would help a lot, additionally, it would not cost us an arm and a leg. By having that done, this piece of heritage would be saved forever and could be a source of knowledge for our upcoming generations. Hence, it has to be done through a proper channel and government have to play its role.

On the contrary, others disagree with the aforementioned point of view by saying that there are other sectors such as health and education worth more to be invested on. Which means that spending taxpayers money on the things which have no positive impact on society cannot be justified. For instance, the development budget must be invested in catering the poor, educating the kids and finding the cures for harmful diseases. Thus, the rest of the factors are secondary and it would be a waste if funded.

In conclusion, It is undoubtedly true that a number of languages are on the verge of disappearance due to the limited users of them. Some often argue that the government should invest from the budget to save them while others disagree. In my opinion, a portion of funds could be dedicated to it because it is a part of our heritage.

topic: The first car appeared on British roads in 1888. By the year 2000 there may be as many as 29 million vehicles on British roads. Alternative forms of transport should be encouraged and international laws introduced to control car ownership and use. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Ever since cars were invented in late 19th century, they have become a popular way of transportation. With the number of cars owned growing rapidly, I strongly believe that the use of other methods to transport should be promoted and new stricter ownership laws should be passed internationally.

Firstly, automobiles have been consuming huge amounts of fuel for the past decades producing smoke that pollutes the air everyone breaths. Regarding that governments should ban cars that consume a lot of petrol as well as restricting the buying of new cars apart from the ones which work on solar or electrical energy. Governments ought also raise the taxes for car owners to force people to switch to more environmentally friendly forms of travel. Bikes for example are a great alternative.

Secondly, it has been proven that cities with neat networks of bus lines, trams and underground metros have less cars on roads than other cities with poorly designed or managed public transportation. Decently priced ticket fares attract far more people to shift to mass transit. A country like Canada has succeeded to double the figures of people using railways to commute since they reduce the price of annual passes by 25 percent.

In conclusion. Cars are releasing toxic substances when burning petrol and to help making our planet less polluted we with the help of our governments need to drop the number of cars used today and stop using fuel consuming cars. Bicycles and rapid transit should be given more international attention.

topic: TOPIC: Nowadays,people can work and study at home through internet. However,the effects of long-distance programs can never be as good as face to face programs. To what extend do you agree or disagree.
essay:
Nowadays, numerous people are working and learning via the Internet.Some people assert that the effects of this modern way could not compare with the traditional way.I am deeply agree with this view.My reasons are as follows.

One reason for this is that face to face communication could definitely promote the relationship between co-workers.If everybody working through screens, then people might have the sense of alienation with each others.Unlike traditional style of communication could cultivate a positive working atmosphere and made people become more intimate, which could lead them to work with each other efficiency.

Besides,Online-education has negative effects on students` health, mentally and physically.Non-face-to-face learning could make students lose the opportunity of asking questions and discussing with others.Teaching by technology style is not only damaging their communication abilities, but also harms their bodies by exploring on the radiation of computers.

However, it is undeniable that remote courses and working could save people`s time indeed.This is because people do not have to waste their time on traffic and they could have more sleep to save energy for the subsequent activities.Nevertheless, in fact, by doing so, people could lose their passion and seriousness about their duties.Therefore, in general, the disadvantages of work and study at home through the Internet are more than it`s advantages.

In sum, I agree with that the effect of face to face programs is better than the online way.In the meantime, we should not overlook that even new technology has it`s limitation, but also has some benefits.In my opinion, we could mainly maintain the classical methods, and explore how to better use the new ways to benefit us.

topic: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? People are never satisfied with what they have; they always want something more or something different. Use specific reasons to support your answer. Satisfaction
essay:
There are many different opinions regarding satisfaction. Some people think that people need some limited things to be satisfied. However, in my view, People always want to have something more for the following reasons.

Firstly, most of the people like to have more money and status. Some people who have good houses and cars want to work harder to buy a bigger and better houses and cars. In fact, these people think about making money even in their last moments of their lives. For example, my friend's father who is sixty years old and has a good life in Iran sometimes work overnight to buy their seventh house in Kish, a beautiful island in Iran.

Secondly, people who like education never give up learning something new. We can see in universities old professors who need more rest at home after a long learning new things and teaching to other students are still reading books and researching about something else. For example, Doctor Hessabi, an Iranian mathematician, even when he suffered from the cancer and was close to death, was studying a new mathematics book.

Some people might argue that most of people are satisfied with their marriage and do not need to get married another woman. This point has some merits on the surface; however, it is probably not a correct statement in any cultures. In Arab cultures, many men have more than one woman. In addition, having some hidden relationship some married men with another women shows that most of the men are not pleased just by having one woman.

To sum up, most of the people can be satisfied by neither gaining money and status nor learning something new. In addition, some men even need more than one woman.

topic: Going overseas for university study is an exciting prospect for many people. But while it may offer some advantages, it is probably better to stay home because of the difficulties a student inevitably encounters living and studying in a different culture.  To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
essay:
Today, in the modern many students go overseas for higher education. Although, this offers students many advantages, they encounter many challenges of living and studying in a developed country. It is thus agreed that for the safety of every students they should continue education at home country. Analysing both the financial difficulties of living and studying abroad as well as inability to master different methods of studying will prove this.

To begin with, It is probable that many international students have to face the unbearable living and studying expenses in order to survive. For instance, a survey conducted by the Daily Telegraph revealed that many international students have to work part time in order to bear the cost of living and studying in Australia. This example clearly shows that unless international students work part time jobs, they are unable to bear the cost of living and studying in Australia. Thus, to save them from financial loss, it is better to continue higher education in their home country.

In addition to this, it is commonly understood that the method of learning in each countries are different. For example, if a student wishes to study in UK, he or she have to master English language which is not the student's mother tongue. As such, students are required not only to read and write in English but also to take presentation in English . Therefore, students cannot adapt to the new system of learning in an English speaking country.

In summary, the unbearable financial cost and the requirement of mastering English language makes it improbable for international students to study in a developed country. Therefore, for the best of everyone students should stay at home.

topic: Some suggest that young people should take a job for a few years between school and university. Discuss what the advantages and disadvantages might be for people who do this.
essay:
These days, it is pros and cons opinion that young people should take a work early after they finish their schools and before attending university. I personally believe that there are any benefits and weaknesses about it.

First and foremost, taking a job at a relative young aged will increase knowledge and rises real life experience to the juveniles itself as they involve in real society. In addition, they learn many things in real environment such how to behave with other people and learning to cope a problem in a job. A success entrepreneur, Bob Sadino, he has worked since he is young. He develops some business through trial and error until he reaches the one of success business, property development. Experience in real life teaches him to be success people, and his company is outstanding in Indonesia and even in over the world now. There is undoubtedly that working at young aged brings an advantage.

However, there is any disadvantage if juvenile take a decision to work rather than entering to the university. Most of them tend to continue their works than attending university as they already know about money. They can do many things with it such buying their stuff whatever they want. Also, they already feel that they can fulfill their needs, so that they become reluctant to take a higher education. Besides, they tend to focus on their jo because already have responsibilities in that field that obligates them to finish it, instead of stopping it. It can be done if they want to enter better education such in university. It can be seen from the example that there is any disadvantage to young people who take a job after they accomplish their school.

The aforementioned shows that making a decision to involve in a job between school and university brings advantage and disadvantage to young people.

topic: Many countries now face an economic downturn so it is better for each country to focus on its own problems rather than helping other countries. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Use specific reasons and examples to support your position.
essay:
In recent years, the degradation of many world's economics has seen a long-term increasing tendency. There is an opinion that governments should shift their emphasis on their development and not invest their efforts and financial resources to help others. I completely disagree with this statement and the following essay will prove my point of view.

To begin with, one nuance which should be taken into consideration when it comes to this debatable question is the fact, that some countries do not have possibilities to tackle their complications by themselves. To put it differently, specific areas of our world always suffer from the environmental disasters which entail the possessing issues for people living in these locations, and the problems cannot be solved without the aid from different parts of the planet. For instance, Georgia has a harsh climate, and every year its residents suffer from drought. Thus, people who reside in the countryside of Georgia do not have possibilities to grow their crops, and only with help of other countries,they can tackle the problems.

In addition, by supporting other regions countries can obtain some brilliant benefits. In other words, two or more countries can organise a community which could potentially help to resolve the difficulties of each other. As an example, Russia and Belarus have recently signed the agreement where they promised to protect and respect each other, and they have decided to share some resources between them. As a result, in this complicated period of time, both governments could maintain a stable situation in some spheres of their citizens' life.

In conclusion, we are all too familiar with the drastic situation which takes place in many countries nowadays. While some people argue that governments should prioritise the resolution of their own issues, I totally believe that they must aid others as this movement has a multitude of positive aspects.

topic: Many animal species are becoming extinct due to human activities on land and in sea. What are the reasons for this and what can be done to solve this issue?
essay:
It is true that a large number of animal species are likely to be extinct as human activities affect their habitats .Although this problem can be contributed by a host of reasons ,some feasible solutions should be considered to address this .

There are a number of reasons why human activities can cause animal extinction .First ,on land ,since people have been destroying animal habitats when enormous areas of rainforests have been cut down in recent years . In fact , some animal species can not find another home to live in, while others face difficulties adapting to a new environment ,which can put these species at a higher risk of extinction .Second, in sea , tourism in coast areas has an adverse impact on marine environment .For instance , waste discharged along the coast contaminates water and poses a serious threat to marine creatures in these areas. Final, human activities , including intense fishing and overexploitation are resulting in damage to the marine ecosystem . In fact , overfishing could directly affect the food chain as it causes the number of many fish species to decline dramatically in the short term .In the similar way , oil spills during the extraction process ,for example ,have killed thousands of marine species .

There are several actions that could be taken to mitigate the problem . Firstly , stricter punishments should be imposed for illegal logging ,deforestation ,overfishing and overexploitation ,this helps people who intentionally break the law ,think twice about an expensive price if they across the line .Secondly ,governments should require businesses and factories to install proper waste treatment systems ,which helps curb a huge amount of hazardous waste discharged into environment ,saving millions of animal lives .

In conclusion , there are various factors leading to animal extinction and some measures can be implemented to tackle this issue.

topic: Being a celebrity, such as a famous film star or sports personality, brings problems as well as benefits. Ċ Do you think that being a celebrity brings more benefits or more problems?
essay:
There is no doubt that the life of a public figure is not easy, especially when they are popular. Although many believe that these people have their fair share of hardships, I opine that it has more benefits. In this essay, I will discuss both sides of the argument and state my opinion on this matter.

First and foremost, those who believe that celebrities do not have any privacy might argue that these personalities are always in news and they are judged on every little action. One reason for this is that the media coverage has increased a lot in recent times, highlighting their private life more than their professional life and trying to create controversies. For instance, even when a popular athlete wants to go for dinner with their friends or family, paparazzi still follow them to click photographs and create some news. In contrast, if these media houses did not follow film stars everywhere, they would get some private time with their family.

On the other hand, I firmly believe that celebrities earn a huge amount of wealth as a result of being popular. This is because popular film stars earn millions of dollars for every film or project. Furthermore, They also get additional cash doing advertisements or endorsing a brand. For example, Shahrukh khan who is a popular actor in Bollywood is one of the richest men in the world. However, if Shahrukh khan had not been so well-liked, he would not have become one of the wealthiest people on the whole planet.

In conclusion, while there can be some complications being in the public eye all the time due to the lack of privacy, It can not be denied that public figures earn more than enough wealth via movie contracts, advertisements and endorsements compensating for these troubles.

topic: Some experts believe that it is better for children to begin learning a foreign language at primary schools rather than secondary schools. Ċ Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
It is undeniable that language is a learned activity and people often willing to learn a new language in their life span. Therefore, some people believe that it is worthwhile for children to start learning a foreign language during their primary schooling time, instead of secondary stage. Although, this trend has both positive and negative outcomes, but, the advantages are immense as compared to its drawbacks.

To begin with, there are piles of benefits if the school curriculum will include the study of foreign language at the initial stage. Because at the age of 6 to 12 children could easily develop their cognitive ability and at this time their grasping power is much higher than any other stage of life so they will be able to start understanding the basics of a new language and try to use that particular language. Moreover, learning a new language means our brain has to cope with the complexity and this will ultimately enable the children to develop their intellectual intelligence in the beginning years. Indeed, there have been some recorded instances of children in India, who have started learning French at their primary school and becomes extremely fluent when they were in the high school. Thus, it is an absolute imperative to indulge the children with the habit of learning a language of different nationalities.

Conversely, the vast majority of people are against the teaching of foreign language in the primary years of their schooling. This group of people believes that school syllabus is already overloaded with heaps of different subject and meanwhile introducing one more language in the primary stage might be a strain on the students and they may feel pressurized because getting mastery in a new language is a difficult task. In addition, some children do not feel confident to be bilingual at the early stage and putting efforts in these would be worthless. For example, according to the survey of Hindustan Times, 60% of children considered themselves the unsuccessful in learning a British language due to lack of time in their former school days. Overall, these few instances make it clear hectic study schedule hinders the learners to be familiar with the new language activity.

In conclusion, bilingual people have more opportunities as compared to monolingual that is why schools are putting more emphasis on teaching languages in the primary schools. Even though it has some negative consequences for the students, but the pile of the advantages of this trend could not be ignored, in fact, the benefits are quite considerable.

topic: Question: In some countries young people are encouraged to work or travel for a year between finishing high school and starting university studies. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages for young people who decide to do this.
essay:
Working and traveling are becoming more popular trend among youngster than finishing their study or applying in university. While this trend has merits and demerits, I strongly believe that it has more benefits than drawback.

It is believed that working for youngster who have no degree certificate will make them as a cheap labor as it shows that they have no skills and less experiences. A 2013 research of South-wales University reveals that about 60 per cent employees who have no higher education certificate get salary under Rp. 1,000,000. It means that this trend will lead the number of cheap labor rate. Also, traveling in the young age will resist their career, and it will cause a rise of the number of unemployment.

However, there are some benefits from this trend. Firstly, youngsters working and traveling experience will improve their soft skill which is essentially needed in the job world. It means that the young people have experience that becomes a basic need for them, so they can find a job. Likewise, working and traveling will open a big possibility for youngsters to find a job link as predominant factor in the job world. Also, traveling can open young people's mind to be more creative and wise as they face a lot of challenges on their traveling.

All in all, despite the demerits of this trend, traveling and working are form of beneficial activities for youngsters so as to improve their basic skills that they need in their future. It is imperative that if youngsters can use their opportunities to travel or work wisely, it will make them easier to find a job.

topic: Parents should spend more time with their children helping them with their homework. Ċ Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Parents have a significant role in their children's progress, especially when they are in school age. Some help students with their homework while others don’t. I have mixed opinion about this issue and will discuss in this essay.

Firstly, helping with student’s homework has numerous pros. It helps students understand class material better, motivate children for education, and signals to offspring that their education is essential. It is in parents’ nature to feel responsible for their kids’ academic performance. Also, they need to make sure that their kids will be prepared for a better future. For example, recent studies demonstrate that, When parents help their school students with studies, it helps to improve student performance, reduce absenteeism and get higher grades.

On the other hand, some opine that parental homework involvement may not always foster students’ desired school outcomes. Suppose parents put so much effort and control pupil home assignments. In that case, it may harm offspring’s liberty and make them more dependent and debilitate their self-management attribute. In addition, moms and dads expect their kids to complete assignments faster without losing the quality. But if kids can’t meet their expectations, it leads to additional stress, anxiety, and headaches. For instance, a study conducted by Fern university in Germany evidenced that Parents’ high expectations significantly impact pupils’ stress levels.

In conclusion, parents always want to have educated children and to achieve that, they try to help kids in their assignments. Still, I do not doubt that this will have both positive and negative effects on students' behaviour, like improving educational performance whilst increasing stress or dependency.

topic: Some believe that people are naturally born as leaders while others feel that leadership skills can develop. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
Some people consider that leaders are genetically skilled. On the contrary, others claim that leadership can be learnt. In my opinion, to be a leader requires some specific traits of personality, while some skills can develop.

To begin with, to be a leader demands some natural skills. The person in charge should have a strong personality in order to take the lead. Furthermore, he/she should be an outgoing person, gregarious, and full of energy. All these personality traits help the leader to manage, to gather people together and, also, to inspire and motivate them. For example, Denis Matsuev, a famous Russian pianist, is a natural born leader who organizes big events like international piano competitions or big concerts. He, with his charisma and high professional abilities, manages a lot of people. So, being charismatic, sociable and having a strong personality are important natural skills for being a leader.
