topic: Many people put their personal information online (address, telephone number, and so on) for purposes such as signing up for social networks or online banking. Ċ Is this a positive or negative development?
essay:
In the contemporary era of communication, personal details of individuals need to be provided for creating social media and other internet sites accounts. This essay will argue why sharing private information online has more negative sides than the benefit it has.

To begin with, an individuals' testimony regarding his address and phone number is essential for verification of the identity of the person. Since protection from spammers and hackers is inevitable to all online platforms, mobile number and other evidence of the netizens have been checked and verified thoroughly in order to give them permission for using websites. For instance, while customers approach opening a new Gmail account, a mobile number is required to be provided so as to validate their identity. For this reason, sharing private data is sometimes necessary to protect the internet world from different calamities such as hacking, spamming, and cyber-bullying.

Despite a few necessities of submitting personal info, the sharing of information can be harmful to the privacy of an individual. As personal evidence of a new user can easily be stored in websites and social media, it might be used for hacking other crucial accounts and belongings of the netizen. For example, Pathao, one of the largest ride-sharing company in Bangladesh, was shared the personal info of its existing users with another company. As a result, the details of many clients’ testimony have been exploited by other companies, and the credit card of many individuals has been hacked. Therefore, providing personal evidence to clients on the internet can expose the user to the risk of losing other belongings.

In conclusion, nowadays, sharing private data on social sites and online is a common phenomenon. Although sometimes it is critical for the websites to obtain the detailed testimony of users, sharing data online can bring more threatening to the privacy of netizens. I think, providing info on online platforms has more drawbacks than positive aspects.

topic: The dangers of smoking are well known, yet many people continue with this habit. What are the causes of this? How can we reduce smoking in society?
essay:
Nowadays, with the involvement of cigarette, people are able to achieve a temporary feeling of satisfaction since the chemical components lie in the content of smoke. Still,the presence of nicotine has been the culprit for being addicted thus this result is eliminating the chance of giving up on smoking. So the purpose of this essay is to indicate major factors that contribute to the addiction as well as methods to tackle the problem.

To begin with, there are countless people who are currently attaching to this habit of smoke consuming generally even they have an acknowledgement of the negative side it could lead to an individual's health. For example,besides having an obsessive circumstance, the government has not banned this business so far in order to reap the benefit contributor by the industry as they are feasible to boost a country's economy. Because of the allowance of smoking, the community has been manipulating the usage of smoking and convert the amusement into a daily custom. As a result, folk's fitness in a nation is flowing in a bad shape of development and the group of elders is the most vulnerable to the effect of tobacco absorption.

On the other hand, there are many ways to reduce the population of smoking that has been researched by health experts. To illustrate, a pattern of regular exercising is one of the best options to disqualify the craving for smoking. Moreover, working out is presumed to help a character to realise the crucial role of energy maintenance together construct a new lifestyle in the result as well. However, according to the psychologist, there is no impeccable solution to the complication because it mainly requires a man's determination rather than the progress of a method.

In conclusion, two major causes for the issue are the permission of running the tobacco trade and the nicotine engagement. Also, the domain answer for this question does not depend on the technical but the willpower of an individual.

Thus, the root causes of addiction are the legal tobacco trade and nicotine’s addictive nature, and lasting change requires internal resolve rather than external interventions.

topic: teaching how to be good members of the society Some people think that parents should teach children how to be good members of the society. Others, however, believe that the school is the best place to learn this. Discuss both views and give own opinion.
essay:
A massive number of people state that parents have pivotal role for teaching their pupils to become responsible society members, while others refuse and claim school is the appropriate place for it. Although, the latter argue it as school has precise learning surrounding, I believe that parents have longer time to control and teach their children.

First of all, it is generally known that school is a place to enhance not only about academic skills but also emotional ability. In the school a student would find friends coming from different backgrounds and they will be united in the class. Hence, this method will give students knowledge about importance of respect and emphatic each other's. Moreover, sometimes teachers give group assignments for students to conduct together which it teaches them specifically about a power of togetherness as well as responsibilities. Thus students will be a good society member if they can assimilate these values comprehensively. Unfortunately, schools are limited by time to run the system.

However, some experts argue that parents have huge responsibility to educate their children because they have much time to guide and demonstrate directly about collective values to their surroundings. Taking for example, when I was child, my father used to ask me to join social activities in my residence area, then today I have understood well about social responsibilities. I also known about the importance of giving cause my mother has given me a good example; she allocates a part of her revenue to unfortunate people in my town. Then, it is valued that parental education is holistic way to develop about social values.

To conclude, I re-state again that children have much benefits to learn about social life through their parents than school.

topic: Some people think that governments should give financial support to creative artists such as painters and musicians. Others believe that creative artists should be funded by alternative sources. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Some people have views that governments should fund artists, while there are opponents who argue that artists should support themselves. I believe that governments should help them.

On the one hand, it can be claimed that governments should pay more attention to other more important things. Those who hold this view claim that art is a type of spiritual requirement of humans, and what they consider is that some other areas, which are more essential, also need financial support, such as education, agriculture and medical care. In addition, another reason for this opinion is that artists are actually just another type of occupation like scientists, workers and farmers. Therefore, those who live by painting, composing and other types of art can sell their works to earn money that can support their lives.

On the other hand, I personally agree with those who are concerned that governments should support these artists. Firstly, in order to generate perfect work, artists usually need to spend an amount of time and energy. For instance, The Mona Lisa, which is famous around the world, took six years to complete it. So during that time, artists have to pause if they do not have either enough savings or external financial help. Secondly, some artworks are not recognized when artists are still alive, which leads to a situation where artists cannot earn money by selling their works. A good example of this is that the famous painter Van Gogh committed suicide due to a series of mental and life pressures caused by poverty. If he had gotten government aid like some living allowance, he might have made more great works.

In conclusion, there are convincing arguments both for and against artists' financial aid, but I believe that governments should assist them.

topic: Some people believe government should spend money on measures of language with few people from dying out completely, others think this is a waste of financial resources. Discuss both views and give your position.
essay:
Today, many languages are disappearing for various reasons. Some people think that governments should spend money to protect these languages from dying out while others think doing so would be a waste of money. Both sides will be analysed in this essay.

It is believed by some that a culture is reflected by its language, to which government should allocate some of its revenue for protection. For example, Australian government established a budget to preserve Aboriginal culture and particularly language. By doing this, the government makes a major contribution in preventing the extinction of one of the world`s oldest cultures. Therefore, the benefits of government involvement in rescuing endangered language can be seen.

However, others argue that protecting unpracticed languages is futile. For instance, the disappearance of dialects unavoidably occurs every day due to the acceleration of globalization. Thus, it is absurd for governments to throw so much money into the black-hole when elsewhere such as education and medication demands more attention. This makes clear why many are of the opinion that authority spending is better exercised in vital areas.

After analysed both opinions, it seems to me that it is necessary to reserve part of government`s income in preserving endangered languages. It is recommended that governments should not only spend money on this preservation but also organise relating events to encourage more people to contribute this cause.

topic: The growth of online shopping will one day lead to all shops in towns and cities closing.Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
In recent years, online shopping has become a phenomenon that is predicted to be a preferred method of buying products in the long run and may replace traditional stores. In my opinion, I partly agree with this statement as purchasing items from the Internet may be more ubiquitous in consecutive decades, traditional shops still play a pivotal role in society. I shall put forth some ideas to exemplify my points in the following paragraphs.

On the one hand, with the advancement of technology, the shopping experience has become more convenient and flexible to busy customers as they can access the information of various goods through websites of producers. Moreover, buyers can also read feedbacks from previous users about the products that they are keen on and make better decisions. With the development and effective collaboration between producers and delivery corporations, consumers now can purchase international products which will be delivered to their front door within a few working days. The emergence of conglomerates such as Amazon or Alibaba has captivated numerous young buyers and become competitors of many local businesses.

On the other hand, while going to traditional markets may be time-consuming, many adults or senior citizens may find it interesting as these markets bring an exciting and cosy ambience to these shoppers. In fact, numerous people in Vietnam consider this a great occasion to relax, socialise and make new friends as while housewives are busy purchasing and bargaining goods, their husbands are keen on waiting in coffee shops and having a chit-chat with others. Nevertheless, the atmosphere of the traditional market is often busy and fantastic on holidays like the Lunar New Year and this is something that can not be experienced when purchasing through the Internet. Last but not least, when visiting physical stores, consumers can actually touch and try items before they decide to buy while shopping online may not provide such opportunities.

In conclusion, while I tend to believe that online businesses may attract more customers in the future due to the convenience, more shoppers may choose to visit traditional markets on special occasions.

topic: Nowadays more and more business meetings and business training are taking place online. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
Online meetings and trainings have been widely in use more than ever. Despite a wide range of benefits that the trend offers, there are some drawbacks of the technology that users should be also aware of.

Virtual conferences are excellent alternatives to traditional ones, especially for those who live in various locations. With meetings conducted over the Internet, people from different parts of the world could communicate with one another without traveling to particular destinations. This also helps companies save costs when running physical conferences such as venue, accommodation, airfare, and catering and refreshments. In particular, the practice has proven its importance during the coronavirus outbreak. When commuting is restricted, video- conferencing applications are brilliant solutions for entrepreneurs to keep their business on the run.

As advanced as online meeting technology is, it has limitations that might affect user experience. First, connectivity issues such as freezing or disconnection may cause disruption and frustration during meetings. Moreover, long-distance meetings sometimes lack personal interaction when people could only rely on limited tools to interact with one another. Even basic conducts of communication such as handshaking or eye contact are impossible to in those cases. Those factors could reduce the efficiency of the meetings and discourage a sense of community among participants.

In general, the use of online platforms for business meetings and trainings help both employers and employees overcome geographical distances, hence, cut cost and time. Although limitations are evident and should be taken into consideration, online meeting is still more a convenience than an inconvenience.

topic: Universities should accept numbers of male and female students in every subject. Ċ To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Higher institutions ought to accept proportions of boys and girls students in all subjects. I completely agree with the statement because it will foster equal opportunity and prevent discrimination.

Universities that enrol both sexes in every subject do this to foster equality. Meaning they ensure that the students have equal opportunity to learn various topics, and become masters in those subjects. For example, the college of medicine in Ibadan admitted an equal number of male and females into their medical school, and this has helped both sexes compete where necessary. Therefore, admitting boys and girls in all subjects in the university will give them the same avenue to explore.

Another reason is that it helps prevent discrimination. That is, the girl child does not feel like she is not recognized as part of the society as more boys are given preference. For instance, my uncle's daughter who read architecture at the University of Benin, Edo State, Nigeria, graduated with a first class because there was no discrimination among students in her class. The lecturers gave each of the students the same tasks, and as such, it helped them realize there is no preferential treatment for anyone. So, bias can be prevented when both sexes are admitted into every subject at the institution of higher learning.

In conclusion, boys and girls should be admitted in every subject in the university because it will promote equality and prevent bias.Given this situation, the government should make it a policy to all institutions going forward.

topic: Some peopl believe that after a child enters school their teachers will have more influence than their parents. To what extend do you agree or disagree It
essay:
It is well acknowledged that, for the past few decades, the value of education escalates. Many people opine that when children are enrolled in schools, lecturers have more authority over them than parents. I completely agree with it. In the upcoming paragraphs, I will put forth my views in detail.

To commence with, even though parents own their kids, during school hours they are under the control of their respective faculty. To elaborate, children spend most of the day time in their schools. Therefore,lecturers could get adequate time to encourage and correct learners for their activities. For example, the survey conducted by a reputed magazine in the UK shows that 47% of students obey their faculty member more than their parents. Thus it is clear from the above details that educators influence their pupil during school life.

In addition, tutors are well trained to control their pupils. To explain, lecturers acquire a specific qualification that is mandatory for their profession. Besides that, every faculty member would participate in respective training sessions during an academic year. It would definitely improve their performance. For example, in the US, a diploma in Psychology is necessary for scholar before undertaking professional responsibilities. Hence having analyzed the above facts it could be stressed the superior control of teachers over their pupils in schools.

To conclude, I would like to close this by stressing my view that, during school life,children are influenced more by their educators. Since concerned faculties are more capable with their qualification, they could guide their pupils in a proper direction.

topic: Governments should spend money on railways rather than roads. Ċ To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
essay:
Railways are the modern system of transporting. Due to this, a number of goods are being delivered in no time via trains. However, it lacks development, so there are differing views that the authorities should arrange their expenditures in this form rather than roads. I do not agree completely because railways might fully replace roads, and there are other spheres such as air traffic which must be focused as well.

To begin with, as some car passages have become ominous these days, people demand the contemporary approach like railways for mobile purposes. To be precise, a multitude of car accidents is occurring in some areas, particularly in countries where a moving method has not been fostered yet. Therefore, citizens hold that they would be safer if train ways were developed. To exemplify, in winter when there are snowfalls, a chance of a crash is extremely high because freezing conditions make roads slippery. Consequently, some transports may slip away, wrecking another one. In contrast, this type of threats is not able to impact on railways as they are resilient to any weather condition. Obviously, travellers can move from point A to point B without anxiety.

Nevertheless, not only should governments spend money on railways, but also they have to do so with an air system. The main reason I strongly assert is that it is feasible to attain and is advantageous. Accurately explaining, if nations develop wind ways, building an air station, it would enable planes to stop there. Thereby, tired pilots could be exchanged for alternative ones so as to escape some sort of unexpected danger, such as exhausted pilots' abrupt sleep during the flight. Even though the autopilot functions, that situation might either lead to false destinations or provoke accidents. Finally, passengers would also benefit by changing their itineraries or enjoying the view of the sky from height in those stations.

By way of conclusion, I once again reaffirm my partial agreement that although governments should invest their budgets in railways because of the reasons outlined above, there is another field like airlines which needs emphases and is a benefit for both pilots and commuters, simultaneously.

topic: Many people believe that international tourism is a bad thing for their country. What are the reasons? Solutions to change negative attitudes. International tourism
essay:
There is a concern that international tourism brings negative consequences for visited countries. This essay will analyze several reasons for this belief and suggest the solutions that could be carried out to improve the situation.

One possible cause of the problem is that foreign tourists may accidentally spead severe diseases into the country they visit. A typical example is H1N1 flu virus, which is dangerously spreat due to the travelling of people around the world. Moreover, since the political situation is not quite secured, tourism can be used as a tool for making terrorist attacks. As a result, the security of that country will be threatened. Another reason why international tourism is not a good thing is that the government may too focus on the development of this industry that they take less care of the enviroment. For instance, natural lands are being turned into hotels, resorts and villas as well as forests and oceans are polluted with the garbages left by tourists.

An obvious solution for the government to solve the problem is to tighten security and health controls at airports and docks. The second solution is that the authorities and the government should have policies to limit the amount of garbarge coming from the foreigners. For example, the campains of collecting rubbish on the beach should be held with the participation of foreign visitors. In addition, international tourists must be provided information about traditions and customs of their destination through holiday brochure to help them understand and have right behaviors.

In conclusion, international tourism brings many benefits related to economical development. However, it also causes problems regarding infectious diseases, threatened security and polluted enviroment. The government should take both sides into consideration so that the citizens can be satisfied.

topic: Nowadays, more and more older people who need employment compete with the younger people for the same jobs. What problems this causes? What are solutions?
essay:
Finding a job is becoming increasingly competitive these days. Even older people have to keep working and compete with younger job hunters to get hired somewhere. This essay will explore why this trend is happening and come up with a solution.

The most important reason why the job is becoming competitive between the older and younger folks is due to the imbalance between job demands and job supplies. In other words, the number of people looking for jobs is higher than actual job positions. The main reason for the increase in demand is population growth, while job opportunities cannot grow as fast as the population. Another reason lies in the fact that the cost of living is increasing, so people have to work even after they are retired in order to be able to pay their expenses. Which also cause a climb in the number of people seeking a job and create a vicious circle. Thus, older job seekers have to be competing with the new workforce in order to make a living.

To tackle this problem, the government should increase pension payments for older workers in order to prevent the need for work after a certain age like 65. Therefore, people will get retire after the age of 65 and no need to compete with younger ones. Besides, the government can subsidise housing and some community services to reduce the cost of living and reduce expenses. As a result of this approach, the number of people competing in one job can be reduced dramatically.

To sum up, the high cost of living and imbalance between job demand and supply cause lots of competition in job markets. To tackle this problem, the government should make people retire at a certain age and make sure they have enough money to make a living by increasing the pension and reducing the cost of living.

topic: Environmental protection is the responsibility of politicians, not individuals as individuals can do too little. To what extent do you agree or disagree? governments and individual's duty
essay:
Environment issues are now becoming a major threat to life on Earth, but some people argue that protection is an obligation of politicians since they have greater impact on a total contribution than individuals. I completely disagree with this opinion because I believe that each of us has a certain role in reducing human impact on Earth.

On the one hand, there are several reasons why politicians are responsible for these problems. Firstly, they are the ones who have been voted by majority in societies and in charge of bringing prosperity to communities. Secondly, they can influence people's habits and opinions by introducing new laws that can regulate the activities of individuals, companies and other polluters then control the pollution. Politicians on behalf of governments could also invest in renewable energy such as solar, wind and water power that limits the emissions of carbon dioxide comparing to fossil fuels. Having such kinds of powerful tools, it is easy to understand why politicians are supposed to be key figure in resolving environmental problems.

However, on the other hand, I still believe that individuals also play an indispensable role to address the problems of environment. For example, each of us should also try to be greener by taking public transport rather than driving, choosing products with less packaging, recycling as much as possible. As the result, the amount of waste and the carbon dioxide emissions has decreased significantly. Furthermore, the public can affect the actions of governments by voting for politicians who propose to concern about environment rather than those who would prefer ignore it.

In conclusion, it is clear to me that protecting the environment is both governments and individual's responsibility and I disagree with those who argue that individuals can do little in this problem.

topic: Some people believe that a great difference in age between people and children is more beneficial. Do you think the advantages of a greater difference in age between them outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
It is generally believed by one part of our community that, higher the gap between multiple age groups, the better it will be for society. I support the above-mentioned statement and opine that the difference surely has higher benefits rather than its side effects. Firstly, we will explain the pros in the upcoming paragraph and secondly, we will elaborate, how the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.

To begin with, kids learn everything from their elder family members either by observing their actions or by adhering to their advice. A great gap amongst two generations might provide the teenagers matured learnings through guardians life experiences. Additionally, it creates a sense of respect as well as fear in youth, if their near ones are aged. For instance, my cousin is 12 years elder than me, because of that I listen plus implement his every suggestion, whereas I don't care about my real brother's opinions, as he is just 2 years elder than me. Thus, it is evident that it is the need of time to have the supervision of mature parents or adults for the younger generation.

On the other hand, it can be clearly observed that inflation is at its peak, consequently giving birth to a baby without financial stability would be a dreadful situation for the infant. Moreover, it is easy to plan a baby in the early stages of life, but extremely difficult to take responsibility. It is quite common that immature couples spoil their relations, as they fight every day over either parent not giving proper time to the child. For example, a lady filed for divorce, as her husband was busy in his office works, also neither he had money nor time to give to the newborn baby. Consequently, we can call this approach of maintaining the period differences between a parent and a child a prudent one.

To conclude, I am not rigid on the above point discussed that it is mandatory to have a huge variance, therefore, it needs to be reasonable enough to become mature, stable and capable, to be a good parent.

topic: [IELTS ACADEMIC-WRITING TASK 2] PUNISHMENT It is important for children to learn the difference between right and wrong at an early age. Punishment is necessary to help them learn this distinction. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion? What sort of punishment should parents and teachers be allowed to use to teach good behavior to children?
essay:
Educating children has always been a tough task that challenges almost all parents and teachers these days. It is thought that children should be the taught to distinguish two different sides of a problem at a young age, and giving them penalty is essential. This essay will discuss why the belief given above is completely acceptable and provide some forms of discipline that could be used to control the young's behavior

I concur that forming a child's personality from an early age by teaching the right and wrong is absolutely crucial. If children are able to recognize what should do and what should not do, they would have a strong determination to resolve a problem properly. Besides, this educational strategy has functions to enhance juvenile's critical thinking, which is useful for their future development, especially in their academic performance. Punishment is compatible with children's process of achieving this distinction. Parent or teaching staffs could impose a mild penalty on children's wrongdoing so that they would remember to eliminate their inappropriate behavior.

In terms of penalty methods, I opine that both parent and teachers should avoid harsh punishments. Mentally abusing, smacking, hitting, etc could potentially leave children psychologically damaged. Instead, it is recommended that the young should be given constructive penalty which enable them to realize their mistakes. For examples, taking away a child's favorite toy for a day if there has been any misbehavior, he or she will remember not to repeat that mistake

In conclusion, I believe that shaping children's personality through constructive punishment is imperative for the social sustainable development.

topic: There seems to be an increasing trend towards assessing students through exams rather than through continual assessment. What are the advantages and disadvantages of exams as a form of assessment?
essay:
It seems to be a growing trend that students are judged through final exams rather than continuous assessments. This can have both advantages and drawbacks.

On the one hand, it is beneficial for students to be assessed by final exams instead of continuous assessment. This is predicated on the assumption that students who have to take one exam throughout their course tend to be under less pressure than those who receive a continuous assessment. Since final exams take place only at the end of a course, students may not be required to spend too much time on revision. This can enable them to have more spare time for their hobbies, extracurricular activities, or part-time jobs, which seem to be less stressful than academic knowledge.

On the other hand, it seems to be a demanding job for teachers to evaluate a student's capability just by one test. A good student may have poor performance on his test day due to many unexpected problems related to physical or mental health. For example, a brilliant student usually has excellent performances in his class but got low marks in his final exams because of his sickness. Consequently, exam results may fail to reflect students' capacity and provide feedback that students can later use to improve their understanding. It is one of the shortcomings if schools apply final examination systems to observe students' progress.

In conclusion, for the aforementioned reasons, assessing the capacity of students by exams instead of continual assessment has both positives and negatives.

topic: Some people think that physical strength is important for success in sport, while other people think that mental strength is more important. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Ċ You should write at least 250 words.
essay:
Some individuals commented that stamina is the most relevant to a sportsman or sportswomen to be well-succeed in games. However, others believe that intelligence confidence is the most pivotal. Personally, I advocate the second opposing the initial since mental confidence overcomes challengers of diverse order. Although the body strength plays its role. This essay will shed light on both sides of the view and provide evidence to prove the arguments.

On the one hand, intellectual thinking defines the athlete. In other words, this skill is behind the other possible players' capabilities. For instance, even if a footballer is heavy, if he is stripped from abilities to think swiftly to dominate his opponent, he soon loses the ball possession. As a result, his football team never gain the match, which means he as a sporter fails. Furthermore, the most famous world players on the planet are because of their intellectual abilities, and not their strong bodies.

On the other hand, stamina balances a competitor. Because every sport needs movement, it is relevant to be strong for sake of offset. The recent research carried out by the UK football confederation pointed out that the overwhelming majority of professional clubs like Manchester United , Barcelona, and Real Madrid prefer football players with a high level of stamina due to their stability during the match for example. Hence, the extremely tight selection is made to hire a professional these days.

To sum up, notwithstanding physical strength to be crucial to some game aspects, intelligence capability is the one that defines a successful rookie. Therefore, I still advocate it. I would go as far as to say, coaches worldwide should look more in highbrowed sporters rather than strong.

The number of crimes has significantly increased annually and the sanction decision should be well managed. Overall, the policy regarding these regulations must be assessed and evaluated to prevent an increasing percentage of crime. Meanwhile, the implementation of this policy should be obeyed by all citizens. Personally, I agree with the circumstances of people's crimes.

If it is dangerous for the community and has a large impact on society, it should be organized well. For instance, some narcotics sellers and corruptors, disrupt national stability such as economic and health state. Additionally, it becomes the best way to overcome people trying to do violation activity. Furthermore, an assertive law must be implemented for those whose cases are related to the major cause of crime.

On the other hand, a community who have an opinion that the circumstances of each person's case and the motivation of doing misconduct action, agree to consider these reasons when deciding on the punishment. Every violation could be divided into some levels and the sanction could rely on each case. For example, a group of robbers. They consist of a leader and members. Moreover, they have different tasks for each member.

In conclusion, there should be an evaluation regarding the policy of making sanctions today. Although it is such an unpredictable issue, it will impact the number of crimes in our country. We must concern about the effect of the breach around us. Subsequently, a fair punishment that would be given must look at all aspects of their plan on crime as well.

Once the temperature increase, which is caused by climate change, happen, it could drive a part of plants and animals to extinct, as well as, reduce a lot of food. That is why recycling is a vital part of nature.

By way of conclusion, I once again reaffirm that environment, wildlife and gas emission might be damaged by a wrong recycling step. Having a good habit of recycling is necessary.

topic: Write about the following topic: Some people think that a sense of competition in children should be encouraged. Others believe that children who are taught to co-operate rather than compete become more useful adults.  Discuss both these views and give your own opinion. Competitiveness or cooperativeness?
essay:
Nowadays, many concern that children should compete each other in someways, while some other suggest that children need to be taught to co-operate. In my point of view, these two ways to educate the young are both important in different situation.

I believe that when children accomplish a task as a a group, they can acquire some abilities of communication, improve the skill of being a leader, and learn to interact with other properly. For example, in class we need to report a presentation in a group. We have to divide the task to a small one, then assign it to each member. In this case, we need to find everyone's specialties and debate when should we have a meeting or a deadline. Everyone should work hard for the group not for itself, and consider the result of one's laziness or arrogance.

On the other hand, it is also very effective method for children to have motivation to improve skills by competition. Though the system of racing with other people, children would have more awareness that "Others are better,so I need to catch up on them." For example,in a basketball team there are only five people who can be on the court. So when you have a chance, you will not just let it go, and if you can not be called, you must will practice harder to improve your skills.

In short, each teaching technique has its reason to make every child more skillful, useful, and even better in their future.

topic: Some people think it would be a good idea for schools to teach every young person how to be a good parent. Ċ Do you agree or disagree with this opinion? Describe the skills a person needs to be a good parent. Ċ Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Ċ You should write at least 254 words.
essay:
The idea of teaching parenting as a subject in schools has been around for some time and also promoted by a few, however, I am of a belief that we must not burden the young ones with an extra subject that they do not need in near future.

Educating kids about good parenting may have some benefits in their development, yet I believe It will do more harm than good. Children in school are too young to understand the nuances of parenting, and lack the required experience to fathom the skills needed to raise a child. It is a subject that involves understanding the complex human psyche. For instance, a good parent may sometimes lie or hide certain information from the younger ones to protect them, but it contradicts with the basic moral values they teach.

There are several skills that a parent may need to be good at their jobs. One such skill is to be compassionate. A child in their early age is very sensitive and needs a lot of attention. Being compassionate can earn some affection and trust from kids. For example, a child is closest to the father or the mother based on who spend more time with them. Another skill is being open minded, meaning changing with the time. Although It is very common as a parent to impose the rules one has practiced in their own childhood on to their kids, one needs to upgrade themselves accordingly to the new generation. To illustrate, In my own case, my father supported me with marrying the person I love, while arrange marriage was a preferred model in his generation.

In conclusion, good parenting is a set of skills that require certain experience in life to understand them. Some may argue, teaching it in early age can be good, but one will only be burdened by the complex information.

topic: Nowadays families move to different countries for work. Some people think it has a negative effect on children, while others disagree. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Immigrating to other nations for business purposes has been a popular tendency for many families recently. Therefore, it has been debated that whether this trend would obtain positive influence on offsprings of one family who resolves to establish their life due to profession's requirements in another country or not. My essay will analyse both of the perspectives and demonstrate my views at the end of the paragraph.

Altering to a new foreign neighbourhood is believed to deal pessimistic effects to a child, and in fact, this is true in some cases. A survey on several teenagers whose parents moved to a completely unfamiliar place just to maintain their financial status when they were younger suffer from many mental sickness like depression, autism, or anxiety disorders. Numerous children who suffer from this case feel lost when they live in the new environment. This is because the ability to adapt to elsewhere new limits for a child, and therefore, they are unable to communicate, or have new relationships. This consequently directly affects their education, state of mind, and physical development.

However, it does not mean that changing new living surroundings is bad due to certain reasons. Once the children are used to the conditions of their new home, which means that they have already overcome their problems they endured initially. Furthermore, these young individuals virtually become successful in their future carried because the ability to handle pressure tasks was laying a solid foundation already. For instance, in the USA, most children who have already experienced such a change in his life find himself more resilient in making crucial decisions which involve in their career.

In conclusion, the advantages and disadvantages of switching living places for busy parents are even. In my opinion, it creates the opportunity for their children to harden themselves in terms of patience as they adapt to that unaccustomed place.

topic: Some believe that charitable organisations should help people no matter where they live. Others argue that charities should only help those living in the country where the charity is based. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
It is believed by certain individuals that charities should assist anyone living anywhere in the world and I also endorse the aforementioned statement, however, others feel that charitable bodies should only aid the ones residing in the nation it belongs to. Both the sides will be discussed in the essay below with relevant examples.

To begin with, some think organizations involved in charity should be helpful to people irrespective of which part of the world they are residents of, as these bodies are made with the purpose to help the needful being unbiased with the location where he/she lives. Moreover, these companies should be reachable and available through all possible means such as the internet, email and in-person so, that anyone sitting anywhere can get adequate assistance in line with his/her needs. For example, one acquaintance of mine wished to enquire about the availability of a place in an old age house in the U.S. and since they have their website online, hence, he could easily get his query answered.

On the other hand, few feel that charities should work to help the people of their country only as it is funded and facilitated by the residents of its nation, therefore, draining the facilities and aiding the overseas individuals can devoid its own men and women with the required facilitation. Furthermore, in order to fulfil the requirements of the human beings living abroad, a huge sum of government's money might be needed which can aid several humans of its own country. For instance, the amount required to send a lung machine from India to Japan to a person could help 20 people in India.

In a nutshell, In my and some people' view, the motive of a charitable should be to assist the individuals without considering the place where they reside as they should work on the principle of serving the humanity and equip the one in need with a helping hand while others believe that they should provide assistance to mankind confined to their nation only else, it will lead to drainage of funds and facilities to other parts of the world.

topic: Prompt : Most medical doctors want to work in cities where they will make a lot of money. Yet in many rural areas there are not enough doctors. What are the reasons for this problem? How can it be solved?
essay:
The vast majority of medical graduates want to be employed in surburban areas ,but reality strikes that the force of doctors in rural areas is woefully inadequate .I can come up with reasons why this circumstance take place and the antidote to this hurdle.

Normally , an undergradute must undergo seven-year training in practice and 3 or 4 years as a junior doctor before becoming a full-fledged one. It is a prerequisite that you need a solid financial backing to pursue your dreams, but this is not the case for most of the would-be doctors.It is reasonable to understand that they want to earn money quickly to pay student loans and enjoy lives

It is common knowledge that everyone gravitates towards conspicious consumerism due to the fact that we live in a capitalistic world . However when we are torn bewteen morality and responsibility .We usually are in a dillemma about prioritizing materialism above societal proprieties or the contrast , especially in unquestionably moral field like being doctors. I put forward some suggestions that can alleviate this conered situation.First and foremost , the government should increase salary for doctors who work in remote areas because the most glaring reason for the insuffiiency is money. The government need to deal with this problem with delicay , they can raise tax to increase salary for doctors but the poor cant even make ends meet .They shouldn't compromise a respectable sector for a less deserving one.

This raises a sense of discontent surrounding the mass in any countries. They can enact a law that people with income over 200k dollars should pay more than 30% of their salaries for government .In my view this is the best solution I can come up with until now.

topic: Children who are brought up in families that do not have large amounts of money are better prepared to deal with the problems of adult life than children brought up by wealthy parents. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
essay:
According to some people, child who is brought up in less well-off family is more quick-witted and can tackle with an adult life problems better than who is from affluent ones. However, I completely disagree with this position.

To begin with, children from poorer families are prone to have bad habits such as: crime, thievery and thuggery. Moreover, these people will not have an access to a good education. As a result, they can be proselytized into bad isms. For example, most of the terroristic groups try to attract uneducated people, because the person with better education has a wider outlook, which will allow no brainwash. In this sense, people with lower level of education have more proneness to be attracted in such isms.

Nevertheless, people who are born in well-off families have access to good education, which will have a positive impact on their later life. Secondly, children from rich families have better skills on how to use money, because they use it a lot of times. Finally, wealthy families can afford better health services and costly medicines, which will be very beneficial for the health of a child. For instance, many good medicines cost vast amounts of money, which cannot be afforded by poorer families.

In conclusion, I disagree with the opinion that children who are brought up in less well-of families are, likely, more successful in the future life due to aforementioned reasons.

topic: It is expected that there will be a higher proportion of older people than that of young people in many countries in the future. Do you think it is a positive or negative development?
essay:
Several countries are expected to have an aged population in the future years. As far as I concern, this movement has many negative consequences, thus governments should try to slow down the disproportionate growth of the population.

The first reason why an excessive number of aged citizens would be detrimental is that there would be a shortage of labour in the next few years. Although people might have more living time, the increase in life expectancy does not equate to the extended amount of workforce, since the seniors are not as capable of working full-time as the younger counterpart. Consequently, the economy of developing countries, which relies dominantly on human capital, would likely suffer in 10 years time. In other words, the anticipated rise in the proportion of elder citizens is likely to threaten the operations of thousands of companies that depend on young and competent human resource.

In addition to the aforementioned ground, a greying population could as well require extra government expenditure on social welfare and medical services, in the form of insurance and the infrastructure of retirement homes. The cost for accomodating the segment of residents is exorbitant in Japan and Europe, which ranges at about 200 billion US dollars annually, and is to rise by 60% in 2040. If the situation happens in societies with limited financial resources such as Vietnam, the government may have to raise the tax to compensate for the spending, which transfers the burden onto taxpayers. As a result, it is for the economic security of not only the nation but also its individuals that a country's demographic should be kept at a balance.

In conclusion, the projected growth of elderly people is likely to cause social issues, the scarcity of labour and the rise of taxes as an example. Therefore, it is no doubt an adverse development to society at large.

topic: Some people believe that it is better to choose friends who always have the same opinions as  them. Other people believe it is good to have friends who sometimes disagree with them. Ċ Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
Friendship is a relationship of mutual affection between people. Many believe that friends should accord with them, whereas others think that this is better to have a diverse opinion in a friendship. I will discuss both viewpoints and give my point of view in the following paragraphs.

To begin with, while making friends, some people are looking for likeminded individuals who share common interests such as choices related to fashion, sports, kinds of music, food and so on. Some would say the friend's similar views have no conflict at all. This is because whenever they are discussing a topic, they do not go into an argument. This helps them to build a healthy relationship in their friendship. For example, when one goes shopping with these types of friends together, they can buy things in less time as they have the same choice of products. Despite this, these people are unaware of the delicate nature of the relationship in the long term.

One the other hand, others believe that difference of opinion would help individuals to raise intellectual levels. For instance, while buying a home, if friends suggest multiple opinions then together they can list down the pros and cons of every site and choose the right home. Furthermore, one can get ample ideas and suggestions when one's friends have different viewpoints. However, sometimes conflict might arise when the opinions do not match.

In conclusion, making friends with people who have a similar opinion and different opinions has its own merits and demerits. From my perspective, I believe that it is an individual responsibility to choose friends who are loyal and truthful to them.

topic: In some countries, a few people earn extremely high salaries. Some people think that this is good for a country, while others believe that the government should control salaries and limit the amount people can earn. Ċ Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
Income, from salaries, is the primary source of livelihood for most families. Although a part of the population thinks that this is beneficial for the nation, there is a significant number who still believes that wages should be regulated by the authorities, thus limiting the amount of money one can make. Though the essay elaborates on both views, in my opinion, there should be minimum federal regulation on the amount of money that people make.

To begin with, salaries are given by institutions to their employees based on their performance at work. Therefore, any hike or decrement in pay works in a ‘carrot and stick’ manner. Good performance is credited and any dereliction of duty, punished. This promotes the wage earner to push harder. For example, a pay-hike will encourage a software engineer to code more applications. Moreover, it generates healthy competition amongst colleagues which improves efficiency in project-work. One of the downsides to this is, it may create unnecessary and fierce competition among peers, leading to a stressful job environment.

Furthermore, state control over payrolls is a measure to prevent such cut-throat competition. But, this is far from reality. Regulation over earnings promotes complacency in the staff and may lead to nihilistic depression. For example, an employee who knows that his income is going to be capped at a certain level will never try to increase his efficiency at his job once he reaches his salary limit. Government intervention also discourages the employees from acquiring new skills and implementing them at work as the amount of money earned stays constant.

In conclusion, authoritarian control has little in its favour and the advantages of having no regulation over earnings of salaried employees far outweigh the drawbacks. Hence, I feel that there should be no federal control over incomes.

topic: the aspects of Communication via internet Topic:Nowadays, more people are choosing to socialize online rather than face to face. Is this a positive or negative development?
essay:
Today more and more people tend to build their relationship on the Internet replace with in person. In my opinion, I think it will become a positive development in the future. There are several reasons for this situation to explain under the following.

The primary reason is the distance for each other. With our transportation system growth, people can go anywhere easily so we will know different nation people in the world. Most time it is difficult to meet each other face to face because we are far from each other. For example, once a time I traveled to German, I made a new friend, Ann, at that time. She is an English girl. During the travel, we chatted and become a good friend and at the end of the tour, we change our information and keep the friendship until now. Even we're not meet each other but we connect to each other on social media.

Another reason is that some people need to leave their family for work or study, for these people when they miss their family or old friend they only can use the online way to talk and see them. Just like my best friend, Janny, she studied abroad, it is hard to see her in the real so we through skype to video chat. Even she was far from me but we feel close to each other.

In conclusion, although it is still limited by distance, with the Internet we can connect the people we want in everywhere. Therefore, socialise online has became more popular for the whloe world and I think it will be a positive trend.

topic: In recent years, the family structure has changed, as well as family roles. What are the changes occuring? Do you think changes are positive or negative?
essay:
At present, the roles of family and the structure of the family has shifted. In the past, family members followed the customs of ancient people, but now, the members of a family has completely inverted the old attitude whether how many people would be to consist of the family, or ,Accept space, whether which work should be done by males and females. From my perspective, it is a positive outlook of modern people who believe in changes.

To begin with, most of the population preferred extended family, while these days, nuclear family, consists of parents and two children, is the most popular. In fact, in the past, three or four generations lived together under one roof, and could help one another. However, the tendency of myriads of people is to construct a small family where women will get the chance to pursue their career, which may, eventually, help them to contribute in the cost of their families. What is more, parents and grandparents used to live together. As a result, grandparents, for example, had a chance to play with their grandchildren.In the modern world, asylum or countryside is the resident of the majority of grandparents.

Strikingly, a positive notion spread, since people live with limited family members. The first good sign is that women have got the opportunity to work outside and to earn money, whereas fathers have changed their responsibilities regarding works which are now confined within domestic activities. Secondly, the modern view is that if family structure is limited, the responsibility of saving increases geometrically. In Bangladesh, for instance, the nuclear family is quite wealthy in lieu of extended family. This is because parents rush to job, leaving their children in the care of child care centres. Consequently, they earn a lot rather than spending.

In conclusion, the family features and roles have been transformed over the years. A huge family is split into a family with 3/4 members where females are going outside for earning purposes. Certainly, in my opinion, these changes are considered as a positive one, which soars the income, and males, somehow, get the new environs.

topic: Nowadays more people are choosing to live with friends or alone rather than with their families. This trend is likely to have a negative impact on communities. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
essay:
The number of people who prefer to leave alone or in a shared flat has been increased.While there is controversial agreement that this is trend harms societies, I believe that it simultaneously has several benefits and drawbacks.

To begin with, living alone might increase the risk of depression. If people don't have effective communication they will have to face mental health problems. In other words, humans need to get emotional support from their families or close friends to remain healthy.They may also feel bored in case of loneliness for a long time. For example, I used to leave alone during my college days and I became introverted to go out and too bored to stay at home. Another difficulty of living on our own in case of emergencies.If people are living alone ,they become ill, there would be no one to take care of her or them.

However, we cannot undermine the disadvantages over the advantages .Firstly, it would make people more independent and raise the feeling of responsibility. They need to learn household chores such as cooking,cleaning on their own and also, they should learn to manage their finances to avoid problems.Secondly, people will have more time to plan and achieve their goals.They can also choose to live near the offices or the countryside.Finally, they are free to have any lifestyle they want that may affect their motivation and discipline.

In conclusion, although there is a population who believe that living alone or with friends would negatively affect societies, in my opinion, this trend would also benefit communities.

topic: People should be allowed to continue to work for as long as they want to, and not be forced to retire at a particular age such as 60 or 65. Ċ Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
There are beliefs that people should have the freedom to continuously work and not be stopped at the age of retirement. In this essay, I will be discussing the reasons why I disagree with the statement before arriving at a conclusion.

Primarily, not only the physical but also the mental health of people degenerate with age. Because of this, the capacity of an individual becomes limited. For example, a 70-year-old civil engineer is still working for a construction firm. Unfortunately, he can only commit on a part-time basis because he cannot endure long meetings and site visits. In addition, the tasks assigned to him are limited because of the fear that he may experience fatigue from working.

Another point to take in is that the younger generations, specifically newly hired employees, are easier to each and can adjust with the advancements. A recent university graduate, for instance, is well-equipped with the latest technology, such as computers and mobile phones, which can contribute to achieving faster results. Moreover, young adults are also more eager to apply their theoretical knowledge to the real world as compared to the senior managers who are used to the same old processes.

In conclusion, it is argued that age should not hinder people from working. In my opinion, they should be retiring at most at 65, because working after that can not only hinder them from achieving tasks but also harm their general health. Furthermore, they should be giving the opportunity to the younger generations in order to apply their learnings and eventually excel in their own fields.

topic: Is the traditional music of a country more important than the International music? There are many different types of music in the world today. Why do we need music? Is the traditional music of a country more important than the International music that is heard everywhere nowadays?
essay:
Music is a form of art that has been created and developed through time. It differs according to the era and the region to which it belongs. There are many different types of music in the world today. Traditional and international music are two forms that are completely different because they're made for different publics.

Traditional music helps to know more about the country. It's a major component of its culture. Personally, when imagining how life would be in Ireland or USA, it's hard not to associate the images that cross my mind to the folkloric music of those countries. However, music has evolved with time to become more international and less representative of its origin. A same song can be heard worldwide nowadays at the expense of traditional music that is only used to introduce a country to the world.

As far as I am concerned, traditional music is more important than the international one because it's the legacy that next generations will inherit. It's an element of their identity. By listening and sharing it with foreigners, they remain connected with their roots.

Furthermore, in music industry, music is widely commercialized when it uses catching rhythms and simple lyrics. The K Pop, for example, even if it's defined as a Korean music is more of a pop music sung in Korean language that fits perfectly western standards of image and sound.

To sum up, making an international song make it more successful but it causes it to vanish with time, unlike traditional music that lasts longer.

topic: Topic: Some people think that all teenagers should be required to do unpaid work in their free time to help the local community. They believe this would benefit both the individual teenager and society as a whole. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
A highly contentious view at issue is that youngsters must do the voluntary works in order to assist their communities because young people and their society would reap many benefits from these works. From my point of view, I totally agree with this opinion and will elaborate on some reasons to justify this stance.

First and foremost, a primary benefit for volunteers would appear to be the improvement of their life skills. That is to say, doing unpaid work helps people to explore their own potential skills and talents. Teenagers could have many chances to experience several fields and activities, which helps them to know what they are interested in and have the ability. Moreover, it is vital that by doing voluntary work, young people could widen their meaningful relationships. There is a proclivity to exchange with co-workers or leaders, who are likely to be in the same fields of career or education.

A further significant factor is that there are many positive repercussions in their societies. This means that when assisted by youngsters, communities could develop faster and effectively overcome difficulties. For instance, In Viet Nam, when the fourth wave of COVID-19 comes, many students at many universities apply for becoming assistants in epicenters such as Binh Duong and Ho Chi Minh city, which helps inhabitants to shop for groceries to reduce the spreading of disease.

On balance, it is logical to conclude that teenagers should be asked to join in voluntary work because of the conferred benefits for themselves and their societies.

topic: In the modern world, it is no longer necessary to use animals and animal products for food, clothing and medicine. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Give your opinion based on your knowledge and experience.
essay:
Nowadays, animal products are being excessively used to fulfil our growing demands. While some think that in this modern technology there is no need to torture animals for these products, some think it could not be substituted. Although there are arguments, I radically believe that it could be replaced by other sources. This essay will discuss the views and explain why I think so.

To begin with, the source of foodstuffs, garments and medical-stuffs could be altered with the help of science. Our technology has been growing so rapidly that now we do have so many unnatural sources to get a product rather than harming the living one. For example, faux fur could be used instead of an original sheep-skin to make a winter-wear. Also, lab-made chemicals could be used for medical purposes to stop extracting them from beasts. In the modern generation, people are becoming concerned about animals; consequently, many people have even opted to vegan foods, which does not contain any animal origin. Therefore, humankind could fulfil their needs without hampering animals' lives.

On the other hand, some sources could not be replaced to some extent, thus, may not be the same quality. Firstly, the overuse of chemicals may affect peoples' bodies. These may have side effects. a lab-grown medicine, for instance, may not be used in a higher dose, hence people rely on some traditional fish-derived sources to treat their health. Secondly, the quality of the product may not be very much superior, if it is made artificially. In other words, genuine leather shoes could never be beaten in the market by any other faux products. As a result, some people still consider this is the best option in order to get a standard material. Moreover, animals could be harmed to justify our living characteristics; however, there could many possible ways to minimize it.

In conclusion, this essay has discussed both views and explained the reason behind these. Though both have pros and cons, I reckon that people should move forward to a better world and should maintain a balance by stop using animals for personal gain if these could be replaced.

topic: Some people believe that advertising to children is harmful and should be banned, while others disagree. Discuss these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
In today's fast-paced world, advertising has become one of the most effective methods of promoting new products and services. It is often argued that there are many drawbacks related to advertising aimed at children. However, opponents consider that advertising which is focused on children has positive effects on them. In this essay, I am going to discuss this question from both points of view and extend my support to the first opinion.

On the one hand, it is clear that choosing children as the target of the advertising industry is harmful for them. To begin with, children do not think carefully when they see television advertisements because of lack maturity. For example, they usually cannot determine that the advertisement has a persuasive message to encourage them or their parents to spend as much money as possible. Moreover, children watch an advertisement in the same way as any entertainment programme because it is engaging and attention-grabbing. As a result, TV commercials lead to children's health and behaviour problems.

On the other hand, some people argue that children-targeted advertisements have many advantages. Firstly, parents can pay attention to products that are useful for their children thanks to TV commercials. For instance, various children's brands, such as clothing, food or drinks advertised on TV, will help parents find out which goods are best for their children to buy. Secondly, children will be more inspired, creative and imaginative if they constantly watch an advertisement because it is exciting, eye-catching and has extremely colourful images. Thus, they will become more innovative and energetic humans when they grow up.

In conclusion, although advertising can be beneficial for children in some aspects, I tend to believe that it has many serious negative consequences and should be eradicated.

topic: Technology is becoming progressively universal. In the Ċ fullness of time, classroom teachers will be totally Ċ substituted for technology. Ċ Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
At present，computers and other kinds of technological devices are developing quickly and they also can be used in educational services. In my opinion, human teachers will never be completely replaced by technical advancements. This essay will illustrate some reasons to support this statement and explain it with some relevant examples.

Firstly, a common factor is that technological progress can not consider the diffidence between the capability of all students. Students have different learning abilities ，some smart students may wish teachers can teach more knowledge in one class，and others might hope teachers decrease the speed to make sure they totally understand. For experienced teachers，they have teaching strategy，like finished this chapter quickly in class and provide extra training for others students who do not understand in class；By contrast，a robotic teacher only teach students in a fixed pattern and can not give extra help to other students. Compared with human teacher’s flexibility and patience, Artificial Intelligence lacks the ability to assist every single student’s need, thus it is less likely to be replaced.

In addition, those robotic teachers can not accurately read pupil’s emotions, which is not constructive for students’ growth. Regarding primary school, for example, it is hard to think about how non-human teachers would face children’s daily problems，such as constantly motivating them to be concentrated on something or consoling them when they cry. However, all of the above emotional needs are need to be catered for during the whole process of learning. Therefore, machines can hardly perform the function of caring for learners’ moods in order to ensure the quality of teaching.

To conclude, because humans are more considerable and flexible than computers，I am not optimistic about the total replacement of technology in the educational realm.

topic: PROTECTING WILD ANIMALS Wild animals have no place in the 21st century, so protecting them is a waste of resources. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Some people believe the idea that it is pointless to spend money on protecting wild animals because it doesn't give us any benefits. To me, I completely disagree with this point of view.

From my perspective, it is unreasonable to say that wild animal has no place in the 21st century. I completely do not agree that the planet Earth was created only for the benefits of humans, and it is absurd to allow the extinction of any species in the world. Overmore, there is no certain reason why we should let animals die out. We do not need to destroy every square metre of land in order to feed or satisfy us; there are many other possible solutions to exists side by side with wild animals - this is our aim.

I also disagree with the idea that protecting wild animals wastes lots of resources. It is the protection of natural habitats and ensures the wild animals' survival. Furthermore, many scientists agree that nature has very important standing in human life. For example, forests produce oxygen, stabilizing the Earth's climate. If we destroy these lands, the costs that we will receive is very sky-high! No oxygen. No stable climate. We can not keep humans survive safely. By protecting wild animals and their habitats, we would maintain the survival of all life on Earth.

In a nutshell, we have no right to decide whether or not wild animals should exist, and I strongly believe that we should do everything we can to protect the wild animals and their habitats.

topic: The rising levels of congestion and air pollution found in most of the world cities can be attributed directly to the rapidly increasing number of private cars in use. In order to stop this decline in the quality of life in cities, attempts must be made to encourage people to use their cars less and public transport more. discuss possible way to encourage the use of public transport.
essay:
Recently an increasing number of heavy traffic jams as well as environmental issues because of accelerating of cars' owners downtown. Fortunately, there are some viable solutions to upgrade people using public transport.

The most obvious solution is improving public transport services. For example, supervising driver tightly to avoid the overloading of people on a bus trip that make passengers freer and more comfortable. In addition, expending the time tables and local stations as far as increasing the trips are very important to ensure that people can go to work as much convenient as possible. As the result, the biggest problem that making people are afraid of waiting for the bus is solved. Furthermore, it is necessary that the government should built more the bus route maps and the sky-carpers at the every local bus depot about quality and quantity. Consequently, not only can passengers find out the way route easier but also do not dress for the weather.

A further step is for offices and schools to provide the transports by themself to get their staffs. And then people can go to work on the time and do not stand of congestion.

If these steps are taken people will be likely more comfortable to choose public transport to go to work. Then the number of private cars will be decreased as well as traffic jams can be gone down.

topic: Walking is known to be beneficial for health and yet fewer and fewer people are walking these days. What are the reasons for this? What can be done to tackle this problem?
essay:
Although it is already proven that walking is good for their healthy, but in this era only a few do people realize this. There are several causes of this problem, and some actions should be taken to diminish it.

There are several predominant factors of low number of people doing walking. These are the busy lifestyle and low security. Busy lifestyle requires the individuals to spend mostly their time to work. According to Bureau of Labor Statistics, American working hours showed gradually rising trend through the 1990s, recently it reached roughly 40 hours each week. As a result, they have no enough time for walking whether it for going to their office or in term of doing exercise.

Moreover, walking is unsafe because of the high percentage of crime regarding to pedestrians. In America, there were roughly 288 pedestrians killed in 2013 due to crime.

Nevertheless, there are several potential ways to solve those problems. Firstly, the company can create the rules concerning to the limitation of elevator utilizing by the workers. Otherwise, the workers can go up and down through the stairs, so it will improve their walking intensity. Furthermore, government needs to conduct several interesting walking events in the weekend, such as walking festival. This can encourage people to spend their weekend by walking. Ultimately, setting some CCTV up and building security post in certain area along the pavement can be the next measures.

To sum up, it is possible for the government and people to increase the number of people doing walking by releasing several steps. It would be better for both government and people to work cooperatively in realizing those ways.

topic: Many manufactured food and drink products contain high levels of sugar, which causes many health problems. Sugary products should be made more expensive to encourage people to consume less sugar. Ċ Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
A plethora of processed meals and fizzy drinks are rich in sugar and lead to different health concerns. I firmly believe that the high price of sugar-coated items would prevent people from consuming low sugar levels by making it inaccessible and offering more healthy menus at affordable prices.

Firstly, the habit of eating junk has recently been increased, particularly among young adults, due to its affordability, and excessive sugar intake can be discouraged by imposing taxes on sweetened foods. For example, in America, the fast-food chains have expanded rapidly in the last decade, while many social activists clearly emphasized the need for less availability of those productions. Therefore, during a pandemic that recently happened worldwide, campaigns and advocacy to eradicate the unhealthy food consumption problem successfully reached the government level. Thus, a 20% extra tariff was imposed on those items. As a result, almost half of the population in different cities of America consumed less than 40% of fast foods in the last six months found in a national survey, indicating that the price of sweets was positively correlated with buyers' consumer behaviour. In short, with high prices, people would not probably go for a single item, let alone have many.

On balance, affordability would make a difference when it comes to diet plans and choice of menu. As the cost was not high previously, it was almost irresistible in young minds. Hence, when many would fail to grab whenever they want, it probably would help them eat healthily. For instance, a promising study revealed that the Swedish food and nutrition department determined how human preferences of choosing a diet were entirely dependent on its affordability. In addition, it was found that more eaters tend to buy nutritional foods when a tasty manufactured beverage is not within range. Finally, overall well-being can be ensured by not promoting sweets by lowering their demands employing well nourishment adoptions.

To sum up, offering more costly sugary products will indisputably reduce their appeal and encourage healthier eating habits.
