Some people say that governments should try to reduce air traffic by taxing it more heavily. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
I agree with the statement that government should be try to reduce air traffic with more heavy taxes. The reason is noise and pollution that airplanes produced and consequently the demanding of airport construction. Thinking at people who lived near the airports. They live in the noise all the time! I think it is terrible to tolerate!

Moreover, there are a lot of pollution near them. It is dangerous, especially for the children and toddler. In the long run it may cause breathing diseases or something else. Solutions could be the reducing of air traffic in specific days of the week or specific hours of the days . Instead another solution could be the air flights in alternative day of the week. Otherwise, the government could hike taxes of the flights especially for the holidays or weekends. Certainly like this more people will discourage to travel or to buy tickets for holiday! However, this is a problem especially for working people that have to travel. Many times these people use airplanes because they are means of transport faster than car or train.

Moreover we have to consider that airplane is a mean of transport that allows us to visit other countries and for the overseas countries it is sole mean.

In conclusion, I would say that is very important that government taxes the flights, especially in the period of holiday. It is necessary to reduce air traffic, pollution and noise but it is also necessary assure for working people the possibility to use the air flights.

topic: Fast food is now universally in most countries and is becoming increasingly popular. Some feel that this is a positive trend, while others do not. What are your opinions in this? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
Modern and busy society makes fast food become more and more popular. Debates on whether this is a good or bad tendency has been a controversial topic. However despite its negative points, I believe fast food bring us more benefits.

Most people considered fast food as junk food, unbalance diet and unhealthy as compare to food made at home or in restaurants, thus discouraging its development. In fact, people having this food on a regular basis are likely to have health problem. For instance, high saturated-fat, large amount of calories and low fiber intake when having burgers for a long time will cause high risk of heart diseases and diabetes. In addition, competitions between these quick serve and take away restaurants drive them to make tastier fattier food to satisfy customer appetite regardless of its nutrition.

Despite these facts, I believe that that fast food are extremely convenient, cheap, filling and can be made healthier. A better burger can be processed by using good quality oil, mayonnaise, lean meat, light cheese and a variety of veggies. Different burger options such as less fat, salty, lean meat and more vegetable will also help people with dietary concerns. Moreover, new fast food dishes that are healthier, more balance and good nutrition should be investigated to meet the need of informed customers.

To conclude, although fast food is considered not as nutritious as restaurant or home meals, as far as I am concerned, it can be created healthier and more optional, its popularity also help us buy it almost everywhere and every time thus should be developed.

topic: Topic - Many people are moving to big cities. Why is that? Do you think it is a good trend?
essay:
Nowadays our government encourages people in rural areas to move to cities, especially big cities. It is likely to be a huge challenge that the government needs to face and cope with when population increases considerably in big cities, at the same time, someone argues that it also provide more energy to big cities.

The reason that people are more willing to relocate to big cities than before is that big cities can supply them with more opportunities and resources to exploit to enjoy a colorful life. Beyond our doubt, there are more infrastructures such as mature traffic system, hospitals and shopping malls that people can rely on in their daily lives. And certainly, there are more vacant jobs as a great plenty of companies, especially international corporations, tend to set up their branch offices in big cities.

More opportunities do not mean everything in big cities is good. It is widely known that the living costs in big cities are much higher than in countryside. For instance, it is not everyone that is able to afford a pricey apartment or house. However in my opinion, it is quite good that people come to contribute themselves in developing the cities and treat as their new home even though people probably initiate to improve their own lives. Besides, they bring more diversity on culture and positive competitions to big cities.

I personally think that the benefits of people moving to big cities outweigh the negative factors from the point of view of cities themselves as long as our government is prepared well on the balance of resources to avoid potential conflicts between original residents and newcomers.

topic: One way to reduce the problem of traffic congestion is by increasing the tax on private vehicles. Ċ Do you think this is a feasible solution?
essay:
Although a multitude of problems bothers urban citizens, traffic is the most troublesome issue faced by them in their routine daily life. Some people believe that there is no other way except rising the taxation on individual bikes and cars to retrench the soaring number of vehicles on roads. However, I personally do not agree with this opinion. Firstly, I will discuss why levying additional cess on nonpublic conveyances will not serve the purpose followed by ways to solve this annoying perplexity.

To begin with, augmenting tax on people's own mode of transport will fail to decrease rush on the city roads. This stems from the fact that many latest surveys published by reputed organisations stated that the number of individuals desiring to have their separate mode of transport is on a constant rise and on its way to peak in spite of the prices of four-wheelers that have already been hiked up by companies owing to the scarcity of raw materials. This can be attributed to fears instilled by the ongoing COVID pandemic which firmly reinstated the need for social distancing in order to avoid gatherings. Moreover, the halt of buses and trains because of lockdowns issued by the government further contributed to the increasing demand. To illustrate, Hyundai India has reported a massive boom in their business in the current year due to changes in customers mindset's and opinions. Thus, people who obviously treat health as the utmost priority would not hesitate to buy a new vehicle despite escalating prices and customs duty.

On the other hand, instead of excess fees, many other measures can be implemented to effectively wane this predicament. One of them is to develop parallel and link roadways by enhancing the existing infrastructure. This ultimately would result in the redistribution of motor cars resulting in reduced congestion. For example, Hyderabad witnessed a significant decline in the frequency of stagnation after improving the linking network and laying contemporary flyovers. In addition to this, several other means like the implementation of even and odd number schemes in Delhi also proved fruitful. Hence, it is up to the local authorities to choose which technology suits best.

topic: Some believe that charitable organizations should help people no matter where they live. Others argue that charities should only help those living in the country where the charity is based. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
A large population in the world is still under the grip of poverty and economic stress. For that reason, it is the responsibility of the charitable institution to support the needy, despite their country or nation. However, few others are of the opinion that the NGOs should consider only their native people. But, I strongly agree with the former view.

To begin with, unemployment and financial instability have caused widespread impoverishment throughout the globe and it is not concentrated on any particular area and this issue cannot be seen with discrimination. Also,there are certain under-developed or developing countries where large scale philanthropic works cannot be undertaken due to financial stress. As a consequence, not all organisations can afford to help their own communities. Hence. they would require outside help. For instance, the WHO (World Health Organisation) has undertaken many charitable activities through the African nation since the country is not self-sufficient. Therefore, it is always suggested to conduct charitable function around the world despite demographic differences.

On the other hand, there is always a possibility for a financial strain on the firm or Trust that conduct worldwide philanthropic activities and in such scenario, it is not viable to share alms to the impoverished within the country. It is due to this reason, a section of speakers oppose charity to cross borders. Furthermore, some organisation fail to recognise their own people who are suffering. For example, in the U.S there are many NGOs and yet the rate of poverty and destitution is at a rise.

In conclusion, in my opinion, the charitable organisation cannot concentrate only on their own native people, and more efforts and work should be put forward to help all the nations to deprive poverty.

topic: Some universities offer online courses as an alternative to classes delivered on campus. Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
essay:
Most universities tend to integrate technology into classroom learning and teaching so more and more online course are published in the Internet and replace the face-to face class .From my perspective, this trend has both negative and positive impacts on students' learning outcomes because of some ideas which are shown below.

On the one hand, offering online courses at university can be beneficial in several ways. Firstly, this way of learning allow students to study at home. Due to the proliferation of the Internet, a myriad of learner are able to access the online learning with the flexible learning schedules. Furthermore , lower costs and the widespread presence of the Internet offer the unlimited numbers of participants regardless of not only their financial demanding but also current living places. Hoc24h is the prime example, which yield the reasonable-priced online courses for all indigent students in Vietnam.

On the other hand, online courses are a poor substitute for traditional classes delivered at university. Without being regular-face-to-face interaction with teacher in class , this can lead to the lower learning outcome for students. During the course, they rarely make friend and compete with their virtual friend on the internet so they can feel lack of motivation and stimuli for scholastic success. Moreover, some student could be exploited by some unworthy and counterfeit online course. Because of lack of control on the quantity, some students feel sense of confusion on the suitable class ,even they can be taken advantages for the financial problem.

In conclusion, having online courses available to choose from while at university benefits students in a number of ways. However, their drawbacks in terms of decreased learning outcomes should be accounted for

topic: In some countries, more and more people are becoming interested in finding out about the history of the house or building they live in. What are the reasons for this? How can people research this?
essay:
In some parts of the world, an increasing number of people are curious about the history of the house or apartments they are now living in. This essay will discuss why people are interested in history and how they can find out about that.

There may be several reasons why histories of buildings are becoming interesting for people nowadays. First of all, in this modern world, people love to observe and learn new things because it makes them excited in some ways. The second reason could be that people want to know about the mysteries that might have happened in where they are living. For example, people are intentionally renting a haunted house in order to experience things they are not expected of or find out whether ghosts really exist.

If people are enthusiastic about researching the hidden story of the buildings, they can take steps to achieve it. Firstly, they can contact the landlord and ask about it. Then they can trace who originally owned that house and have a conversation with the initial owners. In addition, they can find out more about the building by looking at the details such as design and architecture. As an example, people can know when a particular building was built or how old the building is, by paying attention to what types of bricks or styles are used.

To conclude, it is a good thing that a majority of people are eager to learn about the historical knowledge of the building they are living in. There may be personal reasons why they are interested in this and they can research by simply asking their landlord or just looking at the design of the building.

topic: Countries around the world will be facing significant challenges relating not only to the environment, but population and education as well. Ċ What problems will your country face in the next ten years? Ċ How can these problems be overcome? Ċ Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
It is certainly true that the modern world is struggling with not only a lot of environmental issues but also overpopulation and illiteracy. The same problems are there in my country and they will continue to exist in future. I will discuss a few of the problems and methods how these can be addressed in this essay.

To begin with, all the industrialized countries are now seeing severe climate changes due to the emission of unwanted gases into the air causing air pollution and also rural people are moving to urban areas in search of work resulting in population increase in towns. This causing issues for migrants with living space issue and eventually,trees are cut down to create more space for living houses to be constructed.Another problem is less education in society. For Instance,many people do not know about what is happening in the world unless there is a natural disaster happens and the same situation can be seen in my country as well.

As a prevention, the governments should come forward and educate the communities by conducting awareness programs and ensure the message reaches each corner of the living areas across the country. Also, creating an abundance of job opportunities for the villagers, stop people from moving to their native place and look for local opportunities.In addition to this, if public rules are made to upskill the rural people then the dependency on the government should also be reduced. For example, when awareness is spread and more jobs are created for villagers then there will be some improvement in society.

In conclusion, though there were issues across the developed nations including my nation, due to global warming,overcrowed and illiteracy which are high intense problems.However,these can be tackled by the governments easily so that the issues will be addressed and future generations will see a better world.

topic: As global trade increases, many goods, including those we use on a daily basis, are produced in other countries and have to be transported long distances.  Do the benefits of this trend outweigh the drawbacks?
essay:
Currently, international trade has increased. Many primary needs that people require are imported from other countries. Even though this will make small local business bankrupt, its benefits like the availability of citizen's needs which are not found in their countries for eclipse any drawbacks.

There is a disadvantage because of the growth of global trade. This is because people are keen on to choose commodities from another countries which those are better and cheaper than local products. For example, most citizens now are using products that made in China, Thailand, also Canada, and those are available in every modern and traditional markets. As a result, people are able to buy that stuffs. So that, home-grown goods may be too hard and then it becomes lost in sales. There is no doubt that this can make a demerit to the small local business that have a job as a businessman would lose their store and afterwards continue to their livelihood.

On the other hand, there are so many benefits because of that things.  It is caused by various items enter into domestic trade. It is always available every time. For instance, too many rare luggage can be seen in supermarket such as China's garments, Thailand's vehicle, and Canada's cell phone. Therefore, it is very easy to select something that they want to purchase. It is evident that the increasing of global trade has made too many merits for everyone.

The aforementioned evidence reveals that importing of primary commodities will make small local business broke. But, I really believe that it also brings a lot of good points. For these problems, I would suggest to pick something wisely and keep to make home-grown items do not lose in market competition.

topic: In the future, more people will choose to go on holiday in their own country and not travel abroad on holiday. Ċ Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
In this competitive world, people hardly spend their time with their family member or with friends. Hence, whenever they get the time they would like to go on vacation with their loved ones. According to few researchers from the travel and tourism industry, there will be a drastic drop in the travelling pattern abroad and people will prefer visiting their own country instead. In my opinion, I completely disagree with the statement and I think this is not possible due to the reasons of cost of travelling and time taken to travel.

The trend of visiting other nations would not change for more few decades. First and foremost, human being needed some changes in their routine lifestyle to rejuvenate their body, mind and soul. More precisely, every individual needs some piece to relax their mind so that they can work again with full of energy. And this will happen only when they will go outside the country where there will be no colleagues or boss to disturb their routine. Secondly, nowadays in India visiting different states cost the same as travelling abroad. To elaborate further, if we look budgetary wise then one will spend equal amount in their own nation as well as the outside nation, this is due to cheaper flights to another part of the world than the own country. For example, in India, if people want to travel to Manali then they have to go by either flight or by train and if they choose the train option then it will cost cheaper but then they will have to spend 2 -3 days on the train. This can cause more fatigue.

Additionally, human is fond of exploring new things. For instance, it is a common habit of men and women to explore different places and understand their culture. Above all, even they will enjoy some unlike cuisines than daily food they eat. Another point is, apart from culture, mankind will enjoy mismatched weather and learn many things like how to cope up with the weather or what is the history of the place etc...

To conclude, it is undeniable fact that though due to covid 19 pandemic there are some restrictions on travelling; however, it will rise back to its glorious height. I believe that travellers or hikers will try to explore and discover some new destinations and will not be a focus on travel to their native places.

topic: Some people say History is one of the most important school subjects. Other people think that, in today's world, subjects like Science and Technology are more important than History. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
When it comes to children's education there are different opinions about what is more crucial to learn in school: History or Science? It is no doubt that both are important, but in my view learning about past experiences is more necessary.

Technology and science are two main hotspots in today's world, and no one can go on without them. In other words, people are in touch with technology on a daily basis, so they should learn about and know it thoroughly. In addition to this point, societies build their future base on, and with the help of the knowledge, they gain from the works of scientists. For example, I remember that my high school teacher always used to say "The future is in the hands of science". Hence, these topics are building blocks from here on.

On the other hand, human's culture and life have been built on history, so I think it is essential that we teach it to students. First of all, one can learn from the past and avoid some mistakes. Second of all, another thing we can learn from experience is how to solve some problems. For instance, authorities can learn how to solve hunger by reading about previous famine waves around the world, and how they got treated. Lastly, reading about ancient times can be fun, and additionally will teach children the value of what they have right now.

In conclusion, although teaching science and modern technology are important, I believe history classes have more benefits. It is because not only are these classes valuable in problem-solving, but also they are entertaining too.

topic: Individuals can do nothing to improve the environment; only Ċ governments and large company can make a difference. Ċ To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
There is a debate that people are incapacitated to sufficiently care for nature compared to the state and big companies. I totally agree with this statement for different reasons. This position is discussed further in the essay below.

First and foremost, while citizens are able to demonstrate or protest and engage in clean-up campaigns among other actions targeted at caring for the environment, their efforts are usually small-scale and isolated. For instance, despite so many efforts from the grassroots of India, the country's levels of pollution have tripled over the last two decades. This is because the main polluters, the state and private firms, which have big financial and political muscles, have yet to change their detrimental ways.

Secondly, entrepreneurial organisations and the government can use their financial and political clout to advance environmental protection and improvement. Respectively, they can do so by financing conservation and other projects and participating in the formulation of policies and laws that regulate environmental usage. For example, Bill Gates' company is heavily involved in funding anti-poaching campaigns in Africa and many governments of the world are regulating pollution through the 'polluter pays principle', a law unanimously accepted in several United Nations meetings that these countries attend. Their efforts are really significant.

In conclusion, therefore, I completely concur with the view that says states and big companies are in a better place to improve nature than individuals. This is because of the monetary and political power they possess compared to the latter. These and other issues were articulated in the essay above.

essay:

For example, presently people tend to travel or immigrate and occasionally social sites the only way for communication. Likewise, people can present their interests and other via filters can easier search friends for the interests. Consequently, how initially was planned social web has the positive side because still help people connect with each other.

topic: Successful sports professionals can earn a great deal of more money than people in other important professions. Some people think this is fully justified while others think it is unfair.  Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Thousands years ago, the Greece invented many playful games and gradually upgraded them to what we call sports nowadays. Players are free of charge at the beginning, but now when sports becoming a serious industry it has created many millionaires such as football, tennis, baseball sportsman and so on. Some people argue that it is completely wasteful when paying a fortune for playing persons. However, I have a bias towards the principal that who has contribution for the society they deserve to be paid off.

To be success in sport area, besides a nurture gift, those persons ought to practice really hard. Their job are as serious as other careers, therefore any discrimination on payment is unacceptable. Another point is that their success in sport does not only benefit themselves but also their nations' reputation if they achieve a world prize or championship. The money paid to sportsman for the honor they may bring for their countries is just a minor investment against billions dollar spending for wars or weapons.

However, some sportsmen have stuck their images with scandals, drugs, or even prostitutes. This is a phenomenon of overpaying for particular sport stars. Many owners of consuming manufacture really to pay millions dollar to get a famous athlete represent for their products which promises dramatic sale revenue. Easy earnings could lead to easy spending for luxury or even illegal things of a few of sportsmen.

To sum up, everything has two sides, but in this case I believe the downside is just a minor issue compared to greater benefits that sport professional people could contribute for society. For all above, they are worthy of a dream income.

topic: Nowadays, people are spending increasingly large amounts of money on their marriage parties. Many people feel large and expensive weddings cause problems for the bride and groom. Do you agree? Use personal examples in your response.
essay:
For many people having lavish birthday parties or weddings has become a social status symbol. In order to maintain their social image, people tend to spend more than what they intended to spend. In my opinion, although celebrating marriage parties or birthdays is justified, I believe big and expensive weddings create stress and cause problems for the bride and groom.

In today's world, social networking has become an integral part of everyone's life. Everybody, from young teenagers to retired old people are on social networking websites such as Facebook or Twitter. People are under a lot of pressure to maintain their social image and sometimes share fake posts about them so that they can maintain their image. Furthermore, people have big destination weddings to look good on social media, for which they pay large amounts of money and because of this ,they get a lot of pressure. For instance, my friend took a personal loan to have his marriage at a palace in Jaipur. He was quite tensed because of this expensive wedding.

Nevertheless, creating a budget before planning a wedding and not spending money on useless things might help the bride and groom to reduce the strain. In other words, one should plan the wedding according to their budget and not take any unnecessary loans in order to look good on social media. Additionally, spending more to impress people should be controlled. These small plannings can help people to minimize stress during their wedding. For example, I also had a small marriage reception in which only a handful of guests were invited and I was under no pressure during that time.

In conclusion, one should celebrate their wedding as it happens once a life. However, I believe spending large amounts of money does cause stress for the bride and groom.

topic: Some people choose to eat no meat or fish. Ċ They believe that this is not only better for their own health but also benefits the world as a whole. Ċ Discuss the view and give your own opinion.
essay:
Our habits influence our fitness and our planet more than we could ever imagine. Why should food choices make an exception? Nowadays, more and more people are changing their routines to follow a diet without fish and meat, claiming that this will help improve their well-being as well as the whole planet. In this essay, I will acknowledge this view and explain why I think this is an excellent decision.

Despite their accessibility, many of us prefer not to eat meat nor fish, merely for a matter of health. The reason behind this choice is the abundance of nutrients and vitamins contained in vegetables and fruits. To weigh on this topic, for instance, many dieticians advise eating foods rich in omega-three fatty acids like olives and avocados. In addition, several studies have shown that a plant-based diet confers many elements like zinc and magnesium. It is therefore not surprising that the most educated of us decide to switch our habits, turning to a plant-based alimentation.

Moreover, a valuable point making the case for vegan people is the will to protect the global environment. Using animals as a food source can, in fact, lead to the extinction of several species that are considered to be necessary for the ecosystem. Many scientists, for example, are currently advising to reduce the consumption of several species of animals to preserve the global environment. Furthermore, killing big animals could favour in turn the overgrowth of smaller infesting species like parasites, flies and pests, thus harming the vegetation of forests and leading, in the end, to serious damages on a larger scale. For these reasons, it seems of vital importance to avoid eating a great quantity of meat and fish to preserve the natural status quo.

In conclusion, many people nowadays are deciding to change their source of foods turning solely to fruits and vegetables. Despite looking a weird decision, this might reveal to be helpful both in terms of personal health and world preservation. In this essay, I explained why those who follow this path have actually a point and I definitely think this is the best choice for our planet and for our future as well.

topic: Some people think that universities should provide graduates with the knowledge and skills needed in the workplace. Others think that the true function of a university should be to give access to knowledge for its own sake, regardless of whether the course is useful to an employer. Ċ What, in your opinion, should be the main function of a university?
essay:
The university is an institution that transforms individuals into intellectuals, and equips them with skills that would be beneficial in the workplace. While some people support this view, others argue that institutions of higher learning should be more concerned with educating its students just for the sake of knowledge. This essay will discuss the main function of a university.

I believe that the most important duty of higher institutions is to provide basic knowledge and skills that will be needed in the workplace because these days most employers are in search of qualified employees. For example, in most countries, hospital boards are only interested in hiring doctors who have degrees in medicine and surgery, and this is because they are awarded by universities, who ensure that students cover the specific course content and clinical training required. Thus, producing professionals with exceptional clinical skills, who give excellent care to their patients. Therefore, it is necessary for students to gain enough experience within the university environment.

In addition, there is evidence to suggest that graduates who have a good grasp of what their job entails, make outstanding contributions in their place of employment, unlike their coworkers who are not qualified. Moreover, a good example of this can be seen in some private sector organizations in Nigeria, such as pearl group of companies, who has witnessed remarkable growth because of its overly qualified staff force.

To sum up, I strongly support that universities provide the necessary resources to its students, as it will be beneficial to them and their employers. Higher institutions should be encouraged to adequately prepare its students for the highly competitive job market.

topic: Some people think that criminals should be given longer terms in prison , so as to reduce the crime rate . To what extent do you agree or disagree
essay:
In this age and time when most governments around the world are thinking of de-criminalizing various crimes and ensuring that prison time is short but corrective, some people are suggesting the exact opposite. Various researches reveal, lengthier prison sentences does not lead to a reduction in crime. I agree with this view for the following reasons discussed below.

Long prison sentences harden criminals rather than correct them. A large study done in Ghana two years ago reveals to us that young prisoners who were handed maximum sentences for crimes committed ended up having careers as con-men. This is attributed to learning new tricks and getting bigger connections in prison. Some of them, who were dependent on one hard drug, had become dependent on several at exit. The converse was the case for those with shorter sentences, who were also afforded the opportunity of seeing counsellors and attending community service.

Giving lengthier prison sentences is not cost effective. The state wastes more funds when it hands out longer prison sentences to criminals. This is because a lot of money is spent in keeping them in prison. You have to secure the prison, pay the workers, feed them etc. However when released the state still as to spend money on security of its people because they go back to crime.

A lot of research has shown that it is better to hand out shorter sentences with compulsory counselling sessions.

Giving long sentences to criminals increases crime and makes the state insecure. It not cost-effective for the government or state, no wonder there is a drive the world over towards harm minimization.

topic: Countries are becoming more and more similar because people are able to buy the same products anywhere in the world. Ċ Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
essay:
Globalization is rapidly taking over our world as the internet evolves. The similarity among nation is even becoming increasingly accentuated since people are able to purchase the same goods from any part of the globe. This essay is going to support that it is a negative development by analysing the harmful impact globalization has on the different cultures across the world as well as on our environment.

The easy access to buy products from other parts of the world is destroying cultural unities and identities since people are replacing their traditional habits for new ones coming from economically dominant nations such as North Americans and Europeans. For example, a recent research shows that in my country people are listening more International songs than Brazilian ones and even the national songs have been added elements from North American music in order to be successful. As a result, the features of our traditional music are fading rapidly and it represents a treat to our culture.

Furthermore, the environment is another victim of globalization because consumers often buy online instead of buying from local businesses. By doing this, they leverage the number of shipments. For instance, last year the shipping industry was considered the third industry more polluting in the world due to its enormous release of carbon dioxide to our atmosphere. Thus, it contributes to the intensification of global warming, a major concern among societies around the planet.

In conclusion, it is clear that globalization represents a negative development to countries as it undermines cultures and depletes the environment. People should be aware of these facts in order to buy more consciously. Nowadays, we can vote for the future of our nations not only in the elections but also choosing what we purchase.

topic: Universities should accept equal numbers of male and female students in every Ċ subject.To what extent do you agree or disagUniversities should accept equal numbers of male and female students in every Ċ subject.To what extent do you agree or disagree?ree?
essay:
It is often argued that the proportion of women and men students should be equal while accepting candidates in the universities. I completely disagree with the statement and will provide further details to substance my disagreement in the course of the essay.

To commence with, if the educational institutions consider gender in order to provide admissions, they might disregard the merits of the candidates. Whereas this may be considered as an act of women empowerment, it indirectly impacts the future of deserving candidates. For instance, a boy who worked hard through his tertiary education to obtain admission to the top university might not be able to acquire a seat due to these limitations, as a result, he loses this opportunity despite being eligible based on merits.

In addition to this, equality in gender proportion neglects the differences in aptitudes of both males and females. It is undeniable that they have different aptitudes and are more inclined towards certain fields of learning. Women, for example, often opt for nursing, whereas males are more interested in engineering. Even if they have the same aptitudes, the gender arrangement might refrain them from obtaining the education they want to choose for themselves.

In conclusion, after a thorough analysis of the topic, although it might seem fair to provide equal opportunities among the population, it would be unwise to go through this due to the merits and differences in their interests. Therefore, I believe that this approach is illogical as it dilutes the quality of teaching by letting underserving pupils in and preventing capable students from reaching their goals.

topic: Governments make many rules to protect people from danger, for example, by making people wear seat belts in cars or not allowing smoking in public buildings. However, many people believe that there are too many rules nowadays. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement.
essay:
In recent years, the governments have made a wide range of regulations to protect the people from danger. I really agree that in the current era, there are too many rules than in the past, however it is important to note that the rules is made to the prosperity of the all people.

Some people consider that the roles made by government restrict their freedom. For instance, in the train, we must give the chair on the pregnant women or oldest people. The governments also make the rules for smoker and driver. The smokers cannot smoke in any place especially in public buildings and for driver; they must wear seat belts when they drive a car. These rules also are completed with the penalties, so people will get the penalties when they violate these rules. Therefore, for some people, it really limits their freedom. However, I believe that, these rules are made to create the prosperity of the all people.

The level of accident in the recent years has declined. According to the data from one of research published in Governance Journal of Hamburg University in 2015 showed that there were relations between the levels of discipline society on the rules with the level of accident. More and more people who obey the rules, then the level of accident will be getting smaller. It has proved that the rules of the government are effective to protect people from danger.

All in all, I agree that in recent years, the governments have made a wide range of rules; however I believe that those rules aim to create the prosperity of the all people.

topic: In the future all cars, buses and trucks will be driverless. The only people travelling inside these vehicles will be passengers. Ċ Do you think the advantages of driverless vehicles outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
It is predicted that in the future, all vehicles will become driverless wherein only the passengers will be riding. In this essay, I will be discussing both the benefits and drawbacks of using autonomous transportation. In my opinion, this type of advancement will be disadvantageous.

On the one hand, cars, buses, and trucks will become more spacious. They can accommodate more riders as compared to the current situation. For example, a public bus in the Philippines can currently sit approximately 50 people, without counting the driver and helper. Although, if the presence of the driver and helper are removed, additional spaces will be provided for use. Consequently, it will promote less traffic congestion because fewer buses are needed on the roads.

On the other hand, there are numerous adverse effects that this type of technology brings. Obviously, the hardworking drivers will be displaced. These professions, in a way, can become obsolete because eventually, machines will replace them. In addition, safety will become questionable. A self-driven car, for instance, can malfunction and put the lives of passengers in danger. Furthermore, artificial intelligence still does not have the capacity to function and think such as a human being. They cannot decide on what to do when placed in a dangerous situation.

In summary, vehicles will become driverless in the future where only passengers are the riders. This can benefit not only commuters but also the environment because of the added capacity. However, disadvantages can include some losing their jobs as well as people putting their lives at risk. I strongly believe that it poses more harmful effects than advantages because when using vehicles, safety should always be the priority.

topic: Small businesses are disappearing and being replaced by large multinational companies. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
In recent times, big corporations are replacing smaller business entities which are finding it harder to stay afloat. In my opinion, the prolific benefits of cheaper prices of products for consumers and diverse product choices that come with big companies do not overshadow the drawbacks of putting many small-scale organizations out of place and destabilizing the economy.

Admittedly, there are certain advantages to large multinational companies. Firstly, they have the ability to provide goods to consumers at the cheapest rates possible, owing to their business model. This for instance works well for the general masses as they can save as much money as possible. Secondly, as a global organization, they have the capacity to provide items from different international locations to local customers. Without such an arrangement, a person residing in India would never be able to try a Dragonfruit produced in another country.

Nevertheless, despite the above-mentioned advantages, I believe the happenings of having small businesses be replaced by large multinationals does more harm than good. One big reason for this is, it puts the people relying on the small-scale set-up into financial crisis. Every individual relying on it would be in trouble. An example of this is noted when a hypermarket opens up in any neighbourhood. It puts groceries, hardware stores, vegetables and fruit sellers and many more such establishments out of work. Furthermore, the operation model of such companies is structured in a way where the finances are concentrated towards the source of the company. This means that the majority of the profits earned from one locality would, in fact, go to the place where the enterprise originated from, thus, destabilizing the economy where the outlet is actually situated.

To sum up, regardless of the benefits of cheaper pricing and variety of items, in my opinion, these do not outweigh the dire consequences on personal lives and the overall finances of an area.

topic: some people think that secondary or high school student should be taught how to use money management as it is an important life skill. do you agree or disagree with the statement?
essay:
It can not be denied that the children should a have basic knowledge of financial management since it is one of the important skills to learn at the same time schools must teach them as soon as possible. I completely agree with this notion because knowing about cash from a young age have a huge impact on a child's life. The following paragraphs will discuss my stance along with some relevant examples.

To commence with, there are two key factors to substantiate my perspective about budgeting. Firstly, children have a great grasping ability so that if they have had a better idea about saving their pocket money and prioritize things what they need or not, then it would be their personality in future. As a result, perhaps they will think twice before wasting funds. For example, in most countries, parents have a habit of gifting their kids a piggy bank to increase their curiosity about savings.

Secondly, a simple cash calculation would help their brain to work more efficiently. Moreover, handling finance should have an equal concern as other subjects at school. Needless to say, to date, due to Globalisation, there have been certain trends that provokes numerous fluctuations in an economy. Consequently, if students already had an understanding of the economic world then it would be a great support for their further steps. For instance, finance and accounts students easily can enter into business kind of jobs.

To conclude, I would opine that every parent should maintain discipline while providing kids with pocket bills so that they should manage a particular amount of cash cleverly as this skill will help them have a better lifestyle.

This success story is not only for Hellen but also for people who broke the block inside his (hers).

To sum up, it is difficult to overcome from a good condition; therefore, we might brave to move forward for self actualization purposes.

topic: Many people like unhealthy food although they know it is bad for them. Why? What are the effective ways to improve people's eating habits?
essay:
In the modern world where convenience takes priority, more concerns are stemmed from people's consumerism of fast food. Even at the expense of health, people still opt for these unhealthy meals. This essay outlines some possible explanations for this phenomenon and gives out some ways to improve unwholesome eating practices.

To begin with, there are many factors lie that account for the general obsessive cravings. Scientific research has discovered that there is a high amount of sugar and saturated fat in these flavourful meals. For these elements, when we consume fast food, our brains generate chemicals stimulating a feeling of happiness and relaxation. Thus, constantly eating food is a way for our brain mechanism to seek pleasure. Moreover, these fat-laden food contains high calories counts so they provide lots of energy for a busy day. This convenience has led many people with hectic schedules to choose fast food as their favourite meal. Therefore, despite being harmful, fast food is sought after in every meal of the day.

In terms of being healthy, there are some feasible ways to have a salutary eating habit. The crucial thing is substituting high calories food with low energy but a big portion. In order to make this process less painful, people are recommended to find a dish that shares a similar taste . For example, salted nuts and grains can replace crunchy, tasty fried chicken or brown rice with vegetables and sauce can be more delectable than fried rice. In addition to food choices, busy workers are also encouraged to choose eateries providing organic and healthy meals over fast food joints. By strictly adhering to carefully choosing your food, there will be a great enhancement in one's health and invigorates.

To conclude, unhealthy food is undoubtedly palatable because of the aforementioned reasons. However, by changing daily food choices, people can still enjoy the appetizing of dishes while improving their health.

abstractive_summary: Despite the widespread appeal of unhealthy fast food—driven by its high sugar and fat content that trigger pleasure and provide quick energy—people can improve their health without sacrificing taste by making mindful dietary changes. However, healthier habits can be developed by choosing satisfying, lower-calorie alternatives with similar flavors, such as swapping fried items for nuts, grains, or brown rice with vegetables. topic: Some people believe that children's Leisure activities must be educational, otherwise they are a complete waste of time. Ċ Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Some think that the free time of children must be filled with educational activities, otherwise their time is wasted. I totally disagree with that statement as kids cannot constantly study and they need to release their energy in non-educational activities.

Firstly, any educational process requires mental and psyche efforts not allowing anyone to relax and recover. This means that instead of recharging, children are highly likely to become more exhausted and depressed. In addition, their performance may drop down until they burn out. A prime example would be Japan. Some school kids have psychological problems and issues with health due to the fact that the only thing they do is studying.

Secondly, a psychological state is closely bound to a physical state. Without an activity that helps in releasing the accumulated stress, it is almost impossible to stay healthy and be focused. Moreover, if children's leisure time had been filled with physical activities and sports, they would have been more productive and successful at studying. For instance, physiologists revealed that a group of students that do sports, at least, 3 times a week have, on average, higher results than those who lead a sedentary lifestyle.

In conclusion, I am against the idea that children's leisure activities must be educational as it is impossible to study all the time. Also, the accumulated stress must be released preferably with the help of sport. I would recommend parents to control their children's free time and limit the usage of mobile phones and desktops.

topic: Many people go to the university for academic study. More people should be encouraged to do vocational training because there is lack of qualified workers such as electricians and plumbers. To what extend do you agree or disagree
essay:
Nowadays, it is true that more and more people have chosen to pursue academic studies, instead of following vocational training courses. . Although some believe that studying in the university is the only way to be successful, I totally agree that the majority should still be encouraged to become a qualified electrician or plumber in the future.

There are a number of reasons why studying academic courses is not as important as people thinking. First, nowadays, employers have been placing more emphasis on solid experience than the knowledge in university. Therefore, in order to land high-paying jobs, students should study practical courses and work as part-time labourers like electricians, besides studying subjects in their school. Second, many people after graduating from college cannot make a living, or even do not have a job. By encouraging those people to participate in vocational courses, there would be less unemployed workers, which also means fewer crime cases.

There are also a variety of reasons why studying practical courses are of importance for the most people. In many countries, especially developed ones, there is a lack of workers like electricians who have the understandings and hands on experience in their field. For example, many large corporations would offer higher salaries for these qualified workers than ones who graduated from educational institutions, which would make students think twice after applying for higher education. In addition, most of the young people, especially in undeveloped nations, cannot afford to pursue their university. Working for a local company as a plumber, for instance, would be the better option and help them save a great deal of money.

In conclusion, there are several benefits for those who want to become qualified manual labours in the future. Depending on personal circumstances and preferences, everyone should choose the suitable career path of their own.

topic: Individuals can do nothing to improve the environment. Only large companies and business can make a difference To what extent do you agree or disagree
essay:
Big companies could improve environment rather than people because they have big impact on society. While they could take many steps which increase quality of environment. I would tend to argue against that everybody could make environment to be better.

It goes without saying that many big companies decide to make big change to improve environment. They prefer to use renewable energy which more friendly for environment. Moreover, they try to filter their waste carefully to ensure that it could not harm environment around the companies. Many business also use clean technology to manage their emission carefully. Their step suggest people to believe that individuals could not do anything to create better environment.

However, there are number of reasons why not only companies could improve environment but also citizens. First, saving environment is human's responsibility so everybody who lives in the world have to keep their habitat so people should find out many ways to save this. It is clear that companies have big steps to keep this planet but it is not mean that people could not do anything. Individuals could begin with small step like doing go green lifestyle. They could reduce, recycle and reuse their garbage before they throw away to final destination disposal. Second, improving environment could be done by creating social group or community which has good vision to control environment. For instance, social community of forest saver which has vision to elaborate on the challenges of combating harmful deforestation that increase dramatically lately.  In addition, people could corporate to clean their yard every weekend and giving sample to others to make people around them understand that environment is precious.

To sum up, it is evident that individuals could take a part to increase quality of environment. Society must do from simple step and believe that it has big impact.

topic: A person's worth nowadays seems to be judged according to social status and material possessions. Old-fashioned values, such as honour, kindness and trust, no longer seem important.  To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
essay:
A majority of people claim that the qualities such as honor, trust and kindness are not valuable anymore, as social status and possessions have become an identification of a person. While I admit that in some societies people are too materialistic, I would argue that the traditional values such sharing and honesty have even more impact on a personal worth.

One must note that brands like "Armani" or "Mercedes" have become status symbols for many people. As a result, people aspire to earn more money in order to keep a high status in their consumer societies. For that reason, men have started persuading the latest styles and fashion. In my town, for example, people are more judged according to their wealth rather than knowledge or any other quality. But the same case cannot be observed in all regions of my country.

Nevertheless, characteristics such as sharing, honor and kindness are still the paramount factors of getting social status. For example, a much respected person and the president of Uruguay Jose Mujica is described as "the poorest president of the world". Thanks to his qualities like sharing, honesty and kindness, he has got famous all over the world. In this sense, it is one very salient proof of the accuracy of my position.

In conclusion, I believe that the value of kindness outweighs any material possession and keeps being the most important achievement of everyone. From my point of view, every society is to choose gentle manners as a definer of social status.

topic: In some countries it is now illegal to smoke in public places. It is only fair that people who wish to smoke should have to leave the building. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Smoking has been forbidden legally in public areas such as gardens, restaurants, public transports, and hospitals in several parts of the world. I would agree that it is a right method to preserve passive smokers and young generation from harmful effects of cigarettes' smoke.

The essential reason why smoking in public places is illegal is preventing others' health from breathing smoke of cigarettes. It is because cigarettes' smokes consist of various danger substances such as nicotine, benzene, and tar which lead people getting serious medical problems such as heart attack and bronchitis. A survey in Paris showed that more than 600,000 passive smokers who breathe cigarettes' smokes intensively die every year.

Children are driven directly to unhealthy habit is an essential reason to forbid people smoke everywhere. Although the majority of adults in children's neighborhood show smoking as a part of their lifestyle, children can be protected carefully since there is a real law to restrict smokers' zone which teaches them that smoking is hapless activity. In my country, Indonesia, most of public areas such as shopping center and restaurants provide free smoke area, especially in children zone to protect their health and show them that serious disease will be occurred if they use it.

All in all, producing a law to restrict smokers' zone is very beneficial to reduce the chance for others becoming second-hand smokers and protect children' healthy lifestyle early since smokers are surrounded by the strict alarms which are legal to be convicted. Where, possible, some awful punishments should be taken into deliberation.

Public smoke-free zones, especially in child-frequented areas like shopping centers and restaurants in Indonesia, not only reduce health risks but also educate children about smoking’s dangers. Although smoking by adults in neighborhoods may normalize the habit, legal restrictions reinforce that smoking is harmful. Enforcing strict penalties can further ensure compliance and strengthen the impact of these public health measures.

topic: Some people say that advertising is extremely successful at persuading us to buy things. Other people think that advertising is so common that we no longer pay attention to it. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
The advancement of technology had a massive impact on growing the announcement industry. Many individuals think advertisements have a tremendous influence on people to purchase a particular product, while others believe that advertisements are not popular because people find them repetitive. This essay will discuss both opinions and clarify why advertisements are still beneficial despite being so common.

On the one hand, the commercial could still influence people because of two major reasons. First and foremost, nowadays, advertisements are produced on various kinds of platforms, which could aim for a broader range of populations. In other words, propaganda is not limited to radio and TV anymore, and in result, different age groups could be targeted in various kinds of media. Take social media as an example in which young people can be attracted to a publication. A further widely-observed cause may be due to the fact that companies are making ads in much more attractive forms. This is to say, they use numerous kinds of graphical content and even catchy music in their ads. Therefore, the more they make a commercially attractive, the more they can be successful at persuading people to buy.

On the other hand, some advertisements are considered boring and tedious for people in terms of being repetitive and similar to each other. To clarify, a similar repetition of a publication not only would not attract individuals, but would also make people annoyed, leading to a lack of attention to the commercial.

In conclusion, although there might be several repetitive and tedious advertisements to which people would not pay attention, I firmly believe that most parts of the display industry are absolutely successful at luring people to buy their products by using different platforms and technology.

topic: Some people say that it is possible for a country to be both economically successful and have a clean environment. Others disagree. Discuss both views and give your opinion. environmental regulations and economy
essay:
The 21st century is characterized by a burgeoning development of the global economy. Conscious of this propensity, sustainable development has been a topic of concern in the most contentious debates. While some people believe that the desire to develop an economy without any adverse effects on the environment is unfeasible, I believe it is achievable.

On the one hand, the economic growth will incontrovertibly exert a deleterious effect on the environment. To make way for the erection of factories and companies, deforestation will come at the expanse. Consequently, the world will encounter soil erosion, global warming and ecological imbalance, resulting in the loss of natural habitats of exotic species. Furthermore, it is an unpalatable fact that the establishment of multinational corporate behemoths has a serious repercussion on the environment. Specifically, these organizations discharge a great deal of pollutants into the atmosphere and utilise a multitude of resources during manufacturing activities, engendering an increase in carbon dioxide emissions and the depletion of natural resources.

On the other hand, boosting the economy will pose no threats to the environment if we take control of economic activities. Many companies are oblivious to the necessity of cutting down emissions released from industrial operation. Only when a cooperation is aware of using renewable energy such as solar power and wind power can it cover the escalating need of energy and reduce carbon footprints. Furthermore, we can invest money into the upgradation of waste treatment system to extenuate the amount of contamination released into the environment. This system enables people to classify and recycle non-biodegradable materials such as plastic and nylon.

In conclusion, although interwining economic growth with environmental protection seems to be a challenging task, an economy can reap auspicious results and achieve its sustainablity by adhering to environmental regulations and adopt aforementioned environmentally friendly policies during its manufacturing process.

topic: Some people believe that teaching children at home is best for a child's development while others think that it is important for children to go to school. Ċ Discuss the advantages of both methods and give your own opinion.
essay:
Children's education is mandatory whether it's through institutions or at home. Many people think that teaching children at their residency is better for their improvement while opponents argue that kids should attend schools and I'm one of the believers. We will discuss further and review the benefits of both the methods of this topic.

Firstly, studying at home - children's safety is a huge concern for their parents. Due to that many moms and dads prefer to improve their intelligence by educating them at their place. Through this method, they can monitor their offsprings' activity every day and find out about their area of interest; also this develops to create a strong bonding between them. For instance, when a child goes to school, mother or father always rely on their teachers' feedback and often, parents are determined to focus on security, such as the play arena, tools, behaviours of other fellows. Furthermore, in many cases, staffs' behaviours, rather than knowledge progression of the kid, thus makes them insecure.

Secondly, studying at school - although the homeschooling system has some notable benefits, even though, it will not assist their offsprings' further study. At a certain point, every child should face the reality of campus life. A child who goes to school at a young age has a number of opportunities to improve their curiosities also interacting with outsiders improve self-confidence . For example, If the kids attend the classes regularly, this will allow them to share their knowledge with other students as well as gain updates from others pupils. In addition, they will get many opportunities to exhibit their finding in front of the audience. Therefore, they will be prepared for further education with complete confidence.

To conclude, in my opinion, kids should attend official classes outside of their residence in order to gain versatile knowledge experience, through this method they will gain confidence, and easily collaborate with class fellows, which will create a bright path .

topic: longer prison sentences VS CRIME RATE Topic: Some people think that the best way to reduce crime is to give longer prison sentences. Others, however, believe there are better alternative ways of reducing crime. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
It is true that prolonging prison sentences is considered as the best method of lowering crime rate. However, some individuals think that there are other potential alternatives to longer sentence periods. This essay will discuss both views and state my own position.

On the one hand, longer prison sentences would serve as a deterrent for future offenders. There is no doubt that this solution would disseminate a fear of losing freedom among citizens, which obviously forces people to abandon their malevolence. Moreover, by imposing longer sentences on perpetrators, governments could give them more time to deeply reflect on their false preconceptions. For example, several criminals, who had not received formal education before, had been converted into model citizens after spending time in jail contemplating their crimes.

On the other hand, there are other optimal solutions for this problem such as enhancing living conditions of the poor. It is undeniable that people tend to break the law when their basic needs are not satisfied so this method would significantly reduce the conviction rate. Another promising approach to the problem would be to concentrate on improving the quality of rehabilitation and reintegration process of inmates. In this way, authorities would not only promote humanity but also convert the perpetrators to decent civilians. For instance, Scandinavia has the world's lowest recidivism rate thanks to the implement of such methods.

In conclusion, although certain merits of prolonging prison sentences could partially reduce the crime rate, I am convinced by the other aforementioned solutions because of their humanitarian traits. (254 words)

topic: It is no longer necessary to use animals for food, clothing or medical research. Ċ To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
In the modern world, the general public argues that taking advantage of animals to meet human being's demands such as food, clothing or medical purposes. Personally, I keep my opposite perspective that we still depend on aminal resources for our daily activities. I will give my explanation below.

Firstly, it is an undeniable fact that biological advancement fosters a huge change to establish the world without animal products. For example, a famous project carried on by the Dutch company in 2013 successfully found a useful method to produce cultured meat from various stages in the laboratory. The food industry, as well as the clothing and medical aspect, is changing toward a positive trend, however, it just stabilizes at limited research and potential products. Thus, people must accept the reality that our life absolutely is affected negatively when halting completely the use of animals in state of the art society.

Another plausible explanation is that the high-end price of ''green products'' make our community be hesitant to access that kind of product. Some research has claimed that the laboratory expenses including delicate methods and artificial chemicals for making special medicines far outweigh that of resources made from animals. Therefore, the economic benefit is a barrier to reach our environmental purposes.Undeniably, achieving this goal is merely impossible at the moment, although we have a profound belief that with the advocation of the worldwide people and the huge effects from true philanthropists, humanity will change the way we satisfy our needs.

In conclusion, I once again reaffirm my point of view that the opportunity to make a big substitute is out of reach at the present. However, it is definitely a possible achievement in the foreseeable future.

abstractive_summary: Human dependence on animal resources remains essential for daily life, despite advances in biological technology enabling alternatives like lab-grown meat, first demonstrated by a Dutch company in 2013. While industries are gradually shifting away from animal use, current alternatives are largely confined to early research and lack the capacity to fully replace animal-based products. Although green alternatives exist, their high production costs—especially in medicine—make widespread adoption economically challenging, and a complete transition away from animals is not yet feasible. Nonetheless, with continued global advocacy and support from philanthropists, a future where animal use is fully substituted remains a plausible long-term possibility.

pro_keypoints: Advances in technology provide viable alternatives to animal use in food and clothing production.
Synthetic and plant-based materials can effectively replace animal-derived products in most applications.
Medical research can utilize advanced computational models and human tissue cultures instead of animals.
Animal-free methods often reduce ethical concerns and improve reproducibility in scientific studies.
Sustainable and scalable non-animal solutions are increasingly accessible worldwide.
con_keypoints: Animal models remain critical for understanding complex biological systems and diseases.
Current alternatives cannot fully replicate the functions of live animal testing in medical research.
Cultural and economic dependencies on animal-based industries limit immediate replacement.
Natural animal-derived materials possess unique properties difficult to duplicate synthetically.
Widespread transition to non-animal methods requires significant time and infrastructure investment.
